title: Director, Product Management (PrintOps)
description:
Director, Product Management (PrintOps)
Pharos | US Remote

Here's what you'd actually be stepping into: an established product, two new markets it hasn't reached yet, and no one left who can tell you why it behaves the way it does. Some people need that explanation handed to them. Others go dig it up themselves. This role is for the second kind.

About Pharos

Pharos Systems International is the leader in PrintOps, the integrated, user-centric, and cloud-native approach to managing printing and the infrastructure and operations behind it. Pharos' modern print management software empowers enterprises to reduce costs, strengthen security, and support today's hybrid workforce with simple, reliable, and scalable printing solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including many of the world's largest Fortune 500 companies, Pharos has helped eliminate print servers, cut millions in print-related spend, and accelerate the transition to cloud-based infrastructure. Headquartered in Rochester, NY, Pharos has been delivering innovative print management solutions and measurable ROI since 1992.

Our flagship product already runs inside a large, established customer base, which means it carries real history, real workarounds, and a level of hidden complexity that isn't written down anywhere. We're also pushing it into new markets it hasn't served before, without losing the trust of the customers who already rely on it every day. That combination, protecting what works while extending what's possible, is exactly why this role exists.

What This Role Is

This role owns the full product loop for one of Pharos's most established product areas: understanding how it actually works today, bringing its capabilities under control, deciding what to build and what to explicitly leave alone, and making sure Engineering and the rest of the company are working from the same understanding you are.

You'll work directly with enterprise customers, including the conversations where the answer is no, and you'll set direction across customer commitments, technical constraints, and two new markets at once, without letting the loudest voice in the room decide the roadmap for you.

You'll also use AI as a normal part of how you work: discovery, synthesis, competitive research, epic drafting, documentation, not as a novelty, but as how the work actually gets done, in a fast loop with Engineering that doesn't wait on oversized specs.

What You Will Own

  • The model of how this product actually works, and keeping it current as you learn more.
  • A visible roadmap where every item has a reason, an owner, and a real answer for what Pharos is and isn't doing.
  • The path from a raw signal (a support ticket, a sales request, a customer complaint) to a decision someone can act on.
  • Direct conversations with enterprise customers, including the ones where the answer is no.
  • The translation of product direction into work Engineering can actually build and verify against.
  • Making sure Sales, Support, Customer Success, Services, and Marketing know what changed and why, not just that it changed.

What a Strong Background Looks Like

  • You've owned a mature, complicated product, one with real history, real workarounds, and a real customer base, not just a green-field build.
  • You've sat across the table from enterprise customers directly: discovery calls, pilots, advisory relationships, the uncomfortable ones included.
  • You've turned a messy customer or market need into something Engineering could actually build against, and stuck around to see what happened after.
  • You've made a complex product simpler, more consistent, or easier to reason about, not just added more to it.
  • You reach for AI as a normal part of how you think through a problem, not as a novelty.
Not a good fit if…Strong fit if…
You're looking to build and lead a team starting now.
You've only ever built new products from a blank sheet, and haven't lived inside a mature, tangled one.		You dig until you actually understand a confusing system before you trust your own call on it.
You're also comfortable making the next decision before that understanding is complete.

What We Offer

  • Compensation: $145,000 - $150,000 base salary + Bonus
  • Location: US Remote. You must live in, and be eligible to work in, the United States.
  • Medical and dental coverage, 401(k), flexible hours, and PTO
  • Recognized as a Great Benefits employer by Mployer
  • Named a Top Place to Work by USA Today

If this sounds like the shape of work you're already good at, we'd like to hear from you.
Equal Opportunity Employer: Pharos is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local laws. www.pharos.com

title: Python Developer - Market Risk & Data Management
description:
Python Developer - Market Risk & Data Management

Location: Warsaw

Contract Type: 6 Months

Job Type: Hybrid

  • Apply yourexpertiseacross Python, SQL,C#and big data technologies

Company Overview

Our client is an established financial servicesorganisationoperatingacross Poland. Theyspecialisein market risk management and trading systems, supporting critical business operations through robust technology solutions. The companymaintainsa strong focus on data quality and regulatory compliance, working with large-scale data platforms and advanced calculation engines. Their technology teams work on high-impact projects that directly support trading desks and risk functions.

They are seeking an experienced Python Developer to join their market risk technology team in Warsaw on a contract basis. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex risk calculations and data management frameworks that support critical trading and risk operations.

You will work on ACE calculations for HPL (Hypothetical P&L), RTPL (Real-Time P&L) andHVaR(Historical Value at Risk), alongside building Python-based data sourcing,qualityand filling frameworks. This position contributes directly to the accuracy and reliability of risk reporting systems used across the tradingorganisation.

  • Implement data quality checks and data filling logic

  • Write andoptimiseSQL queries for data extraction and validation
  • Collaborate with risk managers to understand calculation requirements
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data and calculation issues
  • Document technical solutions andmaintaincode standards

Requirements

  • 6-8 years of experience in software development
  • Strong Python programming skills with experience in data processing
  • Proficiencyin Oracle SQL for data manipulation and querying
  • Knowledge of market risk management concepts and calculations
  • Experience with big data technologies, particularlyMapRor Hadoop ecosystem
  • Familiarity with C# 5.0 or similar object-oriented languages
  • Understanding of DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with large-scale data platforms
  • Ability to work independently and manage technical deliverables
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communicationskills in English

Benefits

  • Competitive contract day rate
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact market risk systems
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale data platforms and technologies
  • Collaboration with experienced risk and technology professionals
  • Flexible working arrangements

You’llwork within a professional environment alongside specialists in risk management, quantitativeanalysisand technology. The team values technical excellence,collaborationand continuous improvement, providing opportunities to develop your skills across market risk and data engineering.

title: Billing & Guest Services Specialist

- type 45 + wpm.

- provide excellent customer service.

- escort visitors to locations throughout the company

- think analytically and be a problem solver and resolve conflict.

- communicate effectively, both in writing and in speaking, with customers, co-workers, and various business contacts in a courteous and professional manner.

- work completely and accurately under time constraints and deadlines.

- work in a fast pace environment and prioritize multiple work assignments.

Education and Experience:

Any combination equivalent to the following education and experience that would provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities would qualify. A typical way to obtain the knowledge, skills and abilities would be: High School diploma or equivalent; Outlook proficiency, general office experience.

Any noted minimum or maximum years of experience should not be construed as a requirement for consideration; this information is meant to be used as a suggested guideline.

title: Senior .NET Backend Engineer
description:
The Company:

Since 2002, the client has been a market leader in automotive claims management, processing over 18 million vehicle claims annually with a global team of more than 1,000 employees. Operating in over 30 countries, the company specializes in digital solutions that optimize vehicle damage processing for insurance companies, car dealerships, repair shops, leasing firms, and automotive manufacturers. By leveraging automation, advanced technologies, and industry expertise, the client continuously enhances efficiency and accuracy in claims handling.

Your Role:

As a Backend .NET Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations within a distributed, microservices-based environment. You will work primarily with C#/.NET, backend APIs, databases, messaging systems, and cloud technologies. As part of an agile engineering team, you will contribute to technical and architectural decisions, ensure high code quality, and continuously improve the reliability and performance of backend services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using C#/.NET.
  • Build scalable solutions based on microservices architecture.
  • Develop and integrate backend modules and services within complex distributed systems.
  • Design and maintain integrations between internal and external systems.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including SQL Server and MongoDB.
  • Implement asynchronous processing and messaging using RabbitMQ and Hangfire.
  • Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-tested code following SOLID principles and engineering best practices.
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices where applicable.
  • Troubleshoot backend issues and contribute to improvements in system reliability and performance.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and support automated build, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Work with containerized and cloud-based environments, including the strategic migration to AWS or Azure.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other team members to achieve sprint goals.
  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Estimate development tasks and contribute to realistic sprint planning.
  • Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Tech Stack & Tools:

  • Backend: C#, .NET 6, .NET 8, with some legacy .NET 4.5 components
  • Architecture: Microservices, distributed backend services
  • Databases & Storage: SQL Server, MongoDB, AWS S3
  • Messaging & Async Processing: RabbitMQ, Hangfire
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS / Azure, VMware Tanzu, hybrid environments
  • Containerization: Kubernetes
  • CI/CD: GitLab
  • Monitoring & Observability: ELK Stack, Grafana, Sentry
  • Testing: Unit testing, integration testing, TDD

What We Expect from You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of commercial backend development experience with C#/.NET.
  • Strong knowledge of the Microsoft development stack, particularly C#/.NET and SQL Server.
  • Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Experience working with microservices or distributed systems.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, including SOLID, clean code, and maintainable architecture.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Experience working with relational databases; knowledge of NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Understanding of messaging and asynchronous processing concepts.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD processes.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native development is preferred.
  • AWS or Azure experience is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Proactive, self-organized approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an agile engineering team.
  • Willingness to contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English or German

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

As a Lead Full-stack Engineer, you will develop and maintain features across the entire stack for our Client, a European public sector organisation, from user interfaces and consumed APIs through to server-side business logic and database interactions. You will take technical ownership of the solutions you deliver — their scalability, performance, security, and documentation — and act as the connection point between front-end and back-end work so that all system components integrate cohesively.

Knowledge of REST API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC practices, Agile/Scrum, DevOps methodologies, ITIL, and of EU institutional environments and public administration processes is considered an asset
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written, corresponding to Level B2 or higher (CEFR)

title: Projektipäällikkö Sähköasematiimiin

Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään projektinhallinnan, teknisen osaamisen ja asiakasyhteistyön. Saat vastuullesi monipuolisia projekteja, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan kokonaisuuksiin, kehittämään ratkaisuja yhdessä asiantuntevan suunnittelutiimin kanssa ja rakentamaan pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita.



Mitä tehtävä pitää sisällään?

Projektipäällikkönä vastaat itsenäisesti sähköasemasuunnitteluprojektien kokonaisvaltaisesta läpiviennistä aina suunnittelun käynnistämisestä projektin onnistuneeseen toteutukseen. Olet keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että projektit etenevät laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja sovittujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

Millainen osaaja menestyy tehtävässä?

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä projektipäällikköä, joka ottaa vastuuta, pitää kokonaisuudet hallinnassa ja nauttii yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Tehtävässä menestyäksesi sinulla on:

Arvostamme kykyä yhdistää tekninen ymmärrys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja sujuva yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien kanssa.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Meillä pääset työskentelemään sähköverkon kehityksen kannalta merkityksellisten projektien parissa ja osaksi osaavaa, kannustavaa työyhteisöä. Haluamme tarjota sinulle puitteet, joissa voit hyödyntää osaamistasi, kehittyä ammattilaisena ja rakentaa omaa urapolkuasi.

Kiinnostuitko?

title: Senior Finance Administrator – Cash Management - 12 Month FTC
description:
About Law Debenture

Law Debenture is an Investment Trust supported by a wholly owned professional services business. LawDeb is an unusual and exciting proposition; on a day–to-day basis we are nimble, ambitious and small enough to know everyone by name, whilst also benefiting from the profile and credibility of a listed business. This is thanks to our 137-year-old FTSE250 investment trust and our fast-growing independent professional services business of over 300 colleagues across 6 business lines.


At LawDeb, doing work that has a positive impact is important to us. We need the very best people to be the custodians of our business for the next stage of our proud history and growth. We’re ambitious to innovate, collaborate and push forward in providing peace of mind and excellence for our clients and each other.


We’re on a journey to shape a culture we’re all proud to be part of. One where everyone feels trusted, supported and empowered to own their success. Working at LawDeb, you will have access to our enviable network of clients and innovative projects, as well as brilliant colleagues to learn from and collaborate with.


Role Overview

This is a 12-month FTC role and is part of the Cash Management Dept, reporting into the Finance Shared Service Manager. This is a pivotal role, working closely with the Finance Team based in London, Accounts Payable and Credit Control on the cashbook and collections processes.



Job Role & Responsibilities

  • Update cashbooks daily and apply all cash inbound and outbound in SAGE Intacct.
  • Set-up the weekly banking payments as directed by the Accountant: Accounts Payable, London Finance Team
  • Review and action any daily banking requirements such a FX deals and transfers
  • Daily reporting on balances cross all bank accounts
  • Action any exceptional manual payment requests ensuring these are approved in line with LawDeb DOA
  • Any queries which require investigation should be escalated to the appropriate Management team.
  • Daily NAV (Net Asset Value) preparation for the investment portfolio
  • Ensuring that postings to the suspense account are minimised and collaborate with wider Finance team to ensure resolved within SLA
  • Ad hoc Finance tasks as required by the Group Accountant, Technical Accountant and the Management Accountant.
  • Ensure internal controls are operating and monitored
  • Preparation of management information and KPIs
  • Review and maintain procedure documentation for the team to ensure ongoing effectiveness and accuracy
  • Support and adhere to audit requests as instructed by Shared Service Director
  • Review and implement process improvements as and when required
  • Contribute to the development of the Finance team processes to ensure these are cohesive, efficient and effective.
  • Undertake training and development as appropriate and engage fully in the performance management process.
  • Contribute to the Law Deb culture positively, attend meetings as required, and carry out duties willingly and diligently
  • Where regulatory rules apply, abide by these in spirit and fact


Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Experience working within a Finance, Cash Management, Treasury, Banking or Shared Services environment.
  • Experience of online banking administration, including payment preparation, bank transfers and general banking activities.
  • Experience of maintaining cashbooks, processing cash receipts and completing accurate financial records.
  • Good understanding of financial controls and the importance of compliance, accuracy and appropriate authorisation.

title: Plumbing Apprentice
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Plumbing Apprentice
Department: Construction
Reports To: Supervisor
Employment Type: Apprenticeship (Full-Time)

Summary/Objective:

The Plumber Apprentice position is a full-time, paid opportunity for individuals to gain skills in plumbing installation, maintenance, and repair. Apprentices will receive hands-on, on-the-job training in plumbing systems, piping, fixtures, welding, and related equipment, supplemented by related classroom instruction through GCA Trades Academy. The Plumber Apprentice role involves assisting with the installation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of plumbing and piping systems across various project sites. This position places a strong emphasis on following safety requirements, reading blueprints and specifications, using hand and power tools, and working effectively as part of a team.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Install plumbing and piping systems – Install underground storm, sanitary, water, and other piping systems.

Assemble pipes and fittings – Assemble tubing, fittings, couplings, clamps, and other components using appropriate materials and tools.

Install plumbing fixtures and equipment – Install pipes, valves, appliances, water heaters, sinks, toilets, and similar fixtures.

Install and secure pipe supports – Anchor and attach pipes to walls, ceilings, structures, and fixtures using brackets, clamps, hangers, and supports.

Cut, thread, bend, and prepare pipes – Prepare pipes to specifications using saws, cutting tools, pipe threaders, and pipe benders.

Weld and fabricate piping components – Weld metal components and perform specialized welding or fabrication of piping systems.

Measure and lay out plumbing work – Measure, mark, and determine the locations of pipes, connections, fixtures, and openings using levels and other measuring tools.

Read blueprints and specifications – Review drawings, building codes, and specifications to determine installation and repair requirements.

Plan plumbing installations and repairs – Plan the layout and sequence of plumbing installation, construction, or repair work.

Inspect and test plumbing systems – Conduct pressure, hydrostatic, water, or air tests to identify leaks and verify system performance.

Maintain and repair plumbing systems – Repair or replace damaged components, washers, pipes, fittings, and other plumbing parts and clear clogged drains.

Operate and maintain plumbing equipment – Modify, clean, maintain, and operate pipe systems, equipment, fittings, and related machinery using hand and power tools.

Inspect work areas for safety and repair needs – Identify obstructions, structural issues, environmental conditions, and potential safety hazards before and during work.

Install water- and energy-efficient systems – Install green plumbing equipment and fixtures such as flow restrictors, dual-flush toilets, pressure-assisted toilets, and tankless water heaters.

Document work and coordinate personnel – Maintain work-assignment records and assist/direct helpers involved in pipe cutting, preassembly, and plumbing installation.

Qualification, Competencies and Requirements

  • WORK ELIGIBILITY: Must be a U.S. citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • AGE: Must be at least 18 years of age or older.
  • RESIDENCY: Must have resided in Guam for a minimum of three (3) consecutive years prior to entry into the program. A Mayor’s Verification of Residency is required upon hire.
  • COMMITMENT: Must be able to attend a minimum of two (2) classes per week, as specified by the apprenticeship program standards, while maintaining a full-time (40-hour) work schedule with PFM.

Benefits & Growth Opportunities:

  • Paid on-the-job training with experienced HVAC professionals.
  • Opportunity to earn industry-recognized certifications.
  • Career advancement opportunities within PFM.
  • Competitive pay with potential for wage increases as apprenticeship program milestones are achieved.

Work Environment

  • Work outside in various conditions including heat, humidity, rain, dust, noise and cold
  • Must be able to lift 20-30 pounds at times
  • Must be willing to work between multiple worksites

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, hourly position. Hours of Operation are Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. However, due to operational needs, may be required to work before or after normal hours of operations, on weekends or holidays.

Travel

No travel is expected for this position.

As per Executive Order 11246 Section 503, & VEVRAA: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Python Developer
description:
Cześć, nazywamy się Bee Talents i od 2015 roku zajmujemy się budowaniem zespołów w branży IT i nie tylko na całym świecie. Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla Bnewable.

Bnewable to niezależna belgijska firma energetyczna, specjalizująca się w magazynowaniu energii i zarządzaniu energią. Dzięki inteligentnemu sterowaniu bateriami w lokalizacji klienta obniżają koszty energii i pomagają firmom przechodzić na zieloną energię na coraz bardziej zmiennym rynku elektrycznym. W tym celu zgromadzili całą niezbędną wiedzę we własnych strukturach.

Firmę tworzą doświadczeni przedsiębiorcy, menedżerowie i specjaliści z rozległą ekspertyzą, także w dziedzinie energii odnawialnej. Zdobywali swoje doświadczenie m.in. w takich firmach jak Elia, Eneco, Engie, Enspired, EVBox, Luminus, REstore/Centrica oraz Scatec. Ich misją jest wspieranie firm w procesie transformacji energetycznej. Inwestują w zrównoważone i zdecentralizowane systemy energetyczne, rozwijają je i zarządzają nimi - pomagając klientom osiągać cele związane ze zrównoważonym rozwojem, przy jednoczesnym upraszczaniu złożoności produkcji energii, magazynowania i zarządzania aktywami.

O produkcie

na co dzienny m. in. tworzą platformę Voltana, która służy do zarządzania energią i jest oparta na AI, optymalizując stacjonarne systemy magazynowania energii w bateriach dla dużych klientów komercyjnych i przemysłowych w Belgii i Niemczech.

W Bnewable cenią podejmowanie wyzwań, ducha przedsiębiorczości i orientację na wyniki, ciekawość, odpowiedzialność i kooperację. A dziś do tej współpracy w ramach zespołu Virtual Power Plant (10 osób, a w tym 6 Python Developerów, 1 React Developer, 1 DevOps, 2 Technical PO + zarządzający nimi CTO) chcą zaprosić osobę na stanowisko Backend Python Engineera z min. 4 latami doświadczenia po stronie backendu.

Masz okazję zostać częścią teamu łączącego doskonałość techniczną z realnym wpływem na świat - tworząc cyfrowy kręgosłup zrównoważonych systemów energetycznych przyszłości.

Warunki współpracy

Rodzaj umowy: B2B, 30-40 EUR/h

Wymiar pracy: min. 160h w miesiącu

Tryb pracy: hybryda z 3 dniami w tygodniu w biurze

Lokalizacja biura: Concordia Design Wrocław I Centrum Konferencyjno - Eventowe | Biuro coworkingowe, Wyspa Słodowa 7, 50-266, Wrocław, Polska

Główne wyzwanie

Nowa osoba na roli Backend Engineer będzie odpowiedzialna za projektowanie, niezawodność, wydajność i rozwój systemów backendowych zasilających platformę Voltana do zarządzania energią. Rola ta zapewnia, że usługi backendowe spełniają wymagania funkcjonalne i niefunkcjonalne, działają niezawodnie w środowisku produkcyjnym oraz stale się poprawiają pod względem skalowalności i efektywności w miarę rozwoju platformy.

Osoba, która dołączy do zespołu, będzie rozbudowywać systemy backendowe tak, aby gwarantowały solidność, łatwość w utrzymaniu i były dostosowane do rzeczywistych obciążeń energetycznych - aktywnie przyczyniając się jednocześnie do długoterminowej skalowalności architektury i kondycji platformy.

Codzienne zadania na tym stanowisku

  • Projektowanie, budowanie i utrzymywanie usług backendowych, API oraz modeli danych wspierających kluczowe funkcjonalności produktu energetycznego.
  • Definiowanie i utrzymywanie infrastruktury na poziomie aplikacji - w tym baz danych, kolejek komunikatów, cache'ów i usług pomocniczych - we współpracy z inżynierami cloud.
  • Aktywny udział w kształtowaniu architektury systemów i aplikacji, zapewniając ich długoterminową skalowalność, utrzymywalność i niezawodność.
  • Stosowanie najlepszych praktyk inżynierskich, w tym efektywne wykorzystanie narzędzi AI wspomagających development, w celu poprawy jakości i efektywności pracy.

Co będzie Ci potrzebne

  • Doświadczenie: 4+ lata w inżynierii oprogramowania na back-endzie z wykorzystaniem Pythona, relacyjnych (RDBMS) i/lub nierelacyjnych (NoSQL) baz danych oraz implementacji algorytmów.
  • Znajomość chmury: Praktyczne doświadczenie z chmurą (Bnewable używa GCP).
  • Rozwiązywanie problemów: Udokumentowana umiejętność diagnozowania i debugowania złożonych problemów systemowych i kodowych.

Nice to haves: praktyczne doświadczenie w AI/ML (w tym Claude Code, OpenAI, RAG, ale nie tylko) oraz znajomość branży energetycznej, bazy danych PostgreSQL i chmury Google Cloud Platform.

Co dostaniesz w zamian

  • Kwota z przedziału 30-40 EUR/h na umowie B2B.
  • Elastyczny model hybrydowy dopasowany do Twojego stylu życia (3 dni w biurze, 2 dni w domu).
  • W pełni wyposażona wspólna przestrzeń biurowa w zielonym sercu Wrocławia (Wyspa Słodowa, Centrum konferencyjne Concordia) oraz osobny pokój skupienia dla 3 osób z zespołu wrocławskiego.
  • Sprzęt do pracy wraz z dodatkowymi monitorami.
  • Wyjazdy do naszej siedziby głównej w Belgii (2-3x po 3-5 dni w roku, połączone z wspólną pracą oraz integracją po pracy).
  • Duża swoboda działania, poczucie własności i realny wpływ na produkt (każdy wybiera zadania sam, można je realizować samodzielnie lub we współpracy z 1-2 osobami).
  • Praca z najnowszym stosem technologicznym, tematyką i narzędziami - Python, AI, Algorytmy, Github, GCP, DevOps, Big Data (1 bateria wysyła informacje co 1 sekundę).
  • Współpracę w międzynarodowym (m. in. z Belgii, Holandii, Niemiec, Polski, Hiszpanii i Rumunii) zespole specjalizującym się w branży energetycznej!

title: Client Executive – Data & AI Consulting | Brisbane
description:
Build trusted relationships. Shape meaningful opportunities. Help grow what’s next for Altis in Queensland.

We’re looking for a Client Executive who can combine commercial thinking, consulting expertise, and strong relationships to help clients turn complex data and technology challenges into meaningful business outcomes.

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys being close to the market, building relationships, understanding what matters to clients, shaping the right solutions and creating opportunities that lead to high-quality, purpose-driven work.


You’ll play an important role in growing Altis presence across Brisbane and Queensland, working closely with clients, delivery teams and technology partners while helping shape our broader market proposition.

If you’re looking for a role where you can influence growth without stepping away from consulting, client outcomes and the people delivering the work, this could be a great next move.

What you’ll do

You’ll work across client engagement, solution shaping, business development and consulting leadership, helping connect market opportunity with strong delivery.

You’ll:

  • Build and deepen trusted relationships with senior clients across the Brisbane market
  • Identify new opportunities and develop a healthy, sustainable pipeline of Data & AI work
  • Work with clients to understand their business challenges, priorities and future needs
  • Shape Data & Analytics solutions that are commercially sound, practical and capable of delivering measurable value
  • Partner with Altis delivery teams to ensure opportunities are translated into successful client outcomes
  • Lead and contribute to proposals, estimates, solution development and pre-sales activity
  • Support complex engagements from early strategy and solution shaping through to delivery
  • Provide strategic guidance across data, analytics, architecture and emerging technology opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with technology vendors and strategic partners
  • Contribute to Altis market presence, value proposition and brand awareness in Queensland
  • Mentor and develop consultants, sharing experience and helping lift capability across the business
  • Provide leadership across quality, delivery and client relationships

The experience you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with established consulting experience, strong commercial judgement and a proven ability to create trusted relationships that translate into meaningful work.

Your experience may include:

  • Senior client-facing experience within professional services, consulting, Data & Analytics or technology
  • Building and converting a pipeline of opportunities into successful client engagements
  • Developing long-term relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders
  • Leading complex consulting, transformation or technology engagements
  • Shaping solutions and commercial propositions in partnership with delivery teams
  • Business development, pre-sales, proposal development and estimation
  • Data & Analytics strategy, architecture or transformation
  • Leading and developing high-performing teams
  • Working with technology vendors and partners
  • A strong existing network across the Brisbane and Queensland market would be highly regarded.


You don’t need to come from one particular technology background. What matters more is a strong understanding of the Data & AI landscape, the ability to recognise where technology can create genuine value, and enough technical credibility to work effectively with both clients and delivery teams.

The leadership style that matters

Success in this role isn’t just about revenue.

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Commercially curious and able to spot opportunities others may miss
  • Credible and comfortable with senior stakeholders
  • Strategic, while remaining pragmatic about what can actually be delivered
  • Collaborative and visible with the team
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and change
  • People-focused and invested in developing others
  • Confident challenging assumptions and asking difficult questions when needed
  • Able to bring clients, consultants and partners together around a clear direction
  • Accountable for outcomes rather than activity

What success could look like

Over your first 12 months, you’ll be building momentum across the Queensland market.

That means:

  • Developing deeper relationships across priority sectors and strategic accounts
  • Establishing a strong pipeline of meaningful Data & AI opportunities
  • Becoming a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders
  • Helping Altis turn market opportunities into high-quality consulting engagements
  • Strengthening Altis profile and reputation across Brisbane
  • Connecting commercial opportunities with the right people and capabilities across the business
  • Contributing to the development of consultants and the broader Queensland practice
  • Building productive relationships with partners and vendors

Why this role matters

You won’t simply be handed a sales target and expected to operate separately from the consulting business.

You’ll help identify the problems worth solving, shape the opportunity with the client, connect the right Altis capability to it, and stay close enough to delivery to ensure what was promised creates real value.

You’ll also have an opportunity to influence how Altis continues to grow in Queensland from our market presence and client relationships through to the capability we build and the people we develop.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We’re Australian-owned and technology agnostic, which means our conversations can start with the client problem, rather than the product we need to sell.

At Altis, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Build genuine long-term client relationships rather than transactional ones
  • Work across complex Data, Analytics and AI challenges
  • Partner with experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Influence how we grow our Queensland presence and capability
  • Shape opportunities from initial conversation through to delivery
  • Help develop the next generation of Altis consultants
  • Work in an environment where commercial outcomes and quality client outcomes need to go hand in hand

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next chapter starts here

If you’re an experienced consulting leader who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and helping clients navigate complex Data & AI decisions, we’d like to hear from you.

You don’t need to fit one narrow career path. We’re interested in the strength of the relationships you’ve built, the opportunities you’ve created, the teams you’ve led and the outcomes you’ve helped clients achieve.

Join SoftServe’s European Commission engagement as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, developing secure and scalable digital solutions that support EU policy implementation and business operations. You will work across the full technology stack, from modern Angular front ends to Java/Spring Boot services, integrations, cloud environments, and DevOps practices, collaborating with international and multilingual teams to deliver mission-critical platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using Angular, Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Build responsive and user-friendly front-end experiences while developing robust backend services that support complex business processes and policy-driven applications
  • Design, develop, and integrate REST and SOAP APIs, as well as Kafka-based messaging solutions, to enable reliable communication between enterprise systems
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain database functionality using relational database technologies, including MySQL and Oracle, ensuring data integrity and performance
  • Apply best practices for application security, authentication, authorization, logging, monitoring, and compliance throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Perform unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and continuous improvement of application quality and reliability
  • Deploy and support applications in cloud and containerized environments, leveraging Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools to streamline delivery processes
  • Collaborate closely with technical teams, business stakeholders, and international partners, while maintaining accurate technical documentation and contributing to architectural and solution design decisions

Requirements

  • EQF Level 6 university degree (typically Bachelor’s level) with 17+ years of professional IT experience
  • 5+ years of experience with Angular, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, and 3+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot in enterprise application development
  • 3+ years of experience designing and integrating REST and SOAP APIs, as well as working with Kafka-based messaging solutions
  • 3+ years of experience with relational databases, including MySQL and/or Oracle, and strong knowledge of full-stack architecture and front-end/backend integration
  • 1+ year of experience with Kubernetes or similar DevOps and infrastructure technologies, along with experience integrating applications into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience developing secure cloud-based solutions, applying authentication, authorization, monitoring, logging, and security best practices
  • 3+ years of experience supporting EU Cohesion Policy and Structural Funds through digital solutions for EU-funded programmes
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher, strong communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively in multicultural, multilingual, and cross-functional environments
  • Experience with automated testing, additional expertise in Angular, Java, Spring Boot, REST, SOAP, or Kafka, and AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud certifications will be considered an advantage

SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Administrator
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:

✅ We are progressive

To see a real time view of what we are up to check our social channels

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth in a supportive environment including in-house coaching and mentoring.

The role...

We are currently recruiting a Senior Administrator to join our London office. The successful candidate will need a positive, ‘can-do’ attitude and are enthusiastic to take pride in this support position.

The role will involve providing high quality professional support services to the office location and for the wider Practice. You will be expected to work in accordance with the Practice’s values and objectives.

Please Note: This role may be subject to Disclosure and Barring Service, Baseline Personnel Security Standard, Counter Terrorist Check, Security Check, or Developed Vetting clearance.

The selected candidate will…

  • Provide high quality support services to ensure an effective production of work to include: audio and copy typing, photocopying, stationery and supply chain ordering, scanning, filing and travel arrangements.
  • Prepare, coordinate and check documentation and specifications utilising Microsoft Office software ensuing that correct templates, brand protocol, client requirements and framework guidelines have been considered and adhered to.
  • Arrange meetings, prepare agendas, associated paperwork, and take minutes as required both on site, virtual or in an IW premises. Issue Minutes and actions as well as following up to ensure that actions are completed. Maintain the conference room and the associated diary, book in new appointments, provide refreshments and order lunches, if required.

This will include supporting the central teams with vetting processes, supply chain management, audits, financials including invoices and purchase orders, timesheets, expenses, project information and inputting and updating data in all the Practice databases.

  • Coordinate and support the relationship with clients by organising campaigns, networking and meetings/events as directed.

  • Administration experience (preferred).
  • Working knowledge and proficiency of all Microsoft application, in particular Word, Excel, and Project
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritise as required by the team
  • Well organised with a high attention to detail.


We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway - you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

title: People & Talent Associate, Internship
description:
Join our 5x growth journey and help shape the future of People & Talent at Relesys! 🌟 Kick-start your career with hands-on experience in attracting, supporting, and developing great talent in a fast-growing international company.

As our People & Talent Team continues to grow, we're looking for an ambitious and curious intern who wants to explore both recruitment and internal people processes in a fast-growing software company.

If you're passionate about people, thrive in a dynamic environment, and want hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle, this internship could be your perfect next step. You'll play a meaningful role in helping us attract, onboard, and support the talented people who drive Relesys forward.

You'll support the team across both internal and external talent activities, from ensuring smooth recruitment processes to creating great employee experiences. You'll be part of a team that is always looking for smarter ways of working and new initiatives that support the business.

This is an exciting time to join Relesys. Through our strategic partnership with the Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring significant growth and plenty of opportunities along the way. You'll have a unique chance to make a real impact, taking both your career and Relesys to the next level. As we like to say, joining a scale-up at this stage is a "once in a lifetime" opportunity! 🤩


Responsibilities

As a People & Talent Associate Intern, you will focus on both recruitment and internal administrative tasks. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to...

  • Assist on multiple recruitment projects across different profiles and regions, and gradually take on more responsibility of selected projects

  • Conduct efficient search&selection processes, and once ramped, perform screening calls to assess candidate skill levels and organizational fit, presenting and recommending candidates to the Hiring Team accordingly

  • Maintain our job portal and job posts to ensure consistency and quality of our candidate experience

  • Assist in onboarding processes in the creation of onboarding plans and communication with new employees

  • Assist in the maintenance of employee records and files, including updating information in the company's people management systems

  • Schedule and coordinate internal meetings to ensure smooth operations

  • Assist in the execution of internal and external events, such as company thriving events and external employee branding events

  • Articulate our value proposition in a way that engages and motivates active and passive candidates to join us on the Relesys growth journey

  • Assisting with the creation and distribution of employee communications, such as internal announcements or updates to the Employee Handbook

  • Support in the research and development of the Talent department's processes and tools for the purpose of making us even better

  • Take part in assisting and managing our internal Relesys app and contribute proactively to its evolvement

  • Assists on admin tasks and ad hoc


Who are you?

  • You are currently enrolled in a PBA, bachelor's or master's program within the fields of HRM, Psychology, Business Process and Administration or Communication

  • Strong sense of structure and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks efficiently

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with a wide range of stakeholders, including applicants, employees, and team members

  • An analytical eye for detail when completing administrative tasks an organizer with a creative mind who loves structure and is eager to learn and develop

  • You are not afraid to bring your ideas to the table and challenge the ordinary

  • A willingness to adapt to new situations, as well as a proactive approach to problem-solving

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to work well as part of a team and build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders

  • It is an advantage if you have familiarity with people management systems and processes, including recruitment and onboarding, training and development, and performance evaluation

  • You can work full-time during your internship

  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

  • You are located in or near Copenhagen as this internship is on-site 🇩🇰


What we offer

  • "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

  • Positive, collaborative, and supportive colleagues who wish you to succeed

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development as we are growing towards becoming a unicorn business

  • Lots of challenges and opportunities, with respect and flexibility for your education

  • Targeted feedback and guidance from your mentor to further improve your skills

  • Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday 🥗

  • Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

  • Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

  • Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

  • Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!


When do you start?

  • Our Talent Programme is custom-tailored for your internship period. However, we are looking for an intern to start in February 2027

  • We cannot wait to review your application and meet our future colleagues! 🙌

  • Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button


We can't wait to hear from you! 🤩


Who are we?

Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.


Our Culture

Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

title: Guest Relations & Operations Coördinator
description:
Guest Relations & Operations Coördinator

Bij Van der Valk draait alles om gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en aandacht voor detail. Als Guest Relations & Operations Coördinator ben jij de verbindende factor tussen onze gasten, de Front Office en de dagelijkse hoteloperatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat gasten zich welkom voelen vanaf het eerste contactmoment tot aan hun vertrek en weet verwachtingen keer op keer te overtreffen.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Je werkt vanuit de receptie, stuurt het Front Office-team aan en draait zelf actief mee, ook tijdens avond- en weekenddiensten. Daarnaast gebruik je gastfeedback en operationele signalen om verbeterkansen te zien en acties uit te zetten. Zo draag je bij aan optimale gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en een soepel georganiseerde hoteloperatie. Binnen jouw takenpakket valt:

  • Je onderhoudt contact met (VIP-)gasten en creëert persoonlijke verrassingsmomenten.

  • Je speelt actief in op wensen en behoeften van gasten en weet verwachtingen te overtreffen.

  • Je behandelt klachten professioneel, oplossingsgericht en met oprechte aandacht voor de gast.

  • Je zet verbeteracties uit binnen de organisatie, bewaakt de voortgang en bent verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van de afgesproken resultaten.

  • Je coördineert en bewaakt processen op het gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.

  • Je ondersteunt bij de uitvoering van de RI&E, BHV-organisatie en Green Key-doelstellingen.

  • Je bent een zichtbaar aanspreekpunt voor gasten, collega's en externe partijen.

Je bent een meewerkend voorman of voorvrouw en daarmee zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer. Dat betekent dat je ook operationeel meedraait tijdens avond- en weekenddiensten.

WIE BEN JIJ?

Gastvrijheid zit in jouw DNA. Je krijgt energie van contact met gasten, maar vindt het minstens zo leuk om een team mee te nemen en zaken binnen het hotel iedere dag een beetje beter te maken. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je ervaring binnen Front Office, receptie of hospitality;

  • Beschik je over leidinggevende kwaliteiten en weet je collega’s te coachen en motiveren;

  • Ben je organisatorisch sterk en houd je gemakkelijk overzicht;

  • Schakel je moeiteloos tussen gastcontact, dagelijkse operatie en verbeterprojecten;

  • Ben je proactief, oplossingsgericht en durf je initiatief te nemen;

  • Heb je oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en detail;

WAT KRIJG JE VAN ONS?

  • Een veelzijdige functie voor 32 tot 38 uur per week, met een salaris van € 2.645 tot € 3.289 bruto per maand op basis van 38 uur, afhankelijk van ervaring (functiegroep VI Horeca-cao), met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief

  • 30% korting in de restaurants van Van der Valk International;

  • Hotelovernachtingen tegen een aantrekkelijk medewerkerstarief;

  • Toegang tot de Loyalty App met leuke extra’s en rewards;

  • De mogelijkheid om tegen een kleine vergoeding gebruik te maken van een personeelslunch of -diner;

  • Bedrijfsfitness voor slechts € 10 per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per km bij meer dan 10 km enkele reis;

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen Van der Valk.

LEER ONS KENNEN!

Van der Valk Hotel ’s-Hertogenbosch-Vught maakt onderdeel uit van het grootste horeca familiebedrijf van Nederland. Dit hotel valt met een aantal andere hotels in het binnen- en buitenland onder de holding Van der Valk International (VDVI).

Onder VDVI vallen 10 hotels in Nederland: Hotel Hoorn, Hotel Amersfoort-A1, Hotel Leusden-Amersfoort, Hotel Tiel, Hotel ’s-Hertogenbosch-Vught, Hotel Nuland-’s-Hertogenbosch, Hotel Noordwijk, Hotel Lelystad, Hotel Gorinchem A15 en Hotel Gorinchem A27. Daarnaast zijn er 11 hotels in Duitsland, 1 hotel in België, 1 hotel in Spanje en 1 hotel op Bonaire.

KLAAR OM TE STARTEN?

Zie jij jezelf al als het gezicht van onze Front Office en krijg jij energie van tevreden gasten, een enthousiast team en een hotel waarin alles klopt? Wat leuk dat je enthousiast bent geworden van deze functie! Tijd om te solliciteren via de button!

Heb je nog vragen? Dan kun je deze stellen via hr@vught.valk.com. Hopelijk tot snel!

title: Fullstack Developer (Python + JS)
company: Infino Legal Technology for legal practitioners
description:
W Infino Legal rozwijamy flagowy produkt w modelu SaaS z obszaru LegalTech & FinTech. Z naszego rozwiązania korzysta już ponad 200 kancelarii z obszaru upadłości i restrukturyzacji. W związku z rozwojem firmy szukamy osoby, która dołączy do zespołu naszych programistów.

Fullstack Developer (Python + JS)

Dołącz do zespołu, który tworzy system nr 1 dla polskich Doradców Restrukturyzacyjnych

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć?

  • Realny wpływ, zero mikrozarządzania: Pracujesz bezpośrednio z CTO. Rozmawiamy argumentami, nie stanowiskami. Masz pomysł na usprawnienie? Zgłaszasz i wdrażasz.
  • AI w procesie, nie w prezentacji: Claude Code, subagents, skills, worktrees. Testujemy nowe narzędzia i wdrażamy to, co realnie działa.
  • Jakość nie jest deklaracją: CI/CD, testy jednostkowe i integracyjne z pokryciem >90%, automatyczny monitoring błędów. Problemy łapiemy zanim zgłosi je klient.
  • Nowoczesny sprzęt: MacBook Pro 64 GB RAM - narzędzie, na którym da się pracować.
  • Rozwój w wybranym kierunku: Dofinansowujemy szkolenia.
  • Elastyczność i hybryda: Elastyczne godziny, 2 dni w tygodniu w biurze na krakowskim Zabłociu, zero obowiązkowych delegacji i wyjazdów służbowych.

Nasz stack i środowisko

  • Backend: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL
  • Frontend: JavaScript (React), Django Templates / Jinja
  • Ops: AWS, Docker, Ansible, Terraform (IaC) + własny serwer w biurze
  • Narzędzia: macOS, PyCharm / VS Code, Claude Code, GitLab, Jira, Sentry/Rollbar, Slack
  • Metodyka: Kanban

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • Budowaniem produktu end-to-end: Projektowaniem, implementacją i rozwojem nowych funkcjonalności — backend (Python/Django) i frontend (JS/React).
  • Dbaniem o jakość: Pilnowaniem wydajności kodu i aktywnym udziałem w Code Review.
  • Architekturą: Współpracą z zespołem przy projektowaniu systemu i wdrażaniu poprawek.
  • Własnymi inicjatywami: Zgłaszaniem propozycji technologicznych i samodzielnym rozwiązywaniem bieżących problemów.
  • Rozwijaniem naszego AI-toolingu: Testowaniem i rekomendowaniem narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.
  • Kontaktem z biznesem: Współpracą z zespołami Sprzedaży, Marketingu i Obsługi Klienta — będziesz wiedzieć, po co powstaje to, co budujesz.

Szukamy Właśnie Ciebie, Jeśli

  • Masz minimum 4 lata doświadczenia komercyjnego w wytwarzaniu oprogramowania.
  • Bardzo dobrze znasz Pythona, Django i DRF, a frontend w JavaScript (React, Django Templates) nie jest dla Ciebie obcym terytorium.
  • Znasz PostgreSQL, AWS i zasady budowania REST API.
  • Pracujesz z Claude Code lub innymi narzędziami agentowymi (subagents, skills, worktrees) — i potrafisz wytłumaczyć, jak działa kod, który wygenerował model.
  • Posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie min. B1/B2.
  • Cechuje Cię samodzielność, dociekliwość techniczna i odpowiedzialność za to, co wypuszczasz na produkcję.
  • Cenisz sobie nasze wartości: ciekawość, wspólnota, odpowiedzialność i zwinność.

Dużym atutem będzie: doświadczenie w produktach SaaS B2B, startupach produktowych albo branży prawnej lub finansowej.

Co oferujemy?

  • Wynagrodzenie: 15 000 – 21 600 PLN netto + VAT (B2B) (lub adekwatne stawki na UoP ).
  • Pracę w modelu hybrydowym (2 dni w biurze)
  • Narzędzia: MacBook + budżet na akcesoria.
  • Pakiety medyczne i rozwój: Prywatna opieka medyczna LuxMed, dofinansowanie do kursów i szkoleń.
  • Atmosferę i kulturę: Wyjazdy integracyjne, spotkania zespołowe i pełne wdrożenie stanowiskowe.
  • Dodatkowe dni wolne

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacyjny?

  • Selekcja CV: Analizujemy Twoją aplikację i kontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami.
  • Rozmowa telefoniczna: ~30 minut z rekruterem
  • Live coding: ~ 30 min z naszym CTO
  • Spotkanie w biurze: ~1,5 godzina bezpośredniej rozmowy w naszym biurze na Zabłociu.

title: Principal Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.

location: Ang Mo Kio Town Centre, North-East Region

We are seeking an IT Executive (IT Operations & Support) is responsible for the day-to-day delivery of IT support and operational services across the organisation.

The role serves as the primary point of contact for end-user IT support and is responsible for maintaining user accounts, endpoints, IT assets, software, collaboration platforms and operational documentation. The incumbent will provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support, coordinate with internal IT team members and external vendors, and ensure that IT operational activities are carried out in a timely, secure and controlled manner.

The role works closely with the Senior IT Executive – Network & Infrastructure and IT Executive – Cybersecurity, AI & Automation, with complex infrastructure and cybersecurity matters escalated to the respective technical owners.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Service Desk & End-User Support

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to users for hardware, software, operating system and application-related issues.

• Diagnose and resolve issues involving Windows devices, Microsoft 365 applications, printers, peripherals and other workplace technologies.

• Respond to and manage IT incidents and service requests through the established support process.

• Perform initial troubleshooting for network, Wi-Fi, VPN and connectivity issues before escalating infrastructure-related incidents where required.

• Provide remote and onsite support to users across the organisation's offices and locations.

• Track outstanding incidents and ensure appropriate follow-up through to resolution.

• Maintain user-facing guides, FAQs and standard operating procedures for common IT issues.

2. Endpoint & Device Management

• Prepare, configure, deploy, reimage and maintain desktops, laptops and other corporate IT equipment.

• Perform installation, configuration and troubleshooting of approved software.

• Support endpoint enrolment, configuration and compliance through Microsoft Intune and other endpoint-management platforms.

• Coordinate operating system, application and endpoint patching activities.

• Monitor endpoint compliance and follow up on devices that are outdated, offline or non-compliant.

• Support BitLocker, endpoint protection and other organisation-approved endpoint security controls.

• Coordinate warranty repairs, equipment replacement and disposal of IT assets.

3. Microsoft 365 & User Administration

• Perform routine administration of Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Create, modify and deactivate user accounts in accordance with approved onboarding, transfer and offboarding procedures.

• Administer Microsoft Entra ID users, groups and access assignments within delegated authority.

• Manage distribution lists, shared mailboxes and standard mailbox permissions.

• Assign and maintain software and Microsoft 365 licences.

• Assist users with MFA enrolment, password resets and account-access issues.

• Support SharePoint and OneDrive access and permission-related requests.

• Escalate complex identity, security or tenant-level configuration issues to the appropriate IT team member.

4. Joiner, Mover & Leaver Administration

• Execute IT onboarding and offboarding activities based on approved HR requests.

• Prepare equipment and accounts for new employees before their commencement date.

• Maintain standard user-access checklists and records.

• Recover corporate equipment and remove or modify access during employee departures and transfers.

• Ensure IT assets, licences and access rights are properly reconciled following staff movements.

5. IT Asset & Licence Management

• Maintain an accurate inventory of laptops, desktops, monitors, mobile devices, peripherals and other IT equipment.

• Maintain records of asset assignment, location, warranty status and lifecycle.

• Conduct periodic physical asset verification.

• Maintain software and licence inventories and assist with renewal tracking.

• Coordinate equipment issuance, return, replacement and disposal.

• Maintain supporting documentation for procurement, warranty and asset-management activities.

6. IT Operations

• Perform routine operational checks and support daily IT service availability.

• Assist with monitoring backup, endpoint, system and service status where assigned.

• Support routine patching and maintenance activities.

• Perform basic administration and troubleshooting of corporate telephony and communication systems.

• Coordinate operational activities with IT vendors and service providers.

• Maintain IT operational checklists, system records and technical documentation.

• Support scheduled maintenance, system upgrades and IT deployment exercises where required.

Assist with testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for IT system changes and implementations.

7. IT Procurement & Administration

• Assist the Head of IT with IT procurement and administrative activities.

• Obtain quotations and coordinate with approved vendors for IT equipment, software and services.

• Maintain records of purchase requests, licences, warranties, maintenance agreements and subscriptions.

• Track renewal dates and assist with timely renewal of IT services and licences.

• Maintain organised IT documentation and records for operational, audit and governance purposes.

8. Information Security & Compliance Support

• Follow established IT security policies, standards and procedures.

• Support endpoint-security and security-awareness initiatives.

• Report suspected cybersecurity incidents promptly to the IT Executive – Cybersecurity, AI & Automation and Head of IT.

• Assist with evidence gathering for internal and external audits.

• Support implementation and verification of approved security controls on end-user devices.

• Ensure user access, equipment and IT records are handled in accordance with organisational policies and applicable requirements.

9. Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Participate in IT infrastructure, application, endpoint and digitalisation projects.

• Assist with system deployment, migration, testing and rollout activities.

• Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements or automation opportunities.

• Work with other IT team members to improve operational processes and user experience.

• Perform other IT-related duties assigned by the Head of IT.

Requirements

Education

• Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity or a related discipline.

• Relevant professional certifications will be advantageous.

Experience

• Preferably 2–4 years of hands-on experience in IT support, IT operations, desktop support or systems administration.

• Experience supporting users in a Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 environment.

• Practical experience with laptop deployment, troubleshooting and user-account administration.

• Experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint or similar platforms would be advantageous.

• Experience working with external IT vendors and service providers would be advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have practical working knowledge of:

• Windows 10 or/and Windows 11

• Microsoft 365

• Microsoft Entra ID

• Exchange Online

• Microsoft Teams

• SharePoint Online and OneDrive

• Microsoft Intune

• Active Directory fundamentals

• Endpoint deployment and troubleshooting

• Basic TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN and Wi-Fi troubleshooting

• Printers and common office peripherals

• MFA and identity/access fundamentals

• IT asset and software licence management

• Knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Defender, 3CX, ITSM/service desk platforms or endpoint deployment technologies would be advantageous.

Competencies

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

• Service-oriented with good interpersonal and communication skills.

• Able to communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

• Able to work independently and manage multiple support requests.

• Strong attention to detail and documentation.

• Good organisational and follow-up skills.

• Able to prioritise incidents according to operational impact.

• Demonstrates accountability and ownership of assigned issues.

• Willing to learn new technologies and develop broader IT administration skills.

• Able to work effectively with internal stakeholders, vendors and other members of the IT team.

Role Boundaries & Escalation

The IT Executive – IT Operations & Support is the primary owner of end-user IT operations and first-line technical support.

Issues requiring specialised expertise should be escalated appropriately:

Network & Infrastructure Complex LAN/WAN, firewall, routing, switching, SD-WAN, VPN, server and infrastructure issues → Senior IT Executive – Network & Infrastructure

Cybersecurity Security incidents, malware, phishing, vulnerabilities, security investigations and advanced security-control issues → IT Executive – Cybersecurity, AI & Automation

Governance / Major Incidents / Vendors / Projects Major incidents, policy decisions, significant system changes, procurement approvals and strategic matters → Head of IT

The role remains responsible for coordinating and following up on escalated incidents until operational closure.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be assessed against:

• Timeliness and quality of incident and service-request resolution.

• User support responsiveness and service quality.

• Accuracy of IT asset and licence records.

• Timely completion of onboarding and offboarding activities.

• Endpoint deployment and patch/compliance status.

• Quality and completeness of IT documentation.

• Reduction in recurring support issues.

• Timely escalation and follow-up of infrastructure and cybersecurity incidents.

• Compliance with IT operational procedures and controls.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Private Medical & Dental care & Life Insurance

Internal Mobility program - possibility of rotation between projects, locations, accounts

Project Description

Senior data engineer developing and operating Databricks / Spark pipelines and Delta Lake lakehouse layers on Azure for the Client. Accountable for pipeline reliability, data freshness and dataset quality against agreed SLAs.

Key tasks

  • Develop and operate Databricks / Spark pipelines (PySpark, SQL, Delta Live Tables or Workflows).

  • Build ETL/ELT jobs and orchestration with Azure Data Factory and/or Airflow; manage dependencies and retries.
  • Implement data-quality checks and validation (expectations, reconciliation, anomaly alerts).
  • Tune Spark job performance and cluster cost (autoscaling, Photon, job clusters, spot).
  • Manage schema evolution and change control; document lineage and transformations.

Responsibilities

  • Pipeline reliability and data freshness against agreed SLAs.
  • Accuracy and completeness of curated datasets.
  • Schema change management and backward compatibility for downstream consumers.
  • Documentation of data lineage and transformations (Unity Catalog, data catalogue).

Skills

What is relevant to have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years in data engineering, of which 3+ on Databricks / Apache Spark and 2+ on Azure data services (ADF, ADLS, Delta Lake).
  • Databricks (Workflows, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog), Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL), Delta Lake.
  • Azure: Data Factory, Data Lake Storage Gen2, Key Vault, Event Hubs, Synapse or SQL DB; Azure DevOps CI/CD for notebooks and jobs.
  • Python and SQL at expert level; data modelling (dimensional, data vault) and ELT design.
  • Orchestration (ADF, Airflow), data-quality frameworks (Great Expectations, DLT expectations), monitoring and alerting.

  • Experience in financial services, sovereign wealth / investment holding or other regulated enterprise environments.

title: Tax Assistant

title: Senior.NET Backend Engineer
description:
The Company:

Since 2002, the client has been a market leader in automotive claims management, processing over 18 million vehicle claims annually with a global team of more than 1,000 employees. Operating in over 30 countries, the company specializes in digital solutions that optimize vehicle damage processing for insurance companies, car dealerships, repair shops, leasing firms, and automotive manufacturers. By leveraging automation, advanced technologies, and industry expertise, the client continuously enhances efficiency and accuracy in claims handling.

Your Role:

As a Backend .NET Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations within a distributed, microservices-based environment. You will work primarily with C#/.NET, backend APIs, databases, messaging systems, and cloud technologies. As part of an agile engineering team, you will contribute to technical and architectural decisions, ensure high code quality, and continuously improve the reliability and performance of backend services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using C#/.NET.
  • Build scalable solutions based on microservices architecture.
  • Develop and integrate backend modules and services within complex distributed systems.
  • Design and maintain integrations between internal and external systems.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including SQL Server and MongoDB.
  • Implement asynchronous processing and messaging using RabbitMQ and Hangfire.
  • Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-tested code following SOLID principles and engineering best practices.
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices where applicable.
  • Troubleshoot backend issues and contribute to improvements in system reliability and performance.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and support automated build, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Work with containerized and cloud-based environments, including the strategic migration to AWS or Azure.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other team members to achieve sprint goals.
  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Estimate development tasks and contribute to realistic sprint planning.
  • Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Tech Stack & Tools:

  • Backend: C#, .NET 6, .NET 8, with some legacy .NET 4.5 components
  • Architecture: Microservices, distributed backend services
  • Databases & Storage: SQL Server, MongoDB, AWS S3
  • Messaging & Async Processing: RabbitMQ, Hangfire
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS / Azure, VMware Tanzu, hybrid environments
  • Containerization: Kubernetes
  • CI/CD: GitLab
  • Monitoring & Observability: ELK Stack, Grafana, Sentry
  • Testing: Unit testing, integration testing, TDD

What We Expect from You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of commercial backend development experience with C#/.NET.
  • Strong knowledge of the Microsoft development stack, particularly C#/.NET and SQL Server.
  • Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Experience working with microservices or distributed systems.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, including SOLID, clean code, and maintainable architecture.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Experience working with relational databases; knowledge of NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Understanding of messaging and asynchronous processing concepts.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD processes.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native development is preferred.
  • AWS or Azure experience is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Proactive, self-organized approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an agile engineering team.
  • Willingness to contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English or German

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: Lähihoitaja lasten kotihoitoon Helsinkiin
description:
Etsimme lasten ja nuorten kotihoivatiimeihimme vahvistusta. Työ tiimeissä tapahtuu ihanien lapsiasiakkaidemme kodeissa, joissa saat toteuttaa laadukasta ja tärkeää hoitotyötä omalla persoonallasi. Vuorot toteutuvat yhden asiakkaan luona kerrallaan. Tässä työssä korostuukin laadukkaan hoitotyön lisäksi kiireettömyys ja hyvät resurssit. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja asiakkaat ovat Helsingissä, Vantaalla ja Espoossa.

Päivittäinen työ pitää sisällään lääkehoitoa, arjen kuntouttavaa toimintaa, perushoitoa ja kliinistä hoitotyötä, kuten päivittäinen vitaalielintoimintojen mittaus ja tarkkailu, peg-ruokinta, imulaitteen käyttö ja ventilaatiotuenta.

Sinulta toivomme halua tehdä hoitotyötä lasten parissa, sydämellistä suhtautumista vakavastikin sairaita asiakkaitamme kohtaan, luotettavuutta sekä intoa tutkittuun tietoon perustuvan hoitotyön toteuttamiseen. Työssä vaaditaan lähihoitajan tutkintoa sekä kokemusta lääkehoidon toteuttamisesta. Työtehtävien luonteen vuoksi työ edellyttää myös hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Tarjoamme työhön kattavan perehdytyksen, johon kuuluu esimerkiksi sähköinen materiaali, kuukausikoulutukset ja päivystyspuhelin, johon voit olla tarvittaessa yhteydessä 24/7. Työhyvinvointia meillä tukee kattava työterveyshuolto, sekä säännölliset koulutukset, tiimipalaverit ja yhteiset työhyvinvointitapahtumat. Meillä on tiivis työyhteisö, jossa kaikki puhaltavat yhteen hiileen, auttavat toisiaan ja kehittävät yhdessä ideoita niin parasta mahdollista hoitoa kuin työhyvinvointiakin koskien.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, palkkauspäätöksen teemme heti sopivan työntekijän löydyttyä. Jätäthän hakemuksesi siis pian. Mikäli sinulle heräsi kysyttävää työmahdollisuuksistamme, voit olla meihin yhteydessä puhelimitse tai sähköpostitse. Odotamme jo innolla yhteydenottoasi!
