Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube
  • @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

This is a management and facilitation role, not a hands-on development position. Your low-level software background will help you understand the work, ask better questions and support the team effectively.

The role sits close to system software, silicon and hardware development. That gives you real scope to connect people, improve collaboration and shape how delivery happens.

The team and culture

The Drivers and Utilities team builds custom host control software in Linux kernel and user space. Their work includes low-level C and C++ libraries and tools that help customers get more from Graphcore products.

Work spans teams, disciplines and locations. You will help engineers in Gdańsk stay connected, supported and heard within the wider System Software group.

Decisions are shaped through shared context, clear priorities and practical planning. You will work with the Product Owner, technical leads and Senior Engineering Manager to keep progress visible.

What we’re looking for

· Experience managing and developing software engineers through coaching, feedback and career conversations.
· Practical experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar team facilitation role.
· Ability to help teams plan realistically, remove obstacles and improve without adding unnecessary process.
· Experience working alongside Product Owners and technical leads, with clear role boundaries.
· Strong communication and facilitation skills in English and Polish.
· Background in Linux kernel, device drivers or low-level C and C++ software.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Comprehensive healthcare and dental cover: Premium medical and dental insurance, with the option to extend cover to your family
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Fitness and wellbeing support: A fully funded Medicover gym card, giving you access to a wide range of gyms, fitness classes and leisure centres
· Financial protection: Death and disability insurance, providing financial security for you and your loved ones
· Retirement savings: Build your financial future, with a 4% employer contribution from Graphcore, alongside your own contributions
· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): Confidential advice and support for you and your family across a range of personal, financial and wellbeing matters

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in Poland. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to help system software engineers do their best work across people, planning and delivery? Apply now to join Graphcore in Gdańsk.

title: House Supervisor
description:
Must be comfortable working with Challenging Behaviors!


What is a House Supervisor?


House Supervisors oversee the support and supervision of individuals who have developmental, mental health, or physical disabilities. House Supervisors manage the employees assigned to their site and are responsible for overall household maintenance.

Who makes a great House Supervisor?

An individual who:

  • Has a passion for helping others.
  • Has management/leadership experience.
  • Is comfortable with independent decision making and problem solving.
  • Displays the qualities of the company’s core values including service excellence, you centered care, nurturing relationships, ownership, value in every voice, and authenticity.

Why is being a House Supervisor so rewarding?

House Supervisors get the opportunity to teach new Direct Support Professionals about how to be successful in this field! In this position, employees enjoy a variety of work including management, care and supervision for individuals in our homes, training, as well as administrative work. House Supervisors go home every single day knowing not only that they make a difference in individuals lives, but employees lives as well!

What are the responsibilities of a House Supervisor?

  • Supervise day to day operations at the site, ensuring DSP’s deliver services according to policies and procedures.
  • Directly supervise and participate in the orientation and training of Direct Support Professionals.
  • Directly supervise the prudent spending and documentation of financial resources, including general budgets, payroll budgets, program accounts and petty cash accounts.
  • Maintain all individual records and on-site Synova Group/Genesis Group Homes’ records, periodically audit records to ensure compliance.
  • Develop and demonstrate person centered and therapeutic working relationships with individuals, staff, families and friends, management, and other agency personnel.
  • Make, provide transportation to, and attend medical, dental, specialist, psychiatric, and psychological appointments.
  • Assist individuals according to the SP and SPA with daily routines including, but not limited to, household tasks, cooking and eating, individual self-care, socializing, use of leisure time, health and safety, money management and behavior management.

Who are we looking for?

Applicants must:

  • Be 18 years or older, with a high school diploma or its equivalent.
  • Three years of experience delivering services to persons with disabilities.
  • Six months of service in a DSPIII position or six months of supervisory experience.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license, have access to an insured vehicle, have a clean driving record, and need to pass a DHS background study.
  • Exhibit basic computer skills to be successful in this position.

Working Conditions:

The House Supervisor is subject to flexible hours, including split shifts, varied days and times, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and overnights, depending on coverage needs of the site. This position will be cross trained at other sites and expected to cover shifts as necessary. This position includes weekend on-call rotation with other site(s).

This position will travel regularly into the community and work in a variety of settings both inside and outside the site and throughout the community. The House Supervisor is subject to frequent interruptions, crisis management, and imposed deadlines. This person sits, walks, bends, lifts, reaches, and moves intermittently during working hours.

This person is subject to frequent problem-solving activities and has regular contact with individuals, family members, friends, federal, state or county regulatory personnel, other provider personnel, and the general public, who may be hostile or emotionally upset. The position may be subject to physically aggressive individuals and may be exposed to infectious diseases, odor, and dust.

Synova Group offers a competitive salary and a full list of benefits, including PTO, paid holidays, health, dental, life insurance, and disability insurance. Paid training is conducted in our Brooklyn Park office and is led by Synova Group employees. For House Supervisors a company vehicle is provided after 90 days of service. We provide the car and the maintenance! That includes oil changes, car washes, tires, brakes, and anything else the vehicle may need! Employees may choose $6,900 in additional compensation in lieu of the vehicle.

You will work in an environment that makes you feel proud of what you do and work with others who have a strong desire to support individuals with disabilities. Synova Group focuses on person-centered planning to provide the best care to our individuals.

Synova Group provides many growth opportunities for those looking to advance their career and places value on internal promotion!


This position reports to the Services Manager. The position is classified as non-exempt.
Synova Group is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.

title: Director, Product Management (Security)
description:
Director, Product Management (Security)
Pharos | US Remote

Here's what you'd actually be walking into: one early customer, a real thesis, and everything else still unproven. Some people need the market validated before they'll commit to building in it. Others want to be the one who proves it's real. This role is for the second kind.

About Pharos

Pharos Systems International is the leader in PrintOps, the integrated, user-centric, and cloud-native approach to managing printing and the infrastructure and operations behind it. Pharos' modern print management software empowers enterprises to reduce costs, strengthen security, and support today's hybrid workforce with simple, reliable, and scalable printing solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including many of the world's largest Fortune 500 companies, Pharos has helped eliminate print servers, cut millions in print-related spend, and accelerate the transition to cloud-based infrastructure. Headquartered in Rochester, NY, Pharos has been delivering innovative print management solutions and measurable ROI since 1992.

Pharos has an early proof of concept in security and real conviction about where the market is headed. What we don't have yet is proof it holds up at scale, or a repeatable way to turn that thesis into a validated business. That gap is exactly why this role exists.

What This Role Is

This role owns the full loop from thesis to revenue: understanding who the real buyer is and what they'll actually pay to solve, turning an existing proof of concept into something multiple customers can rely on, and building the go-to-market motion that gets it from a handful of pilots to a repeatable business.

You'll work directly with Engineering, not just direct it: prototyping, reviewing technical tradeoffs, and getting into implementation details yourself when that's the fastest way to learn something. You'll also work directly with customers and, over time, with Sales, to turn early proof into paying accounts.

You'll report directly to the CEO, with the autonomy that comes with that and the visibility too. There's no team here yet. What you build, you build largely with your own judgment and your own hands.

What You Will Own

  • The market thesis: who the real buyer is, what they're actually willing to pay for, and what this product will deliberately not attempt.
  • The path from an early proof of concept to something multiple paying customers can rely on.
  • Direct, hands-on work with Engineering: epics, prototypes, requirements, and implementation tradeoffs.
  • The go-to-market motion: positioning, packaging, pricing input, and what it takes to turn a pilot into a paying customer.
  • A fast, honest read on what's working and what isn't, reported straight to the CEO, without waiting for a perfect plan to have that conversation.

What a Strong Background Looks Like

  • You've built and shipped something close to zero to one, not just contributed to an already-mature product line.
  • You've worked directly with customers to test whether a problem is real and worth paying to solve, not just gathered requirements secondhand.
  • You've gotten into the technical details yourself: a prototype, a proof of concept, a spec you wrote and then helped build.
  • You've made a real call with incomplete information and lived with the outcome, good or bad.
  • You reach for AI as a normal part of how you think through a problem, not as a novelty.
Not a good fit if…Strong fit if…
You need a validated market and an established team in place before you're willing to commit to a direction.You're comfortable being the person who validates the market, not just executing inside one someone else already proved.
Your best work has come from directing others rather than building things yourself.You still want to be hands-on with prototypes and implementation, not just strategy.

What We Offer

  • Compensation: $165,000 - $170,000 base salary
  • Location: US Remote. You must live in, and be eligible to work in, the United States.
  • Medical and dental coverage, 401(k), flexible hours, and PTO
  • Recognized as a Great Benefits employer by Mployer
  • Named a Top Place to Work by USA Today

If this sounds like the shape of work you're already good at, we'd like to hear from you.
Equal Opportunity Employer: Pharos is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local laws. www.pharos.com

  • hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes,
  • practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
  • good understanding of microservices architecture,
  • good command of English (min. B2) and Italian (min. B2),
  • willingness to travel occasionally to Italy to visit the client.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

Experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work.

  • Interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Python)
description:
Skill labels: DevOps Practices, On-premises, Python, Security

Our client is a leading global investment management company headquartered in London. It manages over $228 billion in assets and serves institutional investors, pension funds, wealth managers, and other sophisticated clients worldwide. The firm specializes in quantitative investing, alternative investments, systematic trading strategies, and technology-driven asset management. Data science, machine learning, and AI are core components of its investment and research processes.

As part of our collaboration we will focus on two foundational capabilities required to enable safe and scalable AI adoption across the enterprise: Agentic Security and AI-Ready Data Foundations.

We define how autonomous agents authenticate, obtain scoped access, and operate safely across a large, regulated financial estate where the runtime security model genuinely does not exist yet. The value, and the danger, of agentic AI is set by what an agent can reach: an agent that inherits a full user context and long-lived secrets has an effectively unlimited blast radius. Your job is to close that gap.

This is a hands-on senior-level role for an engineer who remains deeply technical and actively ships production code, operating at the intersection of enterprise IAM, platform engineering, and the emerging domain of agentic AI security. You will design and build the IaC-driven, self-service identity patterns, credential flows, and onboarding standards that make the secure way the easy way, across high-velocity teams that have long governed themselves.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a DevOps / platform / systems engineer, with a track record spanning both infrastructure operations and broader platform engineering — not purely a helpdesk/ops role.
  • Software development background: comfortable reading and writing production code, understanding how applications are configured and run, not just how they're deployed. This helps when working directly alongside dev teams on their workloads.
  • Python (required): solid, production-level scripting and tooling ability — automation, integrations, and support for platform/migration work. Not necessarily building a Python platform product, but extending and maintaining real code.
  • Linux systems (required): strong fundamentals — processes, networking, storage, permissions, package management. Comfortable troubleshooting at the OS level across a fleet of machines.
  • Infrastructure as code: hands-on production experience with Ansible and Terraform. Able to write, review, and maintain IaC that's treated like application code (version control, review, testing).
  • Migration experience (highly relevant): direct experience with, or strong aptitude for, OS-level migrations (e.g., CentOS to Ubuntu) and application/workflow migrations (e.g., Airflow 1.x DAGs to Airflow 2.x). Comfortable auditing existing workloads, identifying compatibility gaps, and planning cutover.
  • Kubernetes: working knowledge of how clusters are built, upgraded, and retired, and how workloads get moved between clusters with minimal disruption — relevant to migrating teams off unsupported clusters onto supported ones.
  • CI/CD: experience with at least one major pipeline tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and the practices around it — automated testing, staged rollouts, safe release processes.
  • Observability: familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent, and the ability to use monitoring data to diagnose issues across distributed systems.
  • Security awareness: practical understanding of secrets management, access control, and dependency/supply‑chain hygiene — enough to spot and flag risk, even if not the platform's primary security owner.
  • Collaboration and communication: able to sit with a dev team, understand their workload and pain points, and communicate technical trade‑offs clearly to both engineers and non‑engineers.
  • Problem-solving: persistence in root‑causing failures rather than just restarting services or working around symptoms.

Personal Skills

  • Adaptability: comfortable when priorities, tooling, or migration scope shifts mid-project.
  • Curiosity: pays attention to how other teams solve infrastructure problems and brings useful patterns back.
  • Communication: writes and speaks clearly enough that other teams can act without a follow‑up meeting.
  • Teamwork: works well embedded with teams outside their own, and shares knowledge freely.
  • Ownership: follows a problem to its root cause instead of handing it off once symptoms disappear.
  • Attention to detail: catches the small things — an unpinned dependency, an overly broad permission, a config drift.
  • Prioritization: can judge what to tackle first when multiple teams need help at the same time.
  • User focus: treats the engineering teams using the platform as customers, and measures success by whether their work gets easier.

Responsibilities:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the Python services, libraries, and command‑line tooling that make up the internal infrastructure platform.
  • Working with the engineering teams who consume the platform to understand their workflows and turn recurring pain points into platform features.
  • Replacing manual infrastructure operations with codified, self‑service workflows, so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and safe to change.
  • Building observability into the platform through metrics, structured logging, and alerting, so failures surface before consuming teams report them.
  • Owning production issues in the platform end to end, from triage and root cause analysis through the code or configuration change that prevents a recurrence.
  • Managing and scaling the compute and storage the platform provisions across on‑premises hardware, balancing performance against cost as usage grows.
  • Building security into the platform by default: secrets management, least‑privilege access, dependency hygiene, and an auditable history of every infrastructure change.
  • Evaluating new tools, libraries, and patterns, and folding the ones that earn their place into the platform roadmap.

Why this position:

  • This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and financial services, solving one of the most important challenges in enterprise AI: enabling agents to securely access and reason over trusted data. You'll have the opportunity to design and build foundational platforms that combine large‑scale data systems, governance, and AI technologies in highly regulated environments. It offers significant technical ownership, exposure to cutting‑edge AI agent architectures, and the chance to shape how organisations safely unlock value from their data.

title: ROS Engineer
description:
Project Description
We are looking for a ROS Engineer to join a robotics team working on the migration of an existing autonomous vehicle platform from ROS 1 to ROS 2.
The platform operates as an autonomous Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) and includes navigation, localization, vehicle control, GNSS, CAN-connected hardware, sensors, and higher-level autonomy logic.
You will be involved in the migration, adaptation, integration and testing of existing production software, working closely with Senior and Lead Engineers as well as the customer's robotics team.
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on ROS/ROS 2 migration, C++/Python development, system integration, navigation, localization and troubleshooting of autonomous vehicle systems.
  • Commercial experience with ROS, preferably with both ROS 1 and ROS 2.
  • Practical development experience with C++ and/or Python.
  • Good understanding of core ROS concepts, including nodes, topics, services, actions, TF and parameters.
  • Basic to intermediate practical experience with ROS 2.
  • Familiarity with Nav2 or other ROS-based navigation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ros2_control / ros_control.
  • Basic understanding of DDS and QoS concepts.
  • Experience working with Linux environments.
  • Experience with robotics, autonomous systems or mobile robotic platforms.
  • Experience working with sensors such as GNSS, IMU, CAN and odometry will be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with robot_localization, BehaviorTree / BehaviorTree.CPP, Foxglove or sensor fusion will be an advantage.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software and communication issues in distributed robotic systems.
  • Good English communication skills.

title: Tea Mixologist (Temporary)
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:

Bird & Blend was set up & is run by Krisi & Mike, who met whilst studying Politics (of all things!) at university.

Building Bird & Blend from scratch while staying true to their ethos & values has been Krisi & Mike’s passion for over 10 years.

From the early days of packing tea in their bedroom & attending markets, to now, with an awesome team, multiple retail stores & a thriving international online store, Bird & Blend is leading the way in tea innovation in the UK.

Bird & Blend has grown out of a core belief in doing business in a better way. This is ultimately our why - it’s why we are in business & what we believe in. Of course, we want to welcome as many people as possible into our Magical World of Tea but fundamentally it’s what we care about other than great tea that makes us magical.

You can read heaps more information about us and our mission here:

title: Executive Team Assistant to P&T Senior Leadership
description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

The Product & Technology (P&T) department brings together around 500 product, technology, delivery and data specialists who build and support the digital products and capabilities that help the FT serve more than one million digital subscribers.

The department is led by the Chief Product and Technology Officer, who is part of the FT Management Board. The P&T senior leadership team includes the Chief Technology Officer, Chief Product Officer, Chief Data Officer, VP of Portfolio and VP of Cyber, alongside an Executive Team Assistant and business partners from the People and Finance teams.

This is a new role providing comprehensive administrative and organisational support to the P&T senior leadership team, working in partnership with the Executive Team Assistant already in post.

You’ll help keep a busy senior team organised and connected, managing complex diaries, meetings, travel and expenses as well as supporting events and other departmental activity. You’ll work with colleagues and stakeholders across different functions, levels and locations, so strong communication, sound judgement and the ability to manage competing priorities will be important.

There is also scope to become involved in wider P&T initiatives and the leadership teams of individual executives, providing opportunities to build your knowledge, skills and experience across the department.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate complex diaries for senior leaders, including scheduling across multiple time zones and managing competing priorities.
  • Arrange business travel and process expenses for members of the senior leadership team.
  • Organise internal and external meetings, including room bookings, agenda preparation and meeting logistics, and welcome external visitors where required.
  • Support the planning and delivery of department-wide events, including town halls, working groups, off-sites and social events, working with regional offices including Bulgaria and the Philippines.
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to support clear communication and effective coordination of meetings and events.
  • Support senior leadership meetings through the preparation of slide decks and agendas, taking minutes where required and coordinating follow-up actions.
  • Provide general administrative and ad-hoc support, including equipment ordering, maintaining team memberships and distribution lists, and managing small-value purchases.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities for a busy senior team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate professionally with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels and from a range of backgrounds.
  • A high level of integrity and discretion when working with confidential or sensitive information.
  • A proactive approach, with the ability to anticipate needs, use initiative and solve problems without requiring constant direction.
  • The ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with others.
  • Experience organising meetings and larger events, with the ability to coordinate multiple logistical requirements.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when managing travel, expenses, diaries and meeting arrangements.
  • Confidence using digital workplace tools, such as Google Workspace, Slack, AI tools and project management platforms.
  • Curiosity, openness to learning and a commitment to developing your skills and knowledge.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting multiple senior stakeholders or working within a complex, fast-moving team.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, events or activities involving colleagues across different locations and time zones.

What's in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further Information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com

title: Senior Practitioner - Children in Care, West Essex
description: Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must have a current, unrestricted right to work in the UK. Essex County Council understand how important flexibility and wellbeing is for our colleagues working across children's Social Care and that we need to think differently. We have therefore developed a nine-day working fortnight for full time frontline Social Workers within Children’s services. If you would like more information on this, please follow this link We are a friendly, supportive, and hard-working team where we always hold children at the centre of what we do. We have created an open, reflective and learning culture where social workers feel enabled and supported to raise issues, consider different perspectives, challenge authority, and try out different approaches in a safe and non-blaming environment. Good quality reflective supervision is provided to all social workers and senior practitioners. Sonia and Padraig talk about our great team As a Senior Practitioner you will provide leadership in the team, provide both support and mentoring to newly qualified or less experienced staff, facilitate reflective group supervision, oversee the team’s duty service, deputise for the Team Manager when needed and have responsibility to lead in a practice area. There will be opportunities for your own professional development and for being part of developing our team and service. Children in Care Children in Care (CIC) teams work with children and young people up to the age of 18 who are in care– they’re unable to live at home and are either placed with a foster carer or live in residential homes. They work with children and young people to ensure their experiences in care is a good one and that the work undertaken prepares them for their transition into leaving care or return home to family. The CIC teams receive cases in proceedings after the first hearing, they visit children and young people in placement, develop permanency plans which include Special Guardianship Order (SGO) and adoption, undertake life-story work to enable a child to understand the reasons for being in care and also support children to return home to birth family. To read more about us please visit Children Families Please take a look at our ‘No Magic’ Children Families video Skills, knowledge and Experience A recognised social work qualification i.e. Diploma, degree or masters in social work, CQSW, CSS or equivalent, with current registration with Social Work England as a registered social worker. Evidence of continuing professional development, aligned to any relevant Professional Competency/Capability frameworks or Knowledge and Skills Statements. Significant experience of social work, demonstrating a comprehensive and up to date understanding of all relevant legislation, regulation and guidance. Experience of mentoring both Social Work students and newly qualified and experienced Social Work staff, being a subject matter expert in professional social work practice. Experience of chairing meetings involving clients, family members and/or carers and other multi-agency professionals. Developing strong relationships with partners, other agencies and the local community to achieve joint objectives and offer a supportive framework for children, young people and families. In depth understanding of delivery of value for money interventions balanced against need. Proven track record of clear decision making in order to highlight and limit the potential risks associated with intervention. The role requires you to be mobile throughout a wider operational area including travelling around the county of Essex and beyond, transporting service users and their belongings and to be able to do so in an emergency. Driving licence and car or the ability to meet the mobility requirements of the role through other means is essential. Why Essex? As one of the largest and most dynamic UK local authorities, Essex offers a stimulating public service environment. Covering over 1,420 square miles and serving 1.8 million residents, we’re committed to transformational change and delivering better quality at lower cost. Recognised in the top three of the latest IMPOWER index for productivity, we ensure everyone matters in Everyone's Essex . With flexible working options and a focus on innovation, whether you are looking to develop your career or contribute to the local community, Essex is the ideal place for you. Greater Essex has been accepted on to the devolution priority programme, where we will work towards establishing a Mayoral Combined County Authority. You can read more about these changes, and what this may mean for this role, on our careers site . Essex County Council is proud to be a Disability Confident Leader. We’re committed to interview all disabled applicants who choose to apply under our Job Interview Scheme if they meet the minimum requirements of the job. Please speak to our Recruiters if you require any reasonable adjustments during the process. We’re also committed to interview all veterans and care leavers, who meet the minimum requirements of the role for which they are applying. Once you’ve secured your role within Essex County Council you will receive many great employee benefits, including support for unpaid carers and flexible working arrangements to accommodate their needs. At Essex County Council, we value integrity and ethical behaviour. We kindly ask that you embrace our code of conduct and the Nolan principles , including throughout the recruitment process. Your commitment to these standards helps us maintain a positive and respectful workplace for everyone. As part of employment with Essex County Council (ECC) should your role require a DBS check you will be required to register with the DBS update service. The DBS update service ensures all registered DBS certificates are kept up to date and allows authorised parties to view the status of your certificate. This is an annual subscription, and you will be responsible for ensuring this is maintained. For further information on the DBS update service please go to https://www.gov.uk/dbs-update-service Essex County Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults, and expects all employees and volunteers to share this commitment. title: Campus Security Officer
description:
Sussex County Community College is seeking a part time Campus Security Officer. The SCCC Campus Security Officer focuses on providing a safe and secure environment for student, faculty, staff and guests of the college. Responsible for the implementation of safety and security operations that will ensure the well-being of the campus community. Facilitates the College’s Security department and serves as a public safety agent performing a variety of communications and operational tasks in support of public safety, security and other operations in accordance with facility necessities. This position provides armed security services during the daytime campus operations and serves as a visible presence to deter criminal activity and to respond to emergencies.

Part Time Shift Schedule -

  • Friday 3:00pm - 11:00pm
  • Saturday 3:00pm - 10:00pm
  • Sunday 3:00pm - 8:00pm

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Provide security coverage for assigned campus buildings and grounds.
  2. Conducts routine patrols (foot and/or vehicle) to deter theft, vandalism and unsafe behavior.
  3. Monitor campus access points and respond to security incidents, alarms and emergency calls.
  4. Assist with building access, protection, parking safety and providing overall armed security presence.
  5. Enforces College polices, procedures and applicable laws in a fair and professional manner.
  6. Respond promptly to emergencies including medical incidents, disturbances and safety hazards.
  7. Prepare accurate written reports and incident documentation.
  8. Work collaboratively with College administration, local law enforcement and emergency responders.
  9. Provide customer service oriented assistance to students, staff and visitors.
  10. Performs other duties as assigned.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to the job at any time. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by their supervisor, including maintaining a valid driver’s license in good standing with DMV for those jobs that require driving.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED required

CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Valid New Jersey SORA (Security Officer Registration Act) certification
  • Current CPR/AED and First Aid Certification (or ability to obtain upon hire)
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license in good standing and maintain such status throughout employment.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Work experience in armed security, law enforcement or military service preferred.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS:

  • Ability to work, organize & operate with a high level of efficiency under pressure & extreme stress.
  • Ability to work with diverse populations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Professional and compassionate demeanor

PREFERRED SKILLS:

  • Experience in a higher education or campus environment.
  • Knowledge of de-escalation techniques and community based security practices.
  • ICS & NIMS training certification preferred
  • Knowledge of Clery compliance

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Indoor and outdoor campus environment
  • Must be able to lift 25 pounds

title: Tea Mixologist (Temporary)

description:
Tea Mixologist

About you:

  • Brand Ambassador: Proudly represent our brand and culture, embodying our values and inspiring others to do the same.

title: Project Manager ResiPro
description:
Position Purpose

ResiPro is seeking a high-energy, field-centric Project Manager to drive our specialized residential renovation model in Raleigh / Research Triangle area. This role is built for a professional who excels at both the front-end technical inspection of a home and the back-end execution of project managing residential renovations. You will be the face of ResiPro in the field, ensuring every home is scoped accurately and each home's rehab is delivered to our rigorous quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Tech-Enabled Inspections & Scoping

• Conduct the initial property evaluation process in the Raleigh / Research Triangle area market using our tech to build comprehensive scopes of work in real-time.

• Coordinate and schedule inspections, representing the company with professionalism and transparency.

• Identify and document all repair needs, ensuring the initial scope accounts for both visible defects and the secondary work required to complete those repairs correctly.

• Flag all high-cost, high-liability, and 'deal-killer' items during the inspection to ensure the property meets strict acquisition criteria.

• Ensure all structural, mechanical, and safety concerns are captured accurately to prevent budget overruns and timeline delays once the rehab begins.

2. Renovation Management & Subcontractor Oversight

• Direct and oversee residential renovations, ensuring projects remain on schedule and within budget.

• Schedule and manage subcontractors to execute specific line items dictated in the scope, ensuring all work is completed to ResiPro's standards.

• Perform consistent site visits to verify work progress and ensure subcontractors meet expectations for quality, correct material usage, and adherence to project specifications.

• Ensure all work complies with local North Carolina building codes and that necessary permits and documentation are monitored throughout the construction process.

3. Quality Assurance & Project Closeout

• Perform a comprehensive final walk-through on every property to ensure the home meets all internal quality and safety standards prior to completion.

• Verify that all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems are fully functional and that all finish work meets company expectations for craftsmanship.

• Document the final condition of the property to ensure it is move-in ready and prepared for a successful resale or inspection.

• Ensure the property is clean, well-lit, and fully prepared for market presentation.

The Ideal Candidate

• Field-First Mindset: You thrive being on-site rather than behind a desk. You are a self-starter who manages your own schedule across the market to keep projects moving.

• Detail & Process Oriented: You have a 'keen eye' for identifying defects or safety concerns early and possess an organized approach to driving multiple projects to completion.

• 'Player-Coach' Approach: You don't mind getting your hands dirty when necessary. Whether it's helping a vendor understand a specific installation requirement or jumping in to touch up paint or spread mulch to cross the finish line, you do what it takes to get the job done right.

• Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable using mobile apps, inspection technology, and cloud-based project management software to document work and communicate in real-time.

Job Requirements

• 2–6 years of experience in residential construction management, home inspections, or high-volume scattered-site rehabs.

• Strong 'Multi-Trade' Knowledge: You understand how a change in one area impacts another.

• Solid understanding of North Carolina building codes and common inspection requirements.

• Excellent communication skills for managing local subcontractor relationships and working with the ResiPro team.

• Valid Driver's License and reliable transportation for daily travel across the Greater Raleigh / Research Triangle area Market.

Why ResiPro?

We believe that high-volume renovation doesn't have to mean compromising on quality. ResiPro provides the technology and the framework to help our Project Managers succeed, allowing you to focus on what matters: clear communication, solid craftsmanship, and project completion. If you're looking for a professional, stable, and tech-forward environment to apply your construction expertise, we'd love to meet you.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at.

Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike.

Profile Overview

Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find.

To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter.

This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way.

You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you.

So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries.

We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies.

Your responsibilities

Technology Vision and Strategy:

  • Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces.
  • Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend.
  • Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
  • Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
  • Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.

Security and Compliance:

  • Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
  • Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.

Team Management and Growth:

  • Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here.
  • Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them.
  • Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization.

Execution and Delivery:

  • Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence.
  • Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems.
  • Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows.
  • Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands.

Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management:

  • Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board.
  • Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs.
  • Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth.

Ownership & Autonomy:

  • Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships.
  • Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made.
  • Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement.

What You bring to the table

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company.
  • Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume.
  • Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation.
  • A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick.
  • A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed.
  • Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility.
  • Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else.
  • Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings.
  • Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously.
  • Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise.
  • Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to.
  • Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources.

Prerender is part of, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

description:

REPORTS TO: Chief Mission Officer

We have long-lasting connections with corporate partners. This position will connect and build corporate relationships while expanding corporate opportunities.     2. Serve as the point of contact for individuals and organizations interested in performing special projects.

    4. Promote a positive image of BGH at all times.

  1. Maintain Professional Development

    2. Participates in required Agency supervision and meetings.
    3. Network with other professionals.
  1. Performs other related duties as assigned by CMO and/or CEO.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Some of the work is performed in residential treatment settings. Some of the work is performed outdoors. Significant travel is required.

Must be able to read, walk, see, hear, and speak. Sitting, standing, walking and stooping. The ability to participate in a wide variety of activities is a routine part of the work.

Must be able to handle verbally and/or physically abusive and aggressive clients. Must be able to communicate with a wide variety of community audiences. Must be able to communicate effectively with suicidal, mentally, emotionally and/or psychologically affected clients.


MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT

Computers, printers, calculator, fax machine, copier, kitchen appliances, household appliances, camera, VCR, and vehicle


ORGANIZATIONAL MISSION CORE VALUES:

1. MISSION: BGHNC employees embrace the principles of integrity, servant leadership, dependability, inclusion, and commitment to promote health, healing, and hope to children, youth, and families.

title: Party Chief - Survey
description:
Survey Crew Chief – The Villages (Middleton, FL)

We believe in fostering a positive work environment that promotes growth, collaboration, and employee well-being. As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Party Chief to join our team in our Middleton office (The Villages, FL).

Job Description
As a Party Chief at CFB, you will lead a field crew in conducting a variety of land and construction surveys. This role is critical to ensuring accurate field data collection, proper equipment care, and seamless communication between field and office teams. You’ll play a key part in project execution while mentoring newer team members and staying up to date with surveying technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a field crew in conducting various land and construction surveys.

  • Operate and maintain survey equipment.

  • Mentor and train newer employees.

  • Stay current with surveying technology and equipment updates.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in land surveying as a Party Chief/Crew Chief required.

  • Proficiency with GPS, robotic total stations, and data collectors.

  • Strong understanding of land surveying methods, practices, and terminology.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans.

  • Excellent communication, organization, and leadership skills.

  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Why CFB?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

Join us at CFB and help deliver precise, high-quality survey data that supports the success of our projects and the communities we serve. Apply now to become a valued member of our Survey team!

title: Senior Golang Software Engineer (Data & Infrastructure)
description:

1. Personal Data Controller

The controller of your personal data will be Wakacje.pl S.A. with its registered office in Gdańsk (hereinafter: we).

You can contact us at: Wakacje.pl S.A., al. Grunwaldzka 413, 80-309 Gdańsk

2. Data Protection Officer

We have appointed a Data Protection Officer. This is the person you can contact in all matters related to the processing of personal data and the exercise of rights related to data processing. You can contact the inspector in the following ways:

  • by letter to the following address: Wakacje.pl S.A. / IODO / al. Grunwaldzka 413, 80-309 Gdańsk
  • by e-mail to the following e-mail address: iodo@wakacje.pl

3. Purposes and bases for processing

We will process your personal data for the following purposes:

  1. implementation of labour law provisions (Article 22 (1) § 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure) and preparation for concluding a contract (Article 6 (1) (b) of the GDPR) in the scope of the following data: name(s) and surname; Date of birth; Contact; education; professional qualifications, the course of previous employment;
  2. Your consent (Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR to the additional data that you choose to provide to us voluntarily in your CV, cover letter or during a job interview. Providing additional data, to the extent not specified by labour law or not required by us, will be treated as consent to the processing of such personal data. Giving consent in this case is voluntary, and consent given in this way may be revoked at any time;
  3. our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) in the data collected by us during the interview. We have a legitimate interest in vetting your skills and abilities - we need this to assess whether you are the right person for the position we are recruiting for;
  4. our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR) consisting in the possibility of conducting recruitment by electronic means, efficient communication and ensuring the correct identification and, if necessary, confirmation of the candidate’s identity in the system used to manage the recruitment process (the email address is the candidate’s identifier in the eRecruiter system).

We will also assess your qualifications, abilities and skills during future recruitment - the basis for the processing is your consent (Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR);

Archival and evidentiary data - the basis for processing is our legitimate interest related to the pursuit or defence of possible claims (Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR).

4. Data retention period

We will retain your personal data for a period of one year after you submit your application for the position.

5. Data recipients

We will transfer your personal data to service providers supporting us in conducting recruitment processes, e.g. IT service providers and a service provider providing the eRecruiter recruitment process management system, i.e. eRecruitment Solutions sp. z o.o. Such entities process data on the basis of a contract with us and in accordance with our instructions.

Other companies from the Wirtualna Polska Holding S.A. capital group for administrative purposes, including personnel management throughout the capital group for the purpose of exchanging data within the capital group, in particular in connection with human resources management and organizational structure, administrative, HR, payroll and IT services, planning and reporting at the group level. In addition, if you consent to the processing of your personal data for the purposes of future recruitment, we will be able to transfer your personal data to companies from the Wirtualna Polska capital group, which includes Wirtualna Polska Holding S.A. with its registered office in Warsaw and subsidiaries (https://holding.wp.pl/investor/struktura-grupy-kapitalowej)

6. Rights related to the processing of your personal data

You have the right to:

  1. access to your personal data,
  2. request rectification of your personal data,
  3. request the deletion of your personal data,
  4. request restriction of processing of your personal data,
  5. object to the processing of your data – in cases where we process your data on the basis of our legitimate interest,
  6. transfer of your personal data, i.e. the right to receive your personal data from us, in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable IT format. You can send this data to another data controller or request that we transmit your data to another controller, but we will only do so if such transfer is technically possible. You have this right to portability only in respect of the data that we process on the basis of a contract with you or on the basis of your consent,
  7. to the extent that your data is processed on the basis of consent – withdraw consent to the processing of your personal data at any time. The withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out on the basis of consent before its withdrawal.

To exercise the above rights, please contact us or our Data Protection Officer (contact details in points 1 and 2 above).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Office for Personal Data Protection. This right applies only to the lawfulness of the processing of personal data, and does not apply to the course of the recruitment process.

title: Business Intelligence Data Analyst
description:

The position carries meaningful ownership and accountability, reports to the Manager of Business Intelligence, and is responsible for delivering decision-grade reporting, partnering with stakeholders on KPIs and analytical solutions, improving data quality in collaboration with Data Engineering, and leading self-service BI communications and training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and data models supporting business functions
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define KPIs, and translate them into actionable reporting solutions
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency by validating source data, monitoring report outputs, and documenting assumptions and definitions

  • Excellent ownership, problem-solving, communication, and time management skills with the ability to work independently on multiple projects

Since adding its first customer, SBT has quickly become the leading text provider to consumer finance companies and various other regulated industries. Recognized as part of the Inc. 5000 fastest growing companies as well as Best Places to Work, SBT continues to evolve and expand through the addition of great employees who desire an exciting, collaborative culture.

Solutions By Text is committed to promoting the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it is through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

title: Parttime Sportcoach maandag, dinsdag & donderdag
description:
Ben jij beschikbaar op de maandag, dinsdag en donderdag van 14:00 tot 18:30 en ben je opzoek naar een bijbaan? Lees dan snel verder!


Wat ga je doen?

Als Ubuntu Sportcoach zet je sport in om bewegen voor ieder kind toegankelijk, leuk en leerzaam te maken. Je staat zelf voor de groep en verzorgt sport- en beweegactiviteiten op verschillende scholen en BSO’s. Je werkt met verschillende doelgroepen en op verschillende locaties, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je groepen en zorgt ervoor dat kinderen op een veilige en enthousiaste manier kunnen sporten en zich ontwikkelen. Je werkt vanuit de visie en aanpak van Ubuntu Sport en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen als sportprofessional.

Je weekplanning wordt vooraf afgestemd op jouw beschikbaarheid. Zo werk je op vaste momenten en weet je waar je aan toe bent. Wil je graag extra uren maken? Dan kun je deze aanvullen met andere sportactiviteiten, bijvoorbeeld bij verenigingen, in de wijk of tijdens sportieve events.

We bieden zowel parttime als fulltime mogelijkheden, zodat we samen kunnen kijken naar een werkweek die bij jou past. Je kunt aan de slag op verschillende locaties in Amsterdam, Amersfoort, Hilversum en Utrecht.

Wij zijn Ubuntu Sport

Ubuntu betekent: “I am, because we are” – je groeit door de mensen om je heen en samen kom je verder. Dat is precies waar Ubuntu Sport voor staat.

Met een enthousiast team van meer dan 100 sportprofessionals zijn wij landelijk actief op verschillende locaties, waaronder Amersfoort, Amsterdam, Hilversum en Utrecht. Vanuit deze locaties werken wij samen met scholen, verenigingen, BSO’s en gemeenten. Daarnaast hebben wij een mooie samenwerking met FC Utrecht, waarmee wij onze passie voor sport en ontwikkeling verder versterken.

Met onze Sport to Grow-methode geloven wij dat sport veel meer is dan alleen bewegen. Sport helpt kinderen om samen te werken, zelfvertrouwen op te bouwen, uitdagingen aan te gaan en te groeien als persoon. Zo zorgen wij ervoor dat kinderen niet alleen groeien in hun sport, maar ook als mens binnen én buiten het veld.

Samen maken wij van sport een plek waar iedereen kan groeien, ontdekken en het beste uit zichzelf kan halen.

Ben jij een sportieve kracht en wil je jouw kennis en expertise verder ontwikkelen bij Ubuntu sport? Dan bieden wij je een werkomgeving met volop ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en professionele ontwikkeling. Daarnaast zoeken wij iemand die:

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (minimaal B2-niveau)Minimaal 8–40 uur beschikbaar;

  • Minimaal een afgerond MBO-3 diploma, bij voorkeur aangevuld met relevante werkervaring.

  • Je hebt ervaring als sportcoach en/of in het werken met kinderen.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je groepen.

  • Je vindt het leuk om op verschillende locaties en met verschillende doelgroepen te werken.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor een parttime of fulltime dienstverband.

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar binnen Amsterdam, Amersfoort, Hilversum en/of Utrecht.

** In het kader van informatiebeveiliging en privacy maakt een screening en het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. De kosten hiervan worden volledig door ons vergoed.*

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Salaris tussen de €17,12 en €23,52 per uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en opleidingsniveau.

  • Flexibel contract: uren en contractvorm afgestemd op jouw situatie.

  • 210 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Extra beloning: 8% vakantiegeld én 8% eindejaarsuitkering, allebei boven op je bruto salaris.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer.

  • Ontwikkeling & begeleiding: één-op-één begeleiding, intervisie en interne opleidingen zoals EHBO en BHV.

  • Een locatie die bij jou past: samen kijken wij naar een goed bereikbare werkplek.

  • Ubuntu Sport-kleding: sportief en herkenbaar tijdens je werk.

  • Afwisselend werk: op BSO’s, scholen, sportlocaties en tijdens events.

  • Extra kansen: mogelijkheid om extra uren te werken en ervaring op te doen binnen verschillende Ubuntu Sport-projecten.

title: 2027 Real Estate Internship
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

KKR Real Estate Overview:

Real Estate has been a part of the firm’s strategy since 1981 when we first began pursuing real estate opportunities through our private equity strategy. In 2011, we made a decision to form a dedicated real estate platform. As of March 30, 2026, our team consists of 120+ dedicated investment and asset management professionals across 11 countries, with more than ~$84 billion of assets under management.

Role Summary:

Real Estate is looking for a motivated German-speaking Intern to join the team in London for six months. The focus of this role will be on German deals, with the spared capacity pooled across other jurisdictions. German language skills are a must for this role. An Internship with KKR will provide an excellent real estate private equity experience and outstanding learning opportunities. It will also provide great access to liaise with teams throughout KKR, senior management of companies and other external market participants (e.g. bankers, advisers, brokers, and other buyside investors).

Role and Responsibilities:

The role will be varied, challenging and highly rewarding. Typical day to day responsibilities will involve the following:

  • Excel modelling
  • Drafting of memoranda for internal and external use
  • Market research
  • Development of presentations
  • Performing various analyses to assist in making investment decisions
  • Real estate and public company valuation analysis
  • Assisting with due diligence and execution of transactions
  • Working alongside portfolio companies and operating partners
  • Support asset management and reporting initiatives

Selection Criteria / Required Skills:

  • Strong academic track record
  • Demonstrable interest in Real Estate
  • Prior experience in investment role is preferred
  • Strong financial modelling skills
  • Positive and eager attitude with a willingness and curiosity to learn
  • Ability to learn quickly, take initiative and demonstrate proactivity in approach to work
