We'readdressing the global challenges of ending plastic waste, taking climate action, and supporting a thriving society, while generating value for our customers, investors, and society.

Come Join an Inclusive Team

The Lead Data Engineer is responsible for defining, governing, and actively building end-to-end data architecture capabilities supporting LyondellBasell’s Advanced Polymer Solutions (APS) business. This role owns the full data scope across master data, data enablement, dataflow gate management, governance, and consumption, ensuring a back-to-back architecture integrated with APS business and technology processes. The position ensures continuity, clear accountability, and alignment with business priorities while delivering scalable, secure, and business-driven data solutions across ERP platforms, cloud data services, analytics, and AI enablement.

This position is both strategic and hands-on, accountable not only for defining enterprise and APS aligned data strategy and architectural guardrails, but primarily for direct contribution in key areas such as data modeling, integration patterns, analytical dataset design, and cloud data platform implementation. Operating in a fast moving, agile environment, the role partners closely with technology and business leaders to turn data into a competitive advantage, drawing inspiration from modern, product centric and customer oriented (B2C style) data practices.

A Day in the Life

The Lead Data Engineer serves as the primary owner of APS data architecture and is responsible for translating business requirements into executable data solutions. This role is expected to operate with a high degree of hands on involvement. The Lead Data Engineer is part of the digital technology organization. The individual will work with the APS Digital Transformation Panel to implement end-to-end data architecture, data strategy, and governance. This role will leverage enterprise data management and governance practices as established by the Enterprise Data & Architecture organization. Their focus will remain on prioritizing, sequencing, and executing initiatives with close partnership with the APS organization. The Engineer will also have primary responsibility for ensuring our application and engineering teams have the necessary information and guidance to implement end to end data solutions. The architect is a champion for data analysis and logical data modeling and provides technical mentoring to other DT staff to support skills development.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Hands-On expertise in Data Engineer principles, methods, and tools; deep understanding of data management including integrations, storage, Master Data Management, and analytics.
  • Deep understanding of how APS business processes and operations are supported by data, and how future process changes impact data usage.
  • Ability to translate APS business requirements into logical, physical, and analytical data architecture designs.
  • Maximize enterprise and APS data assets by reducing redundancy, enabling secure accessibility, and promoting shared understanding through metadata management.
  • Develop technical architecture across APS business processes, ERP systems, data flows, and analytics consumption patterns.
  • Collaborate closely with APS Digital Transformation Panel to execute aligned and prioritized ADO projects .
  • Define and communicate future state data requirements supporting APS platforms, analytics, and AI initiatives.
  • Strong experience in data integration, ingestion, and data conversion across ERP and non ERP systems.
  • Excellent skills in data engineering, data modeling, data services, reporting, visualization, and analytics platforms.
  • Proven hands on experience designing and supporting data ingestion pipelines, data transformations, and analytical datasets.
  • In depth knowledge and proven experience with cloud based data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including data lake, cloud data warehouse architectures.
  • Working knowledge of master data management and enterprise data governance practices.
  • End to end data architectural accountability for enterprise and APS data warehousing, analytics, and visualization solutions.
  • Translate strategic APS data requirements into enterprise information architecture artifacts, including enterprise data models, metamodels, common business vocabularies, and taxonomies.
  • Leverage existing or define new data standards and reference architectures for APS initiatives.
  • Experience in Agile development methodology/Scrum framework.
  • Proficient in DevOps and Agile concepts & development principles.

You Bring This Value

This individual must demonstrate strong technical expertise and knowledge in each of the following technology disciplines:

Education & Experience

Role

The Director of Consultant Relations leads Sword’s strategic alliances across top-tier benefits consulting and brokerage firms. In this role, you will own executive-level relationships, shape territory-wide consultant strategy, and translate market influence into consistent pipeline acceleration and net-new business outcomes. You will serve as a key commercial partner across Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to establish Sword as the preferred AI Care solution for major employers.

What you'll be doing:

  • Activate target market events: Design and execute strategic regional touchpoints and executive roundtables that deepen engagement and generate measurable pipeline.

  • Maintain CRM & forecasting discipline: Ensure rigorous tracking of activity, influence, and pipeline metrics in Salesforce to maintain forecast accuracy and clean attribution.

What you need to have:

  • MUST HAVE direct experience working at or interfacing extensively with WTW, Aon, Mercer, or Lockton with a deep understanding of their internal consulting structures and evaluation processes.

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in consultant relations, benefits consulting, or commercial alliance management within the employer health benefits industry.

  • Demonstrated track record of building high-impact relationships that convert into measurable revenue, pipeline growth, and preferred vendor status.

  • Strong business development and multi-threading expertise, with the ability to expand coverage across complex enterprise organizations.

  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills to clearly articulate complex clinical and AI value propositions to senior decision-makers.

  • High operational comfort in a metrics-driven environment, including territory ownership and disciplined CRM hygiene (Salesforce).

title: Deputy Clerk I - PT - Probate Court
description:
Announcement Open Until Monday October 5, 2026, at 5pm

Grade 8: Minimum Wage $17.57 per hour

Dept/Div: Courts/N/A FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

General Definition of Work

Performs intermediate skilled administrative support work processing legal documents, entering data, indexing records and documents, maintaining records and files, assisting the public, and related work as apparent or assigned. Work is performed under the moderate supervision of the Chief Clerk.


Qualification Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Essential Functions

Greets visitors, citizens, and customers; answers telephone; responds to general inquiries related to Court matters or forwards callers/visitors to the appropriate party for disposition; assists the public with general inquires.

Receives citizen inquiries, complaints, and service requests and resolves them within the framework of the established policies and procedures or forwards to appropriate party for disposition.

Types a variety of documents including correspondence, orders for Judges, lists, labels, reports, requisitions, memoranda, etc., where a knowledge of format and presentation is necessary; maintains time sheets; checks items for grammatical accuracy and completeness.

Facilitates the establishment of estates, guardianship and/or conservatorships for adults and minors from the initial court petition through various final processes in accordance with State law.

Provides support to Chief Clerk and Deputy Clerks II; assists attorneys, realtors, title examiners, and law enforcement as needed.

Processes and records legal documents; judgments, and finance statements; stamps and records judgments; scans documents; computes Court fees; assigns case number.

Enters a variety of data into computer; verifies statistical and other records for accuracy and completeness; enters and retrieves sensitive and restricted information into computer system.

Processes concealed handgun permits and verifies information and delivery to agency.

Swears in personal representatives and guardians/conservators.

Prepares various court documents and records.

Processes payments for and issues marriage licenses and vital records

Picks up and delivers mail and supplies; receives, sorts, processes, and distributes incoming and outgoing mail; provides various courier services.

Sorts, indexes, and maintains files; maintains records as requested.

Operates a variety of standard office equipment; performs minor and preventive maintenance on equipment and requests service when equipment is malfunctioning.

Encourages and promotes a culture of excellent service


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

General knowledge of the office methods, procedures and practices of a Court; general knowledge of laws contained within the Official Code of Georgia; thorough knowledge of applicable court policies and procedures; general knowledge of business English, spelling and arithmetic; ability to operate standard office equipment; thorough knowledge of office programs and policies; ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions; ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with court officials, law enforcement officials, attorneys, realtors, title examiners, associates and the general public. Preferred knowledge in probate court.


Education and Experience

High school diploma or GED, or equivalent combination of education and experience.


Physical Requirements

This work requires the frequent exertion of up to 10 pounds of force and the occasional exertion of up to 25 pounds of force; work regularly requires speaking or hearing and using hands to finger, handle or feel, frequently requires walking, sitting, reaching with hands and arms and repetitive motions and occasionally requires standing, climbing or balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching or crawling and lifting; work has standard vision requirements; vocal communication is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word; hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels and to receive detailed information through oral communications and/or to make fine distinctions in sound; work requires preparing and analyzing written or computer data and observing general surroundings and activities; work has no exposure to environmental conditions; work is generally in a moderately noisy location (e.g. business office, light traffic).


Special Requirements

Obtain Public Notary within three months.

May require specific certifications dependent on court assignment.

Favorable background history as determined by review of local, State and Federal records.

title: Finops Engineer - Cloud, SaaS & Estate Cost
description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your hiring experience matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive. If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.


Cloud, SaaS & Estate Cost at Shine

Shine runs a multi-million-a-year technology cost base: AWS, GCP and Azure, a large SaaS portfolio, and an on-premises estate that arrived through acquisitions — Kyndryl-operated infrastructure, Nutanix, Citrix and VMware included. Today nobody owns that cost base end to end. Attribution is partial, commitments are made without a full picture, and every product lifecycle decision — keep, move, or end — is argued without defensible numbers on the table.

Infrastructure & IT is changing that. Spending well means knowing where the company is actually going: products that end must actually end, long-term products are where investment concentrates, and for every open decision we bring the numbers — what it costs to keep, what it costs to move, what it saves to end. This role is where those numbers come from, and where cost stops being a quarterly surprise and becomes a first-class, automated signal in how the estate is run.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. The direction — one legible, shrinking, well-understood estate — is set; how cost visibility, investigation and automation make it real is substantially on you.


Your Role as a Finops Engineer

What you own

Cost visibility across the whole base, end to end. Cloud, SaaS and on-premises in one picture: attribution built into how the foundation is defined (tagging and allocation as code in the Terraform modules, not spreadsheets after the fact), SaaS spend tracked per tool and per owning team, and the acquired on-prem estate brought into the same view rather than left as a line item nobody can explain.

The numbers behind every lifecycle decision. When a product's future is decided, you own the keep/move/end analysis: what it costs to run where it is, what migration costs, what a true sunset saves. Your numbers are what make retirement fundable and commitment planning safe.

Cost automation, built with AI. Reporting, anomaly detection, investigation and forecasting built as automated pipelines — using AI tooling as a working instrument, not a demo. If a cost question has to be answered by hand twice, automating it is your job.

Deep investigation, on demand. When Finance, a tribe lead, or leadership asks why a number moved, you can take it apart to the driver — service, workload, contract, or licence — and come back with an answer that holds up. Granular when it matters; we do not optimize for bolts.

What you'll do day-to-day

  • Build and maintain the attribution layer hands-on: tagging standards and allocation rules as code in the Terraform module library, cost data pipelines, showback with Finance per tribe and per product.

  • Bring the SaaS portfolio under management — one inventory of tools, owners, contracts, renewal dates and per-seat cost, with each team seeing its own bill.

  • Extend the same visibility over the on-premises estate: Kyndryl contracts, Nutanix, Citrix and VMware licensing and capacity, mapped to the products that depend on them and to their lifecycle dates.

  • Produce the keep/move/end numbers for open product lifecycle decisions, and keep them current as decisions firm up.

  • Automate reporting and anomaly detection with AI-assisted tooling — dashboards that answer questions before they're asked, alerts on spend that moves without a reason.

  • Prepare the commitment strategy: unit economics per cloud, a committed-spend baseline that respects the retirement plan, and the analysis behind the hosting strategy decision — so that when the lifecycle decisions are final, the commitment cycle is ready to execute, not starting from scratch.

  • Work with Finance on the cost-per-unit-of-delivery measure and the quarterly cost presentation to tribes — one definition, one number.

  • Investigate specific cost questions raised by teams and leadership, in detail, and turn recurring questions into automated answers.


About you

Must-have

  • 5+ years in FinOps, cloud cost engineering, or infrastructure engineering with substantial cost ownership — you've operated a real cost base, not just read the billing console

  • Hands-on cloud fluency on at least one of AWS, GCP or Azure, with working knowledge of the others' billing and commitment models (CUDs, savings plans, reservations, enterprise agreements)

  • Engineering-grade automation skills: you build pipelines, write code against billing and licensing APIs, and treat attribution as configuration in version control — comfortable working in Terraform, not around it

  • Practical use of AI tooling in your own work — for analysis, report generation, investigation — with judgment about where it's dependable and where it isn't

  • Experience making cost legible to non-specialists: showback or chargeback, unit economics, presentations to finance and engineering leadership that led to decisions

  • Comfort with incomplete data and inherited mess — you can build a defensible picture from partial sources and state clearly what's known, estimated, and unknown

  • Delivery attitude: you ship a working v1 of the cost picture and improve it, rather than waiting for perfect data that never arrives

Strong plus

  • SaaS spend management at portfolio scale: licence optimization, renewal negotiation support, shadow-IT discovery

  • On-premises and hybrid cost experience: outsourced infrastructure contracts (e.g. Kyndryl or similar), virtualization licensing (VMware, Citrix, Nutanix), data-centre unit economics

  • Experience supporting a migration or consolidation program with cost analysis — you know what keep/move/end numbers look like when they're actually used

  • FinOps Foundation certification or equivalent practice familiarity

  • Background in regulated industries (fintech, accounting, banking)

  • Experience in a post-acquisition environment where multiple estates were brought under one view


How we measure success

Visibility

  • Cost attribution coverage across cloud, SaaS and on-prem — trending toward 100%, with unattributed spend held under 5%

  • Inventory of the SaaS portfolio and on-prem contracts: complete, current, and owned

  • Time to answer a cost question — trending down, because the answer is increasingly automated

Decisions

  • Keep/move/end numbers delivered for every open lifecycle decision, on time and defensible

  • The cost-per-unit-of-delivery measure defined and baselined with Finance

  • Commitment strategy ready when lifecycle decisions land — savings captured against a baseline that respects the retirement plan, not despite it

Trust

  • Finance and tribe leads use your numbers without re-deriving them

  • Qualitative signal: teams bring you cost questions early, rather than discovering the answer at quarter close


What this is not

This is not a procurement role, a controller role, or a slideware role. It's not penny-hunting: we report and investigate in detail, but we don't optimize for bolts — the leverage is in attribution, lifecycle decisions, commitments and the SaaS portfolio, not in shaving cents off individual workloads.

It's also not a role where savings are your burden alone. Retirement and commitment decisions are made by product and leadership with the numbers you provide; your part is making the cost base so legible, and the numbers so defensible, that the right decision becomes the obvious one.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.


Our recruitment process

1️⃣ A 30' first call with Ahmed Sadek (Senior Talent Acquisition) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 45' interview with Niklas Gerdt (VP of Infrastucture and IT) to discuss your past experiences and the role we are offering.

3️⃣ A Case presentation to highlight your skills and give you a hands-on feel for the role.

4️⃣ A 30' team introduction, followed by a soft skills interview to see how we can best support your growth at Shine.

title: Senior Ecologist
description:
Senior/Principal Ecologist


At Origin Enterprises, we are dedicated to championing sustainable land use, and our Environmental teams support a diverse range of clients and projects—from land management and development to restoration and conservation.

Joining us means becoming part of a collaborative, purpose driven community where this collective expertise enables us to deliver high quality, fully integrated solutions and contribute to meaningful environmental outcomes across the UK and Ireland.

About Avian

Avian Ecology is a growing ecological consultancy delivering complex infrastructure and land-use projects across the UK, with a strong and expanding portfolio in the renewables sector including onshore wind and solar projects.

We are led by skilled ecologists who also understand business. We deliver a professional service based on pragmatic advice, strong relationships and robust reporting. Our belief is that progressive development and the conservation of our natural heritage can co-exist, as we have demonstrated time and again through our projects across the UK.

The role will include:

As a Senior or Principal Ecologist, your role will focus on leading projects, preparing detailed reports, and conducting ecological assessments, you will also work as part of a larger project team. While the work will be varied, there will be a strong focus on renewable energy schemes, particularly wind projects, as well as more conventional development projects.

You will engage with clients remotely, providing clear advice and robust documentation to support projects across the UK. Liaising with planning authorities, statutory agencies, and stakeholders will be a key part of the role, offering excellent opportunities to further develop your project management skills. You will also supervise junior ecologists and co-ordinate sub-consultants.



Key Requirements:

  • Strong experience in desk-based project management, reporting, and ecological assessments.

  • Experience working on renewable wind projects.

  • Experience in mentoring junior staff and managing small teams.

  • A clear understanding of relevant UK-wide environmental/ecological policy and legislation.

  • Demonstrable ability to produce clear, succinct, and robust technical reports, including: Preliminary Ecological Appraisals, Ecological Impact Assessments, and Technical Appendices.


  • Experience in advising clients on the ecological requirements of their projects and consulting with regulators and stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • A flexible, diligent, and proactive person who is motivated to work independently or as part of a team to consistently high standards.

  • Previous consultancy experience is required.

  • Candidates will have a relevant degree and preferably be a CIEEM member, along with a full clean driver’s license.

Why work for us?

We offer a competitive and supportive rewards package designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally. This includes Life Assurance, access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), and paid professional memberships such as CIEEM. We’re committed to continuous development, offering a blend of internal and external training opportunities to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

As part of our inclusive culture, you’ll have the opportunity to join our monthly Neurodiversity Café, take part in community action days, and benefit from our family friendly policies, including enhanced family leave options. While we value time spent together in our offices to collaborate and stay connected, most roles offer hybrid working and open conversations around flexibility.

You’ll also enjoy 25 days’ holiday, regular performance and development reviews, and the chance to collaborate across the wider Origin Group, especially within our growing family of Environmental businesses.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and are proud to be building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can grow, contribute and feel valued.

Visit our website to learn more — and grow with us.

title: Lead GCP DevOps Engineer - Remote in Poland
description:
your Jared in Warsaw, Poland is seeking a Lead GCP DevOps Engineer to design and deliver Google Cloud Platform solutions. You will lead cloud-native transformations, drive architecture choices, and mentor the team.

The role focuses on defining DevOps practices, implementing CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable cloud applications with Kubernetes. Hybrid work is available within Poland, with occasional international travel.

title: Programista Embedded Linux DevOps Engineer (K/M)
description:
Praca przy systemach Embedded Linux na architekturze ARM w firmie o znaczeniu dla obronności Państwa — rozwijasz i optymalizujesz dystrybucje wbudowane (Yocto, Buildroot), konfigurujesz bootloadery i jądro Linux oraz utrzymujesz pipeline'y CI/CD.

To oferta dla kogoś, kto łączy kompetencje embedded z DevOps i nie przeszkadza mu praca w środowisku regulowanym.

Szczera uwaga: nazwa stanowiska łączy dwie role (embedded + DevOps), a w opisie pojawia się wdrażanie narzędzi opartych na LLM — to technologie, które w zastosowaniach produkcyjnych bywają jeszcze mało dojrzałe, więc warto dopytać, jak realnie wygląda ten zakres.

  • min. 3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku
  • wykształcenie wyższe I stopnia lub wyższe (preferowane: informatyka, elektronika, telekomunikacja, fizyka, automatyka i robotyka)
  • szerokie doświadczenie w pracy z systemami wbudowanymi
  • znajomość architektury ARM oraz doświadczenie z Barebox, U-Boot i jądrem Linux
  • praktyczna znajomość Yocto Project, Buildroot oraz systemów budowania i środowisk CI/CD
  • angielski na poziomie B2

title: Associate III, Catalog Operation[L3] (Search Operations Initiative)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개
Search Operations Initiative는 Search Operations 조직 전반에 걸쳐 산재된 다양한 비즈니스 항목을 하나의 문서 체계로 통합·관리함으로써, 리소스를 효율적으로 활용하고 정보 관리 및 접근성을 향상시키는 역할을 수행합니다. 조직 내에서 수행되고 있는 주요 업무 자료를 표준화된 문서로 정리하고, 이를 교육 자료로 제작·제공함으로써 각 하위 조직이 본연의 Business Goal에 집중할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 또한 Search Relevance ML 모델의 성능 향상을 위한 학습 데이터 제공을 목적으로, HR 운영, 타겟 분배, 대시보드 관리, WBR 운영 등 전반적인 데이터 운영 관리를 담당하고 있습니다. 이러한 활동을 통해 고객에게 보다 정확하고 긍정적인 검색 경험 및 쇼핑 경험을 제공하는 데 기여하고 있습니다.

업무내용
• 검색 품질 및 데이터 운영 - 검색 관련성 평가를 위한 타겟 데이터셋을 관리하고, 데이터 품질 검증 및 운영 정책 수립을 통해 안정적인 Search Labeling 업무를 수행합니다.
• 운영 지표 분석 및 품질·생산성 개선 - 생산성, 품질, 처리량 등 주요 운영 지표를 모니터링하고, 데이터를 기반으로 문제점을 파악하여 운영 품질과 효율을 개선합니다.
• 프로젝트 운영 및 이해관계자 협업 - Search & Discovery, Ads Relevance 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 운영 우선순위를 조율하고, 신규 평가 프로젝트 및 Ad-hoc 업무를 기획·운영하며 발생하는 이슈와 리스크를 해결합니다.
• AI 활용 및 운영 프로세스 고도화 - AI 활용을 위한 데이터 구축과 작업 환경 설계를 지원하고, 업무 자동화 및 SOP·운영 프로세스 개선을 통해 데이터 운영 체계를 지속적으로 고도화합니다.

자격 요건
• 조직의 방향성과 업무 목적을 이해하고, 다양한 관점을 고려하여 의견을 제시하고 조율할 수 있는 분
• Search Labeling 업무 및 프로세스를 이해하고, 새로운 업무와 정책을 빠르게 학습하여 적용할 수 있는 분
• 다양한 유관 부서와 원활하게 협업하며, 합리적인 근거를 바탕으로 의견을 조율할 수 있는 분
• 리소스와 운영 환경을 고려하여 SOP 및 업무 프로세스의 개선점을 발굴하고 효율화할 수 있는 분
• 담당 업무를 주도적으로 수행하고, 발생 가능한 이슈를 파악하여 해결 방안을 제안할 수 있는 분

우대 사항
• 변화에 적응이 빠르고 적극적인 태도로 의견을 제시하고 피드백을 수용 할 수 있는 분
• 자료를 시각화하는데 능하고, 문서작업의 경험이 있으신 분
• 데이터와 관련된 이해도가 높고, 데이터 관련 프로그램 사용 경험이 있는 분 (엑셀/매크로/SQL/tableau 등)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차
• 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항
• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침
• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.
https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류반환정책
1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제 11 조제 6 항에 따른 것 입니다.
2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
3. 위 2 항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
4. 당사는 위 2 항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
5. 단, 위 1 항 내지 4 항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: Product Owner Mijnvergelijker.be
description:
Antwerpen - Bij , onderdeel van DPG Media, helpen we consumenten dagelijks om de juiste keuzes te maken op vlak van financiële producten, verzekeringen, energie en telecom. Onze missie: vergelijken, besparen en bewust kiezen eenvoudig maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Product Owner Bank & Verzekeringen ga je aan de slag met onze marketing, business en development teams om de beste gebruikerservaring te creëren voor Mijnvergelijker.be Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een goede werking van ons platform en juiste oplevering van nieuwe functionaliteiten. We verwelkomen je in een dynamische scale-up omgeving onder de vlag van DPG Media.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van Bank en Verzekeringsproducten op Mijnvergelijker.be

  • Je zorgt voor een product roadmap tot 1 jaar vooruit samen met de Head of Product. Daarnaast zorg je voor een sprintplanning op kwartaalbasis en werkt hier dagelijks aan met het scrumteam.

  • Je neemt een leidende rol in de discovery fase met business voor het bepalen van features, een MVP-versie en doelstellingen.

  • Je zorgt voor analyse en voorbereiding van features en acceptatiecriteria voor het scrumteam i.c.m. team refinements.

  • Stakeholdermanagement is een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw functie. Binnen Online Services werk je samen met de collega’s van IT, Marketing en Customer Care om de beste klantervaring te realiseren. Collega’s weten wat er op jouw planning staat en je communiceert actief over voortgang en resultaat

  • Ook extern heb je regelmatig afstemming met banken en verzekeringsmaatschappijen voor productwijzigingen, verstoringen of nieuwe oplossingen die geïmplementeerd worden.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

Voor deze rol zoeken wij een gedreven professional met een sterke klantfocus. Jij bent ondernemend, betrokken en creatief. Daarnaast bezit jij:

  • Je brengt een sterke trackrecord mee als Product Owner voor een online consumentenplatform en zoekt een wendbare, dynamische omgeving voor je volgende stap.

  • Kom je niet direct uit de consumenten/platform-wereld, maar neem je wel minimaal 5 jaar stevige Product Owner-ervaring mee vanuit een bank, verzekeraar of fintech? Dan maken we net zo graag kennis met je.

  • Ervaring met de agile way of working en hebt daarbij ook je eigen visie hoe je dit efficiënt kunt invullen.

  • Je bent ondernemend en weet van aanpakken. Onze organisatie heeft een sterke ‘can-do’ mentaliteit dus ook als iets nog niet 100% is uitgekristalliseerd durf je een stap vooruit te zetten.

  • Je kunt makkelijk schakelen tussen grotere projecten en kleinere optimalisaties. Je werkt gestructureerd en prioriteert waar nodig in afstemming met de business.

  • Je hebt een sterke klantfocus en maakt continu de afweging tussen het werk dat gedaan moet worden en de waarde die het oplevert.

  • Je hebt ervaring met CX optimalisaties en optimaliseren van klant journeys op basis van data. Je kunt briefings geven aan je collega UX/UI designer en design voorstellen juist beoordelen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk in het Nederlands en Engels, Frans is een plus

  • Je kunt je weg vinden in Agile tooling zoals JIRA of Agile Devops, bekent met Analytics en CX software

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Ook wanneer je niet achter alle vereisten een vinkje kunt zetten. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier!

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Media Campus / DPG Media Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte Mediamaker te zijn!

Wat zit er nog in je pakket?

🌟 Beloning die bij je past: Krijg een salaris dat net zo indrukwekkend is als je cv en talenten.

💻 Alles wat je nodig hebt: We zorgen dat je alles in huis hebt – laptop, telefoon en maaltijdcheques – zodat je helemaal los kunt gaan op je werk.

🛡️ Zorgeloos verzekerd: Met onze verzekering ben je helemaal gedekt, no worries!

📝 Flexibiliteit: Met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerkdagen kies je wat het beste voor jou werkt.

💰 Deel in ons succes: Als DPG Media scoort, scoor jij ook. Extra zakcentjes op basis van onze prestaties. Ka-ching!

🚴 Slimme mobiliteit: Of je nu fietst, met het OV komt of parkeert, jij kiest wat het beste werkt.

🎓 Blijf groeien: Ontdek continu nieuwe hoogtes via de DPG Media Academy. Wie zei dat leren saai moest zijn?

🌴 Tijd voor ontspanning: Met 32 vakantiedagen kun je je batterij weer helemaal opladen.

🏢 Kantoren vol creativiteit: Laat je inspireren in onze bruisende hubs in Antwerpen of Vilvoorde.

🔖 Media Kortingen: Scoor leuke deals op onze media en evenementen. Want wie houdt er niet van een goede deal?

🎉 Top sfeer: Van spontane feestjes tot teamuitjes, hier voel je je meteen thuis. En ons legendarische personeelsfeest? Daar wil je niets van missen!

Solliciteren, en dan?

Ben jij een topper in je vakgebied of heb je de ambitie om dat te worden? Fleur je helemaal op in een warme, creatieve en bruisende omgeving waar je constant uitgedaagd wordt? Solliciteer via de onderstaande button en laten we samen bekijken wat we voor elkaar kunnen betekenen. Want jouw talent is welkom bij DPG Media, ongeacht jouw achtergrond en voorkeuren.

Meer weten neem dan contact op met Toon Hertogs via toon.hertogs@persgroep.net.

title: Junior Python Data Platform Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

We’re a team in Developer Observability, focused on giving engineers the tools and insights they need to ship faster and smarter. Our work supports teams across the organization by improving decision-making and development workflows. We operate as a distributed team across the US and Poland.

Your Impact

We are looking for an Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable systems and data pipelines. You will play a key role in setting engineering standards and driving best practices across the team.

What You’ll Get to Do

  • Design, build, and maintain Python applications, services, engineering tools, and data pipelines.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested Python code, following software engineering best practices.
  • Work with APIs, data processing, automation, and integrations to solve real engineering problems.
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues, improve existing code, and participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Work with technologies such as Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, CI/CD, and containerized environments (with opportunities to learn them on the job)
  • Use AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve coding, debugging, automation, and engineering productivity.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on software development experience, with Python as one of your primary programming languages.
  • Good knowledge of Python fundamentals, including data structures, functions, modules, classes, OOP, exceptions, and package management.
  • Ability to write readable, maintainable, and reusable code, rather than only scripts that solve a single problem.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and external integrations.
  • Understanding of testing and debugging, with experience writing automated tests.
  • Good understanding of Git and modern software development workflows.
  • Good understanding of SQL and databases.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to break larger problems into smaller, manageable pieces.
  • A strong learning mindset and willingness to work with technologies you may not have used before.
  • Ability to ask questions, seek feedback, learn from code reviews, and apply that feedback to future work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building dashboards or data visualizations using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Tableau, or similar.
  • Experience with Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, or other data engineering technologies.
  • Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Terraform or infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk, Prometheus.
  • Experience in developer productivity engineering, including improving engineering tooling and workflows and supporting the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Quality Engineering Lead
description:
We are X, bigly labs, Dis-Chem’s high-performance innovation hub; a place where bold ideas meet data, design, and radical customer focus to reimagine what healthcare can be.

Our mission is to power the future of healthcare by lowering costs, unlocking new possibilities, and improving access to healthcare for all South Africans. We do this through cutting-edge digital solutions that deliver smarter, more human, and truly patient-focused experiences. Here, your work is not limited to a whiteboard; it becomes real. It drives decisions, shapes experiences, and moves healthcare forward. We are driven by one big question: How do we use data and today’s technology to build breakthroughs to better health?

There’s only one question left: are you ready to make healthcare smarter, and actually mean it?

The Quality Engineering Lead is responsible for providing the technical leadership required to embed automation and quality into the earliest stages of the Software Development Lifecycle. The role is primarily focused on establishing and maintaining an automation-first approach to Quality Engineering, ensuring that quality is built into development rather than being treated as a separate testing phase.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related field.
  • Relevant software engineering or Quality Engineering certification advantageous.
  • ISTQB Advanced, Certified Tester, Automation Engineer or equivalent certification advantageous.
  • Relevant DevOps, Cloud, Agile or CI/CD certification advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile and DevOps practices.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Shift Left Quality Engineering and automation-first principles.
  • 5–8 years' experience in Software Quality Engineering, Test Automation or Software Engineering.
  • Minimum 2–4 years' experience leading automation initiatives or acting as a technical QE/Test Automation Lead.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated testing frameworks.
  • Strong programming experience in at least one modern programming language, preferably Java, C#, JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience with API, UI, integration, contract, component and regression automation.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience implementing automated quality gates within Pull Requests and branch workflows.
  • Experience working with Git branching strategies and applying quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Experience with Shift Left testing, including unit, component, API, contract and integration testing.
  • Experience with cloud-native, microservices, REST APIs and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with test data, service virtualisation and environment management.
  • Experience with performance, security and resilience testing is advantageous.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering and testing tools to improve automation productivity is advantageous.
  • Experience working within Agile engineering teams and coaching developers on automation and quality practices.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING?

  • Design, implement and continuously improve scalable automation frameworks aligned to the QE strategy.
  • Embed automated quality checks at the earliest appropriate stage of development, including commit, build and Pull Request validation.
  • Implement and maintain automated quality gates aligned to the engineering branching strategy, ensuring changes meet defined quality standards before promotion.
  • Increase meaningful automated coverage across unit, API, component, integration, UI and regression testing based on risk and business criticality.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testability, automation performance, reliability and developer feedback loops.
  • Coach engineers and QE practitioners to build quality and automation into their development practices.

WHO YOU ARE?

  • Familiarity with agile product development cycles
  • Ability to balance strategic clarity with on-the-ground practicalities
  • Excellent communicator, with the ability to translate technical concepts to business audiences
  • Empathetic, collaborative, and trusted by both business and technical teams
  • Holds high standards in documentation, clarity, and delivery

Our values show up in how we think, build, and make choices that make an impact. We are building a culture that drives progress; one that fixes friction, chases what changes, and owns the outcome. We design with tomorrow in mind, ask sharper questions, and answer them with care, urgency, and systems that scale.

Think you’ve got energy, curiosity, and guts? Come hold the space, make it matter, and own a breakthrough.

title: Juristi
description:
Haemme juristia määräaikaiseen palvelussuhteeseen laki- ja hallintomenettely-yksikköön.

Tehtäviin kuuluvat kunnallishallintoon, toimialan lainsäädäntöön ja vahingonkorvauksiin liittyvät juridiset selvitys- ja valmistelutehtävät sekä juridinen konsultaatio.

Tervetuloa työskentelemään asiantuntijayksikköömme! Yksikössämme työskentelee hallinnon asiantuntijoita ja juristeja. Pidämme osaltamme huolta siitä, että toimialan toiminta ja päätöksenteko täyttää sille laista seuraavat vaatimukset. Yksikössämme on tällä hetkellä 8 työntekijää.

Meidän joukossamme et jää yksin, sillä työmme perustuu vahvaan kollegiaaliseen tukeen, yhteistyöhön ja verkostomaiseen työskentelyyn. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyökykyä ja joustavaa työskentelyotetta. Noudatamme yksikössämme yhteisöohjautuvuuden periaatteita ja jaettua johtajuutta, jossa jokainen työntekijä työskentelee yhteisten tavoitteiden eteen ja ottaa niistä vastuuta.

Toivomme sinulta aktiivista työskentelyotetta ja osallistumista yksikön toimintaan tarvittaessa myös omaa tehtävää laajemmin. Teemme työtämme monipaikkaisesti.

Arvostamme kykyä laajojen asiakokonaisuuksien haltuunottamiseen. Toivomme, että olet ratkaisukeskeinen, kehittämisorientoitunut ja työskentelyäsi ohjaa asiakaslähtöinen ajattelu.


Miksi töihin meille?

Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman työnantajan henkilöstöedut, kuten jopa 550 euron Epassi Flex -edun käytettäväksi työmatkoihin sekä kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa: https://www.hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille


Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4977,46 €/kk. Sen lisäksi maksetaan myös mahdollinen KVTES:n mukainen kokemuslisä.

Jätäthän hakemuksesi 30.9.2026 klo 16 mennessä. Henkilökohtaiset haastattelut järjestetään mahdollisimman pian hakuajan päättymisen jälkeen.


Kelpoisuusehdot:

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehto on oikeustieteen maisterin tutkinto.

Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

Luemme eduksi kunnallishallinnon ja kasvatuksen ja koulutuksen toimialaan liittyvän lainsäädännön tuntemuksen ja kokemuksen toimialaan liittyvien juridisten tehtävien hoitamisesta julkishallinnossa.


Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.

title: EMEA Market Solutions Director
description:
At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

EMEA Market Solutions Director

Skillsoft is hiring an experienced Market Solutions Director to make an impact and drive ARR growth, improve retention, drive a great customer experience, and guide teams through change with clarity and pace. We are seeking a strong operator, coach, and change agent who can turn strategy into repeatable execution across the EMEA markets.

The Market Solutions Director will have the opportunity to be a player/coach and deliver regional results and own the Customer Experience and growth engine for EMEA. Overseeing the regional Market Solutions Leaders and ensuring consistent, disciplined execution across the customer lifecycle to include presales, adoption, expansion and renewal. This role operates as an executive people leader, global practice owner, and partners closely with the EMEA VP of Sales as the region's primary Go To Market change leaders for the region sustaining team confidence, clarity, and pace through continued change.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the Geographical Market Solutions Teams

  • Manage, coach, and develop the MSLs across the geography; set clear performance standards and accountability.
  • Ensure Market Solutions Leaders (MSLs) execute the end-to-end customer solution lifecycle (Sale → Value → Expand → Renew) with MEDDPICC rigor and value-realization discipline.
  • Build a high-performance, coaching-first culture aligned to Skillsoft's Enterprise Leadership Skills; build team capabilities systematically.
  • Guarantee the MSL’s align Solutions Partners across markets to match opportunity size, complexity, and urgency.

Coach Solutioning Capability and Lead Through Transformation

  • Coach MSLs and their teams on advanced solutioning - executive discovery and problem framing, solution architecture and design, value narrative and business case development, and platform and ecosystem expertise
  • Steer the team through an organization in transformation: guide teams through evolving roles, new operating models, and shifting customer expectations with clarity, confidence, and pace
  • Support MSLs in developing the CSM function as a strategic advisor capability - fluent in skills intelligence, data-led insight, executive engagement, and outcome-based partnership rather than reactive account management
  • Support the MSLs in developing Solution Partners as expert customer-facing advisors - deep in product and platform, disciplined in solution design methodology, and credible with C-suite buying committees
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows and tooling to expand strategic capacity and reduce administrative load

Deliver Regional Revenue and Customer Outcomes

  • Co-own regional targets with the EMEA Geo Sales Leaders (AVP): ARR growth, retention, expansion, NPS, and platform conversion.
  • Oversee regional performance management cadences to drive continuous improvement and results; escalate and resolve at-risk accounts; enable growth across accounts.

Own the Global Component – Shared / Channel Teams

  • Define the charter and target operating model for global shared/channel solution teams.
  • Establish rules of engagement between shared CSM pools, MSLs, direct sales, and channel partners.
  • Build channel enablement content and playbooks for solution positioning through partners.
  • Design coverage tiers so tier-2/tier-3 customers receive scalable, high-quality solution support.
  • Report on channel-sourced ARR and shared-team utilization to the Global Solutions Leader.

Drive Cross-Regional Consistency

  • Serve as a member of the Global Solutions Management team alongside peer GMSLs, the Solutions IP Team lead, and the Program Manager.
  • Responsible for ensuring global standards are applied in-region while allowing appropriate local tailoring for market realities.
  • Share regional insights back into the global system — customer patterns, competitive intel, and solution feedback — to inform IP and roadmap.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the Solutions IP Team to translate defined solutions and POVs into repeatable, market-ready plays.
  • Interlock with Professional Services regional leadership on clean presales-to-delivery handoffs.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close feedback loops from field to global functions.
  • Support the Program Manager in keeping data clean, systems used, and operating rhythm consistent.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive management experience in enterprise PaaS spanning some combination of Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting/Pre-Sales, and/or Professional Services.
  • Overseeing Professional / Managed Services and Solutioning (or consulting) experience with demonstrated results driving long-term customer growth with services engagements based on business cases.
  • Proven track record of delivering ARR growth, retention, and expansion in a platform and solutions-based selling motion.
  • Proficient in Salesforce and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Deep fluency in MEDDPICC (or equivalent), value-based selling, and end-to-end customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience as a practice or system builder — designing repeatable processes, tools, or capability models adopted at scale.
  • Possess a strong operational rigor with proficiency in forecasting, pipeline inspection, and data-driven outcomes
  • Have a deep familiarity with EMEA market dynamics.
  • Executive presence with proven ability to engage C-suite customers and internal senior leadership.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience operating in a matrixed global organization and collaborating with strong partnership across Product, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and Marketing.
  • Familiarity with the Learning technologies and L&D functions, learning/talent ecosystems, and AI-enabled workforce transformation.

Skillsoft uses AI-enabled tools to screen applications. Recruitment and hiring decisions are made by Skillsoft personnel and are not based solely on automated processing.

Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in AI-native skills management for the human + AI era. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Shiji Group provides software solutions and services for the hospitality, food service, retail and entertainment industries, ranging from hotel management solutions, to food and beverage and retail systems, payment gateways, data management, online distribution and more.

Founded in 1998 as a network solutions provider for hotels, and later changed to a software provider for the whole consumer market, Shiji Group today comprises 5,000 employees in 80+ subsidiaries and brands, serving over 91,000 hotels, 200,000 restaurants and 600,000 retail outlets.

Shiji is committed to connecting the global business of hospitality. We provide an integrated suite of technological solutions that empower hotel, retail, food, and entertainment companies to better connect with their guests.

Daylight PMS is a distributed system that serves the hospitality industry. It is a solution that allows hotel employees or hotel managers to handle various activities such as managing reservations, payments and hotel services within the hotel or between hotels. The system consists of many domain-oriented microservices developed under a few cross-functional teams.

  • Collaborate with Development Teams: Work closely with developers to understand their needs and provide operational support.
  • Environment Management: Maintain and monitor application environments across different AWS regions to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Infrastructure Updates: Implement and manage infrastructure changes and updates using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment: Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, tests, and deployments using tools like GitLab CI.

Technologies used:

  • Terraform, Helm

  • We write all of our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terragrunt
  • Our application that is written in .NET Core runs on top of Kubernetes cluster deployed in EKS
  • We have very large observability stack that includes collecting logs and metrics and visualizing it in Grafana and Kibana
  • Cloud Infrastructure Team is also responsible for managing GitLab, Jenkins and Nexus
  • We write our internal tool set using Python and Golang

Additional Information

  • Please note that: We are looking for candidates based in the Silesia region (office in Katowice. Fully remote work is not an option, and unfortunately, applications from more distant locations will not be considered in the recruitment process.

title: Medewerker Logistiek (38 uur)
description:
Zorg jij ervoor dat alle producten altijd op voorraad zijn zodat we nooit lege schappen hebben? Kom werken bij BAUHAUS!

Als medewerker logistiek zorg je er samen met jouw collega’s voor dat alle binnengekomen producten in de juiste schappen terecht komen en administratief worden verwerkt. Ook komen klanten regelmatig bestellingen afhalen. Deze worden van tevoren door jou of jouw collega’s verpakt.   • Je hebt mbo werk- en denk niveau.

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om af en toe op koopavonden of in het weekend te werken.

  • Je hebt goede communicatieve skills en je vindt het leuk om in contact te staan met klanten.

  • Je bent 38 uur per week beschikbaar.

  • Het hebben van een geldig heftruckcertificaat is een pré. Het is ook mogelijk om deze te halen als je bij ons in dienst komt!

Wat mag jij van ons verwachten?

  • 💰 Salaris: Een salaris vanaf €2.491 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 38 uur) exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Afhankelijk van jouw leeftijd en ervaring kan dit uiteraard hoger zijn!

  • 🚗 Reiskostenvergoeding: €0,23 per km (vanaf 10 km, max. 50 km enkele reis).

  • 🛍️ Personeelskorting: 10% korting op onze toch al aller laagste prijzen.

  • 🎉 Bonusregeling: Behalen wij ons resultaat? Dan ontvang je een extra bonus als dank voor jouw inzet!

  • 🚀 Ontwikkeling: BAUHAUS is een erkend leerbedrijf. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen door het volgen van diverse opleidingen en cursussen.

  • 🙂 Gezellige werksfeer: Je wordt onderdeel van de BAUHAUS familie met enorm leuke collega’s die elke dag voor elkaar klaar staan. Ook heb je de mogelijkheid tot deelname aan de personeelsvereniging met de leukste feestjes en uitjes!

BAUHAUS is een internationale doe-het-zelf retailer met meer dan 275 vestigingen in 19 landen. Sinds 2015 zijn we actief in Nederland en blijven we groeien. Kun jij niet wachten om de klanten met een glimlach en mooie producten de deur uit te laten gaan en denk je goed te passen binnen onze BAUHAUS familie? Dan zien wij graag jouw CV tegemoet. We kunnen niet wachten om jou te leren kennen!

Onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure is:
- Een integriteitscontrole via het Waarschuwingsregister van de stichting Fraude Aanpak Detailhandel.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Een tip voor een nieuwe collega wel!

title: Geospatial / Engineering Surveyor
description:
Geospatial/Engineering Surveyor, London

We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.
Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance.

Position Overview

We are looking for experienced Geospatial / Engineering Surveyor to join our Digital Engineering team in London.

This is an exciting opportunity for surveyors with strong land and engineering surveying experience who are also confident working with modern reality-capture technologies. The role will involve working across a variety of infrastructure, construction and built-environment projects, using a combination of traditional surveying techniques and 3D laser scanning.

What You Will Do

  • Carrying out topographical, engineering, control and as-built surveys
  • Using Total Stations, GNSS/RTK equipment and 3D laser scanning technology
  • Supporting engineering surveying and setting-out activities
  • Establish, maintain and verify survey control networks, datums and coordinate systems.
  • Understand point cloud registration and processing workflows sufficiently to ensure data captured on site is suitable for downstream processing.
  • Planning and delivering survey fieldwork to meet project requirements
  • Capturing accurate, high-quality survey data across a range of projects
  • Collaborating with Geospatial Engineering, CAD, BIM and Digital Engineering teams
  • Support junior surveyors and less experienced team members where appropriate.
  • Maintaining the highest standards of health, safety and quality on-site

What You Will Bring

  • Qualification in Land Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Proficiency with Total Stations and GNSS/RTK surveying equipment
  • Experience undertaking terrestrial laser scanning surveys
  • Good understanding of survey control, traversing, coordinate systems, datums and survey accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of field QA/QC and the ability to identify missing or potentially inaccurate data before leaving site.
  • Ability to work independently and manage field operations effectively
  • Experience within construction, infrastructure or the built environment
  • The right to work in the UK
  • Flexibility to travel nationwide as required by our clients
  • Possess a full clean manual driving license

Benefits You Will Love

At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience
  • Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools
  • Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance
  • Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives
  • Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert
  • Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution
  • Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme

Equal Employment Opportunity

Woolpert is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, and promote without regard to protected characteristics. For more information, see our EEO resources.

Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com

Agency Notice

Please do not contact any employee of Woolpert or its subsidiaries about this requisition. Agencies not engaged by the Woolpert Talent Acquisition Team will not be eligible for fee payment.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Angular)
description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

We're seeking a Full Stack Developer to join our product team and contribute across backend architecture and customer-facing interfaces. You'll collaborate with the Team Lead, Product Manager, and Product Designer to build reliable, secure, high-quality software.

As part of the team, you'll participate in code reviews, uphold strong testing practices, and effectively use AI-assisted development tools like Cursor or Claude Code.

What You'll Do

Backend Development

  • Build and evolve backend applications in .NET 10 and C# 14

  • Design REST APIs that are consistent, secure, and well-documented

  • Work with PostgreSQL database structures, and help optimize queries, indexes, and overall performance

Frontend Development

  • Build user interfaces in Angular/React and TypeScript

  • Take an active role in our frontend rewrite using Angular/React

  • Ensure UI implementations are performant, maintainable, and true to the product design

Quality & Testing

  • Treat unit and integration testing as a core part of development, not an afterthought

  • Participate in code reviews with clear, constructive feedback

  • Write clean, secure, maintainable code aligned with our standards

AI-Assisted Development

  • Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate development, code analysis, and refactoring

  • Critically evaluate the correctness, quality, security, and performance of AI-generated code before it ships

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Work within GitHub and CI/CD to deliver features reliably and on time

  • Collaborate closely with your Team Lead, Product Manager, and Product Designer, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies

  • Share knowledge with the team

What We're Looking For

  • Solid hands-on experience with .NET and C#

  • Experience building interfaces in Angular/React and TypeScript

  • Experience designing REST APIs and working with PostgreSQL

  • A genuine testing habit — unit and integration tests as standard practice

  • Comfort participating in code reviews and giving direct, useful feedback

  • Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools, and the judgment to critically assess what they produce

  • Good command of English and strong collaboration skills within a cross-functional team

Why This Role Matters

This isn't just about shipping features — it's about contributing to a team that raises its own technical bar. You'll have real input into technical decisions, architecture, and process, working alongside a Team Lead, Product Manager, Product Designer, and the wider Engineering and Platform teams.

title: Commercieel Medewerker
location: Koudekerk aan den Rijn, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Wil jij jouw commerciële ervaring inzetten om klanten te adviseren én relaties te versterken? Lees dan snel verder en ontdek jouw rol als Commercieel Medewerker bij RECO!"

Jouw baan als Commercieel Medewerker bij RECO

Als Commercieel Medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor zakelijke klanten. Word je gebeld met een verzoek voor een verhuuraanvraag? Dan zorg jij wel dat het geregeld wordt! Van het verwerken in ons CRM-systeem tot aan het regelen van het transport met de transportplanner, after-sales en het afhandelen van schades.

Klanten waarderen jou om je passende adviezen

Weet de klant nog niet zeker welk materieel hij het beste kan huren? Dan vertel jij hem er alles over zodat hij de juiste beslissing kan maken. En als jij het ook niet weet? Dan helpt één van je gespecialiseerde collega’s, om tot het beste advies te komen.

Relatiebeheer: blij maken van vaste klanten

Je zult merken dat RECO veel vaste klanten heeft waarmee we een jarenlange samenwerking hebben. Relatiebeheer vinden wij daarom heel belangrijk. Net als service, kwaliteit en flexibiliteit. Jij onderhoudt het contact met onze vaste klanten en nodigt ze bij ons uit om samenwerkingen uit te breiden. Kortom; een uitdagende salesfunctie op onze binnendienst, waarbij je van A tot Z betrokken bent bij onze verhuurorders en de vrijheid krijgt om zelf je eigen klanten te beheren.

Ben je enthousiast, maar twijfel je of je voldoet aan het profiel? Solliciteer dan toch, want ambitie en motivatie vinden we belangrijker dan ervaring en opleidingsrichting!

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met:

✅ Een afwisselende baan in een dynamisch, informeel en groeiend bedrijf waar jij écht gezien wordt;

✅ 28 - 31 vakantiedagen per jaar, zodat je ook kunt genieten van je vrije tijd;

✅ De mogelijkheid om je te ontwikkelen middels cursussen en opleidingen;

✅ Goede pensioenregeling, maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO!;

✅ Een hoop leuke uitjes en events (elk bedrijf roept dat, maar hier ervaar je het echt – lees er meer over op onze pagina ‘RECO Cultuur’)’.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Van aanpakken weet en goed prioriteiten kunt stellen;

  • Je beschikt over MBO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en hebt minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • Snel kunt schakelen, vanwege de dynamische werkzaamheden die bij de functie horen;

  • Een servicegerichte, maar ook een commerciële instelling hebt;

  • Proactief en oplossingsgericht bent;

  • Interesse of ervaring hebt in de bouwbranche of de verhuur van materieel.

Ik ben enthousiast! Wat nu?

Neem dan contact op met onze collega Ilona, zij staat je graag te woord! Bel op 06 48 0550 72, of stuur een whatsapp bericht. Je kunt natuurlijk ook direct het sollicitatieformulier invullen!

Wij vervullen onze vacatures graag zelf, om die reden stellen wij acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature niet op prijs!

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
About the Role:

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) serves as the highest-ranking executive in the organization, responsible for setting the strategic vision and ensuring its successful execution to drive sustainable growth and long-term value. This role demands a dynamic leader who can inspire and align diverse teams, foster a culture of innovation, and navigate complex business environments with agility and foresight. The CEO acts as the primary liaison between the board of directors, stakeholders, and the broader organization, ensuring transparent communication and accountability. They are tasked with overseeing operational excellence while championing change management initiatives that enhance organizational adaptability and resilience. Ultimately, the CEO’s leadership shapes the company’s reputation, market position, and overall impact within the industry and community.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a senior executive leadership role, preferably as a CEO, COO, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated success in strategic planning and execution within complex business environments.
  • Strong technical acumen and familiarity with technology trends relevant to the industry.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading organizations through significant change or transformation initiatives.
  • Background in culturally diverse and global business environments.
  • Track record of building and sustaining high-performing teams and collaborative relationships.
  • Advanced certifications or training in leadership development, change management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working with boards of directors and managing investor relations.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive strategic plans that align with the company’s mission and market opportunities.
  • Lead, mentor, and inspire executive leadership and cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals and foster a high-performance culture.
  • Oversee financial performance, budgeting, and resource allocation to ensure operational efficiency and profitability.
  • Serve as the primary spokesperson and representative of the company to stakeholders, investors, partners, and the public.
  • Drive change management initiatives that support innovation, cultural adaptability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Skills:

The CEO utilizes executive presence and leadership skills daily to inspire confidence and guide the organization through complex challenges. Strategic planning and execution skills are critical for setting priorities, allocating resources, and driving initiatives that align with long-term objectives. Technical and technology skills enable the CEO to understand emerging trends and leverage innovation to maintain competitive advantage. Team and relationship building are essential for fostering collaboration, motivating employees, and cultivating partnerships that support growth. Effective communication and presentation skills ensure clear messaging to diverse audiences, while change management expertise helps the CEO lead transformational efforts with compassion, cultural sensitivity, and adaptability.

title: Oproepchauffeur
description:
Lekker onderweg, flexibel werken en geen dag hetzelfde? Dan zijn wij bij Van Mossel Bedrijfswagencentrum in Tilburg op zoek naar jou!

Voor ons team zijn wij op zoek naar een oproepchauffeur. In deze functie ben je 5 dagen per week beschikbaar, maar het aantal uren dat je daadwerkelijk werkt, is afhankelijk van de hoeveelheid werk. De ene week kan dus wat drukker zijn dan de andere.

Deze functie is bijvoorbeeld ideaal als je met pensioen bent, maar nog graag actief bezig wilt blijven en het leuk vindt om onder de mensen te zijn. Je hebt de vrijheid van flexibel werken, maar blijft tegelijkertijd lekker bezig.

Wat ga je doen?

Als oproepchauffeur zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten en bedrijfswagens op de juiste plek komen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het wegbrengen van klanten naar hun bestemming;

  • Het ophalen en terugbrengen van bedrijfswagens;

  • Bedrijfswagens door de wasstraat halen;

  • Ervoor zorgen dat de bedrijfswagens er weer netjes en verzorgd uitzien voor de klant;

  • Waar nodig ondersteunen bij andere praktische werkzaamheden rondom onze voertuigen.

Geen dag is precies hetzelfde. Het ene moment ben je onderweg met een klant, het volgende moment zorg je ervoor dat een bedrijfswagen weer netjes klaarstaat.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken iemand die:

  • 5 dagen per week beschikbaar is;

  • In het bezit is van een geldig rijbewijs B;

  • Graag onderweg is en het leuk vindt om met mensen om te gaan;

  • Betrouwbaar en representatief is;

  • Zelfstandig kan werken en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de voertuigen;

  • Flexibel is en het niet erg vindt dat het aantal werkuren per week kan verschillen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een flexibele functie als oproepchauffeur bij Van mossel Bedrijfswagencentrum;

  • Afwisselend werk en veel vrijheid;

  • Een prettige werkomgeving in Tilburg;

  • De mogelijkheid om lekker actief bezig te blijven, zonder een vaste fulltime werkweek;

  • Een functie waarbij je direct bijdraagt aan een goede service voor onze klanten.

Lijkt het jou leuk om ons team in Tilburg te versterken als oproepchauffeur? Dan horen we graag van je!

Solliciteer direct via onze website.
