title: DevOps Engineer (K/M) - Dział Rozwoju Oprogramowania
description:
Standort: Poznan


Fachbereich: Development


Karrierelevel: Mid


O nas


Tworzymy i rozwijamy autorskie produkty oraz dedykowane aplikacje dla dużych polskich i międzynarodowych przedsiębiorstw. Budujemy je w architekturze mikroserwisowej, w Javie, .NET, Node.js, TypeScripcie i uruchamiamy w kontenerach.


Nasze systemy działają w All for One Data Center, w infrastrukturach klientów oraz w chmurach publicznych: AWS, Azure i GCP. Wybór dostawcy chmury nie jest tu kluczowy, ponieważ pracujemy przede wszystkim z warstwą aplikacyjną i z procesem jej dostarczania.


Rekrutujemy do Działu Rozwoju Oprogramowania, dlatego stanowisko jest bliżej obszaru Dev niż Ops. Infrastrukturę przygotowuje i utrzymuje nasz dział IT lub klient: system operacyjny, sieć, silnik Dockera oraz klaster Kubernetes.


Twoja odpowiedzialność zaczyna się warstwę wyżej, przy aplikacji i procesie jej dostarczania. Część zagadnień planujemy wspólnie z IT, dlatego cenimy zrozumienie również warstwy niższej. Szukamy osoby, która zadba o to, aby nasze rozwiązania można było sprawnie zbudować, wdrożyć i utrzymać w każdym środowisku, w którym pracują.


Do Twoich Zadań Będzie Należeć



  • rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD dla aplikacji w Javie, .NET i Node.js/TypeScripcie,

  • przygotowywanie obrazów kontenerów oraz pakowanie wdrożeń w Helm charty, wersjonowane dla poszczególnych środowisk i klientów,

  • wdrażanie aplikacji na klaster Kubernetes i konfiguracja warstwy kontenerowej, w tym zasobów, limitów i skalowania,

  • konfiguracja komponentów warstwy aplikacyjnej, na przykład serwerów aplikacyjnych i reverse proxy, oraz automatyzacja tych czynności w Ansible,

  • automatyzacja instalacji i aktualizacji produktu, również w środowiskach klientów,

  • konfiguracja i rozwój monitoringu, zbierania logów oraz alertowania,

  • rozbudowa pipeline’ów o bramki jakościowe: analizę SonarQube, testy automatyczne i skanowanie zależności,

  • zarządzanie konfiguracją i sekretami aplikacji w sposób bezpieczny dla środowisk produkcyjnych,

  • udział w projektowaniu rozwiązań: strategie wdrożeń bez przestoju, skalowalność, spójność środowisk deweloperskich, testowych i produkcyjnych,

  • wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w diagnostyce problemów środowiskowych.


Wymagania



  • minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze CI/CD i automatyzacji dostarczania oprogramowania,

  • praktyczna znajomość Dockera: budowanie i optymalizacja obrazów, sieci, wolumeny, diagnostyka,

  • doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetesem w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz umiejętność diagnozowania problemów z uruchamianiem i wydajnością aplikacji w klastrze,

  • znajomość Helma na poziomie tworzenia i utrzymania własnych chartów,

  • umiejętność pisania idempotentnych playbooków i ról w Ansible,

  • doświadczenie z Jenkinsem i GitHub Actions w modelu pipeline as code,

  • swobodna praca z Gitem i SonarQube w zespole deweloperskim,

  • znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i analizy logów; naszym standardem są Prometheus, Grafana oraz Loki lub Graylog,

  • dobra znajomość systemu Linux oraz umiejętność pisania skryptów w Bashu,

  • język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2, ponieważ pracujemy w środowisku międzynarodowym.


Mile Widziane



  • znajomość Terraform, przynajmniej na poziomie czytania i rozumienia kodu; infrastrukturę planujemy wspólnie z działem IT,

  • znajomość jednego z języków, w których tworzymy nasze produkty: Javy, TypeScriptu lub .NET, w zakresie pozwalającym analizować kod aplikacji i jej wymagania uruchomieniowe,

  • doświadczenie z podejściem GitOps oraz narzędziami ArgoCD lub Flux,

  • doświadczenie operacyjne z bazami PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra lub Solr,

  • wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w pracy inżynierskiej, w tym GitHub Copilot oraz rozwiązań opartych o modele językowe,

  • certyfikaty potwierdzające kompetencje w obszarze DevOps.


Oferujemy



  • Możliwość pracy hybrydowej - 2 dni w tygodniu z biura w Poznaniu na ul. Ratajczaka,

  • Pracę przy rozwoju produktów, a nie w obszarze utrzymania zgłoszeń,

  • Wpływ na kształt procesów CI/CD i standardy techniczne w zespołach produktowych,

  • Kontakt z kilkoma stosami technologicznymi w ramach jednej architektury,

  • Możliwość rozwoju w kierunku platform engineeringu, SRE lub architektury rozwiązań,

  • Pracę w zgranym, nastawionym na rozwój zespole, otwartym na nowe pomysły i dzielenie się wiedzą.

title: Partnership Director
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Partner Director for our team in Spain!

You will be responsible for leading the Partner team in Portugal and Spain, focusing on strategic account management and team leadership. This role involves guiding the team to prospect new partners, manage key relationships, ensure partner satisfaction, and drive the team toward achieving their objectives. The director will balance executive day-to-day tasks with long-term strategic planning, ensuring alignment with company goals and fostering a high-performance team environment.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead and manage the Partner team in the countries, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Provide direct supervision to the team, offering guidance and support for their performance and development, while maintaining alignment with company objectives.
  • Lead the end-to-end sales cycle for game-changing strategic partnerships, from outreach to launch.
  • Responsible for the strategy and delivery of sales targets in alignment with regional market dynamics.
  • Oversee strategic account management for key partners, ensuring satisfaction and profitability.

title: D2C Marketplace Lead
description:
# 

## Company Overview

Utsav is one of India's leading faith-tech platforms, dedicated to connecting devotees with temples through digital offerings such as puja bookings, daan, bhet, prasad delivery, and spiritual experiences. With a rapidly growing user base and strong partnerships with temples, Utsav aims to become the most trusted digital platform for spiritual engagement globally. The company is redefining how devotees interact with their faith through innovative technology and a customer-centric approach.

## Job Summary

The Head of Commerce (Marketplace) will lead Utsav's marketplace and commerce business, driving category growth, expanding the marketplace, and increasing revenue and profitability. This role requires a strategic and entrepreneurial leader capable of managing P&L, launching new categories, building supply partnerships, and delivering sustainable growth through operational excellence and customer-focused strategies.

## Responsibilities

- **Commerce Strategy & P&L Ownership**

  - Own the end-to-end P&L for Utsav's commerce and marketplace operations.
  - Define and implement strategies for category growth, assortment, pricing, and merchandising.
  - Drive revenue, profitability, contribution margins, and enhance customer lifetime value.
  - Identify new category opportunities and lead the launch of innovative commerce initiatives.

- **Marketplace Growth & Supply Expansion**

  - Build and nurture relationships with suppliers, vendors, and marketplace partners.
  - Expand product assortment and improve marketplace selection.
  - Develop strategic partnerships to strengthen the commerce ecosystem.
  - Drive customer acquisition and retention to grow the marketplace.

- **Category Management & Merchandising**

  - Lead assortment planning, pricing strategies, promotions, and merchandising initiatives.
  - Optimize product mix, inventory performance, and category profitability.
  - Monitor customer behavior and market trends to identify growth opportunities.
  - Use data-driven insights to improve category performance.

- **Customer Growth & Commercial Excellence**

  - Collaborate with Growth and Marketing teams to enhance customer acquisition and retention.
  - Optimize key business metrics such as GMV, revenue, margins, CAC, LTV, and repeat purchase rates.
  - Build scalable processes across supply chain, fulfillment, and operations.
  - Enhance customer experience and operational efficiency throughout the commerce journey.

- **Data & Analytics**

  - Establish dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
  - Monitor category performance, inventory efficiency, supplier performance, and profitability.
  - Develop forecasting models and business plans to support growth.
  - Leverage analytics to identify new growth levers and optimization opportunities.

- **Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  - Work closely with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technology teams.

  - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and execution excellence.
  - Develop scalable processes and playbooks to support future growth.

- Proven experience in building and scaling commerce or marketplace businesses.
- Strong P&L management skills with a track record of driving revenue and profitability.
- Expertise in category management, assortment planning, and merchandising.
- Experience in supplier/vendor relationship management and strategic partnerships.
- Data-driven decision-making skills with proficiency in analytics and forecasting.
- Excellent leadership and team-building capabilities.
- Strong understanding of digital commerce, customer acquisition, and retention strategies.
- Educational qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.

## Preferred Skills

- Experience in faith-tech, e-commerce, or marketplace platforms.
- Knowledge of the Indian digital and retail landscape.
- Familiarity with supply chain, logistics, and operational processes.
- Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to innovate and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

## Experience

- Minimum of 8-10 years of relevant experience in commerce, marketplace, or category management roles.
- Prior experience leading teams and managing large-scale P&L responsibilities.
- Demonstrated success in launching new categories and expanding marketplace ecosystems.

## Environment

This role is typically based in a hybrid or in-office setting, depending on company policies. The environment involves collaboration across multiple teams, strategic planning, and operational execution. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup culture with a focus on innovation and customer satisfaction.

Not specified.

Potential career advancement into senior leadership roles within Utsav or related digital commerce and faith-tech domains.

Not specified.

title: Behavior Enrichment Lead
description:
About the Humane Rescue Alliance (HRA)

For more than 150 years, the Humane Rescue Alliance has championed the protection of animals, support for people, and service to the community. With campuses in the District of Columbia and New Jersey, along with the nation’s leading pet transport initiative, it stands as the largest and most comprehensive animal services provider in the region. Each year, HRA transforms the lives of tens of thousands of animals through rescue and adoption, humane protection, access to medical care, innovative community programs, and legislative leadership. Its broad reach and deep expertise enables HRA to reimagine traditional sheltering and address the most complex challenges facing animals and the people who love them.

Job Summary

The Behavior & Enrichment Lead is responsible for leading and implementing HRA’s animal behavior and enrichment initiatives to ensure the well-being, safety, and successful placement of shelter animals. This role provides behavior support, training resources, and consultations to staff, volunteers, fosters, and community members, with the goal of reducing returns and relinquishments. The position oversees daily animal care and behavior programs, supervises staff and volunteers, conducts intake assessments, develops and facilitates advanced volunteer training, and ensures all behavior practices align with force-free, evidence-based methods.

The Role: What You’ll Do

  • Always represent HRA in a professional and courteous manner. Provide quality service to the public, volunteers, and employees recognizing their individual contributions to the success of the organization.
  • Supervise/delegate animal care tasks to ensure effective completion within HRA SOP/Gs' and best practices
  • Provide and maintain an accurate euthanasia list and schedule for euthanasia to be performed in a timely manner.
  • Provide fosters, adopters, and community members with behavior support, training resources, and consultations to reduce returns and relinquishments.
  • Conduct regular revenue-generating behavioral consultations, as determined by the Chief of Operations
  • Conduct intake interviews for all canines, as well as felines with behavior concerns.
  • Coach and train new animal care staff through onboarding and ongoing professional development, providing guidance, feedback, and cross-training to strengthen knowledge of shelter operations, safe handling, enrichment, and behavior best practices for staff and advanced volunteer teams.
  • Develop, update, and facilitate advanced volunteer training programs and related protocols (e.g., Volunteer Behavior Assistants, Purple Level)
  • Design and provide enrichment and behavioral interventions for shelter animals (including requests for medication), especially higher-need cases (HLE, LOS, rapid deterioration) based on behavior and/or length of stay.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate daily enrichment and behavior programs (e.g. playgroups, interactive feeding, sensory garden, individualized, and generalized enrichment plans) for all eligible in-shelter animals.
  • Work alongside the Animal Care and Enrichment team in daily activities including cleaning, feeding, walking, and enrichment of all the animals in HRA’s care. Giving special attention to the animals in 15O housing space.
  • Continuously improve behavioral and enrichment programs based on data and best practices.
  • Ensuring timely reporting and addressing of all behavior concerns for in-shelter and foster animals
  • Ensure all pertinent behavior information on an animal is communicated accordingly, including clear documentation in PetPoint.
  • Observe and document unusual behavior, signs of illness and any injury of an animal daily.
  • Conduct daily department and weekly shelter rounds to ensure all behavior, handling, housing, and enrichment practices are force-free, evidence-based, and aligned with Fear Free® methods and the Association of Shelter Veterinarians Guidelines for Standards of Care in Animal Shelters Communicate vital information to appropriate departments as needed, via protocols outlined in SOP/Gs'
  • Provide expert input on placement suitability (e.g. adoption, transport, foster, field trip, euthanasia)
  • Restrain, confine, and handle animals, including those who are ill, injured, quarantined, and aggressive, including during euthanasia procedures
  • Bathe or clean animals as needed.
  • Perform other duties and projects, as assigned
  • “Develop and lead special projects for HRA, including continuing education initiatives and applied research to support professional growth and organizational advancement.

Qualifications – Education & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of canine and feline behavior, body language, and enrichment strategies that support the physical and psychological well-being of shelter animals.

  • Familiarity with safe handling, restraint, and general animal care practices across multiple species.

  • Proficiency in behavior modification techniques using force-free, science-based methods.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation and behavior reporting.

  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and conflict-resolution skills in a fast-paced, emotionally charged environment.

  • Computer literacy, including Microsoft Office, email, internet, and shelter software (e.g., PetPoint); ability to track and analyze program outcomes.

  • Ability to train, coach, and deliver educational content to staff, volunteers, and community members.

  • Ability to troubleshoot concerns and provide leadership support when supervisors/managers are unavailable.

  • Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in animal welfare, sheltering, or training (direct shelter experience strongly preferred).

Where You'll Work: Physical Requirements & Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the primary functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Ability to safely handle animals of varying sizes and temperaments, including fearful or aggressive individuals.
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs unassisted, 50+ lbs assisted, and walk large dogs.
  • Comfort with strenuous physical activity (lifting, reaching, bending, squatting, moving about facilities).
  • Ability to work in variable environments (extreme temperatures, noises, sights, odors) and outdoors in all weather.
  • Comfortable working with cats, dogs, small animals, reptiles, fish, and wildlife.
  • Due to the nature of shelter work, may be exposed to allergens, zoonotic diseases, fractious/aggressive/deceased animals, euthanasia procedures, hostile or irate persons, and emotionally difficult situations, with limited alterations available.

Other Requirements:

  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, and compassionate communication with staff, volunteers, and community members.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills; able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Reliability, integrity, punctuality, and ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Positive, proactive, and adaptable attitude in a high-stress, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for HRA’s mission and for supporting animals and guardians without judgment or bias.
  • Ability to manage the emotional aspects of shelter work, including euthanasia decisions, in a professional manner.
  • Previous behavior experience in a shelter setting

Certifications (Preferred, not required):

  • Fear Free® Shelter Certification.
  • CPDT-KA, KPA CTP, IAABC credentials, or active pursuit of certification (e.g., IAABC Shelter Affiliate)

Ready to Make an Impact?

Apply today and become part of a team where your compassion, skills, and commitment will directly save lives and strengthen communities.

The Humane Rescue Alliance (HRA) offers a comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, vision, dental and select offerings for pets. Additional information may be provided upon request.

Multilingual candidates are encouraged to apply. A salary premium may be offered for multilingual candidates who demonstrate proficiency in written and oral testing.

HRA is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate because of race, color, creed, gender, religion, national origin, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, citizenship status, or sexual orientation. Accommodation will be provided to qualified individuals requiring them.

Zmieniamy świat na lepsze

Słyszałeś już o naszych farmach wiatrowych, fotowoltaicznych czy technologiach wodorowych? Być może sam korzystasz z naszych rozwiązań technologicznych lub stacji ładowania samochodów elektrycznych?

Jesteśmy największą polską prywatną grupą energetyczną – korzystamy z wiatru i słońca, tworząc całkowicie czyste, odnawialne źródła energii. Naszą misją jest tworzenie lepszego świata dla nas i przyszłych pokoleń. Chcemy być liderem tej zmiany w Polsce i w Europie.

Polenergia to wiarygodny i silny Pracodawca. Rozwijamy biznes w zgodzie z najlepszymi praktykami w obszarze ESG. Od 2005 roku jesteśmy notowani na Giełdzie Papierów Wartościowych w Warszawie.

Dołącz do nas i bądź częścią Zielonej Transformacji!

Tworzymy „zieloną” kulturę organizacyjną

Ekologię rozumiemy nie tylko jako dbanie o nasze środowisko, ale również budowanie sprzyjającej i efektywnej atmosfery pracy. Szanujemy wzajemnie swój czas, uwzględniamy dzielące nas różnice, jak również czerpiemy z tego, co nas łączy.

Na co dzień napędza nas biznes, ale jako zespół różnorodnych pracowników, angażujemy się także w działania edukacyjne i dobroczynne.

Miejsce pracy: Warszawa

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Projektowanie, implementacja i utrzymanie procesów ETL/ELT w środowisku Azure
  • Budowa i orkiestracja pipeline’ów danych z wykorzystaniem Azure Data Factory
  • Tworzenie rozwiązań serverless w oparciu o Azure Functions
  • Samodzielna praca na platformie Databricks – przetwarzanie i transformacja danych (PySpark)
  • Projektowanie i wdrażanie rozwiązań zgodnych z medallion architecture (warstwy bronze/silver/gold) z wykorzystaniem Delta Lake
  • Zarządzanie danymi i uprawnieniami z wykorzystaniem Unity Catalog, w tym dbanie o governance i lineage danych
  • Tworzenie i rozwój Data Products oraz zarządzanie ich cyklem życia
  • Pisanie wydajnych zapytań SQL oraz optymalizacja procesów przetwarzania danych
  • Dbanie o jakość, spójność i bezpieczeństwo danych w ramach budowanych rozwiązań

Nasze wymagania

  • Doświadczenie w pracy jako Data Engineer (min. 3 lata)
  • Bardzo dobra, praktyczna znajomość Databricks – rozumienie architektury platformy i umiejętność samodzielnej pracy
  • Znajomość Delta Lake (formaty danych, ACID, time travel, operacje MERGE/upsert)
  • Doświadczenie z Unity Catalog (zarządzanie danymi, uprawnieniami, governance)
  • Rozumienie zasad data governance i lineage oraz kontroli dostępu do danych
  • Znajomość i praktyczne zastosowanie medallion architecture
  • Ogólna znajomość architektur danych (data lake, data warehouse, lakehouse)
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość SQL
  • Znajomość Pythona oraz bibliotek do przetwarzania danych: PySpark, Pandas, Polars
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z usługami Azure, w szczególności Azure Data Factory i Azure Functions
  • Umiejętność efektywnego wykorzystania narzędzi AI (np. GitHub Copilot, Databricks Assistant, ChatGPT/Claude) do wspomagania procesu wytwarzania kodu
  • Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego
  • Zatrudnienie w Polenergia S.A.
  • Zaproponujemy Ci konkurencyjne wynagrodzenie na rynku i atrakcyjne warunki premii
  • Zadbamy o Twoje Zdrowie - umożliwiając Tobie/Twojej rodzinie korzystanie z prywatnego pakietu medycznego LuxMed
  • Urozmaicimy Twój Czas Wolny - spędzony na sportowo (karta Multisport) lub kulturalnie (dofinansowanie biletów do kina/teatru) albo wyjazdowo (dofinansowanie wypoczynku)
  • Wzmocnimy Twoje poczucie Bezpieczeństwa- oferując Tobie i Twojej rodzinie preferencyjne warunki ubezpieczenia na życie
  • Zainwestujemy w Twój Rozwój - organizując szkolenia, które pomogą Ci w pracy (m.in. językowe, specjalistyczne, rozwój umiejętności)
  • Zadbamy o Twój Work-Life Balance - wprowadzając (tam, gdzie jest to możliwe) system pracy zdalnej lub hybrydowej oraz dogodne godziny pracy
  • Zbudujemy Twoje poczucie Przynależności do firmy- organizując spotkania integracyjne i angażując Cię w życie naszej organizacji

title: Trailer Shunter
description:
TRAILER SHUNTER OPERATIVES (two vacancies)

Northlink

We now have an opportunity for 2 x Trailer Shunter Operatives to support the Serco Northlink Contract on a shift rota basis (9 days on; 3 days off), with excellent renumeration and benefits package available to the successful applicants.

Trailer Shunter Operative duties include but are not limited to, mooring and letting go vessels, moving and securing various trailers, load and unload vehicles to and from the ferries, stow and secure chaining equipment in the dedicated areas.

The successful shunter operatives will have to demonstrate their experience of loading and unloading trailers and preferably have a Driving Licence Class C+E. title: Programista / Programistka Full Stack
description:
Programista / Programistka Full Stack

Miejsce pracy: Poznań

Technologie, których używamy

Wymagane

  • PHP
  • Laravel
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • MySQL
  • Docker
  • Git
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Google Analytics

Mile widziane

  • Claude Code

System operacyjny

  • Linux

O projekcie

Szukamy osoby, która technicznie ogarnie kilka aplikacji webowych i wszystko wokół nich: własne systemy w PHP/Laravel oraz JavaScript/TypeScript (MySQL, Docker), strony firmowe i landing page’e, integracje z płatnościami, wiadomościami SMS, usługami wideo i systemami partnerów, a do tego hosting, domeny, pocztę i analitykę.

Zakres obejmuje rozwój, utrzymanie i wdrażanie aplikacji, a także rozwiązywanie problemów, których nikt wcześniej nie opisał w tickecie.

Praca jest programistyczna, ale również okołoprogramistyczna – część czasu będziesz pisać kod, a część spędzać przy logach, DNS-ach i konfiguracji hostingu albo tłumacząc osobom z biura, co się stało i co możemy z tym zrobić.

Poziom doświadczenia: rozważymy kandydatury osób na różnych poziomach zaawansowania. Szukamy kogoś, kto rozumie, jak działa aplikacja webowa – od bazy danych po przeglądarkę – potrafi samodzielnie zdobywać potrzebną wiedzę i doprowadza sprawy do końca. Resztę wspólnie oszlifujemy.

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji opartych na Laravelu, JS/TS, MySQL i Dockerze: tworzenie nowych funkcji, poprawki, migracje, testy oraz wdrożenia na produkcję.
  • Integracje: płatności online i webhooki, wiadomości SMS, usługi wideo, API partnerów, import i eksport danych oraz mailing.
  • Tworzenie i utrzymanie stron i projektów towarzyszących: landing page’e, strony na WordPressie lub rozwiązaniach statycznych oraz utrzymanie lub wygaszanie systemów legacy.
  • Ogarnianie infrastruktury: hosting, domeny, DNS, Cloudflare, certyfikaty, kopie zapasowe, logi, kolejki, crony i poczta.
  • Techniczne SEO i analityka: przekierowania, mapy witryn, metadane, Google Tag Manager, GA4 i piksele śledzące.
  • Wsparcie biura: diagnozowanie zgłoszeń użytkowników od analizy logów do wdrożenia poprawki oraz wyjaśnianie problemów w sposób zrozumiały dla nietechnicznych osób.

Nasze wymagania

  • Rozumiesz architekturę MVC i REST API w praktyce; potrafisz przeprowadzić request przez walidację, serwis i model oraz zaprojektować wygodny endpoint.
  • Znajomość PHP i Laravel na poziomie umożliwiającym samodzielną pracę.
  • Znajomość JavaScript/TypeScript po stronie przeglądarki.
  • Codzienne korzystanie z Gita (branch → code review → merge), Dockera w środowisku lokalnym, CLI Linuksa oraz SSH.
  • Umiejętność samodzielnego zdobywania wiedzy i doprowadzania spraw do końca; dociekliwość i sprawdzanie kodu oraz logów przed poprawą.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z asystentami AI, np. Claude Code, przy analizie, planowaniu, kodowaniu i code review.

To oferujemy

  • Wymiar pracy: pełny etat
  • Tryb pracy: zdalnie, spotkania w biurze w Koninie raz w tygodniu/raz na dwa tygodnie

Benefity

  • prywatna opieka medyczna
  • dofinansowanie szkoleń i kursów

Twoje dane osobowe będą przetwarzane w oparciu o następujące podstawy prawne: (a) aby podjąć działania na Twoje żądanie przed zawarciem umowy (np. informacje o oczekiwanym wynagrodzeniu i dostępności do rozpoczęcia pracy); (b) w oparciu o nasz prawnie uzasadniony interes (np. imię, nazwisko, data urodzenia, dane kontaktowe, wykształcenie, kwalifikacje zawodowe, przebieg dotychczasowego zatrudnienia); c) w oparciu o Twoją zgodę, która wyrażona jest poprzez przeslanie dokumentów aplikacyjnych zawierających takie informacje jak np. wizerunek czy zainteresowania.Podanie wszystkich danych osobowych, o których mowa powyżej jest dobrowolne, natomiast dane wymienione w lit. a) i b) są niezbędne do wzięcia udziału w rekrutacji. Niepodanie danych skutkuje brakiem możliwości rozpatrzenia kandydatury. Podanie pozostałych danych jest dobrowolne, ale może pomóc w sprawnym przeprowadzeniu procesu rekrutacji.Masz prawo żądać dostępu do Twoich danych (w tym uzyskania ich kopii), sprostowania danych, ich usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przeniesienia, jak również wniesienia sprzeciwu wobec ich przetwarzania. Masz także prawo wniesienia skargi do Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Ochrony Danych.Po wyłączeniu powyższych sytuacji możesz złożyć skargę do ... (continued as in original). Twoje dane osobowe będą przetwarzane przez okres 1 roku, chyba, że wyraziłeś odrębną zgodę na wykorzystanie Twoich danych osobowych w przyszłych rekrutacjach.Wcelu realizacji praw lub w przypadku jakichkolwiek pytań związanych z przetwarzaniem Twoich danych osobowych skontaktuj się z nami pod adresem: malwina.topolska@jpmedica.pl.

title: Client Access Coordinator (Reception) - Fairbanks
description:
Client Access Coordinator |Alaska Behavioral Health
Administrative Team

Who We Are

At Alaska Behavioral Health, our mission is to strengthen Alaska communities and improve the lives of our clients by delivering exceptional behavioral healthcare services. We believe that all Alaskans, regardless of their mental health or addiction needs, should have access to the best possible care. We are dedicated to helping Alaskans recover and thrive.

About the Team

The Client Access Team plays a vital role in ensuring quality customer service is provided in a professional and efficient manner. They facilitate the care of both internal and external AKBH consumers by providing administrative assistance to Clinical Teams, Medical Providers, Program, and Administrative Staff. AKBH Client Access Coordinators are known for their welcoming, positive demeanor and their ability to work effectively with diverse members of the community, including stakeholders and individuals with behavioral or physical limitations or disabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle incoming calls and route them to the appropriate department or staff member.
  • Schedule appointments for new and existing clients across Clinical, Medical, and Primary Care services.
  • Collect and verify contact, demographic, and insurance information from clients.
  • Assist with day-to-day operations of AKBH clinics, including check-in/check-out processes.
  • Communicate and coordinate client and clinic needs to appropriate staff members.Top of Form

Good To Know

  • Location: Anchorage, Alaska
  • Employment Type: Full-Time, Non-Exempt
  • Salary Range: $21.00 to $26.00 per hour (Depending on Experience)
  • Professional Growth Opportunities Available
  • AKBH offers generous benefits including two healthcare options for employees and their dependent children, 401k with immediate vesting and up to 5% match, 3% automatically contributed by AKBH, and 5 weeks of PTO for the first year, and 8 weeks of PTO after the first year.

What We Need from You

  • At least two years of relevant experience or a combination of relevant degree coursework/experience, preferably in the medical or behavioral health industry.
  • Skills to work effectively with a large, diverse client and staff population.
  • Reliability, flexibility, patience, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Regular attendance is required.


Alaska Behavioral Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, fostering diversity and inclusion in our workplace.

title: Werkstudent Facilitair
description:
Wil jij naast je hbo-studie relevante werkervaring opdoen en bijdragen aan een professionele, gastvrije en toekomstbestendige werkomgeving? Als Werkstudent Facilitair krijg je bij Meijers de ruimte om ideeën aan te dragen én uit te voeren. Je helpt ons facilitaire processen slimmer te organiseren, ondersteunt bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en zorgt samen met je collega’s dat medewerkers en bezoekers zich welkom voelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Meijers is de afgelopen periode gegroeid naar meerdere locaties. Daardoor bestaat de behoefte om facilitaire processen verder te professionaliseren en meer als één geheel te organiseren. Jij ondersteunt hierbij vooral de Facilitair Coördinator. Zij zet de lijnen uit en levert input, waarna jij helpt om plannen praktisch uit te voeren.

Je werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend en bestaan onder andere uit:
• Je behandelt facilitaire meldingen en zorgt dat deze bij de juiste collega of leverancier terechtkomen
• Je helpt bij het verder professionaliseren en gebruiken van het facilitymanagementsysteem
• Je ondersteunt bij administratieve werkzaamheden rond schoonmaak, catering, gebouwen en andere facilitaire onderwerpen
• Je denkt mee over leveranciers, contracten, kosten en mogelijke verbeteringen
• Je verzamelt informatie, vergelijkt mogelijkheden en legt ideeën voor aan de Facilitair Coördinator
• Je signaleert wat beter, slimmer of voordeliger kan en wacht niet af tot iemand anders ermee komt
• Je ondersteunt bij voorraadbeheer, bestellingen en uiteenlopende dagelijkse facilitaire werkzaamheden
• Je helpt incidenteel mee bij cateringwerkzaamheden wanneer daar extra ondersteuning nodig is
• Je draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de facilitaire dienstverlening bij Meijers

De nadruk op meldingen, leveranciers, contracten, inkoop, administratieve ondersteuning en het toekomstbestendig maken van Facilitair komt uit de kick-off. Voorraadbeheer, algemene facilitaire ondersteuning en ondersteuning bij activiteiten zijn aanvullend ontleend aan het bestaande functieprofiel, zonder de volledige rol van Facilitair Medewerker over te nemen.

Over het team
Je komt terecht in een toegankelijk en dienstverlenend facilitair team. Het team bestaat uit een leidinggevende, twee facilitaire medewerkers, vijf cateringmedewerkers in Amstelveen en een facilitair medewerker in Heerde. Je werkt vooral samen met de Facilitair Coördinator en de andere facilitaire collega’s. Binnen het team wordt duidelijk gecommuniceerd, wordt meegedacht en staan de medewerkers van Meijers centraal.

Jouw kwaliteiten

Je bent iemand die graag aanpakt en energie krijgt van een omgeving waarin geen dag helemaal hetzelfde is. Je durft initiatief te nemen, ziet wat er moet gebeuren en komt met ideeën voordat iemand erom hoeft te vragen. Tegelijkertijd ben je gastvrij en dienstverlenend. Je vindt het leuk om collega’s en bezoekers te helpen en pakt ook de telefoon wanneer dat nodig is. Humor en gezelligheid passen bij jou, maar je weet ook wanneer er professioneel en zorgvuldig gehandeld moet worden.

Collegialiteit, flexibiliteit, initiatief, servicegerichtheid en communicatieve vaardigheden sluiten bovendien aan bij de competenties uit het bestaande facilitaire functieprofiel.

Jouw toekomst

Als Werkstudent Facilitair doe je praktijkervaring op die direct aansluit bij je studie. Je leert hoe facilitaire processen, leveranciers, systemen en dagelijkse dienstverlening binnen een groeiende organisatie samenkomen. Daarbij krijg je ruimte om mee te denken over verbeteringen en jezelf zowel professioneel als persoonlijk te ontwikkelen. Binnen Meijers werken meerdere werkstudenten en er zijn activiteiten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden voor studenten en jonge professionals.

Kom je in ons team?

Iedereen is welkom om bij Meijers te solliciteren. Ben jij de Werkstudent Facilitair die wij zoeken? Solliciteer via het online formulier met je cv en een korte motivatie waarin je ook je beschikbaarheid vermeldt.

Heb je eerst nog een vraag? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dani Bellod Fernandez, Corporate Recruiter.
Kandidaten die worden uitgenodigd voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek, worden na dit gesprek gescreend. Deze screening is onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze advertentie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Business Analyst
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is looking for a highly analytical and data-driven Business Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in Power BI, SQL, and Advanced Excel to transform complex datasets into meaningful insights that drive strategic business decisions.

As a trusted business partner, you will collaborate with stakeholders across teams to understand business requirements, analyze performance metrics, identify trends, and develop interactive dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate combines strong technical proficiency with excellent communication skills and a passion for solving business challenges through data.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management

  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements from stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Translate business needs into clear reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for process improvements and data-driven decision-making.
  • Act as a liaison between business teams and technical stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets using SQL to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Perform detailed data analysis and reporting using Advanced Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, lookups, Power Query, and advanced analytical functions.
  • Validate data accuracy and maintain data integrity across reporting systems.
  • Develop recurring and ad-hoc reports to support operational and strategic initiatives.

Power BI Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Build efficient data models and implement DAX calculations to support advanced business analytics.
  • Create intuitive visualizations that provide actionable insights for business stakeholders.
  • Monitor dashboard performance and continuously enhance reporting capabilities.

Insights & Decision Support

  • Analyze business performance indicators and provide recommendations to improve outcomes.
  • Identify key trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis.
  • Present findings, insights, and recommendations to leadership teams and key stakeholders.
  • Support business planning, forecasting, and performance management initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or in a similar analytical role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Advanced Excel Analytics, including complex formulas, pivot tables, dashboards, and data analysis techniques.
  • Expertise in Power BI, including:
  • Dashboard Development
  • DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
  • Data Modeling
  • Data Visualization Best Practices
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing and optimizing complex queries.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence reporting.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and ETL processes.
  • Exposure to automation and reporting optimization initiatives.
  • Experience supporting business operations, sales, finance, customer success, or operational analytics.

Key Competencies:

  • Data Analysis & Interpretation
  • Business Intelligence & Reporting
  • Power BI Dashboard Development
  • Advanced Excel Analytics
  • SQL Querying & Data Validation
  • Data Visualization
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
  • Presentation & Communication Skills
  • Attention to Detail

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Want to be a bswifter?

At bswift we’ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state-of-the-art, cloud-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people-first workplaces.

We’re looking for motivated and goal-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you!

You will join the team as a Software Developer, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend systems and APIs that power web and mobile applications. The role requires proficiency in backend engineering, cloud services (preferably AWS), databases, and developing secure, high-performance systems.

You’ll work closely with software developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and performant services that enable seamless user experiences

1. Solution Design & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain innovative, customer-centric, high-performance, secure, and robust applications.
  • Build and integrate scalable backend services with responsive frontend interfaces.
  • Work with architects and other software engineers to develop scalable solutions

2. System Decomposition & Iterative Delivery

  • Break down large, complex systems into smaller, manageable implementation slices.
  • Use prototypes and iterative delivery to de-risk unknowns and validate assumptions.

3. Product Ownership & Lifecycle Management

  • Take ownership of features and systems from prototype to production deployment and operations.
  • Ensure reliability, maintainability, and performance throughout the lifecycle.

4. Observability & Reliability

  • Implement scalable logging, monitoring, and tracing across full-stack systems to enhance observability and system reliability
  • Ensure system health, detect anomalies, and maintain operational visibility.

5. Deployment & Release Management

  • Integrate changes into CI/CD pipelines across frontend and backend using IAAC.
  • Ensure smooth, automated, and reliable build and deployment processes.

6. Code Quality, Testing & Performance

  • Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code across the stack.
  • Conduct unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Optimize performance of backend systems and frontend interfaces.

7. Cloud & Security

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud-native applications using AWS services such as S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, and Lambda.
  • Follow secure coding practices aligned with OWASP guidelines.
  • Remediate security issues and ensure safe handling of sensitive data.
  • Support security reviews and compliance audits.

Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in software development.
  • Strong design and coding skills, with experience in code reviews and SDLC processes.
  • Solid problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, Lambda, and API Gateway.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Must have proficiency in C# /Java, NodeJS, TypeScript, with knowledge of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and best practices;
  • Experience with SQL, NoSQL databases.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs, and web application development.
  • Focus on delivering high-quality, extensible, reusable, performant, reliable, and secure software solutions.
  • Familiarity with development tools like Jira, GitHub, and SonarQube.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Experience with prompt engineering and generative AI is a plus.

At bswift, our mission is clear: Become the preeminent benefits administrator through exceptional people, innovative technology, and delighted customers. And our values are at the heart of everything we do to accomplish that mission. We Pursue Excellence, Embrace Accountability, Deliver Superior Service, and strive to Be A Great Place To Work. We take pride in having an engaged, collaborative team that goes the extra mile to get the job done right.

bswift has been regularly named one of Chicago’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For®, as well as one of the Nation’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For® year after year. We offer a fun, flexible, and creative environment where you can grow both professionally and personally.

If you have what it takes to join our award-winning culture, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Event Service Specialist
description:
Building a Brand Starts with a Story

FIRST is a leading global brand experience agency providing Content, Creative, Digital Technology, Management & Delivery, and Data & Insights services. For 30 years, we have utilised three flexible delivery models: Embedded teams, Corporate Campus operations, and a Full-Service Agency.

Managing over 37,000 events & projects annually across 110 countries, FIRST serves 130+ brands, specialising in Fortune 500 companies within the Financial Services, Technology, Healthcare, Media, and Professional Services sectors. FIRST is part of the broader Encore family of companies. Encore is a global leader in event production and technology.

Consistently recognised for excellence, recent honours include 2026 Chief Marketer Agency of the Year, the Ad Net Zero Award for sustainability, and more.

Learn more at

What You Would Get To Do

The Event Service Specialist will consistently deliver exceptional service to our client through excellent event service delivery. Along with other FIRST team members, the Event Service Specialist will represent the FIRST Solutions brand on-site within a well-known tech company. In this role you, your main focus will be to be the primary point of contact to successfully execute events, working with the FIRST team and various internal service providers.

Your Contributions

  • Primary contact on the event day for event hosts, working hand in hand with event managers and service partners to ensure appropriate execution and service delivery in each area of event support including catering, audio/video production, security, transportation, and room setup support.
  • Work across various event spaces, traveling between different floors and buildings throughout the day
  • Coordinate and execute event logistics
  • Reviews all event needs and re-confirms or clarifies any areas of concern prior to event
  • Support events onsite which could include managing multiple events a day
  • Troubleshoot issues and escalate any advanced needs to the appropriate internal partner
  • Communicate any pertinent adds/changes to the event team and supporting services lines as needed (i.e.: guest count changes, schedule changes, room setup or catering changes)
  • Assist event managers in the planning of large-scale events
  • Support the end-to-end planning for small-scale events as needed
  • Provide administrative support for event managers by keeping tracking tools, event planning documents and internal planning systems up-to-date and accurate
  • Responsible for compiling reports related to on-site events including post-event data
  • Support the Guest Services team as needed, which could include but is not limited to guest check-in, wayfinding, swag organization and distribution and answering questions on event details

What We Are Looking For

  • Up to 1 year of relevant experience
  • Must be fluent in English
  • This role will be assigned to a primary location but will require flexibility to be deployed to support across the campus as required. This is an on-site position.
  • Knowledge of basic and fundamental standards of event management and event operations
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills
  • Experience working cross-functionally with various levels of stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Creative problem solver, resourceful, team player
  • Adaptability to situations and ever-changing demands
  • Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple tasks to meet strict deadlines
  • Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills

title: Parkeerbeheerder Utrecht
description:
Ben jij graag in contact met bezoekers en help je mee de parkeergarages van onze klanten draaiend en netjes te houden?

Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit?
Als parkeerbeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat de parkeergarages in Utrecht goed draaien en op orde zijn. Je bent aanwezig in één van de 3 bemande parkeergarages, vanuit de meldkamer heb je overzicht over wat er in de parkeergarage gebeurt en je kunt vanuit hier verschillende handelingen uitvoeren. Regelmatig loop je rondes door de garage om het netjes te houden, of om controles uit te voeren.


Daarnaast sta je bezoekers te woord; persoonlijk, telefonisch of via de intercom en camera’s. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor een veilige, schone en gebruiksvriendelijke parkeergarage.

Je draait mee in onze wisselende diensten, de parkeergarages zijn 24/7 geopend. Het rooster wordt ruim van tevoren gemaakt, zodat je weet waar je aan toe bent.

  • Toezicht houden via de camera’s en rondes lopen door de parkeergarage;

  • Klanten te woord staan via de intercom of in de parkeergarage;

  • Zorgen voor een schone en nette parkeergarage;

  • Bijzondere gebeurtenissen tijdens je dienst noteren;

  • Je schakelt met je team en Locatiemanager, zodat iedereen weet wat er in de garages speelt.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

  • 27 vakantiedagen per jaar en je kan 1 week per jaar bijkopen (o.b.v. 40 uur);

  • De mogelijkheid om 2 nationale feestdagen per jaar om te wisselen naar andere feestdagen;

  • Minimaal een salaris van €2608,26 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur);

  • Onregelmatigheid toeslagen tussen de 10 en 35 procent, afhankelijk van jouw dienst;

  • Zakelijke telefoon;

  • Pensioenregeling;

  • Bedrijfsfitness (korting op jouw sport abonnement);

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: €0,23 per km vanaf de eerste kilometer die je rijdt vanaf huis naar je werk en andersom, tot maximaal 75 km. Het openbaar vervoer wordt door ons volledig vergoed. Wij werken voor de registratie hiervan met de Fynch app, dit zal je met je zakelijke telefoon registreren.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Klantvriendelijke houding;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • Je kunt prima overweg met een computer;

  • Rijbewijs B;

  • VOG: je kan een verklaring omtrent gedrag overleggen.

Is deze functie iets voor jou?

Solliciteer online of neem voor vragen contact op met de Locatiemanager Tim van Oosten op 06-12588247.

Wij zijn P1

Een innovatief Nederlands parkeerbedrijf. Wij bieden parkeer gerelateerde diensten aan gemeenten en bedrijven in heel Nederland. Parkeren lijkt misschien simpel, maar er zit een hele wereld achter. Daardoor is bij P1 geen dag hetzelfde. We zijn onderdeel van Q-Park en voor ieder project leveren we maatwerk. Op de werkvloer houden we van een persoonlijke, pure, professionele aanpak. We zijn laagdrempelig, no-nonsense en we halen het beste uit onszelf en de ander. Alles start bij P1!

title: Applied AI Architect, Startups
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Solutions Architect on the Startups Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will win the trust of founders and engineers by being an exceptional technical partner, helping startups successfully build on the Claude Developer Platform as they grow from early product to scale. You'll combine deep technical expertise with a builder-first mindset to help startups architect innovative LLM solutions, win technical evaluations, and get the most out of Claude.

Working closely with Account Executives and the broader Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide startups from initial technical discovery through successful deployment and beyond. You'll leverage your expertise to help founders understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Account Executives to deeply understand startup requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the Claude adoption journey from initial evaluation through deployment and expansion

  • Win technical evaluations that demonstrate why Claude is the best foundation for what startups are building, helping them develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

  • Build technical credibility with founders, founding engineers, and startup engineering teams by speaking their language, understanding their build patterns, and guiding technical architecture decisions

  • Gather insights on how startups are building with Claude, identify emerging use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver feedback to Product and Engineering teams

  • Travel to customer sites, startup-focused events, and industry conferences for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder who has done founder-led sales

  • Experience working with startups or high-growth technology companies; you understand the velocity and constraints of early-stage companies

  • Strong builder credibility through experience as a software engineer or technical founder; you speak the language of builders and have the presence to earn the trust of technical founders and startup engineering teams

  • Deep technical proficiency with building and scaling AI products, a pulse on AI engineering best practices, and the ability to demonstrate why Claude is the best foundation

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production, with expertise in context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and modern AI architectures

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into actionable insights for founders and engineering teams

  • Track record of selling technical products in competitive markets

  • Comfortable with Python and familiarity with common LLM frameworks, tools, and integration patterns

  • Passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£165,000—£190,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. If you're a critical thinker, a natural problem solver, and someone who enjoys helping others get the best out of technology, this is an opportunity to make a real impact while developing your skills across a diverse and operationally focused business.

Join us and help drive smarter systems, better outcomes, and continuous improvement across our operations.

title: Flight Data Reporting Engineer
description:
Swarmer develops software that makes drones autonomous and allows them to operate together, in large, coordinated teams - no pilots needed. Our technology has been battle-tested in Ukraine - the world's most intense proving ground for drone warfare.

In March 2026, we became the first Ukrainian defense startup to go public on NASDAQ, following a $15M Series A - the largest investment in a Ukrainian defense tech company since the start of the war.

Working at Swarmer means operating at the intersection of engineering rigor and frontline reality. The problems and environments are complex, and the stakes are very real. We built this software to enable democratic nations to defend themselves.

If you are motivated by building resilient systems that matter and by seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll find purpose here.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for a Flight Data Reporting Engineer to increase the value of flights performed by our flight teams. You'll work as a member of a flight team, gather flight logs and other information from each flight, describe any issues occurring during flights and provide feedback from field operations.

This is a great role for someone who is meticulous and detail-oriented, with a strong willingness to learn about drones and their use. You'll work closely with our head of test flights and provide the feedback from the fields, analyze and aggregate flights' information.

What You'll Do

  • Take part in test flights in the field
  • Follow SOP checklists for pre-flight, in-flight observation
  • Sync all flight logs, photos, videos, and supplementary data
  • Identify deviations or abnormal system behavior and elevate them
  • Investigate any abnormal or emergency situations with UAV and provide for their solutions
  • Detect and analyze UAV flight patterns and propose improvements to the system
  • Support pilots during field operations
  • Gather flight logs and other information from the flights in accordance to post-flight SOP

What We Need

  • Meticulous, detail-oriented, structured, and reliable approach to work in field conditions
  • Fast learner who adapts easily to new tools and systems
  • Clear communicator with a focus on factual reporting
  • Strong data organization and structuring skills
  • Keen eye for data analysis
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written)

Would Be An Advantage

  • Category B driver's license
  • Experience with multi-rotor drones or another type of UAV/UGV/USVs
  • Experience in QA/QC, tech support, or field testing

What You'll Get

  • Hands-on experience with modern UAV systems
  • Path to UAV pilot, Drone Engineer or Flight Analyst
  • Direct collaboration with field teams and engineers
  • Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package
  • A straightforward, no-bureaucracy culture

How's The Hiring Process Going

  • Recruiter Screen
  • Team Interview
  • Test Day
  • Skip-Level Interview
  • Offer

Please note that, as a leading defense tech company, we take operations security seriously and may need to perform additional background checks as part of our hiring process. We will do so in accordance with all applicable EU laws and regulations and safeguard your data in the process.

title: Senior Java Engineer - Core / Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is the Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch team and focus on ensuring that the shared platform functionalities of Elasticsearch are easy to use, performant, maintainable, and secure.

The team’s mission is to create foundational infrastructure and shared functionality that enables engineers to develop, extend, and support Elasticsearch. The team owns common functionality such as services, settings, and scripting, and makes Elasticsearch extensible through plugins or the Painless scripting language. The team also makes Elasticsearch observable by providing logging and telemetry information. We also own the orchestration of Elasticsearch in serverless, the CI/CD workflows, and enable Elasticsearch developers to deliver Elasticsearch to customers - serverless, cloud, and on-premise alike.

You will be a strong individual contributor on the team, but you will also contribute to and lead cross-team projects. We need someone who has great design skills, who can work at a low level of abstraction but can equally drive and communicate technical concepts across a variety of collaborators.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to large, impactful projects that evolve the core infrastructure that underpins Elasticsearch.
  • Making Elasticsearch developers more productive by identifying and developing opportunities for automation, and integrating agentic apps into development workflows.
  • Designing and implementing new horizontally-scalable features and APIs in Elasticsearch.
  • Solving difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Improving operation and observability of Elasticsearch cloud systems.
  • Collaborating in the open with the ES team, Elastic users, and other supporting open source projects.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring

  • Experience crafting APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Proficient in algorithms and data structures.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and practices (Buildkite, Argo CD, GitOps etc).
  • Experience leading large scale projects across engineering teams.
  • Willingness to dive into new issues and ask for help when you need it.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience with observability and telemetry solutions, particularly OpenTelemetry
  • Knowledge of Go
  • Knowledge of containers and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Sr. Engineer, MEMS Characterization and Metro
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.


Job Summary

Join the team revolutionizing the timing industry with the best MEMS-based timing products in the world. As a Senior MEMS Characterization and Metrology Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to develop and deploy custom MEMS test systems for engineering characterization and manufacturing test of SiTime MEMS resonators.

Responsibilities:

  • Exploration and prototyping novel test methodologies for high-precision timing parameter measurements.
  • Hands-on hardware development and system validation of custom MEMS test systems for engineering and mass production.
  • Development of software for test execution and automation, data acquisition, system calibration, and data analysis required for high-precision timing devices.
  • Documentation of MEMS test system architecture, design, software, etc.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams for system qualification and release-to-production.
  • Optimization of system performance focusing on throughput, precision, and reliability.
  • Drive and/or support projects and other company-driven objectives, as needed

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Physics. PhD is preferred. Exceptional candidates with other technical backgrounds will be considered.
  • Proven track record of driving technical projects and executing on aggressive schedules in cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on experience with analog electronics, board-level design and debug, electrical characterization of RF devices, and deep knowledge of associated test equipment.
  • Demonstrated programming experience in C#, familiarity with LabView and MATLAB is a plus.
  • Strong ability to design, conduct, and analyze experiment results
  • Previous experience with MEMS design, test and/or characterization is preferred.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills; strong written and verbal communication.
  • High level of self-motivation and drive for making an impact.
  • Passion for hands-on technical leadership with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability and willingness to work in a highly collaborative, fast-paced team environment.
  • A positive attitude and curiosity to learn new skills.

Compensation:


At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

The annual base salary range for this role is $124,920.00 – $171,770.00. The final offer is determined by factors such as location, experience, education, and training.


In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

Benefits offered : 401k plan, health and wellness that includes medical, dental, vision, life, parental leave, legal services, and time off plans.

SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program.

title: Osastonhoitaja, Tyks yleislääketiede, Loimaa
description:
Tyks Loimaan sairaalaosastot B1 ja B2 hakevat vakituista osastonhoitajaa vastaamaan yksikön toiminnasta, henkilöstöstä ja hoitotyön laadusta. Tehtävän aloitus on 1.12.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtäväsi

Osastoillamme hoidetaan monipuolisesti sairaalahoitoa ja jatkokuntoutusta vaativia potilaita eri erikoisaloilta, kuten neurologisia, ortopedisiä, sisätautisia ja ikääntyneitä potilaita. Lisäksi hoidamme saattohoitopotilaita. Toimintamme on ympärivuorokautista ja potilaat pääsääntöisesti saapuvat meille Tyks Akuutin toimipisteistä tai osastosiirtoina muista sairaaloista. Potilaita voi meille tulla myös suoraa kotoa (kotisairaalan tukiosastosopimuspotilaat).

Osastonhoitajana vastaat yksikön toiminnan suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä ja johtamisesta sekä henkilöstöjohtamisesta, rekrytoinneista ja osaamisen varmistamisesta. Johdat perehdytyksen suunnittelua, toteutumista ja seurantaa sekä huolehdit hoitotyön laadusta, potilasturvallisuudesta ja toiminnan sujuvuudesta. Teet työvuorosuunnittelua yhteistyössä apulaisosastonhoitajien kanssa yhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelun periaatteiden mukaisesti ja vahvistat moniammatillista yhteistyötä sekä toiminnan jatkuvaa kehittämistä.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä apulaisosastonhoitajien, osastonlääkäreiden, hoitohenkilöstön ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän ympäristössä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan sekä henkilöstön että toiminnan kehittämiseen. Tukenasi on osaava ja motivoitunut moniammatillinen työyhteisö.

Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää sairaalaosastojen toimintaa ja vaikuttaa yksiköiden tulevaisuuteen. Tehtävässä onnistumistasi tukevat kattava perehdytys sekä esihenkilötyöhön saatava tuki.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja. Sinulla on kyky organisoida ja hallita laajoja kokonaisuuksia sekä valmiuksia johtaa muutosta, hyödyntää tiedolla johtamista ja kehittää toimintaa tavoitteellisesti.

Arvostamme kykyä tukea henkilöstön työhyvinvointia sekä avointa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää myös hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista osaamista.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus tai aikaisempi hyväksytty osastonhoitajan pätevyys

Kiinnostuitko? Hae vakituista osastonhoitajan tehtävää ja tule johtamaan osaavaa moniammatillista työyhteisöä sekä kehittämään laadukasta yleislääketieteen osastohoitoa.
