title: People Business Partner
description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

  • Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
  • Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
  • Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.
  • Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
  • First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

We’re hiring our first People Business Partner to help define what People partnering looks like at Gigs.

At Gigs, we believe that our People team exists to help the business succeed through its people. We partner closely with leaders to build exceptional teams, make thoughtful people decisions, and create the conditions for our people to do their best work. You’ll be a trusted thought partner to our org leads and managers, deeply understanding their business, priorities, and challenges and helping them navigate the people and organizational decisions that matter most.

This is not a traditional HRBP role. You’ll work across organizational design, talent strategy, performance, manager coaching, employee relations, career development, and organizational effectiveness, while also building the People infrastructure we need to scale, from leveling and career paths to performance, manager enablement, onboarding, and talent programs.

This is a builder role with significant ownership. We’re not looking to import a playbook; we want you to identify what will have the greatest impact, build what Gigs needs, and own it from strategy through execution.

The timing is intentional: our people are hungry for more. Employees are looking for more structure, clarity, and support to grow their careers, while our managers and org leads are eager for a strong thought partner as their teams and challenges become more complex. We’re at a point where investing meaningfully in both can have an outsized impact on the business.

What you will do

Partner with leaders to build exceptional teams

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to org leads and managers on talent, organizational design, performance, and team effectiveness.
  • Translate business strategy and goals into thoughtful decisions about organization, roles, capabilities, and talent.
  • Coach managers at all levels on leadership, feedback, performance, team dynamics, and employee development.
  • Partner with leaders on talent reviews, development, promotions, succession, and retention of exceptional talent.
  • Navigate employee relations and organizational change with sound judgment, empathy, and rigor.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to diagnose problems, identify trends, and proactively surface opportunities and risks.

Build the People systems Gigs needs to scale

  • Design and evolve our leveling and career framework, creating clear expectations and meaningful paths for growth.
  • Build and improve performance management, talent, and manager development programs.
  • Shape key parts of the employee experience, including onboarding, engagement, and other People programs as the company evolves.
  • Partner across the People team to turn business and employee insights into programs that meaningfully improve how we work.
  • Use AI, automation, and better systems to eliminate repetitive work, create leverage, and rethink how People work gets done.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of HR/People experience, including meaningful People Partner/HRBP experience in a high-growth technology company.
  • Experience partnering closely with leaders and managers across functions and levels.
  • Strong business acumen and genuine curiosity about how businesses operate, grow, and win.
  • Deep experience across organizational design, talent, performance, manager coaching, and employee development.
  • Experience building or evolving career frameworks, leveling, talent processes, or other People infrastructure.
  • Excellent judgment, coaching, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to navigate sensitive and ambiguous situations.
  • A first-principles, builder’s mindset: you’re comfortable creating from scratch, questioning existing playbooks, and rolling up your sleeves to get the work done.
  • Strong analytical skills and an interest in using AI and automation to make People work more effective and scalable.
  • Knowledge of employment law and employee relations is preferred.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

title: WW Specialist Solutions Architect In-Memory, WWSO Data
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer's most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market (GTM) plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Within WWSO, this position is part of the Worldwide Specialist Team, where you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-memory and caching architectures on AWS - Amazon ElastiCache and Valkey. This is a developer-facing role: your primary mission is to drive ElastiCache and Valkey adoption through the developer community, meeting builders where they are and making it effortless for them to adopt the right caching strategy. Modern applications - and increasingly agentic AI workloads, where low-latency caching is central to token optimization and cost control - depend on getting the data and caching layer right. You will help developers apply proven caching patterns (cache-aside, write-through, rate limiting, session and semantic caching, and more) and position in-memory data stores within the broader NoSQL, purpose-built database strategy that underpins production-scale AI.

You will work closely with the Database Services team, Business Development, and Sales to enable large-scale customer use cases and drive adoption and revenue for AWS. You will build with developers - writing sample code, reference implementations, and demos - and produce whitepapers, blogs, reference architectures, and conference talks that scale your impact across the developer community. You will also create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, helping other SAs understand when and how to integrate AWS caching services into customer architectures. As a trusted advisor with hands-on technical depth in in-memory / NoSQL systems, you will share recommendations around performance, cost, reliability, security, and operational efficiency to accelerate how customers build data-intensive and AI-powered applications on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive ElastiCache and Valkey adoption across the developer community - through hands-on content, sample code, workshops, hackathons, open-source contributions, and developer events.
- Be the go-to technical expert on caching strategy and in-memory data patterns, helping developers and customers choose and implement the right approach for latency, scale, and cost - including caching for agentic AI and GenAI workloads.
- Accelerate the caching layer for agentic AI; help developers use ElastiCache/Valkey for agent token optimization, semantic caching, session/short-term memory, and rate limiting, positioning in-memory data stores as core infrastructure in the pilot-to-production journey for GenAI and agentic workloads.
- Represent the voice of the developer and customer; bring feedback to product teams to influence ElastiCache/Valkey feature development and the future roadmap.
- Provide advanced technical knowledge to your domain-aligned GTM teams to unblock our customers' largest and most critical business challenges.
- Act as a thought leader, sharing best practices through AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit and AWS re:Invent.
- Partner with Business Development teams to define the technical components of best-in-class GTM concepts, solutions, and initiatives.
- Develop and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts worldwide.
- Create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, to help them integrate AWS caching services into customer architectures.


About the team

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

description:
Senior Human Data Operations Partner, Research

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. title: Crane Operator
description:
Position Overview:


The Drop Ball Crane Operator is responsible for safely and effectively operating the drop ball crane to process scrap metal at the drop ball pit. This role ensures all work is carried out in accordance with company safety policies, standard operating procedures, and site environmental regulations. The operator performs pre-shift inspections, communicates with team members using radios, and follows protocols to minimize hazards and environmental risks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough and documented Pre-Shift Inspections of the crane and work area.
  • Perform visual inspections of the drop ball pit to ensure safety barriers are in place and debris is properly contained.
  • Operate the drop ball crane to break down scrap metal, ensuring materials are placed level and stable to reduce hazards.
  • Load processed scrap into appropriate staging areas and coordinate with the Front-End Loader (FEL) operator for material replenishment.
  • Follow all site safety procedures and wear required PPE at all times.
  • Maintain radio communication with site personnel, especially during active operations.
  • Lower the magnet during breaks and at the end of each shift in designated areas.
  • Stop operations immediately if unauthorized personnel are nearby and notify supervision.
  • Adhere to environmental controls, including dust mitigation and anti-idling procedures.
  • Assist with cable changes and crane walk-in procedures as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Prior experience operating cranes or heavy equipment preferred.
  • Ability to read and understand safety and operating procedures.
  • Comfortable working in an industrial outdoor environment.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:


- Ability to climb ladders and use 3-point contact technique.
- Exposure to dust, noise, and outdoor elements.
- Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and operate machinery for extended periods.
- Must remain alert to environmental conditions such as thunderstorms (operations must cease in such events).

Job Risk Rating:

Low (with adherence to controls)

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be added or changed at any time, with or without notice, to meet business needs.

Summary of Role

  • Develop ad-hoc analyses in response to management requests and emerging business questions.

title: Laboratoriumspecialist Klinische Genetica (LSKG)
description:
Het mooiste wat je met je talent kunt doen? Werken bij het Antoni van Leeuwenhoek en iedere dag bijdragen aan het opsporen van erfelijke aanleg voor kanker! Als Laboratoriumspecialist Klinische Genetica maak jij het verschil voor patiënten én hun families, met de meest geavanceerde moleculaire diagnostiek in een van de toonaangevende oncologische centra ter wereld.

In verband met de pensionering van een collega is er een vacature ontstaan voor een Laboratoriumspecialist Klinische Genetica (LSKG) voor een vaste positie binnen de Moleculaire Kiembaan Diagnostiek (MKD). Als LSKG ben je klinisch medebehandelaar, inhoudelijk expert en vraagbaak binnen een multidisciplinair team van moleculair genetici, analisten, een teamleider, kwaliteitsfunctionarissen, bio-informatici en secretariaat.

Je beoordeelt en interpreteert DNA-veranderingen in genen die predispositie voor kanker bepalen, in het bijzonder genen die een rol spelen bij erfelijke vormen van borst- en eierstokkanker of darmkanker. Daarbij maak je bij Lynch diagnostiek actief gebruik van een recent in-huis ontwikkelde functionele ODMS assay binnen de diagnostiek, waarmee je varianten van onbekende significantie helpt classificeren. Tevens lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling en verdere implementatie van deze en toekomstige testen. Op basis van jouw diagnostiek adviseren klinisch genetici patiënten over hun risico op het krijgen van kanker en preventieve opties.

Als LSKG ben je nauw betrokken bij mutatieonderzoek in het kader van moleculaire tumordiagnostiek. Door de ontwikkelingen in onder meer Whole Genome (Tumor) Sequencing en de integratie van tumor- en kiembaandiagnostiek ben je een spil in de advisering voor verwijzing voor erfelijkheidsonderzoek op basis van de bevindingen van DNA-onderzoek in tumorweefsel.

Jouw taken op een rij

  • Beoordelen en interpreteren van laboratoriumuitslagen en verslaglegging van genetisch onderzoek.

  • Borgen van de kwaliteit en bijdragen aan de dagelijkse diagnostische workflow.

  • Verder implementeren en doorontwikkelen van NGS/WGS-analyses en functionele testen, waaronder onze recent geïmplementeerde ODMS assay.

  • Bijdragen aan de integratie van tumorgenetica en kiembaandiagnostiek.

  • Een sleutelrol spelen in de besluitvorming rondom doorverwijzing naar de klinische genetica bij tumoren waarbij mutaties mogelijk wijzen op een erfelijke predispositie.

  • Bijdragen aan lopend onderzoek. Indien gewenst is het ook mogelijk om eigen onderzoeksinitiatieven op te zetten.

Hier kom je te werken

Het Antoni van Leeuwenhoek (AVL) is een internationaal gerenommeerd kankercentrum waar patiëntenzorg en wetenschappelijk onderzoek hand in hand gaan. Door continue ontwikkeling van Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technieken en functionele testen is de moleculaire diagnostiek ten behoeve van erfelijkheidsvoorlichting en moleculaire pathologie volop in beweging en dat geldt zeker ook voor ons.

Het DNA-diagnostiek laboratorium is onderdeel van de afdeling Pathologie (ISO 15189 geaccrediteerd) en bestaat uit twee nauw samenwerkende subafdelingen: de Moleculaire Kiembaan Diagnostiek (MKD) en de Moleculaire Tumor Diagnostiek (MTD). Op de afdeling werken zestien pathologen, zes klinisch moleculair biologen (KMBP) en twee Labspecialisten Klinische Genetica (LSKG), ondersteund door een sterk bioinformatica-team, kwaliteitsfunctionarissen en een secretariaat moleculaire diagnostiek. Deze disciplines geven gezamenlijk vorm aan uitvoering en innovatie van moleculaire diagnostiek, als integraal onderdeel van de afdeling pathologie.

In het AVL is een eigen afdeling Klinische Genetica met zes klinisch genetici, waarmee de afdeling Moleculaire Kiembaan Diagnostiek (MKD) intensief samenwerkt in het kader van erfelijkheidsadvisering.

Voor deze functie zoeken we een gedreven en enthousiaste LSKG die inhoudelijke expertise wil combineren met innovatie en ontwikkeling. We zoeken iemand die:

  • De opleiding tot LSKG van de VKGL heeft afgerond of deze binnenkort afrondt. Ook een gelijkgestelde opleiding tot Clinical Laboratory Geneticist (ErCLG) sluit goed aan;

  • Beschikt over een promotie in een relevant moleculair biologisch of genetisch onderwerp;

  • Ruime ervaring meebrengt met het opzetten, valideren en interpreteren van NGS-diagnostiek en vertrouwd is met werken volgens kwaliteitsnormen;

  • Enthousiast wordt van tumorgenetica en affiniteit heeft met bio-informatica en automatisering;

  • Een duidelijke visie heeft op de toekomst van de moleculaire diagnostiek en graag bijdraagt aan innovatie en excellente patiëntenzorg;

  • Makkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en goed weet te prioriteren;

  • Graag samenwerkt en bijdraagt aan een open en enthousiaste werksfeer.

Wat bieden we jou?

De basis voor jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden is conform de Cao Ziekenhuizen. Je krijgt van ons:

  • Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd, tussen de 18 en 36 uur per week;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.789,- en € 8.510,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, passend bij FWG 70 en afhankelijk van je ervaring;

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uren aan Persoonlijk levensfasebudget, bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Jaarlijks 8,33% vakantiegeld en een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per km;

  • Gratis parkeren bij het Antoni van Leeuwenhoek, maar met onze fietsregeling en korting op het OV maken we het ook aantrekkelijk voor je om de auto te laten staan;

  • Een mooie kans in een gespecialiseerd ziekenhuis waar je ook zelf kunt blijven leren en groeien als je dat wilt: de AVL Academie biedt vernieuwend en inspirerend onderwijs op gebied van oncologische vakkennis, vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Gelegenheid om te sporten bij onze Fit Boutiqs;

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging en Young AVL: verenigingen die sportieve, culturele en creatieve activiteiten en evenementen organiseren;

Interesse?

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
description:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
• Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes.
• Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
• Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
• Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
• Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, SIDA, US Government, and GIZ.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a WASH Engineer based in Maiduguri and Katsina. The responsibilities include overseeing technical interventions aimed at improving access to safe water, sanitation facilities, and hygiene practices, while supporting the rehabilitation of community infrastructure and strengthening the resilience of vulnerable populations in Borno and Katsina States. The hired candidate will also provide technical guidance to project teams, coordinate with relevant stakeholders, and contribute to sustainable solutions that address the needs of affected communities.


Position Details

Proposed start date: October 2026

Work location: Maiduguri (1) and Katsina (1)

  • Support the governance and sustainable access to safe water by working with RUWASA, LGAs, and other stakeholders to implement WASH governance recommendations.
  • Together with partner, conduct technical assessments, prepare designs, and develop Bills of Quantities (BoQs) for water and sanitation facilities rehabilitation, upgrade and new construction. To visit sites and ensure quality assurance of construction being delivered and adherence to design specifications
  • To make sure that the technical activities are up to the ACF standards (WASH package)
  • Facilitate the selection, design and construction of sanitation and water systems. In water using ground water or surface water, including abstraction, storage, treatment and distribution for new systems or rehabilitation of existing systems.
  • In collaboration of partner, assess sanitation needs, and design and implement the most appropriate form of sanitation system, in consultation with male and female beneficiaries, which includes excreta disposal, refuse disposal, vector control and drainage that can contribute to sanitation ladder using available resources at affordable price that meet at least minimum standard.
  • Consider different maintenance mechanisms, ensuring that they are appropriate to the local context and cultural norms and that facilities are sustainable
  • Regularly conduct water quality test/analysis from and inform result to WASH technical team for decision.
  • Coordinate the data collection in targeted aquifers and monitor water levels, temperature, and conductivity in collaboration with NIHSA.

Mission 2: Build the capacity of staff and partners including community engagement.
  • Prepare training tools on relevant technical topics and conduct trainings for both internal staff and external stakeholders
  • Development of technical guidelines and tools related to quality WASH intervention.
  • Assess areas for improvement and recording lessons learnt for future activities
  • Support the formation gender-sensitive WASH Committees (WASHCOMs) and artisan in target communities, ensuring female representation.
  • Building the capacity of consortium partners on water, sanitation and hygiene.
  • Train and build the capacity of WASHCOMs (WASH Committees), local artisans, Government stakeholders and partners on the construction and maintenance of WASH facilities.
  • Engage with communities to ensure their active participation in the planning, implementation, and monitoring of WASH activities.

Mission 3: Coordinate with internal staff and local stakeholders to ensure smooth project implementation

title: Menadžer proizvodnje - proces profilisanja
description:
U potrazi smo za iskusnim menadžerom koji će preuzeti odgovornost za upravljanje, razvoj i kontinuirano unapređenje procesa profilisanja, kao i za rukovođenje timom koji realizuje ovaj proces.

Ova pozicija objedinjuje procesno i tehničko upravljanje sa vođenjem ljudi. Menadžer za proces profilisanja odgovoran je za stabilnost i efikasnost procesa, optimalno korišćenje proizvodnih kapaciteta, kvalitet proizvoda i kontinuirano unapređenje tehnologije i načina rada.

Ključne odgovornosti:

  • upravljanje i razvoj procesa profilisanja na proizvodnim linijama;

  • rukovođenje, koordinacija i razvoj zaposlenih uključenih u proces profilisanja;

  • organizovanje rada tima i jasno delegiranje odgovornosti i zadataka;

  • postavljanje očekivanja i praćenje učinka zaposlenih;

  • davanje redovnog feedbacka, praćenje razvoja kompetencija i predlaganje programa obuke;

  • odgovornost za realizaciju proizvodnih planova u pogledu količine, kvaliteta i rokova;

  • praćenje ključnih pokazatelja performansi procesa i identifikovanje prostora za unapređenje;

  • analiza zastoja, škarta, neusaglašenosti i drugih gubitaka u procesu i pokretanje aktivnosti za njihovo otklanjanje;

  • optimizacija proizvodnih procesa, tehnoloških parametara i iskorišćenja kapaciteta;

  • analiza podataka iz proizvodnih sistema i korišćenje podataka za donošenje odluka i unapređenje procesa;

  • razvoj i standardizacija procesa, procedura, radnih metoda i tehničkih uputstava;

  • učešće u projektima unapređenja i razvoja proizvodnih linija, opreme i tehnologije (WCM metodologija kontinuiranog unapređenja);

  • saradnja sa Službom planiranja proizvodnje na optimalnom korišćenju proizvodnih kapaciteta i prilagođavanju procesa potrebama proizvodnje;

  • saradnja sa funkcijama kvaliteta i održavanja na rešavanju uzroka neusaglašenosti, kvarova i zastoja;

  • primena i razvoj WCM metodologije, kao i iniciranje i praćenje aktivnosti kontinuiranog unapređenja;

  • praćenje i unapređenje 5S standarda i drugih standarda organizacije proizvodnog procesa;

  • iniciranje korektivnih i preventivnih mera na osnovu rezultata procesa;

  • koordinacija rada Tim lidera, Vođa smene i drugih zaposlenih uključenih u proces profilisanja;

  • izveštavanje Direktora proizvodnje o rezultatima procesa, ključnim izazovima, realizaciji planova i predlozima za unapređenje.

Koga tražimo?

  • visoko obrazovanje: mašinski fakultet / mašinski inženjer;

  • iskustvo u rukovođenju proizvodnim timovima;

  • iskustvo u upravljanju ili unapređenju proizvodnih procesa;

  • izražene liderske, organizacione i analitičke sposobnosti;

  • sposobnost sagledavanja procesa kao celine i identifikovanja uzroka problema;

  • iskustvo u vođenju projekata i realizaciji aktivnosti kontinuiranog unapređenja;

  • proaktivnost i usmerenost na rezultate;

  • poznavanje WCM/Lean principa predstavlja prednost.

Tvoj fokus

Ljudi + proces + rezultat.

Od osobe na ovoj poziciji očekujemo da istovremeno razume tehnologiju i proizvodni proces, vodi ljude i gradi odgovornost u timu, prepoznaje gubitke i probleme, pronalazi njihova sistemska rešenja i pretvara ih u merljiva poboljšanja.

Šta nudimo?

  • stabilno zaposlenje u kompaniji sa dugogodišnjim iskustvom i jasnom pozicijom u metaloprerađivačkoj industriji;

  • rad u kompaniji koja kontinuirano ulaže u proizvodne kapacitete, tehnologiju i unapređenje procesa;

  • mogućnost stručnog i liderskog razvoja kroz rad eksterne i interne treninge;

  • priliku da preuzmete odgovornost za važan proizvodni proces i direktno utičete na njegov razvoj i rezultate;

  • mogućnost da kroz svoje znanje i iskustvo unapređujete tehnologiju, organizaciju rada i efikasnost procesa profilisanja;

  • rukovodeću poziciju sa odgovornošću za ljude, proces i rezultate.

title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

- Scaffolding-industry experience.

- Metalworking or welding skills.

- Forklift experience.

- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

- Car driving licence (Category B).

- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

- Permanent, full-time employment.

- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco's Webex Engineering Group is redefining the future of collaboration. We're building a world where people connect effortlessly to enjoy modern, uncompromised collaboration across every room, desk, pocket, and application.

Our technology powers industry-leading products like Slido, Webex Meetings, Webex Calling, and Webex Contact Center. As a member of our team, your work will ensure every user gets a truly immersive experience regardless of device or location, empowering the hybrid working patterns of the future.

Our team is based in Bratislava. We operate a hybrid working model.

Your Impact

As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines. You will work closely with senior engineers to build robust, efficient solutions for streaming and batch processing, gaining hands‑on experience with our production tech stack. Your work will directly impact the insights available to our partners through Partner Hub Analytics, helping them optimize their operations and improve their experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines for both streaming and batch processing with guidance from senior team members.

  • Develop and optimize data workflows using Apache Pinot, Apache Iceberg, Flink, and Spark.

  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design discussions, code reviews, and testing.

  • Improve data pipeline performance, reliability, and observability by identifying and resolving technical issues.

  • Leverage AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate your productivity and learning.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, product management, and data teams.

  • Participate in incident resolution and learn from production issues through postmortems.

  • Commit to continuous learning, data quality, and operational excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of professional data engineering or software engineering experience (or equivalent internship/project experience).

  • Foundational knowledge of data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) and/or distributed systems.

  • Solid understanding of software development and architecture concepts with a willingness to learn new technologies quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Apache Pinot, Apache Iceberg, Flink, or Spark.

  • Familiarity with Java, Python, or Scala.

  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments.

is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale.   • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 1-5 years in conversational AI, solution engineering, system integration, or delivering AI/LLM-based applications in customer environments, software engineering, or system integration with hands-on delivery of AI/LLM-based solutions.

title: Director of Strategic Finance, Europe
description:
Navan (Nasdaq: NAVN) is the leading all-in-one business travel, payments, and expense management platform. Our mission is to make travel easy for every frequent traveler by delivering an intuitive experience that travelers love and finance teams rely on. From AI-driven search to automated expense reconciliation, we help our customers focus on the human connections that drive their success. Our team is our competitive edge – a high-performance group of smart, driven people committed to winning together. At Navan, we provide an environment where top talent excels, offering the autonomy and fast-paced trajectory needed to build a defining career.

We are looking for a Director / Senior Director of Strategic Finance to act as the primary financial and commercial leader for our Signature Service organisation out of the UK. In this highly visible role, you will serve as the strategic right-hand to the CEO of Signature Services while driving critical global initiatives. You will lead complex structural integrations, shape our global pricing strategy, and build scalable frameworks that drive monetization and streamline commercial operations. We are seeking a dynamic, "commercial first" leader who thrives in ambiguity, commands the room with data-driven storytelling, and can seamlessly translate complex financial architecture into actionable business growth. This role will not be responsible for treasury and accounting but would work cross functionally with their counterparts.

What You’ll Do

  • European Leadership & Signature Services Business Partner: Serve as the core strategic finance partner to the CEO of Navan Signature Services, demonstrating strong partnership with executive leadership and exceptional executive communication skills on diverse regional projects. Fully own the financial strategy and execution for the signature services division to drive growth and profitability.
  • Global Ecosystem Integration: Spearhead the global integration and strategic wind-down of legacy subsidiaries, exercising extensive cross-functional influence to ensure all international entities are seamlessly unified under a single, streamlined financial ecosystem.
  • Global Market & Dynamic Pricing Strategy: Conceptualize and drive global go-to-market frameworks, leveraging deep experience in bespoke pricing and dynamic pricing strategies to adapt to varying market conditions and maximize revenue capture.
  • Strategic Leadership & Monetization: Build and lead a high-performing pricing center of excellence; own the end-to-end monetization roadmap—integrating tiering, value-based pricing, and usage-based financial models—to drive NRR; and develop strict ROI frameworks ensuring product innovation directly translates to margin expansion.
  • Commercial Operations & Deal Execution: Partner with Deal Desk and Sales leadership to architect high-value enterprise exceptions; design and deploy real-time automated pricing calculators to accelerate sales cycles; and own the scenario-modeling engines that provide account management with data-driven facts to optimize renewals and minimize churn.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Education

  • Leadership: 12+ years of experience in strategic finance, pricing, or commercial strategy, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a high-growth technology or SaaS environment in Europe.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly preferred.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Pricing Expertise: Deep understanding of SaaS monetization levers (usage-based, seat-based, tiered) and price elasticity modeling.
  • Financial Powerhouse: Expert-level financial modeling and a mastery of SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
  • Systems Thinker: Experience optimizing pricing/CPQ tools and integrating them with financial planning systems (e.g., Pigment,, Salesforce).

Professional Attributes

  • Executive Presence: Ability to command a room and influence C-suite decisions through data-driven storytelling and clear commercial logic.
  • Negotiation Mindset: A "commercial first" approach to finance—you seek ways to say "yes" to deals while protecting the company’s bottom line.
  • Detailed: Possesses the agility to zoom out for big-picture financial modeling and zoom in to ensure the integrity of the underlying data.
  • Adaptability: Proven ability to build structure in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and a relentless bias for action.

  • Partner with the Director and Assistant Director on creative intent, tone and performance for key characters and sequences;
  • Managing and reviewing work from our offshore partner animation studio.
  • Mentor animators who are new to rigged workflows, including those transitioning from a hand drawn animation background;
  • Assign scenes and manage workload across the team in line with the production schedule;
  • Ensure all animation aligns with the show's style guide and established performance benchmarks;
  • Liaise with Layout, Compositing and Editorial to ensure animation is delivered on time and to spec;
  • Ensure all work remains confidential per code of conduct and security forms.


About you:

  • Proven experience as a 2D Animation Supervisor, Lead Animator or similar senior role in a 2D animation production;
  • Strong hands on experience specifically with rigged or puppet based 2D animation, such as Toon Boom Harmony rigging, rather than hand drawn frame by frame animation alone;
  • Solid understanding of rig mechanics, including pegs, deformers and constraints, and how to work within them to produce natural weight, timing and appeal;
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback;
  • Experience mentoring or upskilling animators, including guiding hand drawn animators into a rigged pipeline;
  • A sharp eye for timing, staging, weight and character performance;
  • Good sense of narrative storytelling, comic timing and camera;
  • Comfortable working to broadcast schedules and managing competing priorities across a season;
  • Ability to be adaptable, flexible and responsive to changes;
  • Passion for animation and storytelling.


How to register your interest

Please send through:

  1. Your portfolio / demo reel (link preferred), ideally showing rigged animation work.
  2. Your location, and whether you're after remote or in-studio work.
  3. Your availability, including any current commitments.


We'll be in touch as timing and role details firm up over the coming months.


What do we do?

Flying Bark Productions is a renowned independent producer of family-focused animation entertainment. For over 50 years, our 2D and 3D production facility has created award-winning feature films and TV series.


Why work with us?

  • We work on some pretty cool projects - check out our website:

  • We have a hybrid approach to work with flexible work from home days on offer.
  • Career development is important to us so we offer training and support opportunities whenever possible.
  • Our employees say our culture is the best they've ever experienced - everyone is welcome and celebrated!

title: DevOps Engineer (K/M) - Dział Rozwoju Oprogramowania
description:
What makes your job exciting

O nas

Tworzymy i rozwijamy autorskie produkty oraz dedykowane aplikacje dla dużych polskich i międzynarodowych przedsiębiorstw. Budujemy je w architekturze mikroserwisowej, w Javie, .NET, Node.js, TypeScripcie i uruchamiamy w kontenerach.

Nasze systemy działają w All for One Data Center, w infrastrukturach klientów oraz w chmurach publicznych: AWS, Azure i GCP. Wybór dostawcy chmury nie jest tu kluczowy, ponieważ pracujemy przede wszystkim z warstwą aplikacyjną i z procesem jej dostarczania.

Rekrutujemy do Działu Rozwoju Oprogramowania, dlatego stanowisko jest bliżej obszaru Dev niż Ops. Infrastrukturę przygotowuje i utrzymuje nasz dział IT lub klient: system operacyjny, sieć, silnik Dockera oraz klaster Kubernetes.

Twoja odpowiedzialność zaczyna się warstwę wyżej, przy aplikacji i procesie jej dostarczania. Część zagadnień planujemy wspólnie z IT, dlatego cenimy zrozumienie również warstwy niższej. Szukamy osoby, która zadba o to, aby nasze rozwiązania można było sprawnie zbudować, wdrożyć i utrzymać w każdym środowisku, w którym pracują.

Do Twoich Zadań Będzie Należeć

  • rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD dla aplikacji w Javie, .NET i Node.js/TypeScripcie,
  • przygotowywanie obrazów kontenerów oraz pakowanie wdrożeń w Helm charty, wersjonowane dla poszczególnych środowisk i klientów,
  • wdrażanie aplikacji na klaster Kubernetes i konfiguracja warstwy kontenerowej, w tym zasobów, limitów i skalowania,
  • konfiguracja komponentów warstwy aplikacyjnej, na przykład serwerów aplikacyjnych i reverse proxy, oraz automatyzacja tych czynności w Ansible,
  • automatyzacja instalacji i aktualizacji produktu, również w środowiskach klientów,
  • konfiguracja i rozwój monitoringu, zbierania logów oraz alertowania,
  • rozbudowa pipeline’ów o bramki jakościowe: analizę SonarQube, testy automatyczne i skanowanie zależności,
  • zarządzanie konfiguracją i sekretami aplikacji w sposób bezpieczny dla środowisk produkcyjnych,
  • udział w projektowaniu rozwiązań: strategie wdrożeń bez przestoju, skalowalność, spójność środowisk deweloperskich, testowych i produkcyjnych,
  • wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w diagnostyce problemów środowiskowych.

What awaits you

Wymagania

  • minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze CI/CD i automatyzacji dostarczania oprogramowania,
  • praktyczna znajomość Dockera: budowanie i optymalizacja obrazów, sieci, wolumeny, diagnostyka,
  • doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetesem w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz umiejętność diagnozowania problemów z uruchamianiem i wydajnością aplikacji w klastrze,
  • znajomość Helma na poziomie tworzenia i utrzymania własnych chartów,
  • umiejętność pisania idempotentnych playbooków i ról w Ansible,
  • doświadczenie z Jenkinsem i GitHub Actions w modelu pipeline as code,
  • swobodna praca z Gitem i SonarQube w zespole deweloperskim,
  • znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i analizy logów; naszym standardem są Prometheus, Grafana oraz Loki lub Graylog,
  • dobra znajomość systemu Linux oraz umiejętność pisania skryptów w Bashu,
  • język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2, ponieważ pracujemy w środowisku międzynarodowym.

Mile Widziane

  • znajomość Terraform, przynajmniej na poziomie czytania i rozumienia kodu; infrastrukturę planujemy wspólnie z działem IT,
  • znajomość jednego z języków, w których tworzymy nasze produkty: Javy, TypeScriptu lub .NET, w zakresie pozwalającym analizować kod aplikacji i jej wymagania uruchomieniowe,
  • doświadczenie z podejściem GitOps oraz narzędziami ArgoCD lub Flux,
  • doświadczenie operacyjne z bazami PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra lub Solr,
  • wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w pracy inżynierskiej, w tym GitHub Copilot oraz rozwiązań opartych o modele językowe,
  • certyfikaty potwierdzające kompetencje w obszarze DevOps.

Your talents

Oferujemy

  • Możliwość pracy hybrydowej - 2 dni w tygodniu z biura w Poznaniu na ul. Ratajczaka,
  • Pracę przy rozwoju produktów, a nie w obszarze utrzymania zgłoszeń,
  • Wpływ na kształt procesów CI/CD i standardy techniczne w zespołach produktowych,
  • Kontakt z kilkoma stosami technologicznymi w ramach jednej architektury,
  • Możliwość rozwoju w kierunku platform engineeringu, SRE lub architektury rozwiązań,
  • Pracę w zgranym, nastawionym na rozwój zespole, otwartym na nowe pomysły i dzielenie się wiedzą.

This is what you can look forward to

Valuable personal freedom

Flexible working hours, mobile work, and a high level of self-responsibility & creative flexibility – providing you with the freedom to incorporate your personality, your rhythm, and your ideas.

30 days leave

Take your time for the things that are important to you.

Great prospects

Create the career you want and benefit from our digital learning platform “One Academy”, practice-oriented career models, systematic knowledge exchange and -expansion with experienced colleagues, as well as dedicated promotion programs.

Attractive bonuses & discounts

Benefit from bonuses for special projects, premiums for staff recommendations, and -anniversaries, staff discounts for private online shopping, discounted leisure- and fitness offerings (Qualitrain) and bike leasing (JobRad).

Work-life balance & health

Among other things, we offer you stress preventions & conflict management trainings, child- and elderly care support, health checks and medical check-ups, company pension scheme models & disability insurance models, as well as an ergonomic workplace.

We Are One

Solidarity, trust, and appreciation are the basis for your and our success – and respectful cooperation on equal footing. You will experience this special Spirit from the first day of our cross-departmental Group-Starter Training.

About All For One Poland

Us: A dedicated community of more than 3,200 transformation- and integration experts, New Work advocates, cybersecurity specialists, big data- and business analysts, industrial IoT engineers and consultants working in SAP, Microsoft, and IBM environments. A a leading consulting- and IT-group, we bring together strategy- and management consulting, process consulting, industry expertise, and technological know-how, providing both IT consulting and -services under one roof. We serve and support more than 4,500 customers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland with their company transformation as well as the development of their competitive position.

title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

The Enterprise Architect is responsible for designing, documenting, and leading the implementation of technical solutions for customers following the sale of Veeam products. This role bridges customer business requirements with Veeam’s technology, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with best practices, while also supporting partner-driven implementations.

The position involves technical leadership, customer consultation, and collaboration with internal teams to deliver successful outcomes—particularly for large enterprise customers undergoing digital transformation.

Beyond direct design and delivery, the Enterprise Architect develops reference architectures and design guidelines that standardize deployments across both customer-led and partner-led projects. Additionally, they collaborate with pre-sales teams to ensure a smooth transition from initial solution design to implementation.

What You’ll Do

Technical Discovery & Analysis

  • Conduct technical discovery sessions with customers to assess their existing IT landscape and requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and architecture enhancements based on Veeam solutions.
  • Solution Design, Documentation & Reference Architectures
  • Design both high-level and detailed solution architectures tailored to customer environments.
  • Create low-level design documents and detailed technical specifications to guide implementation teams.
  • Develop and maintain reference architectures to standardize solution deployments across both direct customer implementations and partner-led projects.
  • Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, design specifications, and implementation plans
  • Ensure solution designs adhere to security, compliance, and scalability best practices.

Project Definition & Estimation

  • Work with Project Managers and stakeholders to define project scope, deliverable, timelines, and resource requirements.
  • Provide level-of-effort estimations to support project planning and resource allocation.

Implementation Support & Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical oversight during solution deployment and post-sales implementation.
  • Assist in proof-of-concept (PoC) projects and technical workshops to validate solution architectures.
  • Support and guide partner-driven deployments, ensuring they follow Veeam’s best practices and technical standards.
  • Support troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex implementation challenges.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure a smooth handover from pre-sales engagements to deployment.
  • Engage with customers, partners, and internal teams to ensure successful solution adoption.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, translating business objectives into effective technical strategies.
  • Communicate technical details effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Continuous Improvement & Technology Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging technologies (especially in containers, security, and hybrid cloud) to enhance solution architectures.
  • Contribute to the development and update of internal best practices and technical standards. improving delivery efficiency and partner enablement.

What You’ll Bring

  • IT experience, including in a solution architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in data protection, backup & recovery, disaster recovery (DR), and cybersecurity.
  • Hands-on experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and container security in enterprise environments.
  • Strong technical knowledge of virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and storage systems.
  • A record of leading transformation projects for large enterprise customers, ensuring technical solutions support business-wide digital evolution.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, etc.), and IT governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills with a strong ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a post-sales consulting, professional services, or solution delivery role with direct customer engagement

Bonus Skills

  • TOGAF (or equivalent enterprise architecture certification) .
  • Veeam VMCE .
  • Experience with automation & scripting (PowerShell, Python).
  • Familiarity with large-scale IT infrastructure deployments.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and drive innovation.
  • Strong Database skills including Database administration expertise will be preferred.

What You’ll Get

  • 15 to 21 annual vacation days (based on role level), plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Private medical plan for employees and eligible dependents, including major medical, hospital, surgical, and outpatient coverage
  • Dental insurance with comprehensive coverage for employees and dependents
  • Annual wellbeing allowance for health and wellness support
  • Life and accident insurance for added financial protection
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

title: Viestinnän korkeakouluharjoittelija kevääksi 2027
description:
Haluatko päästä tekemään viestintää, joka vaikuttaa monien nuorten tulevaisuuteen?

Nuorten yrittäjyys ja talous NYT ry vahvistaa lasten ja nuorten työelämä-, yrittäjyys- ja taloustaitoja eri puolilla Suomea. Etsimme Helsinkiin viestintätiimiimme korkeakouluharjoittelijaa keväälle 2027.

Toiveena on, että harjoittelu alkaisi tammikuun alussa, ja sen kesto olisi 3–4 kuukautta.

Tämä ei ole harjoittelu, jossa seuraat sivusta

Harjoittelun aikana työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista ja innostunutta viestintätiimiä. Saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja pääset mukaan tekemään oikeita asioita, ottamaan vastuuta ja jättämään kädenjälkesi Suomen suurimman nuorten yrittäjyystapahtuman toteutukseen. Harjoittelun aikana saat käytännön kokemusta tapahtumaviestinnästä ja -markkinoinnista, sosiaalisen median sisällöntuotannosta, verkkosivujen ylläpidosta, haastattelun kirjoittamisesta ja mediaviestinnästä.

Tehtävänkuva

Harjoittelun pääpaino on Uskalla Yrittää -tapahtumakokonaisuuden viestinnässä ja valmisteluissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- Uskalla Yrittää -tapahtumien viestinnän ja markkinoinnin toteuttamista



- sisältöjen kirjoittamista verkkosivuille, uutisiin ja sosiaaliseen mediaan



- työmatkoja Uskalla Yrittää -tapahtumiin eri puolille Suomea



- tapahtumissa valokuvaamista (perustaito riittää)



- muita viestintätiimin avustavia tehtäviä


Tehtävässä on olennaista, että

- kirjoitat sujuvasti suomeksi ja ymmärrät ruotsia



- tartut tehtäviin oma-aloitteisesti



- viihdyt ihmisten parissa ja pidät yhteistyöstä



- et hätkähdä, vaikka päivän suunnitelma joskus eläisi



- olet valmis matkustamaan Uskalla Yrittää -aluetapahtumiin



- haluat oppia uutta ja kehittää viestintäosaamistasi



- olet oikeutettu yliopiston harjoittelutukeen (tarkistathan asian oppilaitoksestasi)


Arvostamme viestinnän, markkinoinnin ja journalismin yliopisto-opintoja pääaineena, mutta myös sivuaineopinnot ja vahva suuntautuminen viestinnän alalle ovat eduksi. Kerro hakemuksessa, jos omaat kokemusta sisällöntuotannosta, sosiaalisesta mediasta tai verkkosivujen ylläpidosta – tai sinulla on peräti WordPress- ja Canva-osaamista. Digitaalisten työkalujen käyttöön annamme toki myös perehdytyksen.

Työskentely NYTissä

NYTissä olet osa valtakunnallista, työstään innostuvaa porukkaa. Teemme töitä yhdessä muita kannustaen ja pidämme myös hauskaa. Työllämme on selkeä tarkoitus: haluamme antaa nuorille valmiuksia rakentaa omaa tulevaisuuttaan.

Esihenkilönäsi toimii viestintäjohtaja, ja hänen lisäkseen saat tuen myös koko viestintätiimiltä.

Työsuhde

Toiveenamme on, että voit aloittaa tammikuun alussa. Harjoittelun kesto on 3–4 kuukautta. Työpisteemme sijaitsee Helsingin keskustassa, osoitteessa Eteläranta 10. Työskentelymuotojamme ovat lähi- ja etätyö, mutta harjoitteluun kuuluu työskentely toimistolla vähintään kahtena päivänä viikossa. Palkka on 2 099 € / kk.

Kiinnostuitko?

Voit kuvata hakemuksen liitteeksi maksimissaan 1 minuutin mittaisen videon, jolla esittelet itsesi, osaamisesi ja miksi haet meille töihin.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si viimeistään 13.10.2026. Kirjaathan hakemukseen tiedon oikeudestasi yliopiston harjoittelutukeen.

Voimme haastatella hakijoita jo hakuprosessin aikana.

Lisätiedot

Voit kysyä tehtävästä viestintäjohtaja Kaisa Huikurilta sähköpostilla koska vain tai puhelimitse seuraavina aikoina: 30.9. klo 14-15.00 tai 8.10. klo 12-13.00. Yhteystiedot: kaisa.huikuri@nuortennyt.fi, puh. 045 773 493 47

Haluatko kevääksi harjoittelun, jossa pääset tekemään oikeita viestinnän töitä, oppimaan nopeasti ja vaikuttamaan nuorten tulevaisuuteen? Hae mukaan NYTin viestintätiimiin.


Nuorten yrittäjyys ja talous NYT

Nuorten yrittäjyys ja talous NYT on voittoa tavoittelematon yhdistys, joka tarjoaa työelämä-, talous- ja yrittäjyystaitoja tukevia palveluita ja opintokokonaisuuksia kouluille, oppilaitoksille ja kunnille. Vuosibudjettimme on noin 10 miljoonaa euroa. Meillä työskentelee n. 74 kokopäiväistä ja n. 150 tuntityöntekijää. Tavoitteemme on, että jokainen lapsi ja nuori lähtökohdista riippumatta saa mahdollisuuden oppia tulevaisuutensa kannalta tärkeitä taitoja. Vahvistamme osaltamme lasten ja nuorten valmiuksia muuttuvan työelämän tarpeisiin, oman arjen hallintaan ja omien vahvuuksien tunnistamiseen. Vastaamme NYT Yrityskylän toiminnasta. Olemme osa kansainvälistä JA Worldwide -järjestöä. Yhdistyksemme jäsenenä on mm. elinkeinoelämän järjestöjä, yliopistoja ja säätiöitä.

NYT on työnantaja, joka haluaa edistää työelämän monimuotoisuutta ja toivomme, että hakijoiden joukossa olisi kaiken ikäisiä, sukupuolisia, kielisiä, kulttuuritaustaisia ja vähemmistöön kuuluvia henkilöitä.

title: Serviceadviseur
description:
Ben jij toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de Automotivebranche? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Met jouw communicatieve skills weet jij samen met je collega’s de vestiging van Volkswagen Audi naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je komt te werken binnen een gedreven team waar volop doorgroeimogelijkheden zijn. Benieuwd? Lees dan snel verder!


Wat ga je doen?

Als Serviceadviseur kom je te werken binnen onze Volkswagen Audi vestiging in Valkenswaard. Binnen jouw functie ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten die service en onderhoud nodigen hebben voor hun voertuigen. Met jouw administratieve skills weet jij alles wat er in de werkplaats gebeurt te verwerken. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van afspraken, het ontvangen en te woord staan van de klanten en uiteraard voor het adviseren van de best mogelijke oplossingen. Daarnaast coördineer je de werkzaamheden in de werkplaats en zorg je ervoor dat alles volgens planning verloopt. Kortom, jij bent onmisbaar voor de klant én je collega’s. Daarnaast houd je je bezig met;

  • Het aanmaken van werkorders;

  • Administratief verwerken van de werkzaamheden aan de auto;

  • Inplannen van de werkzaamheden bij collega’s in de werkplaats;

  • Klantvragen en klachten afhandelen;

  • Het bespreken van facturen en uitleg geven aan de klant over de uitgevoerde werkzaamheden.

Wie ben jij?

Doordat jij organisatorisch en commutatief sterk bent weet jij het overzicht goed te bewaren, ook als het plotseling erg druk wordt aan de balie. Jij houdt ervan om met de klanten in contact te staan en hen te ontzorgen. Samen met jouw serviceadviseur collega’s zetten jullie net dat stapje extra om de klanten nóg beter terug de weg op te helpen. Ook als je nog geen ervaring hebt zien we graag jouw cv tegemoet! Verder beschik jij over onder andere:

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

  • Fulltime beschikbaarheid.

Wat bieden wij jou?
In 75 jaar tijd is de Van Mossel Automotive Groep uitgegroeid tot het grootste en leukste autobedrijf van de BeNeLux. Wij zijn ambitieus en groeien hard. Ondanks dat we een groot bedrijf zijn, blijven een familiebedrijf en dat is bij onze vestiging ook goed te voelen. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat er bij ons op de werkvloer een goede sfeer hangt, je komt te werken in een team van gedreven collega’s en wij houden van Brabantse nuchterheid. Naast ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en (door)groei bieden we je een baan waarbij je veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een uitstekend salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Fulltime functie met doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • 24 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Het volgen van trainingen, cursussen en workshops naar keuze;

  • Onbeperkt gebruikmaken van de Van Mossel Academy;

  • Je kunt gebruik maken van ons fiets leaseplan;

  • Sporten met korting door bedrijfsfitness;

  • En natuurlijk een leuke uitdagende baan binnen een snel groeiende organisatie!

Interesse gekregen na het lezen van deze vacature en herken jij je in het profiel? Solliciteren dan snel via de website.

title: Lääkäri, aikuisten mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut (Sipoo/Loviisa/Askola)
description:
Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue hakee LÄÄKÄRIÄ, jonka sydän sykkii mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöhön. Aloitus 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Virka on vakituinen 50% työajalla ja sijoittuu ensisijaisesti aikuisten päihdepalveluihin.

Työtehtävään kuuluu jalkautuminen eri toimipisteisiin Sipoon, Loviisan ja Askolan alueella. Työ sisältää lähi- ja etätapaamisia sekä konsultaatioihin vastaamista.

Lääkärin vastuulla on lääketieteellinen riippuvuushoidon suunnittelu ja seuranta. Työssäsi korostuu asiantuntijuus, yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä positiivinen asenne. Työ on itsenäistä ja edellyttää erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja. Lähiohjaus järjestyy. Työtä tukevat säännölliset työryhmän kokoukset, hyvät konsultaatiomahdollisuudet ja työnohjaus.

Kelpoisuusehtona on Suomessa laillistettu lääkäri sekä päihdelääketieteen erityispätevyys. Kielitaitovaatimuksena on yhden kotimaisen kielen hyvä taito sekä suullisesti että kirjallisesti ja toisen kotimaisen kielen hyvä suullinen taito. Eduksi katsotaan vahva työkokemus opioidikorvaushoidosta sekä päihdehoidosta.

Kelpoisuusehdot täyttävien hakijoiden puuttuessa tehtävä voidaan täyttää määräaikaisesti myös päihdelääketieteen erityispätevyyttä suorittavalla henkilöllä, joka on Suomessa laillistettu lääkäri.

Palvelusuhteen ehdot määräytyvät LS:n mukaisesti. Palkkaus on uraporrasjärjestelmän mukainen. Työaika on 50 % eli 19,125 h/vko. Koeaika virassa on kuusi kuukautta.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain § 48 mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä § 55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Valinta on ehdollinen, kunnes tehtävään valittu on esittänyt työterveyshuollon arvion edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä kuukauden kuluessa työn aloittamisesta.

Lähetä hakemuksesi 11.10.2026 klo 23:59 mennessä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa aikuisten mielenterveys- ja päihdepalveluiden esihenkilö Anni Niiranen, anni.niiranen@itauusimaa.fi, puh. 040 480 3692.

title: Junior Product Engineer (Full-stack, PHP + TypeScript)
description:
Junior Product Engineer (Full-stack, PHP + TypeScript)

Kim jesteśmy?

Droplabs to krakowska firma, która stworzyła system sprzedaży biletów online, wykorzystywany przez największe firmy z branży Tours&Attractions&Activities, jak np. aquaparki, parki rozrywki czy inne atrakcje turystyczne. Naszym celem jest digitalizacja branży rekreacyjno-turystycznej aby wszystkim usprawnić dostęp do najciekawszych atrakcji. Naszymi klientami są m.in. Tatrzański Park Narodowy, Chochołowskie Termy czy Zoo Wrocław.

Od 2023 roku propagujemy i wdrażamy w obiektach turystycznych strategię cen dynamicznych. Opieramy ją na własnych rozwiązaniach z zakresu uczenia maszynowego. Pomagają one przewidywać frekwencję i wyciągać maksymalną wartość z dostępności atrakcji w realiach danego sezonu, pogody i prowadzonego marketingu. Dzięki temu nasi klienci mogą podejmować decyzje w oparciu o dane, efektywniej zarządzać dostępnością i zwiększać przychody, a odwiedzający zyskują lepszy dostęp do atrakcji - samodzielnie podejmując decyzje odpowiadające ich preferencjom budżetowym i preferencjom co do terminu wizyty.

Kogo szukamy

AI sprawiło, że samo pisanie kodu jest dziś szybkie i tanie. Dla osoby na początku kariery to zmienia wszystko: mniej zależy od tego, ile składni masz w głowie, a znacznie więcej od tego, czy rozumiesz problem, potrafisz ocenić, czy zaproponowane rozwiązanie jest dobre, i czy jesteś w stanie obronić swój wybór.

Szukamy Junior Product Engineera - osoby, która chce się nauczyć prowadzić funkcję od początku do końca: od zrozumienia, po co ona w ogóle powstaje, przez implementację, po wdrożenie i sprawdzenie, czy rzeczywiście zadziałała. Na start będziesz to robić przy wsparciu bardziej doświadczonych osób i na mniejszych zakresach. Z czasem przejmujesz coraz więcej.

Pracujesz full-stackowo: PHP po stronie backendu i TypeScript z Reactem po stronie interfejsu. Nie zakładamy, że masz równie mocne podstawy w obu warstwach. Zakładamy, że nie chcesz zamknąć się w jednej z nich.

Pracujesz nad systemem, który obsługuje miliony rezerwacji, a jednocześnie ma panel, z którego codziennie korzystają pracownicy term, aquaparków, parków narodowych i muzeów. Jedno i drugie musi po prostu działać.

Jak wygląda ta rola w praktyce

  • Piszesz kod, który idzie na produkcję. Nie na sandbox, nie do szuflady. Funkcja, którą zrealizujesz jednego dnia, kolejnego sprzedaje bilety.
  • Rozumiesz, po co robisz to, co robisz. Zadanie dostajesz razem z kontekstem: jaki problem klienta rozwiązujemy i po czym poznamy, że się udało. Jeśli tego kontekstu zabraknie, masz o niego dopytać.
  • Uczysz się na realnym kodzie i realnym code review. Każdy Twój PR przechodzi przegląd, a komentarze tłumaczą "dlaczego", nie tylko "zmień to".
  • Masz krótką drogę decyzyjną. Pracujesz w niewielkim zespole, bezpośrednio z CTO i współzałożycielem, bez warstw pośrednich.

Twoje pierwsze miesiące

  • Pierwszy tydzień: uruchomione środowisko, pierwsze wdrożenia na produkcję, poznanie produktu od strony klienta.
  • Pierwszy miesiąc: samodzielne mniejsze zadania na backendzie i froncie, z pełnym wsparciem przy code review.
  • Pierwsze pół roku: prowadzisz mniejsze funkcje od zrozumienia problemu po wdrożenie, sam proponujesz rozwiązania i potrafisz uzasadnić swoje decyzje.

Zakres Twojej pracy

  • Rozwój produktu: implementacja funkcji obejmujących backend i frontend, od modelu danych i API po interfejs, z którego korzysta klient.
  • Jakość: testy jednostkowe i funkcjonalne, udział w code review, dbanie o to, żeby zmiana działała także tydzień po wdrożeniu.
  • Utrzymanie: diagnozowanie i naprawa błędów zgłaszanych przez klientów, dochodzenie do pierwotnej przyczyny zamiast gaszenia objawów.
  • Praca wspierana przez AI: Claude Code jest u nas codziennym narzędziem pracy. Oczekujemy, że będziesz z niego korzystać, i że zrozumiesz każdą linijkę, którą wypuszczasz na produkcję.
  • Współpraca z designem i resztą zespołu: dopytujesz o kontekst, zgłaszasz wątpliwości i proponujesz alternatywy zamiast milcząco realizować coś, co wydaje Ci się bez sensu.

Wymagania

  • Znasz PHP 8+ i rozumiesz podstawy programowania obiektowego.
  • Znasz JavaScript, masz kontakt z TypeScriptem i podstawy Reacta.
  • Znasz SQL i relacyjne bazy danych (MySQL).
  • Umiesz pisać testy jednostkowe (PHPUnit).
  • Znasz gita na poziomie codziennej pracy w zespole (branche, PR, rozwiązywanie konfliktów).
  • Korzystasz z narzędzi agentowych, np. Claude Code, i potrafisz wyjaśnić kod, który powstał z ich pomocą.
  • Potrafisz dobrać rozwiązanie do problemu, zamiast stosować jedno podejście do wszystkiego.
  • Chcesz zrozumieć, po co powstaje funkcja, którą masz zbudować.
  • Umiesz powiedzieć "nie rozumiem" i dopytać, zanim przepalisz dwa dni na złym założeniu.
  • Uczysz się szybko i samodzielnie, a przy tym nie boisz się prosić o pomoc.

Nie wymagamy komercyjnego doświadczenia. Wymagamy, żebyś miał co pokazać: projekt, staż, praktyki, wkład w open source albo cokolwiek, co realnie działało.

Mile widziane

  • Zbudowałeś i wdrożyłeś własny projekt, z którego korzystał ktoś poza Tobą.
  • Miałeś kontakt z Symfony lub Laravelem.
  • Znasz podstawy Dockera.
  • Rozumiesz, jak działa REST API i jak projektuje się integracje między systemami.
  • Rozwijasz własne workflow oparte na AI i potrafisz opowiedzieć, co się w nich sprawdziło, a co nie.
  • Masz wyczucie UX: zauważasz problemy z interakcją i niespójności w interfejsie.

Ta rola raczej nie jest dla Ciebie, jeśli

  • Czujesz się najlepiej, gdy każda decyzja i szczegół implementacji są z góry opisane.
  • Chcesz pracować wyłącznie na backendzie albo wyłącznie na froncie, a reszta produktu to dla Ciebie sprawa kogoś innego.
  • Twoja definicja "gotowe" kończy się na zmergowanym kodzie.
  • Wrzucasz na PR kod wygenerowany przez AI, którego nie umiesz wytłumaczyć.
  • Wolisz dostawać zadania, niż rozumieć problem, który za nimi stoi.

Nasz stack

PHP 8+ · Symfony · MySQL · REST API · React· TypeScript · SQS · Docker · AWS · GitHub Actions · Claude Code

Nie oczekujemy, że znasz każdą z tych technologii. Oczekujemy, że chcesz je poznać.

Co oferujemy?

  • Pracę nad produktem w ciekawej branży, z którego co miesiąc korzystają setki firm oraz miliony klientów tych firm.
  • Pracę nad produktem, z którego można samemu często korzystać.
  • Realne wdrożenia na produkcję od pierwszych tygodni, a nie zadania "na rozgrzewkę" przez pół roku.
  • Code review, z którego faktycznie się czegoś nauczysz.
  • Dobrej jakości sprzęt do pracy.
  • Płatne licencje na narzędzia AI.
  • Program zwrotów pieniędzy za bilety zakupione u naszych klientów.
  • Kącik baristy, w którym przygotowujemy kawę z Kolumbii i Brazylii.
  • Integracje, wspólne wycieczki i wyjścia.

Szczegóły

  • Praca w pełnym wymiarze, na B2B lub umowie o pracę.
  • Wynagrodzenie 8 000 - 11 000 zł netto miesięcznie na B2B lub 7 000 - 9 500 zł brutto na UoP.
  • Praca stacjonarna w naszym biurze w Krakowie, obok Placu Bohaterów Getta.

Jeżeli chcesz, abyśmy zachowali Twoje CV w naszej bazie na potrzeby przyszłych rekrutacji, umieść dodatkowo w swoim zgłoszeniu następującą zgodę:

„Zgadzam się na przetwarzanie przez firmę Droplabs sp. z o.o. danych osobowych zawartych w moim zgłoszeniu rekrutacyjnym dla celów przyszłych rekrutacji”

Przesyłając nam swoje zgłoszenie rekrutacyjne, wyrażasz zgodę na przetwarzanie swoich danych przez Droplabs Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Krakowie, ul. Na zjeździe 11, 30-527 Kraków, KRS: 0000468242, NIP:6772375967, REGON: 12289459500000, w celu przesyłania wzięcia udziału w procesie rekrutacyjnym. Przysługuje Ci m.in. prawo do dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania oraz wyrażenia sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania. Przesyłając zgłoszenie, oświadczasz także, że zapoznałeś się z Klauzulą Informacyjną.

title: Base Operative/Stevedore
description:
Base Operative/Stevedore

Northlink

We have an opportunity for a Base Operative/Stevedore to support the Serco Northlink Contract on a shift rota basis (9 days on; 3 days off), with excellent renumeration and benefits package available to the successful applicant.

Base Operative/Stevedore duties include but are not limited to, mooring and letting go vessels, securing various trailers, load and unload vehicles to and from the ferries, stow and secure chaining equipment in the dedicated areas.

For the successful Base Operative/Stevedore a forklift licence up to 3 ton would be desirable, but not essential. Training opportunities would also be available to progress to be a Tug Shunter Operative, for which a Driving Licence is essential.

As you will be representing Petersons, and working closely with Serco Northlink, your focus on delivering excellent customer service and flexibility, is extremely important. You should also be able to communicate with people at all levels, and work well within a team environment.

This role would also be suitable for a school/college leaver looking to start in a manual hands on role with progression opportunities.

title: Software Developer in Test (Python)
description:

You will work on a variety of Veeam products and features, helping us shape the quality of solutions used by companies around the world. During the hiring process, we’ll match your interests and experience with the team and project where you can make the greatest impact.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain automated tests for Veeam products
  • Collaborate across the software development team
  • Enhance frameworks and modules for automated testing
  • Contribute to test design and implementation
  • Analyze product source code
  • Support internal automated testing systems
  • Build and manage testing infrastructure
  • Analyze test results, and maintain defects database

  • Python, PowerShell, C# (.Net 6, .Net 8)
  • GitLab, Azure DevOps, TeamCity
  • TestRail
