  • Programming experience in Python
  • Experience with Windows and/or Linux environments
  • A strong desire to write high‑quality code and develop your skills in programming
  • An open mind, common sense, clear logical thinking, and a lively, analytical mindset - you enjoy analyzing and understanding how things work
  • English proficiency for daily communication within international teams

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with PowerShell
  • Experience with Git
  • Experience with Jenkins, TeamCity or Azure DevOps

  • Up to 12 free therapy sessions annually, plus legal and financial advice
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on‑demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Equal Opportunity Employer

Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.

title: Operational Performance Lead, Managed Full-Service (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important\: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Your Role

As an Operational Performance Lead, you will play a proactive and strategic role in driving performance across Hyatt’s Essentials & Full-Service Managed hotels in EAME. This includes not only ensuring that new General Managers & the Leadership Committee are thoroughly prepared and equipped for their roles, but also actively identifying opportunities and implementing initiatives to enhance operational efficiencies, guest satisfaction, profitability, and compliance. You will prepare and review property-level support content, distill mission-critical information for hotel leaders, and anticipate challenges to provide solutions before they impact results. In addition to supporting hotels and promoting brand standards, you will also lead special projects & training aimed at improving hotel performance, working collaboratively with other departments to drive successful outcomes.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide support to Select & Full-Service General Managers and the Leadership Committees, ensuring they have knowledge of resources needed to be successful in their role

  • Serve as an additional layer of support alongside other Hyatt organizational departments, such as Commercial, Finance, IT, and HR, partnering to align programs

  • Leverage data insights to prioritize support for underperforming hotels and provide action plans to senior leadership

  • Support handling of escalated tickets from Global Property and Guest Service Team (GPS)

  • Communicate effectively and provide training on Hyatt Brand Standards

  • Develop content and oversee internal resources on intranet, curated for the global portfolio of hotels

  • Lead innovative operational projects & pilots

  • Develop content and host engaging presentations, ensuring clear & consistent messaging of key initiatives and operational priorities

  • Engage hotels proactively to help them effectively focus on metrics that are trending in a negative direction, with a heavy focus on Rooms and F&B Operations

  • Participate in property visits and consulting assignments

  • Drive continuous improvement through technology and data insights

Droplabs to krakowska firma, która stworzyła system sprzedaży biletów online, wykorzystywany przez największe firmy z branży Tours&Attractions&Activities, jak np. aquaparki, parki rozrywki czy inne atrakcje turystyczne. Tatrzański Park Narodowy, Chochołowskie Termy czy Zoo Wrocław.

Od 2023 roku propagujemy i wdrażamy w obiektach turystycznych strategię cen dynamicznych. Opieramy ją na własnych rozwiązaniach z zakresu uczenia maszynowego. Szukamy Product Engineera - osoby, która bierze odpowiedzialność za rozwiązanie od początku do końca: od zrozumienia problemu, przez technical discovery i implementację, po wdrożenie, produkcję i kolejne iteracje. Twoim naturalnym środowiskiem jest full-stack: PHP po stronie backendu i TypeScript po stronie interfejsu, przy czym w jednej z tych warstw czujesz się mocniej i to jest w porządku.

Strona biznesowa odpowiada za kierunek produktu, czyli co i dlaczego. Ty odpowiadasz za jak: wybierasz podejście techniczne i bierzesz odpowiedzialność za jakość tego, co trafia na produkcję. PM nadaje kurs, Ty prowadzisz.

Pracujesz nad systemem, który obsługuje miliony rezerwacji, a jednocześnie ma panel, z którego codziennie korzystają pracownicy term, aquaparków, parków narodowych i muzeów. Jedno i drugie musi po prostu działać.

Jak wygląda ta rola w praktyce

  • Dowozisz, nie tylko dyskutujesz. Ticket nie jest gotową specyfikacją - jest problemem do rozwiązania. Zakres domykasz razem z designem i stroną biznesową, a potem odpowiadasz za jego dowiezienie.
  • Podejmujesz dziesiątki decyzji technicznych dziennie. Kierunek ustalamy wspólnie, detale są Twoje. Nie czekasz na pozwolenie.
  • Widzisz efekt swojej pracy. Funkcja, którą zrealizujesz jednego dnia, kolejnego sprzedaje bilety. Zobaczysz w danych, czy zadziałała.
  • Masz krótką drogę decyzyjną. Pracujesz bezpośrednio z CTO, współzałożycielem, bez warstw pośrednich.

Zakres Twojej pracy

  • Dostarczanie end-to-end: kompletne funkcje obejmujące backend i frontend, od modelu danych i API po interfejs, z którego korzysta klient.
  • Technical discovery: weryfikacja wykonalności, wychwytywanie ograniczeń i kształtowanie podejścia technicznego, zanim zakres zostanie zamknięty.
  • Decyzje techniczne: dobieranie rozwiązań balansujących wartość dla klienta, tempo dostarczenia, utrzymywalność i ryzyko operacyjne.
  • Jakość produkcyjna: testy, wdrożenie, monitoring i obecność przy rozwiązaniu w pierwszych dniach po release.
  • Praca wspierana przez AI: Claude Code jest u nas codziennym narzędziem pracy; serwery MCP, własne agenty i skille są częścią realnego workflow.
  • Współpraca z designem i resztą zespołu: wnosisz kontekst i alternatywy zamiast czekać na w pełni opisane zadanie.
  • Ciągłe ulepszanie: zauważasz powtarzające się problemy i zostawiasz produkt oraz kod w lepszym stanie, niż go zastałeś.

Wymagania

  • Masz komercyjne doświadczenie w PHP 8+ oraz Symfony (lub Laravela i chęć przesiadki).
  • Masz komercyjne doświadczenie w JavaScripcie i TypeScripcie oraz w React.
  • Projektowałeś systemy backendowe, a nie tylko implementowałeś z góry zdefiniowane endpointy.
  • Dobrze rozumiesz logikę biznesową, modelowanie danych, REST API i integracje.
  • Znasz relacyjne bazy danych (MySQL), cache i kolejkowanie zadań.
  • Potrafisz dowieźć zmianę backendową i frontendową jako część tej samej funkcji.
  • Masz wyczucie UX: zauważasz problemy z interakcją, dostępnością i niespójności, zanim zgłosi je klient.
  • Masz swoje zdanie na temat jakości, a Twoja definicja "zrobione" nie kończy się na zmergowanym kodzie.
  • Chcesz zrozumieć problem klienta i biznesu, zanim zdecydujesz, jak go rozwiązać.
  • Potrafisz wytłumaczyć kompromis techniczny osobie nietechnicznej i uzasadnienie biznesowe doświadczonemu inżynierowi.

Praktyczne doświadczenie z Claude Code, Cursorem lub równoważnym środowiskiem jest dla nas ważne.

Szczególnie interesują nas osoby, które używają AI do czegoś więcej niż autouzupełnianie: do technical discovery, pracy w nieznanych częściach stacku, generowania testów, debugowania, eksploracji kodu, specification-driven development i budowania powtarzalnych workflow inżynierskich.

Doświadczenie w tworzeniu serwerów MCP, agentów, skilli lub własnego tooling AI to duży plus.

Mile widziane

  • Zbudowałeś i wdrożyłeś własny projekt, z którego korzystali realni użytkownicy.
  • Rozwijasz własne workflow oparte na AI i potrafisz opowiedzieć, co się w nich sprawdziło, a co nie.
  • Masz doświadczenie z AWS, Dockerem i CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Pracowałeś z przetwarzaniem asynchronicznym i kolejkami (Symfony Messenger, SQS).
  • Współtworzyłeś design system lub bibliotekę komponentów.
  • Projektowałeś rozwiązania obejmujące cache, kolejki, granice usług lub złożone integracje.
  • Możesz pokazać produkt lub funkcję, którą prowadziłeś od problemu aż po wynik na produkcji.

Ta rola raczej nie jest dla Ciebie, jeśli

  • Czujesz się najlepiej, gdy każda decyzja i szczegół implementacji są z góry opisane.
  • Chcesz pracować wyłącznie na backendzie albo wyłącznie na froncie, a reszta produktu to dla Ciebie sprawa kogoś innego.
  • Twoja definicja "gotowe" kończy się na zmergowanym kodzie.
  • Uważasz, że za testy i jakość na produkcji odpowiada głównie QA.
  • Twoje doświadczenie z AI ogranicza się do podpowiedzi w edytorze i okazjonalnych podsumowań.
  • Wolisz dostawać zadania, niż rozumieć i przejmować odpowiedzialność za problem, który za nimi stoi.

Nie oczekujemy, że masz równie mocne doświadczenie w każdej z tych technologii.

  • Pracę nad produktem w ciekawej branży, z którego co miesiąc korzystają setki firm oraz miliony klientów tych firm.
  • Pracę nad produktem, z którego można samemu często korzystać.
  • Realny wpływ na kształt funkcji, a nie tylko na sposób ich implementacji.
  • Dobrej jakości sprzęt do pracy.
  • Płatne licencje na narzędzia AI.
  • Program zwrotów pieniędzy za bilety zakupione u naszych klientów.
  • Kącik baristy, w którym przygotowujemy kawę z Kolumbii i Brazylii.
  • Integracje, wspólne wycieczki i wyjścia.

Szczegóły

  • Praca w pełnym wymiarze, na B2B lub umowie o pracę.
  • Wynagrodzenie 12 000 - 16 000 zł netto miesięcznie na B2B lub 10 000 - 13 500 zł brutto na UoP.
  • Praca stacjonarna w naszym biurze w Krakowie, obok Placu Bohaterów Getta.

Jeżeli chcesz, abyśmy zachowali Twoje CV w naszej bazie na potrzeby przyszłych rekrutacji, umieść dodatkowo w swoim zgłoszeniu następującą zgodę:

„Zgadzam się na przetwarzanie przez firmę Droplabs sp. z o.o. danych osobowych zawartych w moim zgłoszeniu rekrutacyjnym dla celów przyszłych rekrutacji”

Przesyłając nam swoje zgłoszenie rekrutacyjne, wyrażasz zgodę na przetwarzanie swoich danych przez Droplabs Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Krakowie, ul. Przysługuje Ci m.in. prawo do dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania oraz wyrażenia sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania. Przesyłając zgłoszenie, oświadczasz także, że zapoznałeś się z Klauzulą Informacyjną .

title: Clinical Assistant
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Clinical Assistant

Department: Clinical Services/Practice Operations

Reports To: Clinic Manager/Physician

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Approval Date: June 12, 2026


Summary

The Clinical Assistant assists in the examination and treatment of patients under the direction of Peachtree Orthopedics physicians. The Clinical Assistant provides clinical and administrative support to ensure efficient patient flow, accurate documentation, and a safe, high-quality patient experience.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Escort patients to exam areas and prepare patients and rooms for examination.
  • Interview patients to determine medical problems/conditions and document in the EMR (Athena), including Meaningful Use criteria as applicable.
  • Obtain and record patient vital signs and height. weight, and BMI.
  • Support physician orders, lab requests, imaging orders (including X-rays), and followup needs with patients.
  • Collect specimens (e.g., urine, blood) for testing and perform routine laboratory tests when applicable; prepare specimens/forms for lab processing.
  • Obtain patient history and assist with ordering X-rays as directed.
  • Schedule diagnostic studies and/or surgery; schedule pre- and post-operative appointments.
  • Prepare and assist with injections/aspirations; perform dressing changes and remove sutures/staples per protocol.
  • Apply/remove casts, splints, braces; fit/dispense DME
  • Complete e-charge when applicable.
  • Place Physical Therapy referrals for provider signature.
  • Provide patient education materials and instructions related to diagnosis, selfcare/mobility, surgery, diagnostic studies, and equipment/casts.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA standards regarding bloodborne pathogens; monitor biohazardous waste and prepare for disposal.
  • Prepare prescriptions orders for signature and e-prescribe for physician approval.
  • Coordinate work-in appointments; communicate schedule changes and clinic cancellations to team members; assist with rescheduling clinics cancelled with less than 7 days’ notice.
  • Obtain X-ray and imaging results and store/import images in Joints; import outside discs into Joints; scan reports into Athena and match to close out orders.
  • Serve as liaison between patient and physician; coordinate consultations with other physicians.
  • Provide staff coverage for other clinical personnel; X-ray backup available for singlemember teams when assigned.
  • Support administrative clinical documentation and forms (e.g., handicap parking permits, FMLA, disability forms, work excuses) as assigned.
  • Schedule OR cases and maintain surgery schedules; notify manufacturer reps of surgical cases and coordinate special equipment/bone graft needs.
  • Maintain supplies within modules; monitor biohazard waste; ensure compliance with OSHA bloodborne pathogen standards.
  • Wipe tables, change pillowcases, and straighten rooms as needed.
  • Attend meetings and perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • One year of related clinical experience and/or training preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Credentialed/licensed in one of the following (or equivalent): LPN, CMA/RMA, ROT/OTC, ATC, or CNA.
  • Strong communication, customer service, organizational, and EMR skills.


Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)-required.


Physical Demands & Work Environment

Employee must regularly stand, walk, lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and assist patients with mobility as needed.



Peachtree Orthopedics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AFC Operations Team Lead
description:
About the opportunity

We are looking for a dynamic Team Lead to join our AFC Operations Department in Madrid to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and relevant company policies related to Anti-Financial Crime. Our target in AFC is to lead and shape the industry by creating a culture of compliance within N26 that authorities, customers and stakeholders can trust. This role is crucial to achieve this goal.


In this role, you will:


Support all Anti-Financial Crime tasks including AML, terrorism financing, sanctions, KYC, and fraud. You’ll detect Money Laundering typologies and Financial Crime patterns, while handling external and internal requests to detect potential financial crime.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing a team of analysts and investigators.
  • Ensuring timely and accurate investigation of suspicious activities and reporting.
  • Overseeing daily operations to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Monitoring and reporting on the effectiveness of AFC controls.
  • Coordinating with other departments to implement and enforce/improve AFC policies.
  • Developing and implementing process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Support responding to audits and regulatory inquiries as needed
  • Fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the team.
  • Promoting teamwork and collaboration to achieve shared objectives.


What you need to be successful:


Background:

  • Several years with relevant banking experience in Anti Financial Crime
  • Strong leadership and team management skills
  • Experience on French AML/CTF regulation
  • Bachelor’s degree (ideally in law, business or finance) preferred, but not essential
  • Knowledge use of Google Workspace
  • In-depth understanding of Anti-Financial Crime regulations and compliance standards
  • You are fluent in English and French spoken and written
  • Deliver with quality and keep confidentiality
  • Maintain an analytical mindset, willingness of thinking out of the box and appetite for learning

Skills:

  • You are detail oriented, diligent and reliable.
  • You have a hands-on mentality and take on ownership.
  • You should enjoy a fast paced working environment, show high willingness to learn and work autonomously to grasp new topics.
  • You should have ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members
  • Strategic thinking with a focus on process improvement
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines


Traits:

  • Actively help yourself (and others) be successful.
  • Continuously learn and challenge the status quo.
  • Think globally, act locally.
  • Strong bias for action.
  • Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback.
  • Respect and follow internal escalation rules

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are
N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.
Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona. Besides the main offices, N26 also has local offices in Paris, Madrid, Milan, and São Paolo.
Sound good? Apply now for this position.
N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: Tactisch Ziekenhuisapotheker Academisering & Innovatie
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Wil jij richting geven aan academisering en innovatie binnen de ziekenhuisfarmacie? En weet jij onderzoek, onderwijs, opleiding en innovatie te verbinden met de dagelijkse patiëntenzorg?

Voor de afdeling Klinische Farmacie en Toxicologie (KFT) van Maastricht UMC+ zoeken wij een ziekenhuisapotheker Academisering & Innovatie. In deze nieuwe rol geef je leiding aan (ziekenhuis)apothekers binnen het organisatieonderdeel Academisering & Innovatie en werk je samen met de tactisch ziekenhuisapothekers Zorg en Operatie. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de kerntaken zorg, academisering en innovatie goed op elkaar aansluiten.

Je ontwikkelt de koers voor academisering en innovatie binnen KFT en zorgt dat vraagstukken uit zorg en onderwijs leiden tot nieuw onderzoek en innovaties. Omgekeerd stimuleer je dat onderzoeksresultaten en succesvolle innovaties daadwerkelijk worden vertaald naar betere zorg en onderwijs. Je bouwt aan een samenhangende onderwijs, onderzoeks- en innovatieportfolio, stimuleert medewerkers om ideeën verder te ontwikkelen en helpt hen de weg te vinden naar interne en externe financieringsmogelijkheden. Ook speel je een belangrijke rol bij de implementatie en borging van apotheekbrede en ziekenhuisbrede innovaties.

Je geeft direct leiding aan circa 10 tot 15 (ziekenhuis)apothekers die naast hun klinische taken als aandachtsgebied onderwijs, opleiding, onderzoek of innovatie hebben. Je coacht professionals, je geeft duidelijkheid en vertrouwen, stimuleert eigenaarschap en ontwikkeling en zorgt voor een professionele, open en resultaatgerichte werkomgeving. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen en resultaten voldoen aan interne en externe richtlijnen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met de tactisch manager Academisering & Innovatie, die de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen het organisatieonderdeel aanstuurt en leiding geeft aan onder andere projectleiders, postdocs en (research)coördinatoren.

Je zoekt actief de samenwerking binnen Maastricht UMC+, Maastricht University en regionale, nationale en internationale netwerken. Daarbij handel je steeds vanuit het belang van KFT als geheel, ook wanneer dat soms vraagt om over de grenzen van je eigen organisatieonderdeel heen te kijken.

Wat verwachten we van jou?
Je bent een ziekenhuisapotheker met affiniteit met onderzoek, innovatie, onderwijs en opleiding. Je denkt strategisch, weet mensen en ideeën te verbinden en kunt plannen vertalen naar concrete resultaten. Je bent zichtbaar, toegankelijk, durft prioriteiten te stellen en je creëert draagvlak voor verandering. Je herkent je in de MUMC+ leiderschapscompetenties zoals samenwerken, persoonsgericht leiderschap, verbindend leiderschap, en flexibiliteit.

Hoe ziet je werkomgeving eruit?

Je komt te werken binnen de Afdeling Klinische Farmacie en Toxicologie, onderdeel van de Expertise-Eenheid Diagnostiek en Advies (D&A) binnen het Maastricht UMC+. D&A is dé expert in Zuidoost-Nederland op het gebied van integrale diagnostiek en farmaceutische zorg.

Met een betrokken team van circa 220 collega’s leveren we farmaceutisch specialistische zorg aan alle patiënten van het ziekenhuis. Onze missie is helder: bijdragen aan gelukkige patiënten én medewerkers. We werken nauw samen met medische afdelingen en zijn actief betrokken bij het ontwikkelen van zorgpaden en het realiseren van passende zorg.

KFT kenmerkt zich door de sterke integratie van klinische en poliklinische zorg, georganiseerd rondom de patiëntenzorgcentra van het ziekenhuis. We verbinden zorg, academisering en innovatie en hebben de ambitie om voorop te lopen in datagedreven en doelmatige zorg. Vanaf 2027 staan bovendien verschillende grote huisvestingsprojecten gepland, waaronder een volledig nieuwe poliklinische apotheek en een nieuwe bereidingsunit. We dragen ook bij aan klinisch (geneesmiddelen)onderzoek, leiden professionals op en verzorgen onderwijs, onder andere in samenwerking met de Universiteit Maastricht. KFT is een dynamische omgeving waar complexe medicatie wordt klaar gemaakt en waarin 24/7 geneesmiddelen worden geleverd. Tegelijkertijd zet KFT in op slimme logistiek en patiëntgerichte oplossingen, ondersteund door onder andere een modern laboratorium voor het meten van geneesmiddelspiegels.

De afdeling kent drie onderzoekslijnen:
1. Transmurale zorg en medicatieveiligheid
2. Farmaco-epidemiologie
3. Klinische farmacologie

Een afdeling in ontwikkeling
Onze afdeling bevindt zich momenteel in een fase van organisatieontwikkeling. We zijn bezig met de implementatie van een nieuwe organisatiestructuur, passend leiderschap en een cultuur die beter aansluit bij de toekomst. Daarbij worden processen, verantwoordelijkheden en vormen van samenwerking opnieuw ingericht.

Met de nieuwe structuur brengen we het leiderschap dichter bij de werkvloer. Samen met de twee tactisch apothekers Zorg en Operatie vorm je één leiderschapsteam. Jullie dragen gezamenlijk verantwoordelijkheid voor een goede samenwerking en samenhang tussen de verschillende taken van een academische apotheek.

Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de taktisch manager academisering en innovatie die onder de manager bedrijfsvoering valt. Voor farmaceutisch-inhoudelijke innovaties werk je nauw samen met de verantwoordelijke apotheker.

Dit biedt een unieke kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan de nieuwe organisatie, samen te werken met collega-tactisch apothekers en een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere professionalisering van onze afdeling.

KFT bestaat uit de volgende organisatieonderdelen:

  • Bedrijfsbureau

  • Productie

  • Laboratorium

  • Logistiek en magazijn

  • Klinische dienstverlening

  • Poliklinische apotheek

  • Academisering & Innovatie

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Als tactisch apotheker Academisering &Innovatie binnen KFT beschik je over:
Kennis en ervaring

  • WO werk- en denkniveau

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het aansturen en begeleiden van apothekers, bij voorkeur binnen een zorg-, of kennisorganisatie

  • Ervaring met wetenschappelijk onderzoek, onderwijs en opleiding

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van innovaties, bij voorkeur in de zorg.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten of begeleiden van onderzoeks-, innovatie- of verbeterprojecten.

  • Kennis van financieringsmogelijkheden, subsidieaanvragen en/of het opstellen van businesscases.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van samenwerkingsnetwerken binnen en buiten de eigen organisatie.

Vaardigheden

  • Kan onderwijs, opleiding, onderzoek, innovatie en zorg inhoudelijk met elkaar verbinden.

  • Is in staat een onderzoeks- en innovatieportfolio te ontwikkelen, prioriteiten te stellen en keuzes te maken.

  • Herkent kansrijke onderwijs-, onderzoeks- en innovatie-ideeën, brengt focus aan en helpt deze van idee naar implementatie en borging.

  • Stimuleert een academisch klimaat waarin medewerkers kennis delen, leren en vernieuwen.

  • Kan verschillende belangen en perspectieven verbinden, bijvoorbeeld die van onderzoekers, zorgprofessionals, management en samenwerkingspartners.

  • Heeft gevoel voor externe ontwikkelingen en weet deze te vertalen naar kansen voor KFT.

  • Verbindend, communicatief en resultaatgericht voor zowel het eigen organisatieonderdeel als ook in de samenwerking met de andere tactisch apothekers en tactisch managers.

  • Geeft coachend en richtinggevend leiding aan hoogopgeleide professionals en stimuleert eigenaarschap, ontwikkeling en samenwerking.

  • Beweegt gemakkelijk in een veranderende organisatie en geeft richting wanneer kaders en werkwijzen nog in ontwikkeling zijn.

  • Is zichtbaar, aanspreekbaar en consistent.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een uitdagende leidinggevende functie met maatschappelijke impact binnen een academisch ziekenhuis

  • Een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van KFT. Je krijgt de kans om samen met je collega-tactisch apothekers en de tactisch managers vorm te geven aan de nieuwe organisatiestructuur.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, leiderschap en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een organisatiecultuur waarin persoonlijk leiderschap, samenwerken en “Werken vanuit de Bedoeling” centraal staan

Om succesvol te starten in deze rol, is het belangrijk dat je de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst (minimaal B2-niveau) in verband met het contact met onder andere patiënten en collega's. Daarnaast is het een voorwaarde dat je in Nederland mag werken (EU/EER-nationaliteit of een geldige werkvergunning).

Voldoe jij aan deze functie-eisen? Dan gaan wij voor jou! Een ontwikkelassessment zal een onderdeel zijn van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. Hieruit volgt ondersteuning bij je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Salaris

​Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bedraagt het salaris minimaal € 8.394,- en maximaal € 10.851,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling. Dit salaris is exclusief vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Arbeidsovereenkomst

Het betreft een arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar voor gemiddeld 32-36 uur per week conform artikel 2.4.2 Cao umc, zijnde een tijdelijk

Wat bieden wij

title: Coordinator CSR (New Delhi, India)
description:
Job Title: Coordinator CSR
Area: The Rotary Foundation
Reports to: Team Lead CSR
Location: South Asia Office, New Delhi
Rotary International Overview
Rotary unites people from all continents and cultures who take action to deliver real, long-term solutions to pressing issues facing our communities. Each year, Rotary members invest more than $300 million and 16 million volunteer hours to improve lives and create positive change in the world. In exchange for hard work and dedication in support of Rotary’s clubs and humanitarian initiatives, our employees receive competitive salaries, flexible schedules, comprehensive benefits, and job enrichment. To learn more, visit .
Rotary International South Asia Office Overview
Rotary International South Asia Office (RISAO) provides services to more than 9000 Clubs and close to 3 lakh Rotary members spread in 7 countries in South Asia i.e. India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bhutan and Maldives beside assisting Rotary International headquarters located in Chicago, IL, USA by providing guidance/dissemination of Rotary’s policies and procedures to Rotary leaders in South Asia, handles legal & stewardship issues & contributions received from India as well as financial reporting of Fiscal Agents in other countries in South Asia. RI South Asia Office embodies the beliefs, thoughts and practices of Rotary International. Our core values of trust, empowerment and teamwork is a reflection of the same. At RISAO, we believe in:
  • Challenging ourselves to take initiative and be a part of the solution.
  • Encouraging our employees to demonstrate accountability and a proactive attitude.
  • Being professional in our interaction with customers
  • Respecting, recognizing and appreciating individual performance while working in a team.
Rotary’s Commitment to Diversity
As a global network that strives to build a world where people unite and take action to create lasting change, Rotary values diversity and celebrates the contributions of people of all backgrounds, regardless of their age, ethnicity, race, color, abilities, religion, socioeconomic status, culture, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
General Overview
Manage the end-to-end approval, documentation, due diligence, and processing of CSR projects, including due diligence of club and project compliance, accurate and sending timely information for booking of corporate contributions, coordination with internal teams, and facilitating disbursement of approved grant payments.
You Will Have
  • A Bachelor’s Degree.
  • A qualification in Social Service, CSR or a related field is preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years' experience in Non-Profit Organization or a related field
  • Software requirements-MS Office, Oracle, ,
  • Soft skills-Adaptability, Communication, Ethics, Flexibility, Empathy, Teamwork, Detail Oriented
You Are Good At
  • handling CSR projects and are well versed with section 135 of the Company’s Act
  • actively interacting and communicating with all stakeholders.
  • verbal, written and interpersonal communications skills. Fluency in English and an additional Indian language, preferably Hindi.
  • Maintaining proper documentation of CSR projects by keeping all project records in place.
  • Thinking critically and be a problem solver.
  • Being Team-oriented and able to work independently.
  • knowledge of computer applications (Word, Excel and other applicable programs).
  • Written and oral communication
  • Public speaking
  • Showing attention to detail
  • Good knowledge of managing corporate contracts
  • Able to manage the load at peak period
You Are Open To
  • Travel
You Will Be Responsible For
  • Review the grant proposal received from the corporate and/or a Rotary club or district through the designated software/platform or pre-approval process. Assess project relevance, beneficiary need, budget reasonableness, measurable outcomes, sustainability and alignment with CSR requirements and RFI policies.
  • Maintaining CSR data up to date for data analysis and team reporting
  • Review and approve CSR India grant applications, ensuring that all required compliance and supporting documentation is complete before approval.
  • Develop a business presentation tailored to business requirement along with RFI due diligence with donors highlighting RF(I) projects and expertise in handling the projects.
  • Work with the corporate and/or Rotary clubs and districts in finalizing the MOUs and statutory agreements. Meeting with donors to finalize and cease the clauses as per the current guidelines
  • Works with Rotary Zonal/regional and district leadership to strengthen Rotarian’s knowledge of Foundation programs, particularly CSR specific projects in the region.
  • Develops and delivers presentations at Regional, Zonal, District and club events and other meetings as assigned.
  • Review and approve of the CSR India grants application and make sure all the compliance requirements are met
  • Whet the agreements between corporate and RFI as also implementing club(s) in case of a tripartite agreement before putting up to Secretary, RFI for signatures on behalf of RFI.
  • Work in tandem with the Financial Services (FS) team at SAO for contribution booking and grant payment processing as required.
  • Ensure accurate and timely booking of corporate contributions and facilitate the timely processing and disbursement of approved grant payments.
  • Ensure that all statutory, financial and program documentation is complete and properly maintained for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Respond to CSR grant queries from Rotarians and coordinate all the activities between WHQ staff (if any) and project contacts.
  • Works with club/ districts to resolve all outstanding issues for project approval and make sure grants are compliant & complete. Follow through with the clubs/district to expedite the pending documents/information.
  • Work closely with grants team on the overdue reports for new application approvals
  • Provide timely updates to corporate donors for all grants funded by them.
  • Be thoroughly informed on current Rotary Foundation programs and policies with a view to providing accurate information to Rotarians, Rotary Senior and zonal Leaders and HQ colleagues.
  • To develop CSR resources like Newsletter, Annual Report, RFI website and CSR Brochure
  • Work closely with the reporting manager to understand the priority tasks and manage in coordination with the team
  • Adhere to team benchmarks
  • Other duties as assigned.
Leadership Attributes
  • Engagement: Foster relationships by hearing, recognizing, and valuing others.
  • Communication: Be open to receiving ideas from diverse viewpoints and able to communicate messages so that they are universally understood.
  • Productivity: Able to generate results that moves Rotary toward achieving its goals.
  • Accountability: Have a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for actions.
  • Innovation: Move Rotary beyond traditional ways of thinking
  • Adaptability: Respond to changes willingly and recognize when to adjust based on the situation.
Note:
Rotary does not provide VISA sponsorship or relocation assistance.

title: Regional Lead
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're hiring a Regional Lead to join our team in Cameroon. Reporting to the Country Launcher, the role holder will oversee all Wave agent network acquisition and user growth operations for the assigned region, supervising Field Officers' activities and liaising with the respective agent admin teams to achieve the set targets in the region.

In this role, you'll;

  • Agent Ops
    • Agent growth: Coordinate the Field Officers in identifying opportunity areas for new agent locations and acquiring required agents according to the set agent selection criteria and guidelines.
    • Agent Contracting: Ensure the Field Officers recruit agents in compliance with the legal and policy requirements as per the defined procedure. Ensure all agents in your region have executed valid contracts and are trained on the contents of the contract before they sign it.
    • Agent Activation & Training: Ensure all agents are trained and certified (for all products and procedures). This includes Know Your Customer (KYC) and AML/CTF as per the defined agent training procedure and requirements. It also includes delivering supplies and coordinating outlet branding.
    • Agent Ongoing Liquidity Management: Coordinate the cash / e-value availability monitoring at agents in liaison with Liquidity and Agent Quality Territory teams.
    • Risk Management and Routine Visitation: Manage the teams in Monitoring Agent vs. target performance through Reports on emerging issues and assessments of the region's performance.
    • Agent Churn: Coordinate the Identification of Agents for Closure (as per internal procedure), recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure branding material is removed.
    • Compliance & Governance: Monitor and enforce complete legal, regulatory, and procedural compliance for all regional agents, ensuring prompt resolution of non-compliance issues.
    • Brand Management & Visibility: Oversee the execution and maintenance of brand assets across all agent locations to ensure consistent, high-quality representation of the Wave brand.
  • Growth/Distribution
    • Distribution Management: Manage a team of Field Officers who, in turn, manage field-based promoters, whose role is to recruit new users to our financial products.
    • Growth Strategy: Identify and find solutions to critical blockers for user growth and develop strategies to boost the retention of newly acquired users.
    • Distribution Training and Monitoring: Hire, train, manage, and monitor distribution team members and utilise data to make decisions on distribution strategies.
    • Be the primary contact person for all agency networks and new users in your region: Execute operational excellence, manage costs, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines.
    • Champion excellent customer service and implementation of quality service delivery standards.
    • Data Management & Insights: Collect, review, and analyze field operations data to formulate strategic recommendations and optimize regional performance.

Key details

  • Location: This is a field role. You will be based in one of these cities:
    • Yaoundé: to manage Yaoundé, Bafoussam, and surroundings.
    • Douala: to manage Douala, Bertoua, and surroundings.
  • Work authorization in Cameroon is required.
  • Contract type: Permanent Contract
  • Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.
  • We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.
  • We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work.
  • Airtime reimbursement.

Requirements

  • Fluent in English - this role will interact regularly with non-French speakers.
  • Master’s degree in a related field.
  • Speak both French and English fluently.
  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience, specifically managing an agent network and/or user acquisition in Cameroon, and a minimum of 2 years of experience managing field-based teams.
  • Must have worked and overseen agent network activities in the upcountry.
  • Prior launch experience is desirable

You might be a good fit if you

  • Communicate effectively and often, both in writing and in person, to the point of over-communication.
  • Are detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.
  • Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.
  • Enjoy owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.
  • Have built and led strong teams in achieving key results.
  • Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth.
  • Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.
  • Think about culture and process from the users' perspective.
  • Are tech-savvy: comfortable navigating Excel and onboarding to new tools.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of College
description: About the School - OU.LOCATION: Executive Summary Brighton College and Cognita are seeking an inspirational charismatic, and ambitious Head to drive the expansion of Brighton College (Singapore) into one of the region’s leading all-through schools (from Pre-Nursery to Year 13). This is an incredible opportunity for a proven senior leader to shape the ongoing development and growth of the school and work as part of a talented and experienced team of Heads across Cognita and the Brighton College Group. The successful candidate will combine a track record of highly successful leadership experience in education in the UK or internationally, with the cultural awareness and global perspective to inspire the entire College community and manage diverse stakeholder relationships. We are looking to appoint a Head with the energy and vision to lead a world-class academic institution, distinctive in its own right but with the Brighton College DNA at its core. First-class communication skills, with the gravitas to act as a visible leader and ambassador, are crucial, as is the commercial drive to build upon the school’s success. The Head of College is also accountable to a Board of Governors comprising representatives of Cognita and Brighton College UK. The Head of College will be responsible for the delivery of educational excellence, school strategy and parent experience, while working alongside central teams for marketing, human resources and finance support. The role reports into the Managing Director, Singapore Cog. The school is regulated by the SDWA in Singapore and has EduTrust Certification. The Cognita Asia team plays a vital role in managing this regulatory relationship effectively. This opportunity represents a career-defining, professional challenge for an educational leader, who shares our aim of developing well-educated, respectful, and intellectually curious young men and women ready to take a full, active, and positive role in the world. The position is available from August 2027. . About Cognita: Cognita is a global family of 84 schools in 20 countries, with around 100,000 students, 22,000+ colleagues, 14 curricula and nine languages of instruction. Within Cognita, Brighton College is part of the Singapore Cog, alongside other schools across the region. Our strength lies in our diversity. Education is inherently local, so each Cognita school reflects the families and community it serves. When families choose a school, they are making a deeply personal and community-based decision, and Cognita gives schools the freedom to express and protect that local identity. What unites us is a shared ambition to deliver consistently high-quality education alongside an exceptional experience for students and parents. Cognita provides the expertise, investment, systems, leadership and global learning that help schools become stronger, while allowing each school to remain true to what makes it distinctive. Cognita’s vision is Thriving Schools, Inspiring Futures. Our mission is to build the world’s most trusted global schools platform, creating the conditions for schools to thrive; measurably and meaningfully About the Role: The Head of Brighton College (Singapore) will be responsible for leading a successful and thriving school, looking to build on the strong foundations already established in its Prep School and the formative years of its Senior School. Like all Brighton College leaders and teachers, they will understand the values of a British independent school education, the expectations of parents for the highest educational standards, and the needs of pupils who are very motivated to learn. This role will also oversee successful delivery of programmes that are integrated with its mainstream offerings, such as the Preparatory Course Primary and Secondary for intensive English Language acquisition. The Head’s primary, over-arching responsibility will be to manage the school’s ongoing development, encompassing the following priority tasks: Strategic Leadership Academic Pastoral Leadership Teaching Excellence Growth Operational Excellence People Culture Talent Leadership Development Engagement Wellbeing Performance Capability Community Stakeholder Engagement Who we are looking for: First-class strategic thinker with the capacity to provide clear leadership in a changing and complex external environment. First-class communication skills with a demonstrable ability to act as an effective and compelling ambassador for Brighton College in a changing, competitive market. High levels of commercial acumen and a strong understanding of the business aspects of successful Headship. Firm understanding of the role of a Head of College in relation to the leadership of safeguarding, building a strong safeguarding culture and the development of a safe environment. Highly visible leader with charisma, energy, stamina and ambition to inspire and motivate others. High levels of emotional intelligence together with the cultural sensitivity and global perspective required to relate well to people at all levels and from diverse backgrounds. Empathetic relationship-builder with a sophisticated understanding of how to work effectively with multiple stakeholders, build strong teams, delegate effectively and bring out the best in colleagues. Sound judgement and a strong sense of personal and professional integrity. A genuine commitment to the Brighton College values, ethos and educational philosophy. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Education or Bachelor’s degree with PGCE. NPQH or Master’s in Education is advantageous Experience in a successful British or British international school will be an advantage in demonstrating an alignment with the educational philosophy and standards which characterise Brighton College. Track record of highly successful school leadership which demonstrates an understanding of the challenges faced in an international school setting. Experience of leading, developing and motivating high calibre, diverse teams with a strong commitment to the continued professional development of all colleagues. Proven track record of successful delivery of the British curriculum and a demonstrable commitment to the importance of a broad learning environment. Evident commitment to educational innovation, including the opportunities and challenges presented by AI. Strong academic and intellectual credentials to command the respect of staff, pupils, parents and the wider community. The Application Process We are working with Odgers for this recruitment and interested candidates should submit their application to hosbrightonsg@odgers.com The deadline for applications for the position is 10 am October 14, 2026. Applicants should submit: A copy of your curriculum vitae/résumé. A covering letter of no more than two pages. The letter should explain your reasons for applying, the attractions of the role and the relevance of your experience and your views on education. Please make your letter as specific as you can; a letter that is largely generic may result in your application not being given full consideration. The review of files will begin as soon as applications are received. Shortlisted candidates will go through two rounds of panel interviews with senior leadership from Brighton and Cognita. Finalist candidates will be invited to Singapore in November to visit the school and meet with future colleagues and the Brighton College community. The Head of College will be selected after the site visit, final interviews, and reference checks. The successful candidate will assume their professional responsibilities in August 2027 Compensation and Benefits The most important thing is that we find the right candidate, and we will ensure that the salary and benefits package will be commensurate with the role. The benefits package will include relocation benefits, housing support, comprehensive medical coverage, school fee discount and variable pay. Safeguarding and equal opportunities Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed. The College is committed to ensuring that the recruitment and selection of staff is conducted in a manner that is systematic, efficient and effective and which promotes equality of opportunity .

title: Microsoft Technical Consultant - Philippines
description:
• Remote in the Philippines – Full-Time with Inviso
  • C2 English Fluency Level

The Team

Inviso supports Microsoft in providing a range of Assessment services and is expanding our support of Assessments focused on Cloud Migration, Copilot Adoption and Security in Microsoft’s SMB customer segment. This program provides data-driven reports to help customers gain a thorough understanding of their current IT estate and to inform their cloud migration strategy, extending their capabilities and empowering their organizations. The SMB Assessment Desk receives nominations from multiple channels within Microsoft, engaging with customers for pre-deployment technical check calls, deployment support, and report-delivery to customers and partners to enable rapid migration. The Desk leverages third-party Assessment tools Dr.Migrate and QS Solutions’ CSAT. The success of the SMB Assessment Desk is defined by enabling customers to successfully migrate and modernize their infrastructure with Microsoft Cloud services, including Azure and Microsoft 365.

The Role

Our Technical Consultants are the front line, supporting customers in their deployment of relevant Assessment tools, and supporting them in defining a roadmap to achieve their strategic goals through the adoption of Microsoft Cloud technologies. Therefore, applicants’ communication skills and attention to detail are key. Successful applicants will demonstrate strong technical acumen, project management skills, and the ability to effectively communicate across multiple levels of a customer organization (from IT staff to project managers to business decision makers) as well as Microsoft’s internal teams. Successful applicants will demonstrate a diversity of IT systems and administration knowledge enabling them to guide customers in the implementation and use of solutions such as Dr.Migrate, Unifycloud and CSAT

This role will require a C2 level of English, requiring native or full professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

Successful candidates will be able to deliver all components of an Assessment, including:

  • Engagement with Microsoft Stakeholders and Field Sellers
  • Requirements Communication and Kickoff: Understanding and clearly communicating the technical requirements of the Scale Assessment process, as well as the relevant benefits and outcomes to be expected upon delivery.
  • Discovery: Determining the optimal discovery platform to achieve the stated objectives, supporting deployment through complete discovery.
  • Analysis: Reviewing and finalizing an Assessment Report (specific to the tool used for Assessment delivery), identifying and highlighting key insights.
  • Presentation: Presenting key insights and actionable recommendations to relevant customers, partners, and Microsoft contacts
  • Cross-team Coordination: Supporting a seamless customer transition into post-Assessment actions with relevant Microsoft, Partner, or other point(s) of contact
  • Tracking: Log activities and updates in appropriate systems (e.g., internal CRM systems) for accurate tracking and reporting
  • Workshops: Conduct workshop with customers for AI Adoption

Required experience:

  • C2 level of English proficiency.
  • Technical experience in cloud services or SAAS products such as M365, O365, Azure, Copilot (at least 1 of them) or cloud services competitors of Microsoft, such as Google Workspace or AWS.
  • Customer or client-facing experience, making presentations.
  • Experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • 1-2 years’ experience in IT service/support, seeking to leverage those skills in an analytic role.
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and present data.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a queue of projects concurrently with little supervision – project & time management, coordination, status updates, etc.
  • Very strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Additional desirable experience:

  • Experience with discovery and assessment platforms such as Azure Migrate,Dr.Migrate, Unifycloud and CSAT
  • Deliver of Workshops and sessions to customers
  • Any area(s) of IT, Systems Administration, Windows or Linux OS, Networking.
  • Relevant Skills: Networking and Administration for Windows / Windows Server OS and Linux; PowerShell; Active Directory, DNS, DHCP; Virtualization Technologies (ex., VMware, Citrix, Hyper-V).

title: Industrial Robotics Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an Industrial Robotics Software Engineer to develop advanced automation solutions that integrate software, industrial robotics, machine vision, and sensor technologies. Responsibilities

  • Develop rapid prototypes and perform feasibility studies for robotic automation applications.

  • Develop software and communication interfaces for Fanuc and other 6-axis industrial robots.
  • Create libraries and APIs for interfacing with external devices and sensors, including cameras, laser profilometers, ultrasonic probes, PLCs, motor controllers, and digital I/O systems.
  • Develop and optimize robotic path planning, motion control, collision avoidance, and offline programming tools.
  • Implement computer vision solutions using stereo vision, image processing, and 3D object localization technologies.
  • Develop calibration processes for robotic cells, tooling, and workpiece positioning.
  • Evaluate and validate the performance, accuracy, and feasibility of sensors, vision systems, and motion planning algorithms.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to commission, troubleshoot, and continuously improve automated systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and object-oriented software development.
  • Experience with .NET, Dependency Injection, WPF, and MVVM architecture.
  • Experience with development tools such as Visual Studio and Git.
  • Knowledge of linear algebra, trigonometry, and applied mathematics for robotics applications.
  • Experience with or strong familiarity with 6-axis industrial robots (Fanuc, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, or similar).
  • Experience with robotic motion control, path planning, and collision avoidance concepts.
  • Knowledge of machine vision and image processing tools such as OpenCV, Cognex, or Keyence.
  • Experience integrating sensors, PLCs, motor control systems, and industrial communication devices.
  • Familiarity with CAD/CAM, robotic simulation, or offline programming software is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining software development, robotics, computer vision, and automation technologies to solve complex manufacturing and industrial challenges.

The Company:

Viable Engineering Solutions is a world-class concept-to-completion center for the industrial market. We take Research and Development to the next level providing rapid prototyping, robotics, automation, and non-destructive testing solutions in our state-of-the-art concept-to-completion facility. title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
description:
Join the country’s leading Cardiac PET provider! Cardiac Imaging Inc. (CII) is looking for talented and ambitious professionals to join our dynamic team and improve patient outcomes across the nation.

Despite heart disease being the leading cause of death in the US, most physicians and patients do not have access to the leading technology in Cardiology. At CII, our mission is to create a more accessible healthcare system by enabling all physicians to treat their patients with the most advanced technology – all from the comfort of their own practice. Our innovative team drives this mission forward each and every day with our Mobile and Fixed Cardiac PET Solutions. As we continue to grow, we currently have a tremendous opportunity for a Nuclear Medicine Technologist who is up for the challenge. This role will travel throughout Southern and Central California.

Summary/Objective:

The Nuclear Medicine Technologist prepares, administers and measures radioactive isotopes in diagnostic cardiac studies using a variety of radioisotope equipment. The Nuclear Medicine Technologist is responsible for preparing stock solutions of radioactive materials and calculating doses to be administered by cardiologists.

Essential Functions:

  • Administers radiopharmaceuticals intravenously to detect or treat cardiac related diseases, using radioisotope equipment, under direction of a cardiologist.
  • Calculates, measures and records radiation dosage or radiopharmaceuticals received, used, and disposed, using computer and following physician’s prescription.
  • Ensures and maintains quality control in regard to patient care and equipment usage.
  • Performs quality control checks on laboratory equipment, meters, and/or cameras, log into system, follow appropriate procedures for addressing and documenting issues.
  • Maintains and calibrates radioisotope and laboratory equipment; send out for calibration as needed
  • Disposes of radioactive materials and stores radiopharmaceuticals, following radiation safety procedures.
  • Processes cardiac function studies, using computer.
  • Prepares radiopharmaceuticals, adhering to safety standards that minimize radiation exposure to workers and patients.
  • Records and processes results of procedures.
  • Explains test procedures and safety precautions to patients and provide them with assistance during test procedures.
  • Complete system/document backup at end of each scan day
  • Document monthly supply inventory and submit to Corporate
  • Meet with RSO quarterly
  • Inventory and submit supply lists in a timely manner
  • Communicates all issues to provider, Supervisor, and Corporate Office
  • Ensure mobile unit is clean and orderly, all staff is appropriately attired and wearing personal dosimeter(s)
  • Ensure all signage, licenses, Chemtrec, and ACR related documentation is up to date, received, signed and/or filed; ensure all paperwork is printed and available for monthly inspections
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.
  • Travel throughout Southern and Central California.


Education and Experience:

  • Associate’s Degree in Nuclear Medicine from an approved program
  • Certification by the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board (NMTCB) or certification by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) and state certification, as applicable; applicable certification is required and must be maintained
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification is required and must be maintained
  • Nuclear Cardiology experience preferred
  • Recent graduates welcome

Skills:

  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) and Practice Management Systems experience
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others in a professional manner and in a team-oriented environment
  • Ability to communicate verbally and in writing
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Approachable and confident bedside manner

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location: Mumbai, India (onsite)

Type: Permanent

Experience: 10 plus years in data centre / infrastructure engineering (trading/HFT experience strongly preferred)


About the role

Own the physical and logical infrastructure that powers ultra-low-latency trading systems. You'll design, deploy and maintain rack layouts, structured cabling, servers and network hardware across primary data centres and colocation sites—working closely with network, systems and trading-technology teams.

This is a hands-on role where clean builds, precise documentation and fast, safe changes directly impact trading performance and resilience.


What you'll do

  • Design and implement low-latency data centre infrastructure: rack layouts, power, cooling, cable paths and connectivity plans.
  • Perform rack-and-stack of servers, switches, trading appliances and specialist hardware; manage asset lifecycles.
  • Install, test and maintain structured cabling (fibre and copper): LC/MPO/MTP, patch panels, transceivers, SFPs/QSFPs.
  • Configure and support high-speed network hardware (10/25/40/100GbE+) from vendors such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Mellanox/NVIDIA.
  • Work with Linux server hardware and remote management (iLO, iDRAC, IPMI); perform firmware/BIOS/BMC updates and hardware diagnostics.


What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Telecommunications or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • Hands-on data centre experience in latency-sensitive environments (trading/HFT, exchanges, financial infrastructure).
  • Strong knowledge of data centre design: power distribution, redundancy, rack capacity, environmental considerations and best practices.
  • Proven experience with structured cabling: fibre (LC, MPO, MTP) and copper (Cat6/Cat6a), cable dressing and management.
  • Practical experience deploying and supporting servers, switches and network appliances in production.


Nice to have

  • Exposure to low-latency trading infrastructure: kernel-bypass NICs, FPGA/SmartNIC appliances, PTP/NTP timing.
  • Experience with colocation projects across APAC exchanges and data centres.
  • Scripting/automation for provisioning or validation (Python, Bash, Ansible).
  • Vendor certifications (Arista, Cisco, Juniper) or data centre design credentials.

title: Toezichthouder Bouw
description:
Als Toezichthouder Bouw bij Meierijstad werk je binnen het dynamische speelveld van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving (VTH). Door ervoor te zorgen dat alle aspecten rondom bouwactiviteiten en de inrichting van de leefomgeving volgens de geldende wet- en regelgevingen gebeuren, draag je bij aan een veilig en toekomstbestendig Meierijstad.

Voor een leefbaar Meierijstad

Als Toezichthouder Bouw ben je verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van (on)aangekondigde controles op bouw- en sloopwerkzaamheden, evenals op ruimtelijke plannen. Je controleert of alles volgens de verstrekte vergunningen en de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften verloopt. Wanneer je een overtreding constateert, neem je passende vervolgstappen. Je legt nauwkeurig vast wat je tijdens controles hebt geconstateerd, inclusief eventuele overtredingen, en ondersteunt je rapportages met foto’s van de situatie ter plaatse. Deze rapportages vormen een belangrijke basis voor overleg met de juristen van het VTH-team, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt om te adviseren over mogelijke bestuurlijke handhavingstrajecten.

Naast het uitvoeren van controles, onderhoud je ook contact met inwoners en bedrijven. Je informeert betrokken partijen over wet- en regelgeving, constructiegevaar, brandveiligheidskeuringen, bouwfysische en gebruiksveilige knelpunten. Je behandelt klachten, handhavingsverzoeken en meldingen die betrekking hebben op het omgevingsplan en zorgt voor een correcte afhandeling hiervan. De kracht van een goed gesprek brengt jou in deze functie dichter bij begrip, oplossingen en samenwerking.

In deze rol ben je samen met je collega’s inzetbaar voor diverse taken op het gebied van toezicht en handhaving, zowel binnen als buiten reguliere werktijden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan als ondersteuning binnen je team meedraaien bij toezicht tijdens evenementen of andere thematische controles, waar het belangrijk is dat de in de vergunning gestelde eisen strikt worden nageleefd. Daarnaast behandel je klachten, meldingen en verzoek om handhaving en zorg je voor een correcte afhandeling.

Concreet ben je als Toezichthouder Bouw verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Uitvoeren van controles op bouw- en sloopwerkzaamheden en ruimtelijke plannen

  • Toezien op naleving van vergunningen en veiligheidsvoorschriften

  • Streven naar kwaliteitsnormen en het verbeteren van werkprocessen

  • Administratieve afhandeling

  • Een veilig en leefbaar Meierijstad

Werken bij gemeente Meierijstad

Met ruim 85.000 inwoners hoort onze gemeente Meierijstad tot de middelgrote gemeenten van Nederland. Wat je hier doet, doet er echt toe. We geloven in de kracht van samen en zetten de klant centraal. En dat zie je terug in onze hele organisatie. Daar zijn we trots op. Met aandacht voor ontwikkeling en aansprekende projecten werken we met z’n allen aan ons maatschappelijk doel: elke dag verder bouwen aan een Meierijstad voor iedereen. Verder gaan wij voor werkgeluk. Onze dienstverlening bijzonder en persoonlijk maken én houden kunnen wij dankzij jou. En jij kan dat waarmaken doordat je als medewerker helemaal tot je recht komt.

Brabantse gezelligheid, ambitieuze collega’s en een gedreven ondernemende zelforganiserende mindset. Dit kenmerkt onze jonge moderne gemeente. Als toezichthouder word je onderdeel van het werkatelier Vergunningen, Toezicht & Handhaving (VTH). Dit atelier is verantwoordelijk voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving op het terrein van bouwen, ruimte en milieu alsmede voor APV en Drank- en Horecawet. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een mooi werkatelier, dat op weg is naar zelforganisatie. Je gedijt goed in een organisatie waarbij rollen, taken en verantwoordelijkheden binnen de werkateliers gaandeweg worden ingevuld.

Werken voor de gemeente betekent ook dat je, afhankelijk van je functie, een rol kunt vervullen binnen de gemeentelijke crisisorganisatie. Zo draag je bij aan de veiligheid en continuïteit van onze dienstverlening.

Meer weten over hoe het is om bij ons te werken? Kijk op .

Hier krijgt jouw talent de ruimte

Misschien vervul je deze functie op dit moment al ergens anders of heb je een studie in een bouwkundige richting afgerond en spreekt het vak van toezichthouder je aan. In beide gevallen ben je van harte welkom om je kennis en ervaring in te zetten voor een leefbaar Meierijstad. Met andere woorden, jouw skillset is belangrijk. Het is belangrijk dat je daadkrachtig kunt optreden bij geconstateerde overtredingen en dat je adviseert bij de uitvoering van bestuursdwang. Je bent communicatiefvaardig, klantgericht en werkt vanuit argumentatie.

Daarbij verwachten we het volgende:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B.

  • Een flexibele instelling. Af en toe word je inzet ook verwacht in het weekend of in de avonduren.

Het is fijn als je ervaring of kennis van de onderstaande punten hebt. Maar heb je dat niet en wel een bouwkundige achtergrond en ben je leergierig, solliciteer dan ook zeker!

  • Je hebt kennis van bouwregelgeving, de Omgevingswet, Wkb en handhavingsproces.

  • Het is een pré als je in het bezit bent van ABW 1 of 2 of een opleiding brandveiligheid.

  • Relevante kennis van/ervaring binnen het vakgebied bouw en toezicht en handhaving op ruimtelijke ordening.

Wij bieden jou

Samen realiseren we de opgaves en ambities van gemeente Meierijstad. Daar mag je ook een mooie beloning voor verwachten. Toezichthouder is een baan voor 36 uur per week, daarvoor mag je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 5.096,- (schaal 9), op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.

  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 17,05% van jouw salaris. Aan jou dus de keuze wat je met dit budget doet. Extra vakantiedagen, een studieschuld aflossen? Of misschien toch een fiets aanschaffen? Daarnaast kan je het IKB uit laten betalen op elk gewenst moment.

  • Een vitaliteitsbudget

  • Uitstekende aanvullende cao-voorwaarden rondom het ouderschapsverlof.

  • Uitgebreide leer-, ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden. We zijn trots op de carrièrekansen die we bieden.

  • Locatieonafhankelijk werken met behulp van een laptop en smartphone.

  • Een NS-Business Card en gebruik van Greenwheels voor dienstreizen.

Na een arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar bekijken we samen of we dit omzetten naar onbepaalde tijd.

Pak je kans!

​Je weet het zeker, dit is jouw baan. En aangezien jij kansen niet laat liggen, stuur jij jouw cv en motivatiebrief. Solliciteren kan uiterlijk tot en met woensdag 7 oktober. Daarna zal de vacature sluiten en ontvang je zo spoedig mogelijk bericht.

Zijn wij net zo enthousiast als jij?

  • Dan volgt op dinsdagochtend 13 oktober een kennismakingsgesprek met Hanneke Oppers, leidinggevende van het team Toezicht en Handhaving, en collega’s uit het team.

  • Bij een tweede gesprek op dinsdagochtend 20 oktober spreek je opnieuw met Hanneke Oppers en sluiten er andere collega`s aan.

  • Samen met de HR adviseur bespreek je de arbeidsvoorwaarden, welke je daarna van ons per mail ontvangt.

  • Zet jij je handtekening daarna onder het voorstel? Dan heten we je van harte welkom bij gemeente Meierijstad.

Heb je nog vragen over de vacature? Dan staat een van onze HR Medewerkers je graag te woord via 14 0413 of via het algemene mailadres van recruitment.

title: Parts Advisor
description:
About us: We are one of the top three automotive retailers in the UK, proudly representing 32 manufacturer brands, selling a huge range of new and used vehicles from over 150 dealerships across the UK and Ireland.

We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to recognising the valuable contribution each person makes. That’s why we continue to invest in a leading rewards and benefits package designed to support your career, wellbeing, and life outside of work.

Charles Hurst Newtownabbey Kia

Contract: Permanent, full-time

Salary: £29,444 basic plus bonus up to £3,000

Working hours: 44 hours per week (between 08:00 and 17:00 Mon to Fri, plus Saturday Morning 9am-1pm on rota basis)

Join our diverse and dynamic team at Newtownabbey Kia as a Parts Advisor, and kick-start your Automotive career today. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who are driven by success and eager to thrive in our vibrant and successful company.

Our Parts Advisors enjoy a competitive salary, bonuses, and an industry-leading benefits package, which includes ample annual leave that increases with length of service, and access to our health and wellbeing platform Smart Health. As part of our collaborative Parts family, you will receive dedicated support from team members to excel in this dynamic role.

Working in this critical role, our Parts Advisors are key to the smooth running of our Dealership. They are the first point of contact for our customers over the telephone so it’s vital they provide a welcoming experience. We receive a high volume of calls per day enquiring about vehicle parts and accessories, therefore we require someone who can cope with a high workload. This role will involve upselling parts and accessories, through inbound and outbound calls so we require a polite and professional individual, who is also capable of balancing a high workload. You must also be capable of liaising with all the departments in our dealership, including our Technician and Service teams.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring that the Brand image and levels of customer service within the department is in line with company standards
  • Ensuring any customer complaints are dealt with both speedily and effectively, referring any unresolved problems to the Manager

Skills and Experience

You’ll be a real go-getter with heaps of industry knowledge and demonstrable sales or telesales experience. It would be beneficial if you are someone who has automotive product expertise as well as a good technical understanding of automotive maintenance. Previous experience working as a Parts Telesales Representative for a dealership is preferred but not essential.

You must be a natural communicator with an excellent telephone manner, and be adept at negotiating, persuading, and influencing key stakeholders. You will be commercially astute, and a real results driven individual.

If your skills and experience match what we are looking for, please apply today and a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch.

Core Benefits:

  • Competitive salaries with structured pay scales and progression as you grow within the business
  • Generous annual leave that increases with your length of service
  • Enhanced family leave, including 6 months’ full pay for maternity and adoption leave, and 2 weeks’ full pay for paternity leave
  • Access to Techscheme for discounted technology purchases with flexible payments

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Eyecare vouchers to help cover vision care needs
  • Smart Health – 24/7 access to GP services to support your mental and physical wellbeing
  • Dental insurance for everyday dental care and unexpected treatments
  • Optional critical illness cover for peace of mind during life's most challenging moments

Financial Wellbeing:

  • MyView PayNow – access a portion of your pay as you earn, with features to stream, save, and track your money through a user-friendly app
  • Free will writing services to help plan for the future
  • Flexible life assurance options and partner life assurance for added protection

Leisure & Lifestyle:

  • Discounted gym memberships to support an active lifestyle
  • Travel insurance to help you explore with confidence
  • Access to home and technology vouchers
  • bYond card and a wide range of exclusive retail and lifestyle discounts

We strongly believe in nurturing and providing our people with specific manufacturer brand and management training to enhance career development opportunities. We have a great bunch of people, and we like to celebrate and encourage success at all levels.

Lookers and Charles Hurst are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä työntekijää autokorjaamon vastaanottoon.

Tehtävässä toimit asiakkaiden ensimmäisenä kontaktina ja huolehdit siitä, että korjaamon arki pyörii sujuvasti. Työ sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy ihmisten parissa, hallitsee useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja jolla on kiinnostusta autoihin ja niiden tekniikkaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • Asiakkaiden vastaanotto ja palvelu
  • Huolto- ja korjausaikojen varaaminen
  • Työmääräysten tekeminen ja töiden koordinointi
  • Asiakkaiden kanssa asiointi puhelimitse ja paikan päällä
  • Huoltojen ja korjausten hinnoittelu sekä tarjousten tekeminen
  • Yhteydenpito mekaanikkojen ja asiakkaiden välillä
  • Laskutus ja muut korjaamon päivittäiset toimistotehtävät
  • Varaosien ja tarvittavien töiden koordinointi

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
  • Järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
  • Kiinnostusta autoihin ja autotekniikkaan
  • Hyvää suomen sekä ruotsin kielen taitoa
  • Aikaisempi kokemus autokorjaamolta, työnjohdosta tai vastaavista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi

Aikaisempi autokorjaamoalan kokemus ei ole välttämätön, jos sinulla on hyvä asenne, asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä ja kiinnostusta autoihin. Perehdytämme tehtävään.

Tarjoamme

  • Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn autokorjaamon vastaanotossa
  • Mukavan työporukan ja hyvän työympäristön
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittyä autokorjaamoalan tehtävissä
  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan
  • Mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen

Toimitamme ammattitaitoista henkilöstöä 25 vuoden kokemuksella eri toimialoille.

Olemme vastuullinen toimija ja noudatamme aina asiakkaan toimialan mukaista yleissitovaa työehtosopimusta ja voimassa olevaa lainsäädäntöä. Vahvuuksiamme ovat erityisesti toimintavarmuus, nopeus ja luotettavuus. Työnantajana olemme luotettava sekä joustava, ja olemme tukenasi kaikissa työelämän eri vaiheissa.
