description:
Job Function –
Supports assigned areas in strengthening/maintaining relationships with clients in all aspects of Commercial and Business Banking lending including, but not limited to, deposit gathering and retention, loan customer prospecting, loan production, overall customer retention, asset based loan monitoring, sale and servicing of participations.

Job Responsibilities –

Maintain reports and assists/support all lending functions as it relates deposit gathering and retention, loan prospecting, loan production, maturities, past dues and renewals.

Assists with loan closings to include document review, working with closing attorneys to ensure accurate, timely closings.

Provides various periodic reporting to assigned management and lending team such as Pipeline, Past Dues, Maturities and Prospecting.

Assists with exception tracking and exception clearing as well as the tracking and support of branch and assigned lending related training.

Provides support in the collection and analysis of all reporting related to branch loans, deposits and profitability.

Assists with Asset Based Loan Management to include tracking borrowing base certificates, inventory, etc.

Serves as liaison for participation loans to include the intitial placement as well as ongoing assistance and support to assigned participants.

Work with Branch Managers to ensure reporting is accurate and timely

Monitors overdraft issues to ensure all accounts are handled as agreed

Maintains pipeline to ensure that all loans are listed accurately, closed timely and balance to monthly production reports and quarterly incentive reports. Provides reporting to Regional President weekly as assigned.

Manages past due reports and works with lenders to monitor issues and ensure that collection of payments is timely.

Works with various branches to ensure that any commercial loan or deposit administrative issues or customer service issues are handled accurately and timely.

Performs loan portfolio management responsibilities to include the following:

• Facilitates the preparation of credit underwriting and analysis of existing loans in connection with renewals and modifications. Assist in facilitating closing of transactions.

• Assist lenders in managing past due and maturing loans.

• Recommends and models appropriate loan structure for new and existing loan relationships

• Receive and review periodic reporting provided by customers to ensure borrowing base availability as well as to monitor performance

• Assists Lenders to ensure customers are being serviced as needed

• Promotes and monitors customer relationship and growth

Prepares Annual Reviews on existing customers, to include but not limited to:

• Detailed analysis of financial statements.

• Detailed collateral analysis.

• Detailed analysis of debt service and covenant compliance

• Borrower and Guarantor analysis.

Ensures that all work is in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies and guidelines.

Performs any and all other duties assigned.

Education and Related Experience –

• 3-5 years previous banking experience with a focus on loans and deposits, preferably in a financial institution, required.

• Bachelor’s degree in a business related discipline preferred.

Skills and Abilities –

• Good knowledge of commercial banking, particularly commercial lending preferred

• Must possess knowledge of computers and computer operations MS Office software.

• Must possess good organizational and time management skills.

• Must possess ability to perform detailed tasks with accuracy.

title: DevOps
description:
The DevOps Manager is responsible for leading the DevOps function and establishing scalable, reliable, secure, and automated software delivery practices across the organization.

The role owns and continuously improves CI/CD, GitOps, container platforms, developer enablement, deployment automation, and related DevOps tooling while working closely with Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, Security, QA, and Architecture teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the DevOps engineering team and provide strong technical leadership.
  • Own the organization’s CI/CD strategy, standards, tooling, and engineering practices.
  • Design, operate, and continuously improve GitLab-based software delivery pipelines.
  • Lead Kubernetes-based application deployment practices across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Establish and improve GitOps practices using technologies such as Argo CD.
  • Standardize build, test, security scanning, release, deployment, and rollback processes.
  • Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation to reduce manual operational activities.
  • Build reusable CI/CD templates, deployment patterns, and engineering standards for development teams.
  • Improve developer experience through self-service capabilities, automation, documentation, and standardized platform services.
  • Work with Software Engineering and QA teams to integrate automated testing and quality gates into delivery pipelines.
  • Work closely with Cybersecurity to implement DevSecOps controls, including SAST, SCA, container scanning, secrets management, and security gates.
  • Establish proper separation of duties and controlled production deployment processes.
  • Improve application observability by integrating monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting into the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and recoverability of DevOps platforms and services.
  • Define and track engineering and delivery metrics, including DORA metrics, deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and recovery time.
  • Support incident management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of production delivery processes.
  • Evaluate and introduce new DevOps and platform engineering technologies where they provide measurable value.
  • Manage DevOps platform capacity, licensing, vendors, upgrades, lifecycle, and technical roadmap.
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Mentor engineers and establish a culture of automation, engineering excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Cloud Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD or comparable enterprise CI/CD platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker/container technologies.
  • Experience with GitOps and Argo CD or similar technologies.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation.
  • Experience with Linux administration, networking fundamentals, scripting, and automation.
  • Experience with cloud and private-cloud environments such as OpenStack, OCI, GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Understanding of software engineering practices, branching strategies, release management, and SDLC.
  • Good understanding of application security and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service engineering capabilities is highly desirable.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Terraform / OpenTofu
  • Ansible
  • Bash / Python / Go
  • Sentry / OpenTelemetry
  • Secrets management
  • Artifact and container registries

Preferred Certifications

Relevant certifications such as CKA, CKAD, GitLab Certified, KCNA, HashiCorp Terraform, AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI certifications, or equivalent are preferred.

  • Strong technical leadership
  • Problem solving and troubleshooting
  • Reliability and operational excellence
  • Software delivery and release engineering

You’ll ideally have previous experience as a key holder in a fashion retail store, possess a real love of fashion, be able to offer excellent customer service and work well as part of a team. title: Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst Intermediairdesk
description:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld en krijg je energie van contact met zakelijke partners? Heb je affiniteit met lease of financieringen en wil je werken in een team waar je écht het verschil kunt maken in commerciële groei? Stap in en versnel mee als Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst bij onze Intermediairdesk!

Wat is de Intermediair Desk?

Intermediairs zijn tussenpersonen. Denk aan partijen die namens hun klant een lease- of financieringsaanvraag bij ons indienen voor de aankoop van hun voertuig. Zij hebben dus zelf geen voertuig of object nodig, maar regelen dit voor hun klant. De Intermediair Desk is het team (ca. 10 collega’s) dat deze tussenpersonen daarbij helpt.
Wij zorgen dat aanvragen goed en snel worden opgepakt, dat vragen beantwoord worden en dat de samenwerking soepel loopt. Jij bent daarbij het vaste aanspreekpunt: je houdt overzicht, zorgt voor opvolging en denkt mee in oplossingen.

Over de rol

Als Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst ben jij een essentiële schakel binnen het commerciële team van de Intermediairdesk. Jij bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze intermediairs en ondersteunt hen in het hele traject: van aanvraag tot opvolging en beheer.

De focus van je werkzaamheden ligt vooral op relatiebeheer en lauwe acquisitie: bestaande relaties actief houden, opnieuw aanzetten en commercieel verder uitbouwen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van o.a. acceptatie, sales, beheer en operations om intermediairs snel en professioneel te helpen. Jij houdt het proces in beweging en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen, met als doel ervoor te zorgen dat hun klant zo snel mogelijk in hun gewenste voertuig bij de dealer kan wegrijden.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met intermediairs en onderhoudt deze actief;

  • Je ondersteunt intermediairs bij het indienen van aanvragen en bewaakt proactief de voortgang;

  • Je herkent commerciële kansen in bestaande relaties;

  • Je denkt mee in oplossingen die passen bij de klant en de intermediair;

  • Je deelt markt- en klantinformatie met collega’s zodat we slimmer kunnen samenwerken.

  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe processen en communicatie beter kunnen en brengt ideeën in om de samenwerking met intermediairs te verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent commercieel, servicegericht, maar vooral een relatiebeheerder pur sang. Je schakelt en staat stevig in je schoenen.

Verder herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • MBO+/ HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Ervaring in een commerciële binnendienstrol, sales support, relatiebeheer of zakelijke dienstverlening;

  • Affiniteit met lease, financiering of een B2B-omgeving;

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en laat dossiers niet “hangen”;

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden; met een lach weet jij een sterke relatie op te bouwen;

  • Proactief, oplossingsgericht en stressbestendig;

  • Je werkt graag samen, maar pakt ook zelfstandig eigenaarschap;

  • Commercieel ingesteld en op de lange termijnrelatie gericht.

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met intermediairs/tussenpersonen

  • Kennis van kredietacceptatie of interesse om dit te leren

Wat bieden wij jou?

Goed werk verdient een eerlijke beloning. Daarom bieden we bij Hiltermann Lease aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • 28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek);

  • Een pensioenregeling met slechts 3% eigen bijdrage, waardoor je meer nettoloon overhoudt!

  • €30 netto per maand thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • Een gratis dagelijkse lunch op kantoor;

  • Een collectieve zorgverzekering;

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten als je met de trein of bus reist;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer als je met de auto of fiets komt

  • Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken.

Ben je geïnteresseerd?

Grijp deze kans en word onze nieuwe collega! Solliciteer via de knop hieronder. We nemen binnen drie werkdagen contact met je op.

Acquisitie n.a.v. onze vacatures wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Manager, Design
description:
Manager, Design

Hybrid- Gurnee, Illinois

Who We Are:

PurposeBuilt Brands, rooted in a legacy dating back to Weiman, stands as a pioneer in crafting top-tier products for specialty surfaces. Our beloved brands, including Weiman, Goo Gone, Green Gobbler, Biokleen, Gonzo, Magic, Wright’s, Stone Care International, Urnex, Five Star, and Micro-Scientific, are preferred choices among consumers and seasoned professionals alike.

At PBB, we seek to hire employees who bring a level of engagement, drive, and performance that pushes business forward. We work together and are motivated by positive results, while continuously thriving in a scrappy environment. We believe our greatest assets are the talented and passionate employees who are motivated by our purposeful work. Our company may be 60 years old, but the real growth is just getting started.

The Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated, Design Manager to join the HomeShine Studios team within PurposeBuilt Brands. HomeShine Studios is PBB’s newly created internal creative team that is looking to create breakthrough communication for PBB’s portfolio of consumer and commercial brands.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for elevating creative output and execution across new product launches and design assets for a variety of CPG brands.

What You Will Do:.

  • Lead and mentor a team of designers, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.
  • Conceptualize, design and execute across a variety of campaigns and projects.
  • Displays keen attention-to-detail and upholds all work at the highest standards of quality.
  • Execute traditional design including, but not limited to packaging, in-store displays, and branding
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to conceptualize designs that effectively communicate our brand message and product features.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, tools, and technologies (including AI) to continuously improve the quality and impact of creative output.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines while maintaining high standards of creativity and production quality.
  • Ensure brand consistency and adherence to brand guidelines across all deliverables.
  • Oversee the translation of approved concepts into print-ready files.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creative partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Facilitate a seamless handoff process between creative and production.

What You Will Bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in graphic design with a focus on packaging, including 1–2 years in a leadership or managerial role.
  • A dynamic creative portfolio showcasing a range of projects, including packaging and shopper marketing examples.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Strong grasp of packaging design principles, printing processes (digital and flexographic), and production best practices
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities across diverse brands and timelines.
  • Excellent creative and storytelling abilities, with a keen eye for detail and design aesthetics.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present ideas and concepts effectively.

Compensation Range:

$95,000-$110,000

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job related skills, experience, location, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specifics for each salary range.

Benefits:

PBB offers a wide range of benefits because we understand no two employees are the same. We want our employees to feel empowered to set their day up for success, whether that's in the office or remote. (This role is primarily remote but requires occasionally working onsite to create packaging mockups and review proofs. Max 2 days/wk onsite.)

What We Offer:


Flexible work options (fully remote, hybrid, onsite)

Generous paid time off

Competitive salaries and bonus incentives

401K company match

Competitive medical, dental, & vision insurance

Pet insurance

Annual fitness stipend

Unmatched employee discount on all products

Summer Hours

LinkedIn learning membership


PurposeBuilt Brands is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: VP of CRM
description:
As our VP of CRM, you will sit at the core of our growth engine, owning the end-to-end global player lifecycle and engagement strategy. Leading a massive, rapidly expanding organization, you will ensure our global user base returns, engages, and scales in lifetime value. Working hand-in-hand with our product and engineering teams, you will directly shape and evolve our proprietary CRM technology, turning retention into a primary driver of top-line revenue.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end retention, reactivation, and LTV strategy across multiple verticals (Fintech, Gaming, etc.)
  • Lead and mentor a 50+ person organization. Build scalable hiring, onboarding, and management structures to support rapid growth
  • Collaborate closely with the product and technical teams to align CRM strategy with platform architecture, automation logic, and AI integration
  • Oversee high-volume campaign execution across global markets, ensuring quality, deliverability, and localized relevance
  • Define and hit KPIs for churn reduction, ARPU, and engagement quality through advanced segmentation and personalization

Requirements

  • 10+ years in CRM/Lifecycle leadership within fast-scaling tech environments (Fintech, E-commerce or Gaming preferred)
  • Experience managing large teams (50–200+) and know how to build a culture of accountability without being authoritarian
  • Understanding of CRM architecture and "system logic." You don't just send emails; you build automated ecosystems. Expertise in multi-channel user journeys (Email, Push, SMS, In-app)
  • Being a stable, empathetic leader who leads by example. You value transparency and are focused on the collective success of the organization
  • Proven track record of influencing CRM product development and data infrastructure
  • Fluency in English; ability to navigate a diverse, global workforce

Benefits

  • A comprehensive relocation package, including flight tickets and two weeks of hotel accommodation to ensure a smooth transition
  • Attractive office location and facilities
  • A dynamic and supportive environment that values its team, featuring special birthday celebration presents and a collaborative company culture
  • 24 days of vacation per year

title: Program Director
description:
Position Title: Program Director

Classification: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $70,304.00 annually - 11 month Prorated Salary

Location: San Bernardino, California

Reports to: Associate Executive Director

POSITION SUMMARY:

The YMCA of the East Valley is committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility.

Under the direction of the Associate Executive Director, the Program Director is responsible for supporting YMCA operations through effective delivery of programs, services, and member engagement. This position contributes to the achievement of Association goals by promoting the YMCA mission, values, and strategic priorities while providing high-quality service to members, participants, staff, and the community.

OUR CULTURE:
Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing, we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed below are representative of the duties and responsibilities performed by this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list.

Essential Functions

  • Lead all aspects of the program experience, ensuring a welcoming, inclusive, and service-driven environment for all members.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments of program outcomes, satisfaction, and participation trends.
  • Support fundraising efforts including the annual campaign, donor relations, and special events to support branch’s programs and services.
  • All other duties as assigned by management.

Core Responsibilities

  • Perform duties in alignment with YMCA mission, policies, procedures, and operational standards.
  • Deliver high-quality customer/member service to participants, families, staff, volunteers, and community partners.
  • Support departmental and Association goals through effective communication, teamwork, and accountability.
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and documentation as required.
  • Participate in staff meetings, trainings, and required professional development activities.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
  • Support risk management and safety procedures.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to support operational needs.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Mission Advancement

Models and teaches the Y’s values. Ensures a high level of service with a commitment to changing lives. Provides volunteers with orientation, training, development, and recognition. Cultivates relationships to support fund-raising.

Collaboration

Builds positive relationships with staff, members, volunteers, and community stakeholders. Works effectively with individuals of diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Operational Effectiveness

Maintains quality work standards, accountability, sound judgment, and effective time management. Supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Personal Growth

Demonstrates self-awareness, adaptability, professionalism, and commitment to ongoing learning and development.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum of 3 years of YMCA experience or in a customer service field.
  • Proven experience in managing people, programs, and budgets.
  • Excellent human relation skills and an ability to maintain positive communication with staff and members
  • Commitment to the mission and values of the YMCA
  • Proven ability to build genuine relationships
  • Results-driven mindset with the ability to analyze data and adjust strategies
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency in applicable technology, software, and systems.
  • Commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and the YMCA mission.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

Depending on assignment, duties may include:

  • Sitting, standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting.
  • Operating office equipment and technology.
  • Ability to lift up to 10 pounds.
  • Ability to work in indoor and/or outdoor environments.
  • Ability to travel between branch locations, if applicable.
  • Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • The work environment noise level is typically moderate.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

DRIVING REQUIREMENTS (IF APPLICABLE)

Employees assigned to drive company vehicles with driving responsibilities must:

  • Possess and maintain a valid California Driver’s License.
  • Maintain acceptable driving record in accordance with YMCA policy.

BACKGROUND SCREENING & PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of YMCA pre-employment requirements, which may include:

  • Criminal background check/fingerprinting
  • Reference verification
  • CPR/First Aid certifications (if applicable)

WORK SCHEDULE

Work schedules may vary based on operational needs and may include mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.

DISCLAIMER

This job description is not intended to be an employment contract and may be modified by the YMCA of the East Valley at any time, with or without notice, to meet organizational needs.

EMPLOYEE ACKNOWLEDGMENT

If hired, I certify that I am able to perform the essential functions of the job listed above, either with or without reasonable accommodation.

I acknowledge that I have reviewed and understand the essential functions and requirements of this position. I understand that I may be required to perform additional duties as assigned.

title: PR Praktikant hos Transact Denmark
description:
Brænder du for storytelling og har du lyst til at få hands-on PR-erfaring? Her er muligheden for at accelerere din digitale karriere i et dynamisk og succesfuldt team med en dokumenteret historik for at videreudvikle medarbejdere efter endt praktikforløb og uddannelse. Hos Transact søger vi en engageret praktikant til vores Performance PR-team.

Om praktikpladsen

Som praktikant i Transact får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med erfarne specialister. Du bliver en aktiv del af arbejdet med optimering af marketing aktiviteter, kampagner, projekter og analyser for en række spændende kunder inden for forskellige brancher herunder ecommerce, retail, FMCG (fast moving consumer goods), B2B, tele, rejse- og oplevelsesøkonomi mfl.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Din vigtigste opgave bliver at kontakte journalister hos førende medier med det formål at opnå omtale for vores kunder og kampagner
  • Udvikle pitch-historier og vinkler
  • Identificere relevante publikationer og journalister vi bør kontakte
  • Ansvar for rapportering og let kundeadministration
  • Bidrage til kreativ idéudvikling af kampagner for eksisterende og nye kunder
  • Hjælpe med dataanalyse og/eller mindre designopgaver

Du bliver en del af et praktikantteam på tværs af Transact afdelinger. De første uger vil du følge diverse introsessions, hvor du vil blive sat godt ind i Transact som helhed – både socialt og fagligt.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse f.eks. inden for journalistik, mediekundskab, retorik eller kommunikation
  • Har interesse for storytelling, PR, kommunikation og det generelle nyhedsbillede.
  • Er struktureret, nysgerrig og trives med at have mange bolde i luften
  • Har stærke analytiske evner og er god til formidling
  • Er god til at samarbejde og er ikke bange for at tage initiativ
  • Høj grad af vedholdenhed og vilje (der kommer masser af ’nej tak’ fra journalister, men det motiverer dig kun endnu mere til at lande medieomtale!)
  • Trives i et omskifteligt miljø, hvor alle dage ikke nødvendigvis ligner hinanden, og hvor prioriteter skifter hurtigt

Denne rolle passer perfekt til dig, hvis du er nysgerrig på medielandskabet og interesserer dig for, hvordan data kan omsættes til historier, indsigter og overskrifter. Du trives med nye udfordringer, har lyst til at lære og er ikke bange for at kaste dig ud i nye opgaver. Samtidig har du stærke skriftlige kommunikationsevner og nyder at formulere budskaber og skabe indhold, der fanger modtagerens opmærksomhed.

Hos os får du:

  • Et uformelt og energisk arbejdsmiljø
  • Indflydelse og ansvar
  • Praktisk erfaring med PR og digital marketing
  • Masser af sparring og læring
  • Fredagsbarer, firmafester, fagdage og en stærk teamkultur
  • Gratis frokost og forplejning

Det praktiske

Praktikforløbet løber fra januar til maj 2027 og har arbejdssted på Midtermolen 3, 2100 København Ø, tæt på Østerport Station. Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne dit CV og ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonas Grünfeld, Performance PR Director, på jonas.grunfeld@omc.com.

Om Transact
Transact er en del af Omnicom Media, der er en global virksomhed med mere end 70.000 ansatte, som arbejder med marketing, kommunikation og reklame. Vores netværk giver os adgang til de bedste specialister i hele verden og særligt tætte relationer til de største medie- og teknologivirksomheder. Transact er også regionalt til stede i Norden med kontorer i Sverige, Norge og Finland, og sammen med vores nordiske kolleger arbejder vi effektivt på tværs af regionen med de samme strømlinede processer og markedsledende services inden for performance marketing og connected commerce.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Your impact

You'll join the Core team to rebuild our Core product with a fresh look and a new design system. You'll also maintain and improve our existing features along the way. This team is responsible for almost the entire user-facing interface, for which you will play an important role in its future development.

The Wrocław team works in a hybrid setup, i.e., we meet in the office twice a week (rented coworking space). On top of that, we try to have a small gathering every month in Wrocław. The schedule is adjusted to our needs.

Your responsibilities

  • Work with product, design, and other engineers to build new product features from start to finish: through ideation, research, implementation, and maintenance. For example, you might build an in-restaurant ordering feature.
  • Leverage your full stack knowledge to help improve performance and reliability and polish existing features.
  • Build and implement a roadmap to migrate the frontend from our old (existing component libraries) to our new stack (in-house design system).
  • Establish best engineering practices for the Core Team.

What You'll bring to the table

  • Great English language skills.
  • Experience with building SaaS applications (ideally in a product-led company).
  • Experience with modern JavaScript (and TypeScript), CSS, and Web APIs.
  • Experience with component-based, declarative UIs (we use React).
  • Experience with building APIs (both internal and external ones, e.g., for 3rd parties).
  • Knowledge of rendering and design systems (as you’ll be building it up with us).
  • Insights into accessibility in web apps.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of DevOps culture and tools like GitHub Actions or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Meteor.js (or similar real-time solution).
  • Experience with GraphQL (we use Apollo Federation heavily).
  • Experience with AWS and its ecosystem (Lambdas, going through CloudWatch logs).

Why You’ll love working at aleno

  • Flexible working hours. Due to the customer support and the daily cycle of our core customer base, 10:00-15:00 CET is required. If you need to finish up earlier, it’s fine — that’s just the default. Other than that, there are no restrictions — just attend the meetings and stay in alignment with the team.
  • Paid time off. All bank holidays are off. On top of that, there are 26 days of paid time off and 5 days of sick leave.
  • Hardware. We can take care of a laptop and a headset for you (if needed).
  • Traveling. Company retreats are expected but not mandatory (once for the whole company and once for the product team). All conferences, local events, and online events (meetups, conferences, etc.) are highly encouraged but not mandatory. Travel expenses can be covered in case of being a speaker and clearly mentioning aleno (for hiring, marketing, etc.)

Our hiring process

We aim to make our hiring process transparent, respectful of your time, and focused on finding the right mutual fit. After reviewing your application, we’ll invite selected candidates to a series of interviews. These typically include a conversation with the team, a technical or role-specific exercise, and time to get to know our culture and ways of working.

We do our best to keep the process efficient and streamlined — usually completing all steps within a couple of weeks.

You will be working on a Website as a Service (WaaS) platform that powers and maintains corporate websites for multiple large international clients. Instead of managing a single isolated website, you will maintain and scale a unified platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

As a dedicated DevOps Engineer on this product, you will take ownership of the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security, and environments (Dev, Staging, Prod).   • CI/CD & Automation: Proven track record of setting up, maintaining, and optimizing automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Mindset: Strong ownership, proactive approach, and ability to work effectively as the main DevOps specialist while supporting development teams.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain, scale, and optimize cloud infrastructure for a high-availability WaaS platform.

Our company is strong enough to be not just a vendor but a tech partner.

title: Head of Customer Insight
description:
Location: HSK, London, W8 5HY

Position: Full Time/Permanent

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced and engaging audience insight leader who can help us integrate customer-first thinking across the Daily Mail.

Main Responsibilities

This role will be responsible for:

  • Building and owning our "always-on" customer insights function - heading a continuous, prioritised programme of qual and quant research - and liaising with Brand, Product, Commercial, Strategy and third party partners to ensure insights serve all well
  • Making insight on our customer segments is easily accessible to the business, through self-serve, team-specific tools and regular reporting and stakeholder engagement
  • Integrating customer thinking into decision flows (planning, commissioning, roadmaps, pricing) both before and after KPI setting
  • Making sure our customer segmentation is a living, iterative framework - resized against new data and revisited regularly
  • Working alongside teams to turn insight into prioritisation and strategic bets, helping translate segments into clear calls on which audiences to win, positioning, value proposition and brand, and help defend those trade-offs at a leadership level
  • Driving cultural adoption and change management - embedding customer segments into day-to-day thinking, upskilling teams
  • Managing Brand Tracking across the UK, US and Australia, and using this tracking to inform marketing strategy and business decisions
  • Driving high standards for how customer insight is used across the organisation

Person Specification

We’re looking for a confident Head of Customer Insight - you’ve likely already done this role, or you’re a highly experienced insight Lead. You’re;

  • Used to seeing gaps where Insight can better serve an organisation
  • Used to setting the insight agenda, not just being given briefs to complete
  • Confident in commissioning, designing and leading qualitative and quantitative mixed-methods research
  • Able to scope, commission, quality-assure and interpret both in-house qualitative and large-scale quantitative research (segmentation surveys, cluster analysis, pricing/WTP work), directing agencies and internal analysts with confidence
  • Track record of building insight archives and tooling that scale access to insights
  • Happy presenting, dissecting and debating insight at a senior level
  • Experienced in hiring and managing a small team (1-2 reports) and using AI to extend the reach and support of insight across an organisation

Our Commitment

We are committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability.

We are Disability Confident Committed. Please let us know if you require any recruitment documentation in other formats or if you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process. Please be assured that any such information will be held separately to your recruitment application and will not be considered as part of the selection process.

description:

ASales Oy on B2B- ja B2C-asiakashankintaan sekä ajanvaraukseen erikoistunut yritys. Olemme kasvaneet jo yli 50 henkilön organisaatioksi, ja rekrytoimme nyt 10 uutta ajanvaraajaa vahvistamaan tiimiämme. Autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan sopimalla laadukkaita myyntitapaamisia.

Jos olet tavoitteellinen, nautit ihmisten kanssa keskustelemisesta ja haluat kehittyä myynnin ammattilaisena, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Ajanvaraajan tehtävässä sovit myyntitapaamisia asiakkaidemme puolesta ja olet tärkeässä roolissa uusien asiakkuuksien rakentamisessa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

Aloitat yhdessä neljästä ajanvaraustiimistämme, jossa saat kattavan perehdytyksen, tiiminvetäjän tuen ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä päivä päivältä. Lopulliset ansiot määräytyvät oman aktiivisuuden ja tulosten perusteella.

Meillä työskentelevät viihtyvät hyvin; mm. aloitamme ja lopetamme päivän yhdessä, ja välillä haastamme toisiamme erilaisten myyntikilpailuiden kanssa. Eli meillä on aidosti mukavaa töissä!

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

Job Description

CD PROJEKT RED is looking for aSenior Full-Stack Engineerto join our Asset Pipeline Web Services team. We develop web applications and backend services that support game production workflows across the studio, helping teams plan their work, manage assets, review content, and collaborate more effectively.

In this role, you will use your strong Python and backend engineering expertise to design and build reliable services, APIs, and system integrations. You will also contribute to backend services written in Node.js and TypeScript, frontend applications built with React and TypeScript, and the deployment and operation of our solutions in a cloud environment. You will work across the complete application stack, taking features from technical design through production delivery.

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who combines technical depth with an ownership mindset and strong collaboration skills. The position is also intended for someone interested in gradually developing toward a coordinator role. Alongside your engineering responsibilities, you will progressively support the organization of the team’s day-to-day work, facilitate communication, and help keep priorities and dependencies visible.

Daily Responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and APIs using Python as well as Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Delivering features end to end, from data models and service architecture through React-based user interfaces.
  • Making pragmatic architectural decisions and improving the reliability, security, maintainability, and performance of our systems.
  • Designing integrations between internal applications, production systems, and external services.
  • Participating in the deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of applications in a cloud environment.
  • Collaborating with product, UX, infrastructure, and game development teams to understand their workflows and turn their needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Taking ownership of larger areas of work and breaking them down into clear deliverables.
  • Gradually taking on selected coordination responsibilities, including helping organize the team’s day-to-day work, facilitating communication, and keeping priorities and dependencies visible.
  • Contributing to code reviews, technical documentation, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • 5 + years professional of experience.
  • Professional experience in software engineering at senior level, with deep expertise in Python and backend development.
  • Experience with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, or comparable frameworks and libraries.
  • Experience designing maintainable APIs, data models, integrations, and service architectures.
  • Hands-on experience developing backend services with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience developing frontend applications with React and TypeScript. Deep UI specialization is not required, but you should be comfortable delivering and maintaining complete user-facing features.
  • Good working knowledge of relational databases and experience with database systems such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience deploying, operating, or troubleshooting applications in a public cloud environment.
  • Understanding of containerization, CI/CD, application monitoring, and production support.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, secure API design and general web application security.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, code review, debugging, and maintainable design.
  • A strong ownership mindset and the ability to communicate clearly and respectfully in an international, cross-functional environment.
  • Interest in gradually developing toward a Coordinator position, supported by strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience building distributed or event-driven systems using technologies such as Redis or Kafka.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or cloud-native observability.
  • Experience developing internal tools for technical or creative users.
  • Experience in game development, media production, digital-content pipelines, or another domain with complex production workflows.

Additional Information

Working mode

  • Relocation to Warsaw is required.
  • Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time orhybrid mode.

Relocation Support

  • Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered.
  • Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of.
  • Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too.
  • Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
  • Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
  • Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
  • Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being webinars.
  • Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
  • Menstrual leave — all menstruating employees are entitled to one day off if they suffer severe period symptoms that interrupt their work.
  • RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
  • RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.
  • A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
  • Trainings, lectures, and courses — internal workshops, external training for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
  • REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
  • Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!

Social Activities & Life in the Office

  • Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
  • Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
  • Healthy selections — canteens.
  • Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
  • Sustainable campus powered by renewable energy, including electricity from our own solar panels, green zones in offices and on campus, green open-air work and social area, electric and hybrid cars charging points, flower meadows, eco-activities for employees, and much more.
  • A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
  • An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
  • No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.

title: One full-time Postdoc position (m,f,x) for three years on Hyperproperties for Partially Observable S
description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) 01.01.2027, we are looking for

One full-time Postdoc position (m,f,x) for three years on Hyperproperties for Partially Observable Systems under Uncertainty (TV-L E14, 39.83 hours per week)

The chair of Artificial Intelligence and Formal Methods at the Ruhr-University Bochum in Germany (headed by Prof. Dr. Nils Jansen) conducts broad foundational and application-driven research on decision-making under uncertainty.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to develop formal methods for specifying and verifying hyperproperties of partially observable systems operating under uncertainty. The project combines techniques from formal verification, probabilistic model checking, quantitative reasoning, and strategy synthesis to analyze systems whose behavior depends on incomplete information and stochastic environments. The research is motivated by the growing need to ensure security and safety in autonomous, cyber-physical, and AI-enabled systems. Hyperproperties provide a powerful framework for expressing requirements such as information-flow security, privacy, and consistency across multiple executions, while partial observability and uncertainty reflect the challenges of real-world decision-making systems. The project aims to advance verification and synthesis techniques for trustworthy systems with rigorous correctness guarantees.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 years
Start: 01.01.2027
Apply by: 2026-10-05

Your tasks:

  • The main task of this position is to conduct research in the research areas listed above
  • Support of the chair’s teaching program in the form of conducting exercises and the organization of seminars and lectures
  • Establishment and further development of an in-house, independent line of research for the independent scientific investigation of topics and the establishment of an independent research perspective

Your profile:

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree and PhD in Computer Science or Mathematics
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English
  • Background in one or more of the following areas:
  • Formal verification and probabilistic model checking
  • MDPs, stochastic games, and strategy synthesis
  • Hyperproperties and information-flow verification
  • Quantitative reasoning and uncertainty-aware verification

title: System Director of Rehabilitation Services (Full Time)
description:
About North Country Healthcare (NCH):

North Country Healthcare is a non-profit affiliation of four medical facilities, Androscoggin Valley Hospital, North Country Home Health & Hospice Agency, Upper Connecticut Valley Hospital, and Weeks Medical Center, located in the White Mountains Region of New Hampshire. NCH includes numerous physicians and medical providers at multiple locations. This leading comprehensive healthcare network which employs hundreds of highly-trained individuals delivers integrated patient care through three community hospitals, specialty clinics, and home health and hospice services. NCH remains committed to the health and well-being of the communities we serve. As a leader in a management position this role emphasizes advancing High-Reliability Organization (HRO) principles, embedding a culture of safety, accountability, and consistent high performance.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Adhering to System Values, Service Excellence and Standards of Behavior, the Director of Rehabilitation Services will be responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, and oversight of rehabilitation services across NCH Entities; Androscoggin Valley Hospital (AVH), Weeks Medical Center (WMC), Upper Connecticut Valley Hospital (UCVH), excluding North Country Home Health and Hospice (NCHHHA). This includes directing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and improving quality of care and patient outcomes. The director will work closely with clinical leadership, hospital staff, and senior executives to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement on the journey to high reliability. All essential functions will be performed along with the other Rehabilitation managers’ involvement as best suited to their talents to assist the System Rehabilitation Director.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Eligible for NH State licensure in Physical Therapy (PT), Occupational Therapy (OT) or Speech/Language Pathology (SLP).

Certification:

  • All employees and contracted staff will have either successful completion of an American Heart Association* accredited course in Basic Life Support (BLS), or ACLS and PALS combined. (for clinical staff), Heartsaver CPR AED (for nonclinical staff), and renewal on a regular basis.

*Refer to the NCH Life Support Certification Policy for position specific requirements.

Licensure:

  • Current New Hampshire License in PT, OT and/or SLP required.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare regulations, patient safety standards, and quality improvement practices.
  • Financial acumen, with experience managing budgets and resources effectively.
  • Ability to think strategically and drive change in a complex, multi-facility environment.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) and healthcare management software.

Work Experience:

  • 2 years, or more, progressive leadership experience preferred.
  • 5 years, or more, clinical experience required.
  • Multi-facility or system-level leadership experience preferred.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Leadership and Oversight:
  • Provide strategic leadership and direction for Rehabilitation Services operations across NCH entities, clinics, and service locations.
  • Collaborate with department leaders to support seamless patient care transitions, coordinated services across the continuum of care, and standardized Rehabilitation Services policies, procedures, and best practices across NCH entities.
  • Mentor, support, and evaluate Rehabilitation Services managerial, supervisory, and technical staff fostering a culture of teamwork, accountability, and patient-centered care.
  • Serve as a liaison between Rehabilitation Services and other System departments, fostering collaboration and open communication.

  1. Operational Management:
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate policies and procedures that promote efficient, high-quality patient care and standardization across NCH entities.
  • Oversee day-to-day Rehabilitation Services operations, including inpatient and outpatient patient flow and staffing levels.
  • Oversee the implementation of electronic health records (EHR) and other technology systems that enhance patient care.

  1. Quality and Patient Safety:
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Lead Rehabilitation Services toward high reliability by keeping the five HRO principles at the forefront of decision-making: sensitivity to operations, preoccupation with failure, reluctance to simplify, resilience, and deference to expertise.
  • Lead efforts to monitor and improve Rehabilitation Services patient outcomes, safety, and satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with quality improvement teams to address clinical issues and identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Communicate effectively with patients and their families, addressing concerns that escalate beyond local managers.

  1. Regulatory Compliance and Life Safety:
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory agencies; Federal, State and Local.
  • Coordinate Rehabilitation Services related to accreditation surveys and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all necessary documentation and processes are in place.
  • Serve or delegate Rehabilitation Services representation on relevant committees and programs.
  • Ensure local site participation in drills, exercises, and after-action reviews.
  • Oversee Rehabilitation Services are compliant with licensure, certification, and inspections.
  1. Strategic Planning and Growth:
  • Lead Rehabilitation Services for system-wide capital planning, prioritization, and execution.
  • Collaborate with finance and organizational leaders on capital budgets, long-range planning, infrastructure needs, strategic priorities, and growth opportunities related to Rehabilitation Services.
  • Identify opportunities for service line growth and expansion, ensuring that new programs align with organizational goals.
  • Monitor industry trends and make recommendations for programmatic changes or innovations.
  1. Budgeting and Financial Management:
  • Develop and manage Rehabilitation Services budgets in collaboration with direct reports, ensuring cost-effective and resource-efficient operations.
  • Monitor departmental financial performance, reduction, sustainability, and cost-saving initiatives.
  • Ensure financial accountability and the alignment of Rehabilitation Services with organizational financial goals.
  1. Staffing and Development:
  • Collaborate with Human Resources on recruitment, retention, and development initiatives for rehabilitation department staff, including therapists, assistants, and support staff.
  • Provide mentorship and professional development opportunities for managers and staff.
  • Evaluate staffing needs and ensure the appropriate allocation of resources to meet patient care demands.
  1. Performs additional duties as assigned.

Meille on tärkeää, että asukkaamme voivat elää mielekästä ja itsensä näköistä arkea. Kuljemme heidän rinnallaan tukien ja avustaen heitä itsenäisessä päätöksenteossa, oman arjen hallinnassa ja toimimisessa osana yhteisöä.

Tutustu kotimme arkeen lisää Instagramista: [@esperi_pansio](https://www.instagram.com/esperi_pansio/)

Minkälaista sinun työsi olisi meillä?

Lähihoitajana tehtäväsi on vahvistaa asiakkaan toimintakykyä sekä itsenäisyyttä ja tukea häntä oman näköiseen elämään. Tehtäviisi kuuluu ohjaus- ja perushoitotyö asukkaiden yksilöllisten tarpeiden mukaisesti sekä lääkehoidon turvallinen toteuttaminen osana kokonaisvaltaista kuntoutusta. Autat asiakasta arkisissa asioissa, kuten talon ulkopuolisissa asioinneissa, ryhmätoimintaan osallistumisessa ja ulkoilussa. Suunnittelet ja toteutat yksilöllisiä tukitoimia ja aktiviteetteja asukkaidemme tarpeiden pohjalta. Pyrit edistämään heidän osallisuuttaan ja osallistumistaan yhteisöllisiin toimintoihin ja harrastuksiin.

Työsuhteen tiedot

Tehtävä on vakituinen. Työ on tuntityötä 0-115 h/3vk ja 3-vuorotyötä. Aloituksen ajankohdasta voimme sopia kanssasi!

Palkka

Palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Lähihoitajan tuntipalkka on 15,29 €/h (palkkaluokka G20C). Tehtäväkohtaisen peruspalkan päälle maksetaan mahdolliset kokemuslisät sekä työehtosopimuksen mukaiset vuorokohtaiset lisät.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- lähihoitajan tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkelupia tai valmiutta suorittaa luvat heti työsuhteen alussa

- hygieniapassia ja tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa

- vähintään toimivaa suomen peruskielitaitoa (B1)
- kielitaito tulee tarvittaessa voida osoittaa


Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemuksen mielenterveyskuntoutujien kanssa työskentelystä tai suuntautumisen mielenterveystyöhön opinnoissa. Pyydämme lisäksi rikosrekisterilain mukaisen rikosrekisteriotteen nähtäväksi.

Miksi sinun kannattaa tulla meille töihin?

Lämmin vastaanotto. Otamme sinut lämpimästi vastaan osaksi meidän porukkaa. Varmistamme sinulle hyvän perehdytyksen ja saat koko työyhteisön tuen työllesi. Teemme töitä yhdessä tiiminä asukkaidemme hyväksi, tavoitteenamme laadukas hoito ja hyvinvoiva henkilöstö.

Työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapaino. Meille on tärkeää, että työ ja vapaa-aikasi ovat tasapainossa ja kuuntelemme toiveitasi työvuorosuunnittelussa. Työsuhde-etuina saat käyttöösi ePassin virike-edun, työmatkaedun sekä Cityshopparin kautta alennuksia ja tarjouksia. Työntekijänämme olet oikeutettu työterveyshuoltoon Mehiläiseltä.

Uuden oppiminen. Työympäristönä kotimme on mielenkiintoinen ja monipuolinen. Haluamme mahdollistaa sinulle hyvät edellytykset toteuttaa työtäsi ja kehittää osaamistasi.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae meille työkaveriksi!

Jätä hakemuksesi 7.10. mennessä ja kerro meille itsestäsi! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja sovimme työn aloituksesta heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy tehtävään. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme tietoturvasyistä ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta jätetyt hakemukset.

Haluatko kuulla lisää tehtävästä? Lisätietoja antaa yksikönjohtaja Sari Mantere p. 050 570 7759, sp. sari.mantere@esperi.fi.

Olisi ilo kohdata sinut!


Esperi Koti Pansio

Esperi on suomalainen asumispalveluita tarjoava valtakunnallinen yritys. Työllistämme yli 7200 sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaista, ja Esperi-koteja löytyy yli 100 paikkakunnalta ympäri Suomen. Kodeissamme asuu ikäihmisiä, mielenterveyskuntoutujia sekä vammaispalvelun asiakkaita. Hoitotyötä teemme asukaslähtöisesti ja laadukkaasti. Korkea asukastyytyväisyys (50 NPS) on ylpeytemme aihe. Tule kokemaan itse, minkälaista meillä on olla töissä! Kaikki avoimet työtehtävämme löydät [täältä](https://esperi.fi/tyopaikat/avoimet-tyopaikat/).

Sähköposti: sari.mantere@esperi.fi Sijainti: Pernontie 27, Turku

title: Team Leader- Network 5
description:

The "Residential Supervisor," formally known as Team Leader, is under the direction and supervision of the Network Director, the Team Leader supervises and guides all individual community and home activities. The Team Leader supervises all staff assigned to the home, participates as a member of the Community Support Team in the development and completion of assigned implementation strategies (flourish plans), and represents the organization in leadership and administrative activities. The Team Leader also ensures a positive home environment. A critical component of the Team Leader's role is to ensure the safety and wellbeing of individuals served in order for all to live full and abundant lives.

Essential Functions

  1. Provides complete oversight and supervision for two or more twenty-four (24) hour or intermittent community residential sites, which includes on-call responsibilities and, at minimum, two late nights per work week and one weekend per month; each site requires supervision to up to two (2) or more full-time Independent Living Coaches (ILC).

  2. Reviews Independent Living Coach applications and interviews potential candidates for the Independent Living Coach position.

  5. Delegates responsibilities to two (2) or more full-time Independent Living Coaches.

  6. Delivers quality onboarding to newly hired Independent Living Coaches which includes orientations, on-the-job trainings (OTJs) and Quest within the first few months of the new employees' employment.

  7. Delivers coaching, and leadership to the team or teams of Independent Living Coaches assigned to the supervised home(s).

  8. Instructs Independent Living Coaches in the proper methods of conducting individualized programs and activities.

  10. Communicates with parents, guardians, staff, visitors, community agencies, and other internal or external entities in a professional and timely manner.

  11. Functions as a member of the Trinity leadership team in the organization including task groups; is actively involved in the network and organization-wide committees.

  1. Responsible for ensuring a clean and safe environment for program participants and employees; which includes completing necessary checklists and initiating any necessary maintenance requests.

  1. Instructs and carries out written implementation strategies and behavior support plans.

  2. Encourages and monitors individuals to engage in community activities and events, individually and on a small group basis.
  1. Promote natural support networks to facilitate continuity in existing relationships and build new relationships.
  1. Advises the Network Director and the Network Nurse (or designee) of any immediate or non-immediate medical problems regarding any program participants.
  1. Monitors the implementation of medical and special dietary needs of each program participant across all assigned home(s).
  1. Monitors the oversight of medication administration across assigned home(s).
  1. Works collaboratively with the staff at community day services and/or Supportive Employment in seeking growth for program participants.

  2. Provides ongoing monitoring of program participants needs including physical health, emotional wellbeing and preferences.

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to make independent decisions and problem solve

  • Able to plan, organize, develop, implement, and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies and procedures, necessary for providing quality care
  • Able to communicate policies, procedures, regulations, reports, etc. to staff, program participants, family members, visitors, and government agencies/personnel
  • Able to seek out new methods and systems and be willing to incorporate them into existing practices
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strongly self-motivated

Physical Demands

  • Be able to push and pull 75 pounds
  • Be able to complete deep knee squats
  • Be able to push wheelchairs up to 200 pounds or more
  • Remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods

  • Physical activities that could be used include: driving, balancing, pulling, pushing, standing, climbing, climbing up and down stairs, grasping, stooping, crouching, crawling, kneeling, reaching, lifting, and repetitive motion.

Qualification

  2. Valid Drivers License

title: Data Engineer (Lakehouse)
description:
The company is looking for a Senior Data Lakehouse Engineer to own the architecture and evolution of the data platform behind millions of financial events across 12M+ active users.

You’ll be responsible for how data is ingested, stored, retained, governed, and reconciled across S3 and Snowflake/Databricks, ensuring analytics, finance, and regulatory teams work with accurate and consistent data.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the lakehouse architecture, including bronze/silver/gold layers.
  • Define data layout, partitioning, compaction, file sizing, and query optimization at TB+ scale.
  • Design reliable CDC and streaming ingestion using Kafka and Debezium.
  • Manage schema evolution and handle late, duplicate, and out-of-order events.
  • Own retention, archival, immutability/WORM, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Ensure data correctness through reconciliation, freshness SLAs, and drift detection.
  • Define governance standards including lineage, access control, PII masking, encryption, and audit trails.
  • Monitor ingestion health, platform performance, and cloud storage/compute costs.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering.
  • Strong experience designing and owning lakehouse architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Strong knowledge of S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Trino, or Athena.
  • Experience optimizing large‑scale data platforms through partitioning, compaction, and storage design.
  • Experience with CDC, Kafka, streaming pipelines, and schema evolution.
  • Understanding of immutability/WORM retention, governance, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Experience with financial, wallet, ledger, iGaming, fintech, or other audit‑heavy data is a strong advantage.

Please note: This is a hybrid role based in Kraków, requiring 2 days per week in the office. Fully remote candidates cannot be considered.

title: Enterprise Account Director
description:
Position Overview:

As an Account Director with Diligent, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth, deepening customer engagement, and shaping the future of how businesses utilise our cutting-edge solutions. Success in this role means expanding product adoption among current customers and introducing new clients to our platform. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role that demands strategic vision, proactive relationship-building, and relentless pursuit of excellence. You’ll be responsible for everything from engaging prospects and managing a robust pipeline to delivering accurate forecasts and closing deals. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategist, you’ll lead account planning, orchestrate internal collaboration, and leverage expertise to elevate customer success and revenue growth.

We’re looking for a commercially sound sales professional with a track record of exceeding targets, a natural collaborator, and someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments. If you’re driven to create value, embody a customer-first ethos, and deliver innovative solutions, this is the role for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with 50% office-based work required (periodic travel to partner offices will be required). This role is open to candidates based in London.

Regrettably we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, so you must be eligible to work in the UK.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Proactively build a deep knowledge of and expertise in Diligent’s products, solutions, strategy and business priorities.
  • Responsible for prospecting new and existing business within the designated vertical / territory for complex accounts with longer sales cycles.
  • Adopts a ‘solutions’ selling approach, understanding customer needs and developing solutions through the lens of the Diligent One Platform.
  • Build deep relationships with prospects and customers during interactions by being customer-focused and consistently honouring commitments and connecting the customer to internal commercial stakeholders to foster product growth.
  • Develop and execute on account plans to ensure revenue targets, quota and customer business needs are met and collaborates with key stakeholders to drive integrated joint account wins for mutual business growth.
  • Leads the coordination of Sales stakeholders to prioritise actions for multiple assigned accounts based on customer needs, sales generating importance, and account risks.
  • Develops specialised business plans for customers that drive business outcomes to generate new business and upsells. Presents business plans to customers to generate new non-qualified opportunities.
  • Create and lead feedback loop processes with product management and product marketing to communicate and relay customer pain points and feedback.
  • Demonstrate Sales excellence by managing the end-to-end sales cycle from opportunity to deal close using the Diligent approved sales methodology.

title: .NET Backend Developer — 6-Month Project (Hybrid)
description:
The Role

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto-tagging engine - the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem-solving in a highly collaborative, AI-integrated environment.

About The Product

The product is an AI-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real-time content creation.

Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.

Team Structure & Collaboration

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Video Indexing & Auto-Tagging: Build and maintain the C#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto-tag live sports events
  • Technical Leadership: Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
  • On-Call Rotation: Participate in a shared on-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
  • Proactivity: Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel-based team

What We Expect

  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with 5+ years of commercial .NET experience
  • Hands-on experience developing within Azure cloud environments
  • Familiarity with and daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
  • High autonomy, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
  • Familiarity with event-driven messaging services such as Azure Service Bus or Kafka
  • Working knowledge of SQL databases (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
  • Basic familiarity with DevOps terminology and Kubernetes (operational expertise is not required)
  • Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, 3 days from the office in Warsaw

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

  • Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale - no full-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high-load microservices, indexing engines, and real-time processing
  • High-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

title: Persoonlijk begeleider, Touwbaan 21 Sliedrecht
description:
Wij zijn voor Touwbaan 21 in Sliedrecht op zoek naar een Persoonlijk begeleider.

Wat ga je doen?
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor 3 tot 4 bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking. Als persoonlijk begeleider coördineer je de behandeling en begeleiding van een aantal cliënten met een (zeer) intensieve begeleidingsvraag. Je geeft daarbij zelf uitvoering aan de behandeling door mee te werken in de directe begeleiding van cliënten Zo zie je met eigen ogen wat er nodig is om het samenspel tussen cliënten, verwanten en begeleiders vast te houden en te versterken.

Tijdens je dienst zorg je ervoor dat de bewoners op jou kunnen vertrouwen. Je bent betrokken bij het ochtendritueel of vangt de bewoners weer op als ze klaar zijn met dagbesteding. Je betrekt ze bij de dagelijkse gang van zaken en de huishoudelijke taken op de woning. Wij gaan uit van het samen 100 principe. Je vult de bewoner aan, zodat je samen op 100% komt. Voor het realiseren van de beste behandeling en begeleiding coördineer je samen met de orthopedagoog en de teamleider de planning van de behandeling, en werkoverleg.

  • Je hebt een actieve rol in het opstellen en evalueren van een dag-, ontwikkelings- en/of trainingsprogramma

  • Je hebt maandelijks een overleg met collega’s en overige disciplines over de inhoud van de zorg

  • Je wordt aangestuurd door een teamleider en geeft zelf sturing aan begeleiders en ondersteunend begeleiders.

  • Als team zijn jullie samen verantwoordelijk voor de beste menswaardige zorg

Wie zoeken we?
Je bent sensitief: je voelt aan wat de (onvervulde) behoeften achter het gedrag van bewoners zijn. Vanuit (zelf)vertrouwen neem je verantwoorde risico’s. Je bent sterk in zelfreflectie en neemt je verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent een doorzetter, die met een open blik zoekt naar mogelijkheden in beperkingen. Zo vind je manieren om de omgeving en de dag invulling van bewoners zó vorm te geven, dat zij het gewone leven kunnen ervaren. Omdat je op een woning werkt, draai je onregelmatige diensten.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding SPH, MMZ 4 (uitstroom GHZ) of SPW 4.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding MBO 4 Specifieke doelgroepen, Associate degree (AD) SPH of Social Work (met leerarrangement).

  • Je wilt behandelen en begeleiden volgens de uitgangspunten van Triple-C.

  • Je laat je niet (af)leiden door probleemgedrag, maar richt je op de menselijke behoeften.

Wat krijg je?
Een veelzijdige baan waarbij je samen met je collega’s kijkt naar mogelijkheden van bewoners en niet naar beperkingen. ASVZ wil niet alleen een goede zorgverlener zijn, maar ook een goede werkgever. Een organisatie waar je met plezier werkt en waar je je verbonden voelt met je collega’s.

Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • Mogelijkheid tot een vast contract, afhankelijk van je kwalificaties.

  • Een parttimebaan voor 24 tot 28 uur per week.

  • €2.893,00 tot €3.902,00 o.b.v. 36 uur. Een salaris afgestemd op jouw ervaring in salarisschaal FWG 40, volgens de CAO gehandicaptenzorg.

  • 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en uiteraard onregelmatigheidstoeslag (ORT).

  • Aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden, naar b.v. Meewerkend Teamleider.

Werkplek
De bewoners op Touwbaan 21 worden begeleid of ondersteund bij de ADL. 2 bewoners worden verzorgd m.b.v. een tillift en een badbrancard. De bewoners hebben veel nabijheid en positieve begeleiding nodig. Ze zijn ouder en dus wordt het dagprogramma aangepast op hun tempo. Er zijn altijd 2 begeleiders op de groep. De persoonlijk begeleider zal voor 3 bewoners de plannen maken en opvolgen, contacten met de verwanten onderhouden en collega's aansturen op wat er nodig is en attent maken op de behoeften van de ouder wordende bewoners, om zo een menswaardig bestaan en een fijn leven te hebben.

Bij Touwbaan 21 zoeken wij iemand die enthousiast is en het leuk vindt om het veranderproces met het team mede vorm te geven en daar een positieve bijdrage aan wil leveren. Iemand die, naast de goede contacten met bewoners, goed is in de contacten met collega's en een teamplayer is.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct!
Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust door contact op te nemen met Marjon de Graas, meewerkend teamleider via 06-689016249.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Liever niet.
Ben je zzp'er? Solliciteer dan alleen als je bij ASVZ in loondienst wilt komen.

title: Full Stack Engineer
