Our values - Agile, Collaborative, Empowering, Fair, and Passionate - shape our culture and the way we work. Together, we're helping shape the future of flexible work.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will join a small, sharp team operating in an AI-first development environment, with autonomy to shape architecture, influence engineering culture, and help us ship high-impact products quickly and pragmatically.

title: Polyvalent Uitvaartplanner Brussel
description:
Sereni is een sterk netwerk van ondernemers, waarbij lokale verankering belangrijk is. Door onze krachten te bundelen kunnen we ons groeiend netwerk uitvaartondernemers ontzorgen, zodat zij zich kunnen focussen op taken, waar ze echt het verschil maken voor mensen.

We evolueren van een uitvaartbedrijf naar een volwaardig zorgbedrijf.

Bij Sereni zijn we sterk doordrongen van de grote maatschappelijke impact van de uitvaartsector en de rol die we in de samenleving vervullen. Onze mensen zijn onze allerbelangrijkste troef. Alle medewerkers krijgen de nodige autonomie en vertrouwen om elke dag het beste van zichzelf te geven, creatief na te denken, kansen te creëren en te grijpen.

Onze missie en kernwaarden vormen een kompas bij het bouwen van ons Sereni DNA. Ons ondernemerschap werkt aanstekelijk. We blijven innoveren en zorgen voor een frisse wind in het uitvaart landschap. Zo maken wij ‘echt het verschil’


Om ons team te versterken, zijn we op zoek naar een polyvalent uitvaartplanner voor de regio Brussel.
Ben jij een ondernemend persoon die samen met het bestaande team het kantoor wil uitbouwen? Weet jij als de beste hoe je een mooi en persoonlijk afscheid moet organiseren? Ben jij iemand die zich goed kan inleven in de emoties van anderen en beschik jij over een groot empatisch vermogen? Dan is deze vacature misschien wel iets voor jou.

Wat zal je doen als polyvalent uitvaartplanner?

  • Het tot in de puntjes regelen van een persoonlijke uitvaart op maat.

  • Een luisterend oor bieden aan de nabestaanden. Als polyvalent uitvaartplanner begeleid je niet enkel de nabestaanden maar luister je ook naar hun wensen en noden en sta je ze bij bij al hun vragen.

  • Het overbrengen en opbaren van overledenen (inclusief wachtdienst).

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat families nog een laatste groet kunnen brengen aan hun dierbare.

  • Het uitvoeren van administratieve taken waaronder het in orde maken van de nodige documenten (zoals de medische overlijdensakte en de toestemming tot lijkbezorging)

  • Op een ondernemende manier ga je om met een zeer breed en gevarieerd takenpakket.

  • Je behandelt de families zoals je zelf wil behandeld worden op een belangrijk moment in het leven.

  • Je leidt een serene ceremonie in zowel kerk als aula.

Wie zoeken we?

  • Je hebt een bachelor diploma of al enige ervaring in een commerciële of dienstverlenende sector

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B

  • Je bent tweetalig Nederlands-Frans en kan je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk vlot uitdrukken in beide landstalen.

  • Een nine-to-five is niets voor jou. Je bent flexibel en weekend- en avondwerk schrikken jou niet af.

  • Je hebt een oog voor detail en houdt van plannen en organiseren.

  • Je hebt een verzorgd en dynamisch voorkomen.

  • Omgaan met stress en deadlines vormen geen probleem voor jou.

  • Je bent sociaal aangelegd en werkt graag samen met anderen mensen

  • De nabestaanden komen bij jou steeds op de eerste plaats. Je bent bereid om voor hen net dat tikkeltje meer te doen.

Voor deze functie bieden wij een vast contract van onbepaalde duur met een voltijdse tewerkstelling van 40u/week.

Je kan rekenen op een verloning volgens barema en ontvangt daarbovenop extralegale voordelen:

  • maaltijdcheques

  • een groepsverzekering met extra waarborg gewaarborgd inkomen

  • een hospitalisatieverzekering met extra waarborg tandzorg voor jou en je inwonende gezinsleden

  • 12 ADV-dagen

  • een uitgebreid voordelenprogramma met personeelskortingen bij oa Decathlon, Kinepolis, Hema, Expedia, Ikea,... via Benefits at Work

  • toegang tot ons Employee Assistance Program (EAP) voor jezelf en je inwonende gezinsleden. Dit programma geeft je toegang tot onafhankelijke experten voor emotionele, fysieke en praktische ondersteuning voor zowel professionele als persoonlijke topics. Je kan onder andere 24/7 terecht bij onafhankelijke psychologen voor een vertrouwelijk gesprek. De dienstverlening is volledig gratis, anoniem en confidentieel.

Bij Sereni geloven we in de kracht van diversiteit en een inclusieve werkomgeving. Iedere gekwalificeerde kandidaat wordt met gelijke zorg en discretie behandeld.

title: Lead SAP Consultant (Data & Analytics)
description:
The headlines...

Latest start date - early January 2027

Working model - mostly remote (UK) with occasional travel to our Bristol HQ (roughly once a month) and occasional client site visits nationally and internationally

Salary - £72,000 - £95,000/annum (DOE)

Why this role exists…

We're looking for a hands-on SAP data and analytics consultant who wants to help clients get more from their SAP landscape as it evolves; someone who's genuinely interested in bringing the trusted SAP data to modern cloud platforms like Snowflake and Databricks, and in becoming one of the rare people who can make the best use of the strengths of each platform.

As Snap's SAP practice grows, so does the work. You’ll have the opportunity to jump straight onto projects that involve standing up a new data platform on SAP Business Data Cloud and help customers migrating from SAP BW to Databricks. Both initiatives aim to switch off costly legacy systems, speed up decision-making and enable the business to run AI workloads on SAP and non-SAP data. Both kick off around the start of 2027, which is why we're hiring now.

You'll join a small, growing SAP team where you'll own real client delivery, rather than being one more pair of hands on someone else's plan. It's a role with a good balance of autonomy and support. You'll be trusted to lead your own workstream while working closely with our SAP practice lead and technical lead, learning alongside people who've delivered this kind of work before.

So, if you know SAP BW inside out, enjoy the puzzle of making SAP data work on modern platforms, and want to help build something rather than slot into a fixed machine, this could be for you.
You'll lead a workstream on live client projects, owning the deliverables, the plan and the design decisions underneath them.

It's a role that flexes with the project. Sometimes you'll be hands-on inside SAP, building on BDC or Datasphere. Other times you'll be the SAP data expert on a non-SAP build, using your BW knowledge to help a team deliver on Databricks or Snowflake.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Leading a workstream end to end which involves owning a set of deliverables and the plan to get there

  • Running client discovery, getting into the detail fast, defining the design and setting a build team up to start

  • Extracting SAP source data and rebuilding it as analytics on a modern cloud platform

  • Making the architecture decisions on your workstream and being able to defend them

  • Coaching more junior consultants on the SAP side, bringing them along, not managing them

  • Contributing to pre-sales, proposals and our growing SAP capability as you settle in
In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:
  • Completing a discovery phase and getting a pilot or detailed design in front of the client

  • Enabling the build team to start implementation

  • Getting hands-on with a modern cloud platform if you haven't already; we're a Snowflake and Databricks specialist, so you'll have the chance to learn it on live work

  • Building trust with client stakeholders and becoming their go-to on the SAP data side
We're looking for someone who knows SAP data inside and out, communicates with clarity rather than volume and is genuinely up for learning the parts they don't know yet. Someone who's comfortable when the path isn't fully mapped (some of this technology could be new to you) and who takes things forward rather than waiting to be told.

You’d be a great fit if you have:
  • Strong, hands-on SAP BW/BW/4HANA experience
  • A solid understanding of SAP as a source system (ECC or S/4HANA, and functional areas like Finance, Sales, Procurement or Supply Chain)
  • Real SAP data modelling and data architecture skill; you can design the solution, not just build to someone else's
  • Consulting delivery experience; you've led a workstream before and you build trust with clients quickly
Bonus points if you have:
  • SAP Datasphere experience, or exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud or SAP Analytics Cloud (highly desirable)

  • Hands-on time with Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric or Azure; awareness is plenty, you'll deepen it here

  • Experience migrating clients off SAP BW or BusinessObjects onto cloud analytics

  • Integration tooling (Fivetran, SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, SAP Data Services), Power BI or Agile delivery

  • Industry experience in Manufacturing, Retail, FMCG, Energy or Financial Services
If you meet most of the "great fit" list and the work excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

This role might not be the right fit if you're looking for:
  • A pure development role where someone else owns the plan and the client relationship

  • An all-SAP world - you'll spend real time helping build on non-SAP platforms

  • A big, established practice with narrowly defined roles and everything mapped out for you
  • The chance to become one of the rare SAP consultants who can bridge SAP into Snowflake and Databricks, a skill clients are crying out for

  • Real ownership from the start; you'll lead a workstream, not wait your turn

  • A small, scaling SAP practice with room to grow, from leading a workstream to leading a full engagement, and into commercial, technical or delivery leadership as you choose

  • A genuine balance of autonomy and support, learning alongside people who've done this before

  • Remote-first working, UK-based, with roughly one day a month in Bristol and occasional client or international travel

  • The backing to learn the cloud-platform side on live projects, not in your own time
Our benefits...﻿﻿

title: ESTIMATOR
description:
Estimator - Civil Construction

Company Overview:

We’re a Utah-based excavation and civil construction company that builds projects from the ground up. Our work covers site development, earthwork, underground utilities, and concrete for commercial, municipal, and infrastructure jobs across the region.

What we do is the foundation everything else sits on. If we don’t get it right, nothing else will. That’s why we hold the line on quality, precision, and doing the job the right way every time.

We’re a crew of hardworking people who take pride in tough jobs. The work isn’t easy, and it’s not for everyone. We work side by side with project managers, contractors, and clients to keep jobs moving, stay safe, and deliver results that hold up.

Around here, reliability matters. Skill matters. Showing up and pulling your weight matters. Everyone on the team is expected to take ownership of their work and contribute to getting the job done right.

Job Summary:

The Estimator is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for excavation, earthwork, underground utility, and civil construction projects. This role reviews plans, specifications, quantities, subcontractor pricing, and production requirements to build complete project estimates and proposals.

The Estimator works closely with project managers, superintendents, vendors, subcontractors, and company leadership to support bidding, budgeting, and project planning efforts.

This position requires strong attention to detail, the ability to manage deadlines, and a solid understanding of excavation and utility construction methods.

Essential Functions:

  • Review project plans, specifications, geotechnical reports, and bid documents for excavation and civil construction projects
  • Perform quantity takeoffs for earthwork, utilities, grading, concrete, and related scopes of work
  • Develop detailed project estimates including labor, equipment, materials, trucking, subcontractors, and production costs
  • Solicit and review pricing from subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers
  • Attend pre-bid meetings, site walks, and project review meetings as needed
  • Identify project risks, access issues, utility conflicts, and scheduling concerns during the estimating process
  • Work with operations teams to verify production assumptions, equipment needs, and construction methods
  • Prepare bid proposals, clarifications, and supporting documentation
  • Coordinate bid submissions and ensure deadlines are met
  • Track and maintain estimate files, bid logs, and historical cost information
  • Support project handoff meetings with operations teams after award
  • Assist with budgeting, value engineering, and change pricing as needed
  • Communicate with clients, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams professionally and clearly
  • Perform other tasks as needed to support preconstruction and operational goals

Supervisory Responsibility:

  • No direct supervisory responsibilities
  • May assist with training or mentoring junior estimators or project engineers as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in excavation, underground utilities, estimating, or heavy civil construction
  • Strong understanding of excavation methods, grading, trenching, and underground utility installation
  • Ability to read and understand construction drawings, specifications, and civil plans
  • Experience performing quantity takeoffs and building construction estimates
  • Knowledge of construction means, methods, labor production, and equipment costs
  • Strong math, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously
  • Clear communication skills with field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and clients
  • Proficient computer skills including estimating software, spreadsheets, email, and document management
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Previous experience estimating excavation, sitework, or utility projects
  • Experience with HCSS or similar estimating software
  • Knowledge of local subcontractor and supplier markets
  • Civil construction field experience
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or related field preferred but not required

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time
  • Ability to review plans, drawings, and digital documents in detail
  • Ability to occasionally walk active construction job sites and uneven terrain
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Ability to travel to job sites, pre-bid meetings, and vendor locations as needed

Work Environment:

  • Work is primarily performed in an office environment with occasional job site visits
  • Job site visits may involve exposure to heavy equipment, dirt, dust, noise, mud, and changing weather conditions
  • Fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and changing priorities
  • Requires coordination with field operations, subcontractors, vendors, engineers, and clients
  • Requires strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately under time constraints

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Embedded Software Engineer – Job Description

Department: Engineering
Reports To: Program Manager and Engineering Director
FLSA Status: Exempt / Full-time

Security Clearance required

Salary Range: $90,000 - $125,000 Annually (depending on experience)

ROLE

  • Present and explain software designs and solutions to internal teams and customers.

QUALIFICATIONS

Summary:

As part of organisation, we bring together data, technology, and services to help clients make confident decisions and scale with agility. Our open ecosystem and global support model enable investment professionals—from portfolio managers to private markets specialists to navigate complexity and drive innovation. At Charles River, we thrive on collaboration, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to shaping the future of financial technology.

The role requires a strong full-stack engineer who can work across rich web functionality, backend services, automated testing, performance engineering, and system scalability while contributing to sustainable technical design and high-quality delivery in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Work under minimal supervision to analyze, design, develop, test, and debug small to large software enhancements and solutions within Charles River’s business and technical problem domains, with strong ownership of delivery quality and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Managers to turn business requirements of moderate complexity into working and sustainable software.

Required Qualifications

  • Able to work well with peers in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Wellbeing Referral Coordinator
description: Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must have a current, unrestricted right to work in the UK. Areas Covered: South and West Essex. Interview Date: Tuesday 13 th October 2026. The Opportunity The Early Help Wellbeing Team is a welcoming, compassionate, and exciting team to work in, offering preventative and early help to connect people to opportunities in their own communities and provide support that enables them to achieve personal ambitions, goals, and aspirations. Mental health social care is transforming into a new operational delivery model improving our early intervention and prevention offer to Essex residents with a focus on people currently not receiving services or falling through existing gaps. The offer is to ensure care act compliance across the system offering information advice and guidance and providing support to improve wellbeing outcomes. Within this service there will be a mixture of the team carrying out direct work alongside adults and completing care act assessments relevant to wellbeing outcomes and the completion of care act reviews. To read more about our business area, please visit: Adult Social Care The Role The Wellbeing Referral Co-ordinator will be required to effectively coordinate and support the delivery of tasks, processes and activities relating to meeting the mental health and wellbeing needs of the Essex population within Adult Social Care. The Wellbeing Referral Coordinator will support the Early help and wellbeing team which is a newly created merged ASC service focusing on wellbeing outcomes for people. The role must be able to manage a number of differing tasks, manage the front door to the team including having detailed conversations with the public around referral enquiries. The role must also demonstrate excellent administrative skills and the flexibility of being able to manage differing priorities. Accountabilities Manage the referrals from public and agencies; into the Early help and wellbeing team and support the team by triaging and signposting to community support which enables service users to receive excellent information, advice, and guidance. Manage spreadsheets, analyse data, and produce performance reports for the Early help and wellbeing team, which will be presented at the Mental health transformation board. Deliver a high-quality administrative support service to the team in relation to managing the referrals into the service. This includes inputting information into the social care management system and supporting administrative tasks associated with incoming work. Work collaboratively with colleagues and team manager to ensure consistency of processes and ability to challenge and escalate to managers any complex situations and scenarios involving people contacting the team. Managing contact from internal and external partners via email contact or phone contact to ensure a collaborative and efficient response. Liaising with corporate communications team for social media presence. Involvement in team activities such as mental health awareness events and any team activities associated with promotion of services, this will be taking an active role alongside the team. Managing team share and resources to ensure information is relevant and up to date. Any other administrative duties relevant to supporting the team function. This could include maintaining a training matrix and taking team meeting minutes. Specific individual and shared targets and objectives are defined annually within the performance management framework. The Experience You Will Bring Educated to RQF level 2 (GCSE) including English, or equivalent by experience. Good working knowledge of mental health, to include an understanding of the types of mental ill health, the effect of being mentally unwell, and the ways in which someone with a mental health problem can be supported into recovery. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. A good understanding of adult social care and current national social care and health agenda and the range of complex needs of vulnerable adults at risk. A working knowledge of the Care Act and excellent understanding of the key principles and an understanding of Inclusive Essex. A good working knowledge and ability to use information technology and related systems, particularly Excel and MS Teams. The ability to work autonomously and manage own workload. Why Essex? As one of the largest and most dynamic UK local authorities, Essex offers a stimulating public service environment. Covering over 1,420 square miles and serving 1.8 million residents, we’re committed to transformational change and delivering better quality at lower cost. Recognised in the top three of the latest IMPOWER index for productivity, we ensure everyone matters in Everyone's Essex . With flexible working options and a focus on innovation, whether you are looking to develop your career or contribute to the local community, Essex is the ideal place for you. In March 2026, Greater Essex was accepted on to the devolution priority programme, where we will work towards establishing a Mayoral Combined County Authority. You can read more about these changes, and what this may mean for this role, on our careers site . Essex County Council is proud to be a Disability Confident Leader. Please speak to our Recruiters if you require any reasonable adjustments during the process. At Essex County Council, we value integrity and ethical behaviour. We kindly ask that you embrace our code of conduct and the Nolan principles , including throughout the recruitment process. Your commitment to these standards helps us maintain a positive and respectful workplace for everyone. The role requires you to be mobile throughout a wider operational area including travelling around the county of Essex and beyond, transporting service users and their belongings and to be able to do so in an emergency. Driving licence and car or the ability to meet the mobility requirements of the role through other means is essential. title: Linux Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to more than 227,000 people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around AI, digital, engineering, cloud and software, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products.

We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology & Services, Semiconductor, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, Mobility and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending March 2026 totaled $14.7B

Overview of the Role

The Linux Cloud DevOps Engineer plays a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining cutting-edge Linux Cloud services to support business objectives. This position is central to advancing HCLTech’s cloud infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency, reliability, and security. As part of an agile DevOps or SRE team, you will leverage automation, modern cloud technologies, and industry best practices to optimize the Linux environment, drive rapid lifecycle management, and deliver exceptional service to global clients.

Detailed Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for the Linux Cloud landscape, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for clients.
  • Develop, configure, and maintain Linux Cloud services tailored to business needs.
  • Manage operational tasks within a global team, emphasizing automation, scalability, security, and customer satisfaction.
  • Utilize CI/CD frameworks to support rapid platform lifecycle management.
  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for incidents, problems, and service requests.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party suppliers to resolve incidents and implement changes.
  • Implement automation and self-healing solutions to minimize manual intervention and reduce operational toil.
  • Monitor and address reliability issues, reducing error budgets and associated risks.
  • Create and maintain internal technical designs and comprehensive user documentation.
  • Support ITSM processes, including incident, problem, request, change, and capacity management.

Skill Requirements

  • Azure Associate certification or equivalent expertise.
  • Linux (RHEL) and Ansible certifications.
  • Professional experience: minimum 5+ years for senior candidates; minimum 3+ years for mid-level candidates.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Terraform, Python, and Ansible Automation Platform.

  • Strong security mindset, ensuring all activities adhere to best practices.

  • Adaptability to fast-paced and dynamic environments.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for technical issue resolution.

Other Requirements (Optional)

  • Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

title: Homemaker (Full Time)
description:
Position is based out of Littleton, requires travel.

Job Summary:

The Home Health Homemaker position is a highly rewarding position that helps clients remain in their homes by improving their quality of life and contributing to a safer environment. The Home Health Homemaker assists individuals and families with light housekeeping, as well as emotional support. The Home Health Homemaker must be highly self-motivated, non-judgmental, flexible, possess excellent communication skills, and be able to work independently and as a part of the home health team. Preservation of confidentiality from all aspects of this position is mandatory.

Essential Qualifications: BLS certification is required. Valid driver’s license, good driving record and maintain personal auto liability, as specified in policy.

About NCHHHA:

North Country Home Health & Hospice Agency (NCHHHA), based in Littleton, NH, serves residents of Coos and Grafton Counties. Compassionate, patient-focused services include Home Care, Palliative Care, and Hospice Care. Home care offerings include, but may not be limited to, skilled observation and assessment, nursing care management, disease management, surgical aftercare, wound care, injections and IV therapy, maternal and baby health, pediatric care, rehabilitative services, and therapeutic assessment and rehabilitation planning specific to the home.

Palliative care services include in-home consultation with a provider and/or Medical Social Worker, advanced care planning, symptom management recommendations, social and spiritual support, and bereavement and grief support. Hospice care includes a certified hospice nursing assessment, 24/7 clinical support, in-home provider visits for pain and symptom management, medical supplies, equipment, hospice medications, volunteer support and companionship, social and spiritual support, and bereavement and grief support. A proud partner of North Country Healthcare (NCH), NCHHHA is a Medicare-certified, non-profit organization and a member agency of the Home Care Association of NH.

About North Country Healthcare (NCH):

North Country Healthcare is a non-profit affiliation of four medical facilities, Androscoggin Valley Hospital, North Country Home Health & Hospice Agency, Upper Connecticut Valley Hospital, and Weeks Medical Center, located in the White Mountains Region of New Hampshire. NCH includes numerous physicians and medical providers at multiple locations. This leading comprehensive healthcare network which employs hundreds of highly-trained individuals delivers integrated patient care through three community hospitals, specialty clinics, and home health and hospice services. NCH remains committed to the health and well-being of the communities we serve.

North Country Healthcare is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to the Human Resources department at the affiliate to which you are applying.

Please Note: All new hires are required to attend a mandatory three-day orientation at Weeks Medical Center in Lancaster, NH. This orientation provides essential training, compliance information, and an introduction to our organizational culture to ensure a smooth and successful transition into your role. Attendance on all three days is required for onboarding completion.

Additionally, if Weeks Medical Center is not your designated home base, you will be eligible for travel reimbursement in accordance with our standard travel policy.

title: Sample Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Sample Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you are responsible for the day-to-day handling and movement of product samples across the organization. You make sure samples are received, unpacked, sorted, stored, and placed in the right location at the right time, so that teams across Buying, PJM, Sales, Quality, and Sourcing can easily access what they need.

This is a very hands-on role in which you are actively working with samples throughout the day, including lifting, moving, unpacking boxes, organizing storage areas, and maintaining the showroom and sample spaces. A large part of your work is physical and operational, combined with keeping basic tracking and administration accurate and up to date.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is practical and hands-on, and takes ownership of keeping the sample flow organized and running smoothly.

Job overview:

Administration & Coordination

  • Track sample status updates for all PJM projects in Vendor Portal.

  • Maintain accurate records of sample movements, storage locations, and project clean-up activities.

  • Act as the main point of contact between departments regarding sample management and logistics.

  • Approve monthly shipping invoices/payments received from Finance.

  • Support onboarding of new employees regarding sample processes and storage procedures.

  • Monitor and follow up on FedEx shipments.

  • Register and manage photography samples.

  • Receive, organise, rotate all inbound samples (PP, MP, QIMA, Photography, and Sourcing samples).

  • Ensure that all samples are inspected for quality before storage or shipment, and that any defective or outdated samples are discarded or flagged.

  • Record and physically manage QIMA samples and coordinate project sample clean-up with PJMs and Buyers.

Storage, Showroom & Inventory Management

  • Prepare, pack, and dispatch samples for Buying/PJM/Sales departments.

  • Coordinate Active Ants and De Zwaluw sample shipments.

  • Organise and coordinate the monthly Opkoper (reseller) collection.

  • Manage the showroom, including organisation, cleanliness, maintenance, and restocking.

  • Manage external storage facilities and maintain sample inventories.

  • Order and maintain packaging materials and supplies.

  • Support the Quality team with sample disposal, lab organisation, and general housekeeping activities.

  • Regularly review and dispose of samples together with Buyers and PJMs.

Requirements:

  • MBO education in Business, Logistics, or similar is a plus.

  • 2–3 years’ experience in inventory, sample handling, or related roles.

  • Strong organizational skills; detail-oriented and able to manage multiple tasks.

  • Familiar with inventory systems; Excel knowledge is a plus.

Knowledge

  • Understanding of inventory/sample tracking best practices and basic warehouse/logistics processes.

  • Eager to improve and structure sample management processes.

Key Competencies

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong time management and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication and teamwork across departments.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to lift and move packages.

  • Comfortable standing, walking, or sitting for extended periods.

Who we are?

Karsten International develops a wide range of products for daily use, from the latest gadgets to sustainable beauty products. You name it, we make it. In addition to working hard and delivering quality, enjoyment and collegiality are our top priorities. The team consists of driven product developers, sales experts, logistics talents, online marketing specialists and graphic designers. Thanks to a broad international network and more than ten years of experience, we are winning the hearts of consumers all over the world with our products. You will be given every opportunity to contribute to this.

What you can expect from us:

At Karsten International you will join a supportive, ambitious team where we work hard, stay sharp, and enjoy what we do. We are growing fast, so there’s plenty of room to share ideas, take ownership, and really make an impact. We communicate openly, help each other out, and keep things direct but respectful.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of space for personal growth, ownership and continuous improvement

  • Excellent pension scheme

  • Travel allowance or OV card, 13th month & 8% holiday pay

  • Daily fresh lunch, fruit, and great coffee

  • Bootcamp, yoga, football team

  • Option to lease a bike

  • OpenUp for mental well-being + massage at the office

  • Discounts on great products & fun company outings

  • Easily accessible office in Amsterdam

  • Support with HSM visa and 30% ruling (if applicable)

Our core values (woven into how we work together):

  • Efficient & cost-conscious: We manage time and resources smartly, think critically and value what’s already in place.

  • Ambitious with long-term focus: We take ownership, build lasting relationships and stay humble in our success.

  • Striving for the best: We measure, learn, improve—and challenge each other to exceed expectations.

  • Direct & respectful: We communicate openly and treat everyone with respect, regardless of background.

  • We like to have fun: We enjoy what we do and create a positive, energetic work environment.

title: Accessibility Consultant
description:
Career Fulfillment & Culture

People come to work for Deque because of what we do: enable businesses and organizations to make their sites and apps accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. The personal fulfillment employees feel here is unparalleled. In addition to the altruistic nature of our jobs, the organizational structure is extremely flat and welcoming. Women-owned and operated, Deque CEO Preety Kumar is internationally revered for her down-to-earth personality and work ethic. Deque's core values are central to our culture of customer satisfaction. Do you share them?
  • Innovation with results that matter
  • Deliver what you promise
  • Can-do attitude
  • Open, direct & respectful communications
  • We care deeply
  • We practice humility
At Deque, you’ll work with the best and brightest minds in the industry, sharing best practices, tackling new issues and uncovering new approaches. Accessibility Consultants at Deque also love their jobs because of the support systems in place.
Deque experts regularly contribute to W3C Accessibility Working Groups and collectively hold more CPACC, WAS, & CPWA certifications issued by the IAAP than any accessibility testing company in the world.

Position Description

Deque is seeking an Accessibility Consultant that will provide robust WCAG 2.0/2.1 A/AA accessibility testing, design reviews, and consulting to customers. The person in this position will work directly with customers and a Deque team to deliver high-value digital accessibility services to our customers. They will help customers find and fix accessibility issues. A strong candidate for this role will be proactive, a life-long learner, and have a track record of delivering exceptional service, is passionate about digital accessibility, and has a desire to learn and grow in the field.

Primary Responsibilities

title: Director of Franchise - EAME (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important\: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Your Role

The Director of Franchise EAME acts as the primary liaison between Hyatt Hotels Corporation and franchise owners and third-party management operators. In this highly collaborative role, you will help drive accountability and performance across an assigned portfolio, with a focus on market share, brand health, commercial performance, core metrics, and the successful delivery of Hyatt brand initiatives.

You will build trusted relationships with owners and operators while partnering closely with colleagues across Development, Brand, Commercial Services, Finance, Legal, IT, Food & Beverage, Purchasing, Facilities, and other teams. Through these partnerships, you will help address owner and operator needs, strengthen alignment with Hyatt, and support hotels in operating efficiently and successfully.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead performance reviews with owners and operators, creating a clear understanding of Hyatt’s Core Metric performance expectations and driving accountability against them.

  • Engage owners and operators in meaningful performance conversations, providing recommendations and guidance to help optimize hotel results.

  • Support and enforce Hyatt accountability programs, including the Focused Improvement Policy, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliant Program, Quality Assurance audits, and renovation policy.

  • Strategically support the delivery of Hyatt brand initiatives, ensuring owners and operators understand expectations, timelines, and implementation requirements.

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders while developing a deep understanding of Hyatt’s business strategies, processes, and systems.

  • Coordinate solutions to owner and management company needs by partnering across Development, Product and Brand Design, Marketing, Purchasing, IT, Finance, Legal, Food & Beverage, Brand Support, Facilities, and other relevant teams.

  • Support Commercial Services guidance across Sales, Revenue Management, and Marketing to help grow hotel top-line revenue and increase Hyatt fee potential.

  • Monitor market share and brand health across the assigned owner/operator portfolio, identifying and escalating performance concerns as appropriate.

  • Represent Hyatt’s franchise performance priorities with owners and operators in a way that builds trust, reinforces accountability, and strengthens long-term alignment with Hyatt and its brands.

title: Data Engineering - Global Banking and Markets -Warsaw-Vice President
description:
Data Engineering - Global Banking and Markets -Warsaw-Vice President

Job Description

Data Governance at Goldman Sachs is being reinvented.

This is a chance to define and build the next generation of Data Governance infrastructure for Global Banking & Markets. Our team owns the Data Governance strategy across a truly global platform spanning New York, London, Warsaw, Bengaluru, Singapore, Dallas, and Hyderabad, supporting regulators, data consumers, and business stakeholders around the world.

This is not a traditional governance technology role. We are not treating governance as a bolt-on control layer, a manual parallel process, or an afterthought audit trail. We are embedding governance intelligence directly into platform and product design from day one: governance by design, not governance by exception.

As part of the firmwide One GS 3.0 transformation, we are modernizing to cloud-native architecture and building an AI-first data governance capability where engineering, controls, and business workflows converge. The mission is bold: automate operational toil, interpret an ever-changing legal and regulatory landscape, detect issues before they surface, and create proactive monitoring that scales with global market complexity.

We are looking for disruptors, builders, and systems thinkers who want to reimagine what data governance can be: an integrated, automated, self-improving, evergreen solution where governance enables data-driven transformation rather than restricting it.

How will you fulfil your potential?

  • Build secure, high-quality, maintainable systems with technology and strategy teams using approved tools and modern engineering practices.
  • Partner with global technology and business teams to deliver regulatory obligations as integrated platform capabilities.
  • Design AI-enabled workflows that automate exception handling, reduce manual reconciliation, and improve control transparency.
  • Embed intelligence directly into the systems themselves so they can detect anomalies, route exceptions, explain decisions, and support proactive monitoring.
  • Build AI-powered governance capabilities that continuously interpret global regulatory requirements, internal standards, and policy updates for evergreen compliance coverage.
  • Engineer governance-by-design controls into data pipelines and data products, including policy-aware lineage, ownership, and quality enforcement.
  • Help move the team from reactive compliance to regulatory-by-design engineering.
  • Track key performance metrics to measure control effectiveness, operational efficiency, and transformation outcomes.
  • Learn from and contribute to engineers building the next generation of cloud and AI systems for markets infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discussions, architecture, design, development, and testing for strategic regulatory engineering initiatives.
  • Define and enforce engineering best practices across the delivery lifecycle.
  • Guide teams in building reliable, scalable, secure, and auditable systems.
  • Drive the shift toward AI-first, embedded, and explainable regulatory platforms.
  • Help create systems that make regulatory outcomes faster, smarter, and more transparent.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience designing and implementing real-time distributed processing systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Proven expertise in large-scale migrations from on-premises legacy systems to cloud-based Lakehouse environments, preferably AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, managed services, and containerization such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience building secure, highly available, scalable systems in large enterprise environments.
  • Proficiency in Python, C++, or Java.
  • Experience developing, testing, and maintaining production-grade code.
  • Experience building AI-first applications and interfaces with generative features, streaming LLM responses, and Model Context Protocol integrations.
  • Practical experience using AI/ML to drive operational automation, transparency, anomaly detection, and proactive monitoring.

Relevant

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and Snowflake in enterprise Lakehouse patterns, including governed data product development and operationalized controls.
  • Practical experience designing interconnected graph ecosystems for advanced data asset governance, including lineage intelligence, ownership relationships, and policy propagation.
  • Experience with near real-time transactional systems and NoSQL/event platforms such as Kafka and Elasticsearch.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience as an Engineering Manager or Senior Technical Lead, ideally in cloud-native development or platform engineering.
  • Experience designing multi-agent systems using frameworks with governed orchestration logic.
  • Strong product mindset and the ability to redefine how regulatory outcomes are delivered at scale.

title: USCG MPC Developer

description:
Position Summary: LMR is seeking a Technical Writer to develop Maintenance Procedure Cards (MPC). The ideal candidate will utilize their USCG or US Navy practical engineering experience and technical writing skills to develop Maintenance Procedure Cards (MPCs) for Coast Guard’s Asset Project Office (APO). The purpose of this work is to provide detailed and technically correct MPCs for the Hull, Machinery and electrical (HM&E) equipment on floating Coast Guard assets from Small Boats to Icebreakers in accordance with USCG procedures, processes, and specifications.


Location: Remote in the United States.


Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Author MPCs to include, drafting, updating, reviewing, correcting and quality control reviews in accordance with the Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Development Process Guide CGTO PG‐85‐00‐230‐S by performing the following tasks:
  • Review Maintenance requirements generated by the Reliability Centered Maintenance process and generate new MPCs identified on the approved Maintenance Requirement List (MRL).
  • Develop detailed maintenance procedures for required preventive and corrective maintenance tasks.
  • Identify required tools, consumables, expendables, and appropriate cautions and warnings
  • Research various systems for technical and supply data; provide technical recommendations for Technical Publication updates. Translate Original Equipment Manufacturers’ (OEMS) recommended maintenance procedure into Coast Guard format.
  • Review drawings for accuracy; provide technical recommendations for drawing/photo updates.
  • May be required to perform ship visits to validate technical information for inclusion in MPCs or to validate MPCs before publication.
  • Format technical information to align with the approved process and develop clear procedures to conduct required maintenance.
  • Implement changes required in response to field generated maintenance feedback reports
  • Conduct data calls to the fleet.


Minimum Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Five years’ experience with relevant naval engineering maintenance procedure development or accomplishing maintenance for the Coast Guard (MPC Development experience preferred.)
  • Possess a working knowledge of varying Coast Guard processes, principles, and tools. These include databases used to review, maintain, and update cutter maintenance records.
  • Possess a working knowledge of all standard office equipment (phones, computers, scanners, fax machines, etc.) as well as Microsoft Office applications.
  • Be able to work in a team environment collaborating with others to solve problems, address issues, and develop innovative solutions often working with a geographically dispersed team.
  • Be able to clearly speak, read, and write in American English using proper grammar and punctuation.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.


Education: High School Diploma (AA degree preferred)


Certifications Desired: RCM level II preferred, Secret Clearance Preferred

title: Data Technician I
description:
Job Description

SUMMARY: Installs and operates electronic flow monitors, smoking equipment and remote TV camera system to conduct tests and video inside sewer lines to compile reports used to determine need for sewer repairs. Enters data gathered into computer, formulates reports and/or makes graphs. Uses computer programs, GPS, GIS, and Granite. Performs related duties as required. Employee will be required to perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Helps locate line sections to be videoed. Determines setup and confined space procedures.
  • Assists in setting up cable stands over manholes. Floats rope used to pull camera to adjacent manhole to thread through sewer lines.
  • Attaches pulling cable to camera in sewer line and to turn cable stand handles that enables camera to move inside the pipe. Videos at intervals using judgment until camera reaches downstream manhole.
  • Detaches camera from cable, rewinds cable into reel and disassembles equipment.
  • Confers with supervisor to discuss condition of sewer lines as shown in videos. Drives truck to haul crew and equipment. Occasionally services, adjusts, and makes minor repairs to camera, equipment and attachments.
  • Communicates with supervisor verbally and in writing. Coordinates with the Engineering Staff on aspects of the video product.
  • During absence of supervisor, gives direction to workers in efficient and safe use of camera and equipment, work methods and safety precautions. Prepares daily reports listing lines photographed.
  • Installs flow monitoring devices in manholes to determine if excessive flow exists as an indication of needed sewer repairs.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBLITIES:

During absence of supervisors directly supervises one employee of the data collection team.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must be able to obtain Fort Benning Access required.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

High school graduate of GED is the minimum requirement for position. Specialized training in relation to electronic and computer based equipment and software. One year experience working in a wastewater collection system which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities. Possession of a valid Drivers License and a clean driving record is required. A NASSCO Pipeline Assessment Certification is preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions for electronic systems and procedures. Ability to write routine reports, correspondence and record keeping. Ability to read blue prints.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to draw and read all graphs types.

REASONING ABILITY:

Ability to apply commonsense to carryout instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram form. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representatives of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or equipment; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear, and smell. The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb and balance.

The employee frequently lifts and moves objects of 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristic described here are representative of those the employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Employee will be regularly exposed to moderate or high noise levels, extreme outside weather conditions, uneven, steep, slippery terrain conditions, dusty conditions, and wet and/or humid conditions.

• The employee will be exposed to moving mechanical parts and heavy equipment operation.

• Employees will be subject to roadway hazards, i.e., traffic.

• Employee will be subject to outside hazards, i.e., poison ivy, bees, spiders, dirt, and animals.

• Employee will be subject to confined areas, i.e., confined spaces, sewer manholes, water vaults, wastewater pits, and/or protected trenches, fumes, gases, and airborne particles.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About Element34
Element34 is building modern enterprise solutions for software quality and test automation. Our
flagship product, SBOX, helps enterprises run their Selenium, Playwright and Appium tests
securely within their own infrastructure, behind their firewall and within their security and
compliance boundaries.


We are part of Banyan Software, a long-term owner of profitable vertical software businesses.
Element34 operates with a lean engineering organization, giving engineers the opportunity to
work closely with product, customers and leadership and see the direct impact of their work.

About SBOX
SBOX is an enterprise test automation platform that enables organizations to run browser and
mobile automation at scale within their own environment.
The platform supports Selenium, Playwright and Appium and includes capabilities around test
execution, browser/device management, reporting, integrations and AI-powered quality
capabilities.
We are continuing to evolve SBOX into a more AI-native quality engineering platform, making
reliability, automation intelligence and actionable quality insights an important part of the
product.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a SDET / Quality Engineer who wants to play a key role in building the next
generation of quality engineering for SBOX.
As our product and engineering velocity grow, we want to make quality an integral part of how we
build and release software — not something that happens only at the end of the development
cycle.
You will help us build stronger automation, improve regression confidence, identify quality risks
earlier and create better ways of understanding and resolving failures.
This is a high-ownership engineering role. You will have the freedom to identify opportunities,
propose solutions and take them from idea to implementation.
You won't just be executing predefined test cases — you'll help shape how quality engineering
works at SBOX.

What You'll Work On
Automation & Quality Engineering
● Design, build and maintain robust automation for critical SBOX workflows.
● Develop automation using Playwright, Appium and Selenium.
● Translate product requirements, user stories and customer workflows into meaningful
automated scenarios.
● Build reusable automation components and frameworks that scale with the product.
● Continuously improve regression coverage and test reliability.
Test Execution & Failure Analysis
● Build and maintain automated workflows that run reliably in CI and unattended
environments.
● Work with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or equivalent.
● Analyze test results and investigate failures across application, automation, infrastructure
and environment.
● Debug failures deeply and drive them through to resolution.
● Identify and eliminate flaky tests and recurring sources of instability.
Quality Strategy
● Partner with engineers and product managers early in the development lifecycle.
● Help define the right testing strategy for new features and major product initiatives.
● Identify edge cases, integration risks and potential regression areas.
● Contribute to release-readiness decisions using meaningful quality signals.
● Continuously improve our automation architecture, testing practices and tooling.
Test Management & Defect Management
● Create and maintain test cases, workflows and regression suites.
● Track execution progress and manage defects through their lifecycle.
● Participate in defect triaging and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams.
● Improve visibility into automation health, product quality and release confidence.

What We're Looking For
Must Have
● Strong experience in SDET, QA Automation or Quality Engineering.
● Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and Appium
● Experience with Real-device/mobile testing
● Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or another programming
language.
● Hands-on experience with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or
equivalent.
● Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks.
● Experience converting requirements and user stories into automated test scenarios.
● Experience running automation in unattended/CI environments.
● Strong debugging, problem-solving and failure-analysis skills.
● Experience with test management, defect tracking and triaging.
● Experience working in a startup, scale-up or lean engineering environment.
● Strong sense of ownership and ability to execute independently.
● Experience with AI testing and quality engineering, AI-assisted coding tools
Nice to Have
● API testing and automation
● Accessibility testing
● Visual regression testing
● Performance/load testing
● Docker and Kubernetes
● CI/CD platforms
● Enterprise software and security-focused environments
How We Work
We are a small, experienced and highly collaborative engineering team. Our size gives every
engineer the opportunity to have a meaningful impact.
We value:
● Ownership — Take a problem from understanding through implementation and outcomes.
● Initiative — We appreciate people who identify opportunities and proactively make things
better.
● Independent execution — You will have autonomy to decide how to solve problems while
having support when you need it.
● Engineering excellence — We care about building maintainable solutions, not just getting
a test to pass once.
● Speed and pragmatism — We move quickly, learn quickly and continuously improve.
Because we operate with a lean structure, you will have broad ownership and visibility into your
work. You won't be limited to a narrowly defined QA function — you'll collaborate across
Engineering and Product and have the opportunity to influence how we build quality into SBOX.

Recruitment Notice

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

Protect yourself by following these steps:

  • Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
  • Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
  • If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Production Program Manager
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Voyager team in Anduril Industries is an engineering and design division with a vast experience in developing innovative computing and communications solutions for the network edge. The team specializes in integrating enterprise networking capabilities from global IT leaders with purpose-built hardware and software platforms designed to meet market demands for the most stringent of environmental requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Voyager production team deliver products to third party customers, and to other Anduril business lines. We are looking for a Production Program Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will drive the operational cadence of our production business - building execution plans, analysing production data, and maintaining the dashboards that keep stakeholders aligned. You will act as a cross-functional liaison, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and proactively unblocking bottlenecks before they impact delivery. This requires strong analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency, ERP experience, and a willingness to leverage AI tooling to work more effectively.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Operational Execution & Planning

  • Works with the Production Manager to manage the operational cadence: Manage and execute the "routine rhythms" of the production business, ensuring key meetings, reporting cycles, and deliverables are completed on time.
  • Works with cross functional teams (Supply Chain, Quality, NPI, Logistics. Production Engineers) to gather/collate/report production schedule requirements.
  • Create plans that translate high-level business objectives into concrete, structured execution objectives for the production team.
  • Aggregates and analyses data - gathers, cleans, and synthesizes complex operational and production data from various sources to provide a clear picture of performance and bottlenecks.
  • Builds and maintains spreadsheets, dashboards, and financial/operational models to track KPIs and support decision-making.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Acts as a cross-functional team liaison point – connects and proactively works with key stakeholders, including manager, DivOps, the 1P team, VP, and the production floor.
  • Translates complex data and production updates into concise, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Drives alignment by facilitating communication across teams to resolve dependencies and ensure everyone is aligned on production priorities.

Problem Solving & AI-Leverage

  • Rapid Problem Identification: Proactively monitor operations to identify bottlenecks, risks, and inefficiencies before they impact production.
  • High-Speed Execution: Act as a high-bandwidth generalist who can rapidly unblock issues and implement solutions with a strong bias for action.
  • Leverage Modern Tooling (Claude/AI): Integrate AI assistants (like Claude) into daily workflows to draft communications, synthesize data, and accelerate problem-solving.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4–8 years of experience in operations, consulting, program management, or a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Oracle and/or SAP or similar transferable skills
  • High level of business acumen
  • Knowledge of hardware production environment with high value components and BOM’s
  • Highly adaptable; comfortable stepping into ambiguous situations and creating order out of chaos.
  • Advanced Excel skills are a must. Experience leveraging LLMs (like Claude) to optimise work output is highly valued.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MSc in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Data Analytics

title: AR & Collections Specialist
description:
About the Role

Taher is seeking a hands-on Senior Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist to take full ownership of the collections process and help strengthen cash flow. This individual will be responsible for reducing past-due receivables, developing effective collection strategies, resolving customer account issues, improving processes, and providing clear visibility into collection risks and expected cash receipts.

The ideal candidate combines persistence and sound judgment with a professional, relationship-focused approach. This person will work directly with customers and internal teams, lead improvements within the accounts receivable function, and support general accounting and month-end activities related to accounts receivable.

Key Responsibilities

Collections Strategy and Customer Account Ownership

  • Take full ownership of the collections process across assigned customer accounts.
  • Develop and execute collection strategies to reduce aging, improve cash flow, and support timely payment.
  • Analyze aging trends, customer payment patterns, disputes, and collection risks; recommend appropriate actions.
  • Proactively contact customers regarding past-due balances, payment status, invoice disputes, and promised payment dates.
  • Build positive customer relationships while maintaining consistent, professional, and effective collection follow-up.
  • Research and resolve payment delays, deductions, billing disputes, and account discrepancies.
  • Negotiate payment arrangements when appropriate and escalate significant collection risks to Finance leadership.
  • Maintain complete and accurate collection notes, commitments, follow-up dates, and supporting documentation.
  • Provide clear reporting on collection status, high-risk accounts, disputes, expected receipts, and actions required.
  • Drive measurable reduction of past-due receivables and strengthen accountability for customer follow-up.

Billing and Accounts Receivable

  • Ensure customer invoices and billing statements are accurate, timely, and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Apply customer payments accurately and research unapplied or misapplied cash.
  • Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing and payment discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare and enhance accounts receivable aging, collections, cash application, and cash forecast reporting.
  • Partner with Operations, Accounting, and other departments to resolve customer and billing issues.

Process Improvement, Automation, and Systems

  • Lead process improvement initiatives within collections and accounts receivable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve reporting, and strengthen follow-up workflows.
  • Develop and document clear, repeatable standard operating procedures.
  • Use approved technology and AI tools to improve account research, reporting, productivity, and customer follow-up.
  • Support ERP, reporting, and financial system enhancements affecting accounts receivable.
  • Help strengthen internal controls, data accuracy, and accountability across the accounts receivable process.

General Accounting and Month-End Support

  • Prepare accounts receivable reconciliations, supporting schedules, and related journal entries.
  • Analyze general ledger activity related to accounts receivable and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assist with month-end close, financial reporting, and audit requests related to accounts receivable.
  • Collaborate with the accounting team on broader process improvements and finance initiatives.

About Taher

Taher is a family-owned, chef-driven food service management company operating in 27 states. We partner with schools, healthcare facilities, senior living communities, corporate dining programs, and other organizations to deliver high-quality food service experiences. Our continued growth is supported by strong customer relationships, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the business.

title: Directiesecretaresse
description:
Welke uitdaging ga je aan?

Ben jij iemand die graag regelt, organiseert en ervoor zorgt dat alles achter de schermen goed loopt? Krijg je energie van een dynamische werkomgeving en houd je makkelijk overzicht, ook als er veel tegelijk speelt? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Voor de directie van de regio Zuid-Holland Noord West zoeken wij vanaf januari een directiesecretaresse. Samen met een collega ondersteun je twee directeuren in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je beheert complexe agenda's, houdt overzicht, denkt vooruit en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken en processen soepel verlopen. Dankzij jouw ondersteuning kunnen de directeuren zich richten op hun belangrijkste werkzaamheden.

Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar geen dag hetzelfde is. Je werkt nauw samen met een ervaren collega-directiesecretaresse die je wegwijs maakt binnen de organisatie. Tegelijkertijd krijg je ruimte om je functie op jouw manier vorm te geven, mee te denken over verbeteringen en initiatief te nemen wanneer je kansen ziet.

Jouw werkzaamheden

Als directiesecretaresse ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen de directie, collega's en interne stakeholders. Je ondersteunt op secretarieel, organisatorisch en administratief gebied en zorgt ervoor dat processen soepel verlopen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Beheren van complexe agenda's, mailboxen en correspondentie en bewaken van de voortgang van afspraken en acties.

  • Organiseren van en ondersteunen bij overleggen, bijeenkomsten en managementdagen, van voorbereiding tot opvolging.

  • Ondersteunen bij projecten, beheren van documentatie en bijdragen aan een duidelijke interne communicatie.

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en actief meedenken over slimme en efficiënte werkprocessen.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een professionele en proactieve directiesecretaresse die overzicht houdt, ook wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je weet hoofd- en bijzaken van elkaar te onderscheiden, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en gesprekspartners. Daarbij ben je communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief en voel je goed aan wat er nodig is.

Je bent een echte verbinder die prettig samenwerkt met collega's op alle niveaus van de organisatie. Dankzij jouw natuurlijke overwicht, daadkracht en enthousiasme weet je mensen in beweging te krijgen en processen soepel te laten verlopen. Daarnaast werk je nauwkeurig, denk je vooruit en durf je initiatief te nemen wanneer je kansen voor verbetering ziet.

Verder beschik je over:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau en je hebt een afgeronde secretaresseopleiding;

  • 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een soort gelijke functie;

  • Geavanceerde kennis van MS 365/ Office/Teams.

Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt voor de directeur algemene zaken en de directeur behandelzaken. De directie stuurt de managementteams aan. Als directiesecretaresse maak je onderdeel uit van het team Je standplaats is Leiden. Je komt te werken in een dynamische werkomgeving waarin we zijn gestart met Rivierduinen Verleggen. Binnen deze ontwikkeling bundelen we onze krachten en brengen we o.a. poliklinische zorg, FACT-zorg en ouderenpsychiatrie samen in “Dichtbijteams”. Daarnaast heeft dit directiekoppel Eetstoornissen Ursula en het MBT-team in hun portefeuille.

Wat krijg je van GGZ Rivierduinen?

Naast dat je in een dynamische omgeving komt te werken bieden we je uiteraard een goed pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. Zo krijg je van ons:

  • Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur (afhankelijk van je wensen), waarbij er een optie tot verlenging naar een vast contract is;

  • Gedeeltelijk thuiswerken behoort tot de mogelijkheden. Alsook flexibele werktijden.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3.180,- en €4.273,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (FWG 45 conform CAO GGZ);

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris;

  • 8.33% vakantietoeslag, 166 vakantie-uren en 35 LFB-uren per jaar (bij een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Reis- en onkostenvergoeding;

  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;

  • Meerkeuze systeem arbeidsvoorwaarden (bijvoorbeeld voor de aankoop van een elektrische fiets of het kopen van extra verlofdagen);

  • Keuze uit twee aantrekkelijke collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Jaarlijks een balansbudget van maximaal €1000,-, om te zetten naar extra verlofuren of uit te betalen als brutoloon; Indien ingezet voor opleiding, bedraagt het €1.400 op voltijdsbasis.

  • Opleiding en ontwikkeling via onze Rivierduinen Academie waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt tot het volgen van zorginhoudelijke scholingsprogramma's voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Michelle Mutschelknauss (Directeur algemene zaken) via m.mutschelknauss@rivierduinen.nl.

Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie over de procedure? Neem gerust contact op met Marique Huyben, recruiter via 06 83190174 of stuur een mail naar m.huyben@rivierduinen.nl

Goed om te weten; onze sollicitatieprocedure omvat een referentiecheck en bij indiensttreding vragen we om een verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG).

GGZ Rivierduinen

GGZ Rivierduinen biedt geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) aan mensen van alle leeftijden met ernstige psychische klachten en hun naasten. Onze 2.100 collega’s helpen zo’n 15.000 cliënten in de regio’s Alphen aan den Rijn, Duin- en Bollenstreek, Gouda, Leiden, Leidschendam en Zoetermeer. We hebben onder andere ambulante zorg, acute zorg, klinieken, verblijfsafdelingen, dagbesteding en een specialistische afdeling voor eetstoornissen.

Onze bevlogen medewerkers zijn het kloppende hart van Rivierduinen. Daarom geven we je de ruimte om werk te doen dat bij je past. Wil je doorgroeien? Met opleidingen en onderzoek neem je zelf de regie over je ontwikkeling. Jouw vakkennis is onmisbaar in de samenwerking met cliënten, hun naasten, collega’s en ketenpartners. Zo maak jij het verschil!

title: Product Transfer
description:

The Palletizer plays a crucial role in maintaining accurate records, ensuring the integrity of palletized products, and contributing to the overall efficiency of warehouse and production operations.

  1. Inventory Scanning:
  • Scan finished goods into the inventory management system (E21) accurately to update real-time stock levels.
  • Scan boxes and other materials in and out of E21, ensuring precise documentation of warehouse movements.
  1. Adherence to Safety Protocols:
  • Follow established safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a secure working environment.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY:
