title: Test Technician
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com.


Job Summary:

  • We are seeking a highly motivated Sample Test Technician to join SiTime’s New Product Introduction (NPI) team. This role offers a unique opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers at the forefront of semiconductor reliability, validation, and manufacturing.
  • As a Sample Test Technician at SiTime, you will play a critical role in ensuring the world‑class quality and performance of our timing solutions through rigorous device testing, validation, and hardware development activities.
  • This position focuses on testing, trim, and burn‑in of devices to support sample orders and evaluation boards. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, including NPI, Test Engineering, System Engineering, and Customer Engineering, to support SiTime products across package, test, and reliability environments, ensuring all solutions meet stringent industry and customer requirements.
  • Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet all listed qualifications. We value motivation, learning ability, and hands‑on aptitude as much as direct experience.


Responsibilities:

  • Execute device testing using Orpheus, ATE, Saunders, and Exatron handlers in accordance with defined Product Flow requirements.
  • Perform and document data collection and analysis related to product performance, yield, and Test Travelers to support validation and release decisions.
  • Manage coordination with scheduled shipments for all sample orders, ensuring on‑time execution and on‑time delivery to internal and external customers.
  • Support test program validation in collaboration with the Test Engineering team, and assist in validating SiTime products across package, test, and reliability stages.
  • Provide feedback and solutions for tester performance issues involving Teradyne ATE system, Exatron handler systems, and Orpheus and Saunders test systems.


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education: Associate or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field is required.
  • Hardware Skills: Familiarity with hand-test environments and Hardware Setup on ATE system.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of lab safety compliance and industry standards for semiconductor reliability and qualification.
  • Software Proficiency: Proficiency in data analysis and statistical tools is a plus.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Good written and verbal communication skills required.
  • Willing to learn different skills and test methodologies.
  • Self-motivated and desire to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work well with others in a collaborative team environment


Compensation Range:


At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.


The annual base hourly salary range for this role is $21.00 – $40.00. The final offer is determined by factors such as location, experience, education, and training.


In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

Benefits offered: 401k plan, health and wellness that includes medical, dental, vision, life, parental leave, legal services, and time off plans.


SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program.

title: Service Desk Team Lead
description:
Salary: $4,000 – $4,200 per month

The Service Desk Team Lead oversees the day-to-day operations of the service desk, ensuring timely and effective resolution of IT support requests, incidents, and service requests. This role combines hands-on technical support leadership with team management, process improvement, and stakeholder communication.


Responsibilities as a Team Lead:


Team Leadership & People Management

· Supervise, mentor and develop a team of service desk agents.

· Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions and skills development planning.

· Manage staff schedules (duty roster), shift coverage and workload distribution.

· Handle escalations related to team performance or conduct.

· Support recruitment, onboarding and training of new team members.


Service Delivery & Operations

· Ensure adherence to SLAs (response time, resolution time, first-call resolution).

· Monitor ticket queues and reassign/ prioritize work as needed.

· Act as the escalation point for complex or high-priority incidents.

· Ensure proper ticket documentation, categorization, and closure standards.

· Oversee incident, problem, and request management processes (typically aligned to ITIL).

· Monitor daily performance of wireless and network infrastructure under managed service contracts.

· Ensure all permits to work are in force.

· Work with respective departments to carry out level 1 & 2 resolutions on time.

Process Improvement

· Identify recurring issues and drive root-cause analysis with relevant teams.

· Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides.

· Recommend and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and customer satisfaction.

· Evaluate and improve ticketing tools, workflows, and automation opportunities.

Reporting & Metrics

· Attend Operations Meeting.

· Track and prepare maintenance contracts.

· Analyse trends to proactively address capacity or quality issues

· Escalation to Operations Manager on issues which need further attention.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

· Ability to diagnose and resolve basic technical issues.

· Proficiency in English.

· Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Ruokapalveluvastaava, Kontulan ala-aste
description:
Etsitkö työtä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään rautaista keittiö- ja asiakaspalveluosaamistasi? Hallitsetko sujuvasti niin suunnittelun kuin käytännönkin työn keittiössä? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö! Haemme ruokapalveluvastaavaa huolehtimaan Kontulan ala-asteen keittiön päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta.

Ruokapalveluvastaavana toimit osana Palvelukeskus Helsingin monipalvelut-yksikköä, jonka henkilöstö tuottaa ruoka- ja puhtauspalveluita kaupungin eri yksiköissä. Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet koulun keittiössä varmistaen keittiön toiminnan sujuvuuden ja laadun. Osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä huolehdit päivittäisen kouluruoan tarjoamisesta sadoille asiakkaille!

Kontulan ala-aste on monitoimitalo, jossa toimii ala-asteen lisäksi myös päiväkoti. Kohteessa ruokailee päivittäin 500 ala-asteikäistä oppilasta, 230 päiväkotilasta, 70 iltapäiväkerholaista sekä henkilökuntaa noin 60 henkeä. Kohde toimii valmistuskeittiönä, jossa valmistamme asiakkaillemme maittavat aamupalat, lounaat sekä välipalat. Saat ympärillesi osaavan tiimin, jossa työskentelee lisäksesi kokki ja ruokapalvelutyöntekijöitä.

Mitä pääset meillä tekemään?

Ruokapalveluvastaavana pääset loistamaan keittiö- ja asiakaspalvelutehtävissä. Tehtävässä toimit 4-5 hengen tiimisi esihenkilönä vastaten perehdytyksestä, työtehtävien jakamisesta sekä keittiön kokonaisvaltaisesta toiminnasta. Suunnittelet ja toteutat päivittäistä toimintaa itsenäisesti ja innovatiivisesti, huolehtien samalla ruokapalveluiden sujuvuudesta. Tehtäviisi kuuluu aterioiden ja lisukkeiden valmistus, ruokien esillepano, astiahuolto sekä keittiön yleisestä siisteydestä huolehtiminen. Hoidat myös tilausten tekemisen, laskutuksen, taloudellisten tavoitteiden seurannan ja laadunvalvonnan. Koska kohtaat työssäsi päivittäin paljon ihmisiä, odotamme sinun lähestyvän jokaista asiakasta ammattimaisesti, suurella hymyllä.

Näillä edellytyksillä menestyt tehtävässä:
Sinulla on soveltuva koulutus tai vastaavaa työkokemusta.
Olet suorittanut hygieniapassin.
Olet taitava organisoija ja kykenet toimimaan hektisessä ympäristössä.
Hallitset sujuvasti suomen kielen, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.
Olet positiivinen esimerkki ja tiimipelaaja.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työpaikan, jossa työaikasi on säännöllinen ja ennakoitava, arkisin klo 7-16.30 välillä.

Tarjoamme Suomen suurimman työnantajan vakauden lisäksi kattavat edut hyvinvointisi tueksi, kuten runsaat lomaedut (jopa 38 arkipäivää), kokemuslisät (5 vuoden kokemuksella 3 % ja 10 vuoden kokemuksella 8 %), kaupunkipyöräedun, ePassi Flex-edun, joka sisältää liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, työsuhdematkalippuedun sekä hyvinvointiedun (maksimissaan 550 €/kalenterivuosi) ja lounasedun. Voit itse vaikuttaa ansioihisi erilaisilla palkkioilla, minkä lisäksi kaupungin työntekijöillä on etusija Auroranlinnan asuntoihin. Panostamme myös henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämiseen tarjoamalla erilaisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Miten rekrytointiprosessi etenee?

Mikäli koet, että tämä paikka voisi olla juuri sinua varten, jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Ennen työn aloittamista valituksi tulleen henkilön tulee esittää hyväksytty työterveyshuollosta saatava työhöntulotarkastuslausunto ja rikosrekisteriote.

Kiinnostuitko? Odotamme jo innolla hakemustasi!

title: Delivery Excellence Leader
description:

title: Information Security & Data Privacy Engineer - SKF Automotive Business
description:
Career Opportunities: Information Security & Data Privacy Engineer - SKF Automotive Business (912)

By creating bearings and solutions for everything from industrial applications to vehicles, SKF plays an essential role in our everyday lives. In Q4 2026, SKF intends to spin off its Automotive business and list it as a separate company under the name of SKF Vertevo. A company created to support the future of the automotive market, and to co-drive the future of mobility faster. This role will be a part of that new company. Would you like to join us, and move people further?

Information Security & Data Privacy Engineer- SKF Automotive Business

As the Information Security & Data Privacy Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring security, privacy, and regulatory requirements are effectively embedded across SKF Automotive's technology landscape. Combining strong cybersecurity expertise with specialist knowledge of GDPR, personal data protection, and regulatory compliance, you will act as the bridge between Security, Legal, Procurement, Engineering, and Business teams. In this unique and specialised position, you will help ensure that IT, OT, Cloud, Data and AI solutions are designed, implemented, and operated in accordance with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. You will champion Secure by Design, Privacy by Design, and responsible data governance principles while enabling innovation and business growth.What you can expect in the role

  • Translate security, privacy, regulatory, and contractual requirements into practical technical and operational controls.
  • Lead security and privacy assessments, including DPIAs, PIAs, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Provide expert guidance on GDPR, PII processing, data retention, data minimisation, lawful processing, data subject rights, and records management.
  • Review and provide security and privacy input into Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Controller-to-Processor agreements, Controller-to-Controller agreements, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), and supplier contracts.
  • Assess data residency, data sovereignty, cross-border transfer, and third-party processing risks across cloud and SaaS environments.
  • Review solution architectures and technology implementations to ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Validate/audit technical safeguards including Identity and Access Management, Data Loss Prevention, encryption, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and information protection controls.
  • Conduct security and privacy due diligence of suppliers, technology partners, data processors, and cloud providers.
  • Support internal and external audits, certification activities, customer assessments, and regulatory enquiries.
  • Manage compliance gaps, remediation plans, security exceptions, and risk acceptance activities.
  • Support AI and data-driven initiatives by assessing data processing, privacy implications, information protection requirements, and compliance obligations.
  • Monitor emerging privacy, security, and AI regulations and ensure organisational policies and controls remain aligned.

You will enjoy working here if you have

  • Strong technical cybersecurity background with experience in security governance, compliance, architecture, or assurance.
  • Expert knowledge of GDPR, personal data processing, PII protection, controller and processor obligations, data sovereignty, and privacy regulations.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating DPAs, privacy clauses, and data-sharing agreements.
  • Deep understanding of security controls including IAM, DLP, encryption, cloud security, application security, and information protection.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 27701, TISAX, NIS2, and other relevant security and privacy frameworks.
  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory assessments, and compliance programmes.
  • Ability to assess AI workloads through established security, privacy, and data governance principles.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

If you want to go further This position is located at one of our major SKF sites in Poznań (Poland), Pune or Bangalore (India), Saint-Cyr (France), or Cajamar (Brazil). You will report to Malonie Guha, Chief Information Security Officer, who is located in Milton Keynes, United Kingdom. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Martin Andersson, Talent Acquisition Specialist, by email martin.n.andersson@skfvertevo.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email. Transparency and fairness matter to us At SKF, we see diversity in our workforce as an asset that supports better business results. We are committed to having a fair and inclusive recruitment process where all hiring decisions are based on objective, job-related criteria, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates. To support a fair and transparent recruitment process, the process may include assessments, and before hiring, we may also carry out background checks and verify application information. We will discuss your salary expectations during the first interview, and our final offer will be based on an objective evaluation of your experience, skills, and potential, aligned with the scope of the role and our internal salary guidelines. Our recruitment process may differ from country to country and will always be in line with applicable country-specific laws and regulations. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

title: Senior AWS DevOps Migration Engineer
description:
Role Objective / Success Criteria / KPI

  • Support enterprise AWS migrations in accordance with the agreed target architecture and migration strategy.
  • Design, implement and operate secure, scalable and reliable AWS platform services, migration tooling and deployment pipelines.
  • Deliver lift-and-shift, re-architecture, database and data migrations with controlled cutover and effective hypercare.
  • Improve platform governance, observability, automation and operational support using AWS and Infrastructure as Code technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess workloads and select appropriate migration approaches in line with the AWS 6 Rs framework.
  • Prepare target environments, install required software and execute migrations, cutovers and post-migration hypercare.
  • Support containerisation and re-architecture using Amazon EKS, Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Build infrastructure and application deployment pipelines using Terraform, GitHub, GitOps and AWS-native tools.
  • Migrate databases using AWS Database Migration Service and AWS Schema Conversion Tool.
  • Design data-transfer solutions using AWS DataSync, Storage Gateway and Amazon S3.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support for AWS platform services and core products.
  • Collaborate with platform architects, application teams and business stakeholders throughout delivery.

Tasks

  • Use AWS Application Migration Service where appropriate for lift-and-shift workloads.
  • Install migration agents, perform assessments, convert schemas, synchronise data and manage database cutovers.
  • Provision and manage cloud resources through Terraform, AWS CloudFormation and AWS Account Factory for Terraform.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across EC2, S3, EKS, RDS and other AWS platform services.
  • Configure IAM, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, Microsoft Entra ID integrations and AWS Network Firewall policies.
  • Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework and NIST cloud-security standards across platform and CI/CD solutions.
  • Set up monitoring, KPIs, alarms and alerts using Amazon CloudWatch and AWS Config, and support incident resolution and platform optimisation.
  • Provide AWS platform training and create onboarding guides, FAQs and operating procedures.
  • Migrated applications, databases and datasets aligned with the approved target architecture.
  • Secure and reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Configured AWS governance, identity, access-control and security policies.
  • Operational monitoring, alerts, support procedures and incident-resolution outputs.
  • Migration plans, cutover documentation, onboarding guides and knowledge-transfer material.

Decision Authority / Responsibility

  • Recommend appropriate AWS migration patterns, tooling and automation within the agreed architecture and strategy.
  • Own assigned migration and platform-engineering activities through assessment, build, testing, cutover and hypercare.
  • Apply governance, security, reliability and cost-management controls to AWS platform solutions.
  • Escalate material architecture, security, operational, cost or delivery risks to the appropriate stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Proven experience delivering large-scale cloud migrations using the AWS 6 Rs framework.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services and CI/CD pipeline development.
  • Experience with AWS Account Factory for Terraform, CloudFormation, Terraform, GitHub, GitOps and AWS Developer Tools.
  • Experience with AWS Systems Manager, Ansible and automated cloud operations.
  • Strong knowledge of IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies and NIST cloud-security standards.
  • Experience with AWS FinOps and observability tools, including Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports, AWS Glue, CloudWatch and AWS Config.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker and orchestration using Amazon EKS or comparable Kubernetes platforms.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication and stakeholder-management skills, including explaining technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Able to work effectively within international, Agile and cross-functional teams.
  • Successful completion of the required background verification before onboarding.

  • Standing, walking, bending, and reaching throughout the shift

  • Working around manufacturing equipment, varying temperatures, and industrial environments

title: Program Manager Intern (12 months) - FY27
description:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.

You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?


What’s in it for you?

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
You will collaborate with different internal stakeholders to learn how to improve a program’s offering and its benefits for our customers. This internship provides an opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, demonstrate project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.

You will work on one or several projects with your hiring team in tracking open actions, conduct deep dives, provide data insights, analyse processes to identify critical points and anticipate risks.

You will support the team in recommending and executing network improvements.

You will contribute with innovative long-term and lasting solutions beneficial for the entire team.

A day in the life
Every day is different as a Program Manager Intern. You'll work alongside your dedicated mentor and team on real improvement and innovation projects that support the growth of Amazon's European network. You might spend your morning analysing a large dataset to identify operational bottlenecks, then spend your afternoon aligning with stakeholders across different countries on a project rollout plan. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, track project milestones, and share updates with senior management.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve extracting insights from data to drive decisions. You'll develop solutions to real operational challenges, test different approaches, and present your findings to leadership — building your analytical, communication, and project management skills in a fast-paced, international environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.



Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.



Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.



Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.



Internship Start Dates across the year:

We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

title: Middle Full-Stack Software Engineer (React + .NET)
description:
What is the project, and why should you care?

Our client is a global customer strategy and insights company that helps leading brands better understand their customers and turn those insights into meaningful business decisions. Combining technology, research, data, and human-centered design, the company creates digital solutions that enable organizations to engage with customers, gather valuable feedback, and continuously improve their products and services.

The Development Team plays a key role in building, maintaining, and continuously improving these digital products and platforms. Working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside UX specialists, product experts, researchers, and data professionals, the team develops reliable, scalable, and intuitive solutions while tackling complex technical challenges.

We are currently looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer (React + .NET) to join the Development Team. In this role, you will work across both back-end and front-end development, contributing to existing applications as well as their ongoing modernization. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, participate in code reviews, and collaborate with colleagues across development, design, QA, and operations.

We are looking for an engineer who values clean, maintainable code, pragmatic problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, and who is comfortable working with both established systems and modern technologies.

You will be an excellent fit for this position if you have:

Required

  • 3+ years of .NET and application development experience.
  • Experience building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core, .NET Core / .NET MVC, and C#.
  • Familiarity with modern web development: HTML5, SCSS, TypeScript, React, and Redux.
  • Experience with Entity Framework.
  • Experience with source control systems (Git preferred).
  • Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD processes.
  • Familiarity with technical design, architecture, best practices, and patterns.
  • English proficiency at B2 level.
  • Experience working with AI technologies, including integrating AI features or tools into applications.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or Octopus.

Here are some of the things you'll be working on:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+).
  • Work effectively with legacy .NET applications, understanding existing architecture and identifying opportunities for incremental modernization.
  • Refactor and modernize legacy functionality without unnecessarily introducing risk to existing applications.
  • Understand the differences between traditional monolithic .NET architectures and modern distributed/cloud-based architectures.
  • Develop clean, maintainable, testable, and reusable code.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and microservice-based solutions using modern .NET technologies.
  • Understand API contracts, versioning, authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, and service-to-service communication.
  • Understand the principles and tradeoffs associated with monolithic versus microservice architectures.
  • Build services that can be independently developed, tested, deployed, and scaled where appropriate.
  • Understand asynchronous processing, messaging, and event-driven patterns.
  • Apply pragmatic architectural decisions based on business and technical requirements rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.

Data & Entity Framework

  • Strong working knowledge of Entity Framework Core (EF Core).
  • Develop and maintain data access layers using EF Core.
  • Understand Code First, database migrations, LINQ, relationships, transactions, and change tracking.
  • Diagnose and optimize database queries and application performance.
  • Experience working with SQL Server and relational database concepts.
  • Understand when direct SQL, stored procedures, or alternative data-access approaches may be more appropriate than ORM-based solutions.

Team & Delivery

  • Contribute as a team member to Agile projects and Scrum team workflows.
  • Develop and unit test web application features across back-end and front-end, including maintenance and support.
  • Support and collaborate with teams across design, development, quality assurance, and operations.

title: Senior Data DevOps Engineer Krakow · Full-Time · Remote Data
description:
Our client is one of the largest game studios known for their very successful MOBA and FPS franchises. You will be a member of the Data Operations team focused on modernizing the Analytics Platform and building the services, tooling, and infrastructure that support data ingestion, schema management, and reliable delivery of analytics data into Databricks.

As a core contributor, you will play a vital role in building dependable data solutions capable of processing petabytes of information. Your work will span backend services, schema and metadata tooling, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and production operations. You will help product teams and internal platform users adopt new data standards, migrate safely from legacy systems, and operate their services with improved reliability, observability, and efficiency.

You will bring your experience working with large-scale data systems and production infrastructure to help design and operate a modern data platform that is easier to evolve, safer to change, and better aligned with future data engineering needs.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate services and pipelines that power analytics data ingestion, schema management, and delivery into Databricks
  • Modernize legacy platform components by migrating services, libraries, and deployment workflows to modern Java and application standards
  • Build automation, CI/CD flows, and scenario/integration test coverage to make platform changes safe and repeatable
  • Design and maintain production infrastructure in AWS using Infrastructure as Code tooling such as Terraform
  • Improve data quality through stronger schema validation, metadata capture, lineage tracking, and operational guardrails
  • Build tooling and paved paths that help internal customers migrate to new ingestion and schema standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare design docs, rollout plans, and implementation strategies for platform changes
  • Monitor live systems, investigate incidents, and be part of the on-call team that provides 3rd line support to live analytics services
  • Support performance, reliability, and cost optimization across ingestion and processing flows

Required qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years commercial work experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related field
  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Coding skills, with commercial experience in one of the following languages - Java, Python, Golang
  • Knowledge in Infrastructure as Code tooling, e.g. Terraform
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling, e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker
  • Experience with streaming and schema-driven systems, e.g. Kafka, Protobuf, JSON Schema, or schema registries
  • Commercial experience with Airflow and DBT (Data Build Tool)
  • Commercial experience with Databricks
  • Commercial experience with Spark/PySpark
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills

Nice to have

  • Experience migrating legacy services or frameworks to modern application stacks
  • Experience with Databricks Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog
  • Experience with AWS, especially Kafka/MSK-based data flows, S3, IAM and VPC/networking.
  • Experience with Buf, Protobuf tooling, or JSON-to-Protobuf migration work
  • Familiarity with Golang for internal tooling or automation
  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring and on-call practices using tools like Datadog and PagerDuty
  • Experience working with cross-discipline organizations that build data products
  • Experience in the gaming industry, particularly with online multiplayer games
  • Proficient in large-scale data manipulation across various data types
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and optimize complex ETL pipelines

title: Senior Consultant – Investor and Sustainability Communications
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:
Overview

The Black Sun Global Advisory team is looking for candidates with strong financial and corporate communications skills, combined with sustainability advisory experience, to join us in advising our exceptionally strong client base of FTSE 100 and 250 companies on their corporate and sustainability reporting requirements.

The Black Sun Advisory team works closely with regulators, industry bodies and our clients to ensure we are able to provide the highest standards of advice and support on all aspects of corporate and sustainability reporting. Primarily focusing upon Annual Reports, we help companies navigate the regulatory landscape from ISSB, CSRD and Net Zero Transition Plans to preparing for the UK SRS, aligning to the UK Corporate Governance Code and applying both established emerging best practice reporting.

The successful candidate will be a key member of our Advisory team and will work closely with all parts of the Black Sun Global business as well as colleagues across the Positive Change Group collection of stakeholder engagement businesses. They will help to win new business, developing strategic roadmaps for clients, delivering projects on-time and to a high quality and contributing to Black Sun Global’s award-winning thought leadership and best practice consultancy services.


Key responsibilities

Client work

  • Working with our clients to shape their corporate reporting suite in line with current and forthcoming disclosure requirements demonstrating an excellent understanding of the regulatory reporting landscape.
  • Providing best practice strategic advice on corporate reporting, sustinability and wider communication to clients and new business prospects, using your expertise and knowledge to help shape clients’ communications strategies.
  • Developing strategic communications presentations and interim assessments of Annual Reports and Sustainability Reports supported by peer analysis; benchmarking; content audits and guidelines; and ad hoc consultancy work, including taking an active role in presentations to senior stakeholders at our clients.
  • Conducting deep dive research into the corporate communications of Black Sun Global clients to assess their current communications approach, content and overall effectiveness.
  • Leading client workshops, presentations and external events on best practice communication with a particular focus on topics such as strategy, ESG, climate, corporate governance and relevant regulation.
  • Helping devise and promote Black Sun’s wider communications offer to existing Black Sun clients as well as new business prospects and demonstrate the value of developing an impactful communications framework and plan, beyond simply disclosing or reporting data and information.

Team

  • Working closely with other members of the team to develop key processes, methodologies and best practice approaches.
  • Providing guidance, education, support and expertise to junior members of the Advisory team as well as other internal teams as required, ensuring the account teams are well equipped to drive discussions with clients.

Business development

  • Helping pitch for and win new business, with existing and new prospects as relevant.

Research and thought leadership

  • Helping develop and deliver Black Sun Global’s own research and benchmarking.
  • Contributing to the development of Black Sun Global’s impressive thought leadership and editorial productions.

Skills and experience

  • Experience in communication roles, preferably in corporate reporting, financial PR or investor relations.
  • Ideally, experience of working with listed companies, presenting and providing advice on best practice corporate reporting and communication.
  • Familiarity with the UK corporate reporting and regulatory environment for investor and sustainability communications, including Annual and Sustainability Reports.
  • Knowledge of relevant reporting frameworks (including TCFD, ISSB, CSRD, UKSRS, GRI and the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act)
  • A strong interest in business issues and company news in particular..
  • Rounded individual that demonstrates these qualities:
  • Take ownership of work;
  • Work as part of a team;
  • Show attention to detail;
  • Confident and professional presentation and written communication skills;
  • A proactive approach;
  • Eager to learn and improve.

Interview process

Phone chat with talent acquisition manager
1st Interview with hiring director
2nd interview with hiring director and at least one other senior colleague


About Us:

Black Sun Global

Black Sun Global is a stakeholder advisory and engagement agency that's been driving transformation and positive change for ambitious brands for more than 20 years. With deep expertise in disclosure and reporting, ESG, sustainability, and digital engagement, we reshape how organisations connect with customers, investors, employees, and the wider world.

We are trusted partners to some of the most influential global organisations, sparking innovation and sustainable performance through our strategic insights, partnerships, and proprietary technologies.

As founders of the Positive Change Group, we are on a mission to create a new kind of stakeholder relations partner. Our world-class specialists work closely with executive leadership teams to protect reputations, inspire trust, and promote responsible business practices - building resilience and long-term value in a rapidly changing world.


The Positive Change Group

Positive Change Group is a global stakeholder engagement business. Our specialist agencies work as one, bringing together reporting, culture, communications and sustainability through a connected model that helps organisations close the gap between what they say and what people see, so they can present a clear and consistent story across every stakeholder group.

When that alignment is in place, organisations move faster, make better decisions and build confidence in their direction.

Headquartered in London, with an international network across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and South Africa, Positive Change Group supports over 100 multinational organisations at C-suite and board level.


Join the people driving positive change

At Positive Change Group, we bring together bold thinkers, challengers and collaborators from across disciplines, sectors and geographies - connected by a shared mission and a drive to make a real difference. We're guided by The Changemaker Way: five shared values that define how we work, lead and grow - with each other, our clients and the communities we serve.

Location: Hong Kong
Type: Full Time
Reports to: Sr. Director, Design

The Role

We are looking for a skilled VFX Artist to join our team and help create immersive, dynamic, and deeply satisfying gameplay experiences. In this role, you'll bridge the gap between art and engineering, bringing stunning visual effects, polish, and tactile gameplay feedback to life in Unity.

You'll work closely with the art director, designers, artists, and engineers to develop and implement real-time effects, visual feedback systems, and environmental interactions that heighten player immersion and reinforce the impact of gameplay actions. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of Unity's rendering and shader systems with a keen artistic eye for timing, motion, and visual feedback to make every moment feel alive and rewarding.

What You'll Do

  • Implement real-time visual effects (e.g., impact feedback, slashes, dashes, explosions or magic) using Unity's VFX Graph, Particle System, and Shader Graph (or custom shaders).
  • Collaborate with designers to amplify game feel, ensuring player actions are satisfying, readable and responsive.
  • Optimize visual effects for performance while maintaining high artistic quality.
  • Develop tools, scripts, and shaders to streamline asset integration and improve artist workflows.
  • Work with environment artists and designers to enhance environmental storytelling through lighting, VFX, and dynamic world elements.
  • Collaborate with character artists and designers to enrich character visuals using shaders, special effects, and dynamic components.
  • Troubleshoot rendering, lighting, and material issues and propose creative technical solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Technical Artist or VFX Artist in Unity-based game production.
  • Solid understanding of real-time rendering, materials and shader creation.
  • Strong grasp of timing, motion, and visual rhythm to enhance moment-to-moment player feedback.
  • Experience with performance optimization techniques (profiling, LOD, draw call reduction, shader optimization, etc.)
  • Proficiency with C# scripting to implement and control visual systems.
  • A collaborative mindset, comfortable bridging the gap between the art and development teams.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and artistic audiences.
  • Passion for creating high quality and deeply satisfying experiences that touches players.
  • Curiosity and drive for continuous learning and growth.

Pluses

  • Extensive knowledge of game performance optimization and provide guidance on art assets best practices. +++
  • Be able to plan and maintain rendering budget with artists for individual project's requirement. ++
  • Ability to design and concept VFX art. ++++
  • Expertise with Unity’s render pipelines and the ability to customize them for specific hardware and project needs. ++
  • Knowledge and experience in UI animations and UI VFX. ++
  • Knowledge and experience in 3D animations pipeline, e.g. rigging, animating. ++

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a diverse group of highly skilled individuals, all driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about technology, innovation, and the possibilities that space offers, join us in our mission to push the boundaries of what's possible.

The D-Orbit Group, which includes Planetek Group, brings together complementary expertise in space logistics, Earth observation, geospatial solutions, and advanced space services.

Hiring Process

Here's how our hiring process works:

  1. Application Review – We carefully review your profile and assess potential alignment with current or future opportunities.

  2. Introduction Call – If there is a potential match, a member of our People & Culture team will contact you to get to know you better and discuss possible opportunities.

  3. Interviews – Depending on the opportunity, you may be invited to one or more interviews with hiring managers and team members.

  4. Offer – If there is a strong mutual fit, we will share an offer and discuss the next steps.

The exact process may vary depending on the opportunity.

We genuinely appreciate every application, even when there is not an immediate match. We're excited to get to know you and explore whether D-Orbit could be part of your future journey.

NON-EU applicants:

At this time, we can only consider candidates who already have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based.

Please note that this role requires a regular on-site presence and is not a fully remote position.

Some activities must be carried out in our facilities, many others are location-independent, and they can be performed effectively even remotely. This is why we don't measure the performance of people by how many hours they spend at the office: we only measure the outcome.


At D-Orbit, diversity and inclusivity are not just values, they are integral to our mission and the way we operate. We are committed to fostering an environment where all individuals are respected, valued, and celebrated for their unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is not only the right thing to do, but it also leads to better decision making, innovation, and overall success. We actively strive to build a culture where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work, and where all voices are heard and valued. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, supported, and empowered to share their ideas, and where everyone is given equal opportunities to grow and excel. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we will continue to work diligently to create an inclusive culture at D-Orbit that reflects this belief.

title: Draughtsperson
description:

  • Assist in projects from inception to completion, including reviewing tender costings, prepare construction drawings using AutoCad, prepare material take-offs, and updating Bill of Quantities (BOQs) to reflect design changes.

Commitment to understanding and meeting customer needs.

Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple project drawings simultaneously.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
The Solution Architecture team supports a wide range of projects across Evoke’s global online gaming business, including casino, poker and sports betting products. The team works closely with Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, delivery teams, and functional and technical specialists to translate business needs into effective, scalable and secure solutions.

The Solution Architect is the end-to-end owner of the overall solution, accountable for defining its scope, relevant business domains and technical architecture. The role translates business strategies and requirements into clear designs and implementation plans, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose and aligned with applicable architectural patterns.

What you'll be doing:

  • Defining and documenting solution and system architecture.
  • Producing detailed architecture designs and system interaction diagrams.
  • Identifying and incorporating non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, privacy and security.
  • Working with Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, project teams, and functional and technical analysts.
  • Leading technical working sessions and resolving architectural questions.
  • Presenting proposed solutions and building stakeholder alignment and consensus.
  • Maintaining ownership of the solution’s quality and suitability throughout the project.

Requirements

Who we're looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
  • At least three years of experience working as a Solution Architect.
  • At least three years of experience designing or developing scalable, enterprise-grade software solutions.
  • Experience designing high-scale, real-time systems.
  • Strong knowledge of solution architecture, system design, integrations and system interactions.
  • Ability to translate business strategies and requirements into practical technical designs and plans.
  • Understanding of non-functional requirements, particularly performance, scalability, privacy and security.
  • Demonstrated ability to create innovative and effective solutions.
  • Strong presentation and stakeholder-engagement skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical subjects clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional teams.
  • High proficiency in English and experience working in a global environment.

Behaviour we look for in this role:

  • Takes end-to-end ownership and remains accountable for the quality and suitability of the solution.
  • Seeks to understand business objectives and stakeholder needs before defining the technical approach.
  • Applies sound judgement when balancing business value, technical feasibility, risk and long-term maintainability.
  • Approaches complex challenges with curiosity, creativity and a practical problem-solving mindset.
  • Adapts effectively to different projects, business domains and changing r equirements.
  • Collaborates openly, listens to different perspectives and builds consensus across teams.
  • Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to varied audiences.
  • Maintains high standards for performance, scalability, privacy and security.
  • Works effectively with minimal supervision while contributing positively to the wider team.
  • Shares knowledge, welcomes feedback and continuously develops technical and business expertise


What we offer:

  • ﻿A senior-level opportunity to shape infrastructure, automation, and reliability strategy.
  • A high-impact role in a team that values ownership, hands-on engineering, and continuous improvement.
  • The opportunity to work with modern DevOps technologies across cloud and on-prem environments.
  • The chance to help define how AI is applied in real-world DevOps and SRE work.
  • A collaborative environment where you can influence technical direction and mentor others.


Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an environment where our people can thrive. Check out some of the fantastic benefits on offer:

  • Holiday entitlement: You’ll be entitled to 22 annual leave days, plus bank holidays and an extra day for your birthday.

  • Health & wellbeing: Tools and services to help support your well-being, including support with mental health and financial education. You will also have access to gym discounts.
  • Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • ...and more


More about evoke

We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888, and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction, and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke.

At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you.

Apply

At evoke, we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth.

title: VP, Consultant Relations
description:
Sword Health is shifting healthcare from human-first to AI-first through its AI Care platform, making world-class healthcare available anytime, anywhere, while significantly reducing costs for payers, self-insured employers, national health systems, and other healthcare organizations. Sword began by reinventing pain care with AI at its core, and has since expanded into women’s health, movement health, and more recently mental health. Since 2020, more than 700,000 members across three continents have completed 10 million AI sessions, helping Sword's 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid over $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies and over 44 patents, Sword Health has raised more than $500 million from leading investors, including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, Transformation Capital, and Founders Fund. Learn more at .

The VP of Consultant Relations at Sword Health will spearhead the company’s global consultant and brokerage strategy, owning and scaling strategic partnerships with leading benefits consulting and advisory firms. This role is pivotal in expanding Sword’s market influence by positioning Sword as a trusted, category-defining, AI-first healthcare partner to consultants and their payer, employer, and health system clients. You will be responsible for crafting and executing strategies that leverage these partnerships to drive sustained growth, enterprise adoption, and long-term revenue impact.

This role reports to the Chief Enterprise Officer and is a core member of the Commercial Leadership Team. You will work cross-functionally with Enterprise and Payor Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, and Clinical teams. As the function scales, you will build, lead, and develop a high-performing Consultant Relations team focused on strategic influence, enablement, and pipeline acceleration.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the strategy and execution of Sword’s global consultant relations and alliance initiatives, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives.
  • Build, hire, and develop a top-tier Consultant Relations team, with a strong emphasis on talent development and performance.
  • Cultivate and maintain senior executive relationships with leading consulting and brokerage firms (e.g., Mercer, WTW, Aon, Lockton, Gallagher) to drive strategic collaboration and advocacy.
  • Own consultant-influenced pipeline and bookings targets, in partnership with Employer, Payor, and Enterprise Sales.
  • Develop consultant-specific engagement models, enablement programs, and go-to-market strategies that increase Sword’s footprint across the digital health ecosystem.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing to optimize consultant- and broker-influenced pipeline generation, co-selling, and joint marketing efforts.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to consultants by articulating Sword’s clinical outcomes, AI differentiation, and economic value.
  • Monitor and report on alliance performance, consultant influence on pipeline, and ROI, making data-driven adjustments as needed.
  • Act as the primary executive liaison for high-level issues, contract negotiations, and representation at key industry, consultant, and partner events.

What you need to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in consultant relations, including 5+ years in a leadership role at a major benefits consulting or brokerage firm; experience at WTW, Aon, or Mercer strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing alliance strategies that drive meaningful and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of the employer, payor, and digital health market, with the ability to influence complex, multi-stakeholder buying decisions.
  • Exceptional executive-level communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, data-driven environments.
  • Demonstrated history of exceeding alliance and partnership targets while balancing near-term impact with long-term strategic value.

To ensure you feel good solving a big Human problem, we offer:

  • A bright future at a promising high-tech startup company.

title: AWS Fraud Investigations - Site Leader, AWS Fraud Investigations Team
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) has the most services and more features within those services, than any other cloud provider – from infrastructure technologies like compute, storage, and databases – to emerging technologies, such as machine learning and artificial intelligence, data lakes and analytics, and Internet of Things. AWS Platform is the glue that holds the AWS ecosystem together. Whether t's Identity features such as access management and sign on, cryptography, console, builder & developer tools, and even projects like automating all of our contractual billing systems, AWS Platform is always innovating with the customer in mind. The AWS Platform team sustains over 750 million transactions per second.

This role sits within the Payments and Fraud Prevention (P&FP) organization, whose vision is to make AWS the easiest and most trusted cloud to adopt and pay for, anywhere in the world. We deliver this through a reinforcing cycle: expanding customer access to drive adoption and revenue, empowering our internal teams, reinvesting in AI and automation for smarter fraud detection, and protecting the business in a way that enhances customer trust. This role is central to the "protect the business" pillar — keeping AWS safe to transact on while minimizing friction for legitimate customers.

Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud. They are harnessing the power of AWS to enable innovative applications, websites, and businesses. However, there are always a few people that try to take unfair advantage of a good thing.

Are you interested in taking your skills and career to the next level, while having fun and fighting fraud in the cloud? Join a growing world-class team that conducts investigations in order to prevent malicious and fraudulent usage on AWS.

You will lead a team of investigators, analysts, and specialists conducting complex investigations of fraud activity, while setting the strategic direction for how your team detects and prevents emerging fraud threats to AWS. You will drive related intelligence initiatives, shape investigative strategy, and stay at the forefront of trends and fraud issues impacting the cloud industry to ensure AWS is leading the curve in identifying, mitigating, and preventing fraud attacks.

As a Manager - Risk Investigations, you will manage a team of Investigation Specialists (and their leads), setting the vision, direction, and culture of the team by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing coaching and one-on-ones focused on making our platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as an escalation point. Beyond running your own team, you will define long-term operational direction in areas of ambiguity, and influence and partner cross-functionally with AWS Payment and Fraud Prevention (P&FP) leaders, engineering, science, and Investigation Managers around the globe to ensure global operations run effectively and efficiently.

This position is full-time and may require shift work, including the possibility of working weekends.


Key job responsibilities
- Set the strategic direction and long-term vision for your investigations team, driving initiatives in areas where the path forward is ambiguous.
- Analyze, meet, and report on goals aligned to customer experience improvement, fraud operating-expense reduction, and service levels.
- Review and analyze performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity that drive performance improvement.
- Deliver business impact and contributions to AWS through quality, productivity, and customer-experience improvements.
- Demonstrate excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently in situations with a high level of ambiguity.
- Develop the careers and skills of investigators by hiring the best, providing effective coaching, identifying growth opportunities, and implementing supplemental training.

title: Health Counselor
location: Manhattan - Headquarters, NEW YORK, NY, US
description:
The Community Service Society (CSS) is an independent, not-for-profit organization that has been at the forefront of public policy innovations that support low-income New Yorkers for more than 170 years. CSS’s Health Initiatives Department runs several statewide programs that help New Yorkers find and use their health insurance or otherwise access health care. In October 2018, CSS launched New York State’s first ombudsman program targeting the needs of people with mental illness and/or substance use disorder, Community Health Access to Addiction and Mental Healthcare Project (CHAMP). CHAMP operates statewide through a toll-free live-answer helpline and in partnership with eight community-based organizations and three specialist organizations. The goal of CHAMP is to help people with substance use and mental health care needs navigate and secure benefits through their insurance plans.


The CHAMP Helpline fields calls from people who need help getting and using health insurance coverage for substance use disorder and mental health care, serving not only those in need of care but also their family members, care providers, and other advocates. CSS seeks to hire a Health Counselor who will provide high-quality consumer assistance through the CHAMP Helpline to clients with mental health conditions or substance use disorder, their family members, and health care providers, helping them navigate the difficulties they may face in accessing care.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Respond to live calls from consumers, family members and providers on the CHAMP Helpline, including during extended Helpline hours (until 7pm) approximately once per week.
  • Assist with filing grievances, complaints, appeals, and provide hearing and/or appeal assistance to consumers contesting denials of health insurance coverage.
  • Assist consumers with filing grievances, complaints, appeals contesting denials of health insurance coverage.
  • Assist with document collection and evaluation for prior authorization requests, peer-to-peer reviews, and appeals.
  • Provide information, education, advice, and navigational services to consumers on how to successfully use health insurance and/or access care.
  • Maintain thorough case records of services provided, advice, appeals, and/or referrals.
  • Help identify systemic trends or practices that adversely affect consumers and work closely with senior CSS staff and other appropriate stakeholders.


Job Requirements:

  • Graduate degree in social work, health policy, public health, biology, or other relevant discipline preferred.
  • A minimum of one year's experience providing assistance to consumers and/or advocates on health insurance or health care access issues preferred; experience working with people with substance use disorders and/or mental health conditions strongly preferred.
  • Outstanding research, writing, and oral advocacy skills required, including excellent reading comprehension, organized thought, and the ability to speak, type, and write clearly, concisely, and persuasively; keeping detailed notes of all communications required.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail required.
  • Excellent oral communication skills, including a genuine enjoyment of talking with people on the phone and the ability to project patience, competence, and care for others' concerns through both oral and written communication.
  • Customer service and written advocacy experience preferred.
  • Mission driven.
  • Written and spoken fluency in Spanish preferred.
  • Competency with Office Suite and Salesforce, along with research and data-based management skills, preferred.


Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $46.92.


Additional details: This is a temporary position requiring valid work authorization in the United States.


Physical Requirements: Office work that requires sitting, use of a computer, answering phone calls, participating in virtual meetings, and other standard office functions.


CSS currently offers a hybrid work environment requiring onsite work at CSS’ office at least two days per week and three days per week remote work. CSS will provide all equipment necessary to perform the job from home, but the employee must have their own wired internet connection.

***Interested applicants should provide a cover letter and resume at the time of application submission***

CSS is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

CSS complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing employment, recruitment, and hiring.

title: Team Leader, SRE
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

Remote's SRE team exists so that our engineers can move quickly and our customers get a product that stays up. The team owns Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL, CI infrastructure, our observability stack and the reliability practices that sits on top of all of it.

We are looking for a Team Leader to run that team. This is a 60% IC, 40% leadership role. You will own the career development of your reports, steer the teams focus using judgment against the company goals, and you will be the spokesperson for the team across engineering. You will also stay close enough to the technical work to set direction with credibility and to know when something is going wrong before it is escalated to you.

Reliability practice at Remote is maturing rather than mature. Our SLO framework is live on its first few teams and needs to reach the rest, there is real work to do on how we balance operational load against project delivery. If you want a team where the foundations are in place and the interesting problems are still open, this is that team.

What you bring

People leadership

  • You have led an SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering team, and you have owned your reports' growth, performance and career progression rather than just their sprints.
  • You coach both craft and the soft skills, you can point to people who grew because of it.
  • You handle underperformance directly and early, with clarity and empathy.
  • You have hired engineers, and you can tell the difference between a good interview and a good engineer.
  • You read team dynamics well and you resolve conflict rather than routing around it.
  • You have a natural talent fostering commitment to the goals of the company.

Technical depth

  • A hands-on background in site reliability, DevOps or cloud infrastructure engineering, deep enough that you can review your team's work, challenge a design and be taken seriously in an incident.
  • Kubernetes in production, including the operational reality of it rather than the happy path.
  • AWS at meaningful scale.
  • Hands on AI building, enablement, scaling AI infrastructure.
  • Solid o11y practices and principles,
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • CI/CD systems such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Docker and shell scripting.
  • You have run a reliability practice: incident response, on-call, SLOs and error budgets, and the discipline of turning incidents into changes that stick.
  • Understanding and history of working in regulated environments.

Ways of working

title: General Foreperson - Utility Veg. Management (Glendale, OR)
description:
ABOUT ARBORWORKS, LLC

ArborWorks LLC is a nationwide leader in professional vegetation management, specializing in utility line clearance, fire remediation, and large-scale environmental projects. Established in 2003, we have built a reputation for quality and safety by leveraging advanced mechanized equipment and a skilled team of dedicated professionals. Guided by a commitment to innovation, safety, and superior customer service, ArborWorks prides itself on an exceptional safety culture, recognized through industry-leading third-party ratings.


Whether you’re looking to grow your career or contribute your expertise, ArborWorks offers a dynamic environment where team members are valued, and professional growth is a priority. We are passionate about creating safe communities and delivering excellence in every project.


JOB OVERVIEW: GENERAL FOREPERSON – UTILITY VEGETATION MANAGEMENT

The General Foreperson is a senior field leadership role responsible for directing and overseeing multiple utility vegetation management crews to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution of contract work. This position exists to translate operational plans and utility requirements into consistent field performance while reinforcing ArborWorks’ safety culture, quality standards, and productivity expectations.


Acting as the primary operational liaison between field crews, utility customers, and internal support teams, the General Foreperson drives contract compliance, production performance, workforce readiness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong leadership, sound decision‑making, and the ability to balance safety, quality, and production in dynamic field environments.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Crew Management:

  • Provide direct supervision, leadership, and accountability for multiple Forepersons and their assigned crews.
  • Set clear expectations related to safety, quality, productivity, and conduct; hold Forepersons accountable for performance.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop Forepersons and crew members to support skill development and succession planning.
  • Recognize strong performance and address performance or behavioral issues in accordance with company policy.
  • Promote a consistent, professional field leadership presence aligned with ArborWorks values.


Operations & Work Execution:

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee daily vegetation management operations to ensure efficient use of labor, equipment, and time.
  • Conduct pre‑job planning, work scheduling, and task delegation to meet production and contract goals.
  • Monitor job progress, adjust resources as needed, and ensure timely completion of assigned work.
  • Perform post‑work inspections to verify work completion, quality, and adherence to specifications.
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of all required production, timekeeping, and job documentation.


Safety & Regulatory Compliance:

  • Lead and reinforce ArborWorks’ safety culture across all assigned crews.
  • Conduct and oversee safety tailboards, job briefings, and field safety observations.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable OSHA, ANSI Z133, utility, and company safety standards.
  • Verify crews properly maintain and use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Support and participate in incident, near‑miss, and property damage investigations.
  • Ensure corrective actions are implemented and communicated to prevent recurrence.


Contract, Scope & Quality Management:

  • Ensure all work is performed in accordance with utility contracts, specifications, vegetation prescriptions, and work methods.
  • Monitor scope compliance, including clearance requirements, trim standards, and completion criteria.
  • Support utility audits, inspections, and corrective actions as required.
  • Identify quality issues and coach Forepersons on corrective techniques.
  • Reduce rework, customer complaints, and inspection failures through proactive field oversight.


Production, Metrics & Reporting:

  • Monitor daily and weekly production metrics for assigned crews.
  • Identify productivity trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Implement corrective actions to support contract timelines and operational goals.
  • Ensure accurate reporting of production, labor hours, and job status to support billing and performance tracking.


Equipment, Vehicles & Asset Management:

  • Ensure proper inspection, care, and safe operation of vehicles, tools, and mechanized equipment.
  • Coordinate equipment maintenance, repairs, and replacements with Operations.
  • Enforce company policies related to vehicle use, equipment accountability, and safe operation.


Workforce Planning & Development:

  • Support workforce planning by identifying staffing needs, training gaps, and readiness concerns.
  • Assist with onboarding, field training, and performance development of new Forepersons and crew members.
  • Provide input and recommendations regarding promotions, reassignments, and additional training based on field performance.


Customer & Internal Coordination:

  • Serve as a primary field contact for utility customers, inspectors, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate professionally to address customer inquiries, concerns, or escalations.
  • Partner with internal departments (Operations, Safety, HR, Payroll, Billing) to support workforce needs, compliance, and operational efficiency.


Emergency Response & Storm Support:

  • Support emergency response, storm restoration, fire mitigation, and other high‑priority operations as required.
  • Coordinate crews, equipment, and communication during emergency events.
  • Ensure safety, compliance, and operational control during extended or emergency work schedules.



REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Foreperson or equivalent leadership role in utility vegetation management or related field operations.
  • Minimum of 12 months of hands-on experience in utility line clearance, vegetation management, or arboricultural operations.

Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong leadership and team management skills in a field‑based environment.
  • Solid understanding of utility vegetation management operations and safety requirements.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Ability to make sound decisions in dynamic and sometimes high‑risk field conditions.
  • Proficiency using technology for reporting, documentation, and communication.

Licenses / Certifications:

  • Valid Class C Driver’s License with the ability to meet company driving requirements.
  • CPR and First Aid Certification (required within 90 days of hire).

Required Training:

  • Groundperson Training
  • Climber Training
  • Annual Aerial Rescue Training
  • Tree Feller Training
  • Bucket Operator Training

Successful Completion of the Following Assessments:

  • Line Clearance Certified Professional (LCCP) Test
  • Line Clearance Qualified Professional (LCQP) Book
  • Foreperson Test (minimum score of 70%)
  • General Foreperson Test (minimum score of 70%)



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience managing multiple crews across multiple job sites or contracts.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance safety, quality, and productivity in utility operations.
  • Prior experience working directly with utility clients or inspectors.
  • Strong administrative and reporting skills related to compliance and performance tracking.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Primarily field‑based with daily presence at active job sites.

  • Regular exposure to outdoor environments, varying weather conditions, uneven terrain, and roadside or right‑of‑way work zones.

  • Frequent interaction with mechanized equipment, vehicles, and energized power line environments.

  • Physical demands include standing and walking for extended periods, climbing in and out of vehicles, and occasional lifting of equipment or materials.

  • Work schedule may include early mornings, extended hours, weekends, and emergency response as operational needs require.

  • Travel within assigned service areas is required.

We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

AI-Augmented Developer (Full Stack)

  • Dbanie o jakość kodu: Samodzielne pisanie testów (jednostkowych/integracyjnych) oraz tworzenie i aktualizowanie dokumentacji technicznej.

Nasze Wymagania

  • Doświadczenie Full-stack: Praktyczna, poparta projektami znajomość wybranego ekosystemu backendowego (Python, Node.js, PHP) oraz frameworka frontendowego (np. React, Vue) lub czystego, wydajnego JS.

  • Myślenie produktowe: Rozumienie konsekwencji architektonicznych (wydajność, bezpieczeństwo, paginacja danych) przy systemach dostępnych publicznie lub komercyjnie.
