title: Senior Staff, Platform Engineer, DevOps
description:
About Us

MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. The Company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines. MoneyHero had over 280 commercial partner relationships as at June 30, 2026, and had approximately 3.7 million Monthly Unique Users across its platform for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

The Senior Staff, Platform Engineer, DevOps will be responsible for:

  • Platform Architecture & Technical Direction: Own the architecture and roadmap of our cloud platform. Drive key infrastructure decisions, set engineering standards, and mentor engineers across teams.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Management: Design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPCs), with high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery built in. AWS is our primary cloud, with exposure to GCP and Azure.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate provisioning and management of cloud resources, ensuring consistency and repeatability across environments.
  • Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Manage and scale Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, overseeing deployment, scaling, and operation of containerized workloads across multiple environments.
  • GitOps & Continuous Delivery: Use ArgoCD to manage GitOps workflows and fully automated deployments to Kubernetes clusters.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, deployment, and monitoring of applications.
  • Networking: Own core networking, including VPC design, routing and peering, DNS, load balancing, and network security controls.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar) to track infrastructure health and surface issues before they impact the business.
  • AI Infrastructure: Provision and operate the infrastructure behind our AI-powered products, including managed AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock), secure API key and secrets management, and usage and cost monitoring, with the access controls and audit logging needed to meet AI governance expectations in our markets.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement cloud security best practices, manage IAM roles and policies, safeguard sensitive data through encryption and access controls, and support compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Collaboration & Optimization: Work closely with development and operations teams to continuously improve infrastructure processes, performance, and automation, including cost optimization as business demands evolve.
  • Troubleshooting & Support: Provide expert-level support for infrastructure and cloud issues and lead incident response for platform-level problems, ensuring fast resolution and minimal downtime.

In this role, we are looking for someone with :

  • 12-15 years of DevOps/Platform engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on Kubernetes design, build, and operation.
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC) and cloud infrastructure management (required).
  • Experience with ArgoCD and GitOps workflows and other Kubernetes-native CD tools a plus.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Solid experience managing Kubernetes clusters (EKS and/or self-managed) and deploying containerized applications at scale, with strong Docker expertise.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: VPC design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and network security controls.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and deployment pipeline automation.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or CloudWatch.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, including IAM and network security.
  • Exposure to running AI/LLM workloads in production (managed AI services such as AWS Bedrock, API and secret management, cost monitoring), strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Azure and GCP a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to quickly resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • High degree of autonomy, comfortable owning initiatives end-to-end from design through operation.
  • Strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

title: Algorithms Engineer – Data Fusion & Mapping
description:
Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

Our customers are the utilities, transportation agencies, and government bodies that build the world's infrastructure — LA Metro, Caltrans, National Grid, Israel Railways, and 100+ teams worldwide. To date we've de-risked $75B in infrastructure investment and mapped 86.1M square feet of ground.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

Our Algorithms Team is a highly multidisciplinary group spanning physics, signal processing, computer vision, classical machine learning, and modern AI models, built around problems that don't have off-the-shelf solutions.

As an Algorithm Engineer on Exodigo's Algorithms Team, you'll build the algorithms that turn raw subsurface signals into an accurate map — automating and outperforming work that today only geophysicists and civil engineering experts can do. You'll work across the full span of our data: multi-sensor field acquisitions, and the existing record of what's already known underground. The hard part is the fusion — reconciling physics-driven detections with incomplete and contradictory records into a single coherent picture of the subsurface. You'll work directly with our mapping and engineering experts to validate what you build, and with our software team to get it into the production pipeline.

Responsibilities

  • Translate real-world physical and engineering problems into mathematical models and algorithmic solutions.
  • Design algorithms that fuse heterogeneous sources — sensor modalities with different physics and resolution, alongside vector, raster, tabular, and unstructured data.
  • Extract structure from noisy signal: detection, segmentation, and interpretation where ground truth is scarce and the physics is only partly cooperative.
  • Build evaluation methodology alongside the algorithms, so downstream engineers know what to trust and how much.
  • Partner with the maps analysis team to test, benchmark, and iterate on performance.

Requirements

  • B.Sc. in technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or similar.
  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Solid grounding in machine learning, with judgment about when a classical method beats a deep model.
  • Expertise in graph theory, computational geometry, statistics, optimization, and data analysis.
  • Strong Python programming skills (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, etc.).
  • Versatility in selecting and combining tools to fit the problem at hand.

Nice to Have

  • M.Sc. in relevant field.
  • Experience in Geo Information Systems (GIS).
  • Experience working with BIM data and 3D modelling.
  • Experience applying LLMs to information extraction from unstructured or scanned documents.
  • Experience in cloud environment development (AWS).

SUMMARY: Performs heavy manual labor and operates any required mechanical equipment used by Field Services Teams. Prepare for daily assignments by loading assigned truck with all necessary materials, supplies, and equipment as per supervisor(s) introductions.

From time to time, this employee may be called upon to perform other duties as deemed necessary by his supervisor.

Confined Spaces Entry, Entry of manholes and other tight spaces.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Experience in the construction and maintenance of a Water Distribution and Wastewater Collection System. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must be able to obtain Fort Benning Access required.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

High school graduate or GED is the minimum education requirement for position. Possession of a valid Drivers License and a good driving record is required. Ability to perform heavy manual labor required. Ability to receive certification in Confined Space Entry, Trench Excavation, Flagging, CPR and First Aid Standard within one year of employment required. A Commercial Driver's License within six months of employment is preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, drawings and operating instructions.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide and measure.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram form. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representatives of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or equipment; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear, and smell. The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb and balance.

The employee frequently lifts and moves objects of 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those the employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Employee will be regularly exposed to moderate or high noise levels, extreme outside weather conditions, uneven, steep, slippery terrain conditions, dusty conditions, and wet and/or humid conditions.

• The employee will be exposed to moving mechanical parts and heavy equipment operation.

• Employees will be subject to roadway hazards, i.e., traffic.

• Employee will be subject to outside hazards, i.e., poison ivy, bees, spiders, dirt, and animals.

• Employee will be subject to confined areas, i.e., confined spaces, sewer manholes, water vaults, wastewater pits, and/or protected trenches, fumes, gases, and airborne particles.

title: Ondersteunend begeleider, Maria van Oranjestraat 1-3 Leerdam
description:
Werken bij ASVZ – Ondersteunend Begeleider

ASVZ biedt zorg aan mensen met een verstandelijke beperking, gericht op een zo gewoon mogelijk leven. We werken volgens het Triple-C behandelmethode, waarbij we kijken naar wat iemand wél kan.

Als ondersteunend begeleider help je cliënten bij hun dagelijks leven. Ervaring in de zorg is niet nodig of je nu net van school komt of uit een andere sector, bij ASVZ leer je het vak in de praktijk. Wat telt is je betrokkenheid en bereidheid om écht iets te betekenen.

Werkplek

De woning Maria van Oranjestraat 1–3 in Leerdam is een warme groepswoning van ASVZ, gelegen op locatie Lingebolder. Hier wonen 11 mensen met een verstandelijke beperking die behoefte hebben aan ondersteuning in het dagelijks leven. De woning ligt in een rustige woonwijk, waardoor bewoners zoveel mogelijk onderdeel zijn van het gewone leven in de buurt.

In de woning wordt begeleiding geboden, gericht op wonen, persoonlijke verzorging, structuur en het versterken van zelfstandigheid. Overdag gaan veel bewoners naar dagbesteding of werk, waarna zij ’s middags en ’s avonds terugkomen op de woning voor ontspanning, gezamenlijke maaltijden en individuele begeleiding.

Wij werken vanuit de visie van ASVZ: kijken naar mogelijkheden in plaats van beperkingen. Samen met bewoners en collega’s draag je bij aan een veilig, voorspelbaar en prettig leefklimaat, waarin bewoners ruimte krijgen voor eigen regie en ontwikkeling. Op de Maria van Oranjestraat werk je in een betrokken team, waar samenwerking, vertrouwen en mensgerichte zorg centraal staan.

Wat ga je doen?
Als ondersteunend begeleider help je bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking in hun dagelijks leven. Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht en werkt volgens het Samen 100%- principe. Je leert begeleiden op maat, denkt mee in team overleggen en krijgt goede begeleiding als zij-instromer.

Wie zoeken we?
Iemand met geduld, doorzettingsvermogen en een warm hart voor de zorg. Je bent flexibel inzetbaar (ook avonden/weekenden) en hebt een vmbo/mavo/lbo/havo/vwo- diploma. Je kunt omgaan met gedragsproblematiek en en staat achter de visie van ASVZ.

Een betekenisvolle baan in een betrokken team, met oog voor jouw groei én die van de cliënt. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast

  • Een parttime baan van 16 tot 28 uur in de week

  • Salaris € 2.373,00 tot € 3.385,00 (FWG 30, o.b.v. 36 uur) Vakantiegeld, eindejaarsuitkering & ORT

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden en trainingen (o.a. Triple-C) Vitaliteitsprogramma met o.a. yoga en padel

Enthousiast? Solliciteer direct! Vul het online sollicitatieformulier in en ontdek of ASVZ bij jou past. Je start met een kort assessment en gaat daarna in gesprek over jouw wensen en mogelijkheden. Vragen? Bel gerust met Linda Mulder via 06-23807419

title: Assembler-General
description:
About Lake Air Products

Lake Air Products is a fast-growing contract manufacturer serving medical, aerospace & defense, industrial markets and more. We are committed to quality, performance, and building strong teams while proudly living by our Core Values: Customer Focus, Passion for Performance, and Right People – Best Teams.

Position Summary


Located in Little Chute, WI. The General Assembler is responsible for assembling parts and subassemblies by following blueprints, work instructions, and production specifications to support quality and delivery goals. This role prepares materials, inspects components for quality, troubleshoots basic assembly issues, and assists with packaging and labeling products in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The position requires attention to detail, teamwork, and the ability to maintain safety, quality, and productivity standards while supporting daily production operations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities


  • Prepares work to be accomplished by studying assembly instructions, blueprint specifications, and parts lists, gathering parts, subassemblies, tools, and materials.
  • Organizes parts and subassemblies for an efficient assembly process.
  • Verifies specifications by measuring completed components/products.
  • Resolves assembly problems by altering dimensions to meet specifications; notifying the supervisor to obtain additional resources.
  • Maintains supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 1+ years of varied manufacturing experience in Mechanical Assembly
  • Bend and lift, loading and unloading workpieces on to pallets, and move from one workstation to another, alternately sitting and standing
  • Lift objects up to 50 pounds throughout the day.
  • Perform repetitive work more than 9 hours per day
  • Ability to quickly learn new blueprints and perform all necessary measurements
  • Hand/power tool skills (Drill, Adjustable Wrenches, Pliers, Hammers, screwdrivers, etc.)
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). Safety glasses, hearing protection, and steel-toe shoes


Lake Air Products Offers:

  • Competitive Pay
  • Full Benefits
  • 401(k) Employer Match
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holiday Pay
  • Gym Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement

Unless an exemption applies, candidate(s) must be a U.S. Person* within the meaning of the law or obtain an export control license. Candidates who do not meet the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements or choose not to pursue such positions are not disqualified from applying for other opportunities with Lake Air Products. Nothing in this posting should be interpreted as limiting applications based on nationality or citizenship status.

*A U.S. Person under export control laws includes a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or protected individual who has been lawfully admitted for temporary residence in the U.S. as a refugee or asylee under U.S. law.

title: Investment Banking Senior Associate
company: Agensi Pekerjaan Great Pyramid Sdn Bhd
description:
About the client:

Our client is a boutique mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and financing advisory firm that helps tech, marketing, and professional services companies buy, build, and sell their businesses across the Asia-Pacific region.

They are looking for an Investment Banking Senior Associate to join the team in Malaysia. You'll work directly with our co-founders and the team in Malaysia at every stage of the deal, from the first conversation with a founder about whether now is the right time to sell, through to negotiating the final terms with a buyer.

﻿﻿About the role:

  • ﻿﻿Run financial analysis, valuation, and modelling for sell-side mandates, including comparable company, and precedent transaction analysis.
  • Build marketing materials (e.g., teasers, information memorandums) and buyer-facing materials that do justice to a founder's business.
  • Research and map buyer universes across APAC and beyond, and lead early-stage outreach to strategic and financial acquirers.
  • Use AI tools to speed up buyer research, first drafts of materials, and the early passes on financial analysis, so more of your time goes into judgment calls and client conversations rather than manual grunt work.
  • Manage the due diligence process end to end, coordinating between founders, buyers, lawyers, accountants, and other advisors.
  • Sit in on management meetings and negotiations, and start owning parts of the buyer and founder relationship directly rather than working purely behind the scenes.
  • Keep deals moving, flagging issues early and bringing solutions rather than just problems.
  • Contribute to how we build the firm itself: our processes, our positioning, our point of view on the markets we cover.

Requirement:

  • Experience strategy consulting (MBB or strong tier-2), preferred with Big 4 corporate finance, investment banking, transaction services or corporate development experience.
  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills, genuine comfort with financial statements and valuation; you don't need hand-holding on a three-statement model.
  • Strong written communicator: your materials go in front of founders and acquirers unedited.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools (e.g. Claude, Claude Cowork) as part of your daily workflow, not just aware that they exist.
  • A track record of working directly with clients, not just producing analysis for someone more senior to present.
  • A degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
  • Based in Malaysia, with the flexibility to travel in the region as mandates require.

﻿﻿
